Summary: Unfortunately, this one didn't work for me...
Text:
I dislike writing bad reviews, I'm one of those people that believes that if you don't have something nice to say, you shouldn't say anything at all. BUT, I am a tea reviewer and above all, it is important for me to tell it like it is, and sometimes that requires me to say something is bad when it is.

And unfortunately, this Peach Matcha just doesn't hold up to the other Matcha teas that I've tried. I've tried quite a few of Red Leaf Tea's Matcha (as you can tell by looking at the number of reviews that I've posted), and there have only been two that I've not enjoyed - this one and the apricot.

Prepared traditionally using hot water and whisking, this is has a strong chemical taste that is really off-putting. However ... and this Matcha's one redeeming quality which is why I gave it two stars instead of one ... if you make it as a latte, it ends up tasting much better. The chemical taste is nearly gone (there are still traces of this taste, but it is very faint) and I can taste the peach and the matcha. These flavors are also muted a bit because of the milk, but, it makes a nice, tasty matcha latte that tastes of matcha and peach.

However, even though the latte was far better than the traditionally prepared Matcha ... I can't give it a higher rating because of that chemical taste. I do hope that Red Leaf Tea considers finding a better flavoring for the peach and the apricot. I had high hopes for them.

Millions of peaches...peaches for me! Millions of peaches....peaches for free! Yay! Flashback to the nineties, y'all. This time I've tried the Peach Matcha from Red Leaf Tea, and yum...it takes a bit of fiddling, but once you get it right, it is delicious. A welcome addition to any collection! And keep in mind that I'm still new to matcha and trying to figure it all out.

As any good Southern girl would, I have a deep love in my heart for peaches. Deep, deep love. That fruity sweetness...is there anything better? There are few things in this life better than a fresh, juicy peach. A close second is ice cold peach tea. Peach cobbler, peach pie...summer is a good time to be in the South!

I opened my package of this matcha and, my wife will back me up on this, my first words were "Whoa, momma!" It smells so good. Like juicy peach candy....nom. It smells painfully delicious.

The taste certainly follows up on that scent! It tastes like a big, juicy peach lollipop. It's not a fresh peach, but it's a peach candy. It reminds me of the peach soda I used to get in high school at the local Food Lion to take to our weekly slumber party with my best friend. So I'm grateful for those memories. Makes me want to pop a big bag of popcorn and dip it in nacho cheese. Oh yes, we were super healthy.

Anyway, this matcha has the same bitter kick as the lemon matcha, but a touch of sugar chased that away. I think that's just a matcha thing. It's definitely one I want to try again and see how it goes. Maybe cut it with a touch of the vanilla...peaches and cream! Yes please! This would be good in my smoothies this summer, maybe a peach raspberry smoothie dream...nom.

I made a second cup with different parameters (12 ounces of water instead of 8 to one half teaspoon of matcha, as well as a bit more sugar) and it is heavenly. Juicy enough to satisfy this Southern gal! Finishing off my sample of this will be no great hardship, I assure you. It tastes like a fuzzy navel without the alcoholic bite! Or those peach gummy candies...yum!

I let some of this chill and GAH. Cold, this is beyond amazing. This is what I needed, cold and fruity and peachy! It's not too sweet, it's not too bitter, it's just a beautifully refreshing cold drink for summer...I have a feeling this will be a staple in my cupboard this summer.

Summary: Great stuff!  A nice change from straight tea
Text:
I drink mainly black tea, but there are some green and herbal teas I also enjoy for variety. Bigelow Orange and Spice herbal tea is one of my favorites--a really zippy treat. Right from the start, when I do my deep sniff test of the teabag after opening the foil pouch (my favorite moment with tea!), Orange and Spice provides a pleasing combination of citrus and spice aromas. They are only slightly reduced once the tea is steeped in the cup, so when you're drinking you get the wonderful flavor in your mouth and nose at the same time. It also has a great aftertaste.

Orange and Spice is a true herbal tea, and does not contain any actual black or green tea. The ingredients listed on the foil pouch are: rose hips, spices, hibiscus, orange peel, roasted chicory, and natural orange flavors. I think the orange peel and spices are the strongest flavors.

I always drink tea straight--no sugar, no honey, no lemon, no milk! So my reviews are my opinions of the straight tea flavor, not how it interacts with another agent. I drink Bigelow tea almost exclusively, because it's readily available, modestly priced, and has lots of varieties that are all of decent quality. If I give a Bigelow flavor less stars, it reflects only my taste preference, and is not a statement of low product quality.

Text: I will only buy these type of gummi bears. Haribo Gummi Bears ROCK!  These are the most delicious, authentic-tasting candies I've ever tasted.  They have this true fruity taste and none of the artificial after-taste you can get with other gummi bears.

I can't open this bag. It is just too beautiful. Five glorious pounds of gummi. It sits on my kitchen table. The rainbow of colors twinkling in the sunlight. Every time I get close to picking this HUGE bag up, my heart starts racing.

These Gummis were made in Turkey and imported into Baltimore.

The bag is not resealable so ensure you have some tupperware or a resealable bag when you open it. A resealable bag is a must. Gummis that have been exposed to air will harden and lose flavor. To waste a single, solitary gummi would be a crime.

For those who track such things, the average gummi serving is 17 pieces. That serving will get you 140 calories. With FIVE pounds of gummis, you will be counting all night long.

It takes, on average, approximately 45 minutes for a gummi to melt away in your mouth -- that is, if you can keep it in your mouth that long. Most people, myself included, will immediately start chewing on the gummi to get at the tasty fruit flavors.

Speaking of flavors, let's talk about the goodness that goes into a gummi. There are many ingredients: Corn Syrup, Sugar, Gelatin, Dextrose, Citric Acid, Starch, Artificial and Natural Flavors, Fractionated Coconut Oil, Caarnauba Wax, Beeswax Coating, and Artificial Colors -- Yellow 4, Red 40, and Blue 1.

I'm not sure how they cram all those ingredients into a gummi less than an inch tall and a 1/4 wide...but they do...and it tastes amazing.

Even now, as I write this review, I'm enjoying a pair of gummis. My mouth is doing a dance as I type.

You won't be disappointed.

My understanding is that if you're going to introduce a new dog food into your dog's diet, you should do so gradually, so she'll get used to it (and so will her digestive track). After the cake came out - it release from the pan very easily - I brushed it with lemon curd and topped it with sliced strawberries. The cake was pretty good, I thought - not dry, with a tender crumb. I thought there was a slight hint of grainy texture, but the lemon curd went a long way towards softening the cake. I will say that it's a little bland - it didn't much taste of vanilla to me - and so I think that if I made this again, I would add even more flavoring - an almond extract might be nice, or rum (or just a lot of vanilla - think 2tsp). This wouldn't be my go-to cake (I would always prefer one made from scratch), but this is pretty good, and doesn't taste at all of chemicals like regular non-gluten free cake mixes do.

Summary: great as the base for berry shortcake!
Text: I would agree with most reveiwers that this is not the mix I'd use for delicious cupcakes or cake, but it did have a great flavor... a bit like the sweet cornbread others have mentioned... but not dry like cornbread can tend to be. I decided to follow another reveiwer's recommendation and use it for berry shortcake and it was incredible.  I baked it in two round cake pans so it made it thinner, sliced it like you would a pizza, made some fresh whipped cream and then topped it with fresh strawberries and raspberries from the garden.  It was delicious and my non-gf friends LOVED it!  When I'm craving shortcake and feel too lazy to create my own recipe, this will be my goto!  :)
they have done something recently to make this much better. crunchy. improved taste. it's got the right amount of sweetness without getting carried away.
This item is a healthy and inexpensive treat for the whole family.  Easily enjoyed while driving, watching TV, or almost anything.  With no salt it's great for restricted sodium diets.

Summary: DO NOT BUY - Made in China
Text: I purchased this for a snack for my toddler. I was shocked to discover the fruit is from China. Do your research, don't buy this!

Summary: Perfect for that picky toddler who loves a little crunch
Text: We have been trying to get my son to eat fruit as long as I can remember, with no progress. Until I found crisps, now he will sit down and eat an entire bag! His favorite is the apples. If I am not careful my 10 & 11 year old stepsons will raid the strawberry banana!!!!
These are good, but they are made in China. I wondered if they followed safe practices.  Not being certain, I'll opt out of buying again.

Summary: GREAT snacks for daughter (AND Hubby & I)
Text: I love that these snacks are 100% organic fruit with no additives.  They break into small pieces for a healthy snack for my little one who is learning to eat solids.  My husband and I love to grab them for a great on-the-go snack for ourselves, too!!

Wow!  We were pleasantly surprised by this product.  We love to eat dried fruit, and the handy packs were great for an on the run treat.  I will be buying more for lunchboxes!  The Asian Pear was my daughter's favorite.

These are WONDERFUL -- BUT, the title makes it sound like you get 24 bags that are 6.78 ounces each. NOT SO! Each bag is only 0.28 ounces. The 6.78 ounces is the amount you get for all the bags put together.

As I said, these are wonderful! But they are very expensive for the amount you get.

I gave them 4 stars because the title is deceiving! If you zoom in on the picture, you'll see the bag says 0.28 ounces.

Poor quality product. Chips have very little flavor. They are the consistancy of styrofoam.
Would not recommend or purchase again>
The apple flavour is the best out this whole pack. The banana feels sort of bizarre. And the pear has no flavour what so ever.

I got these snacks when I was searching for the Veggie Straws.  They LOOKED tasty.  However, I didn't care for the consistency.  Since they are called "crisps" I assumed they would be crunchy...like chips.  But instead they dissolve in your mouth...kind of like party mints.  I cancelled my subscription and gave the packages that I had to someone else to try.  Lesson learned.

Summary: Great snack when fresh fruit isn't an option
Text:
I can't stand the thought of feeding my daughter processed, sugary snacks that lack nutrients. I give her fresh fruit and vegetables as often as possible. These are perfect for stocking the diaper bag so she can have an impromptu snack. I try everything I give her because if I won't eat it, I won't make her eat it. I love these! The apple is probably my favorite. The banana does leave a strange after taste but that's to be expected.

I saw a review that said they only received a 12 pack but I didn't have that problem. They\re packaged in a 12 pack but I was sent 2 of them. I received these very quickly too.

Overall, a great product.

Summary: very yummy my kids loved these
Text: These were wonderful! Everyone in my house loved them.  They were great for a snack at home or on the go.

We got these [...] for $7 a box which was a great price!  My daughter is 1.5 yrs old and she LOVES them.  When we ask her what she wants for a snack she says "Ap-ple"  It is great, she gets a full serving of fruit and there is nothing in them that is bad for her. I think that the prices here seem high, however when you take into account that each bag has one whole apple, you would pay that amount for fresh produce and end up throwing out some of it anyways.  My daughter easily finishes an entire bag and what she doesn't we can save for the next day.  WE LOVE these apples!
I perfer Starbucks Breakfast Blend and I got this as it was on sale. A good cup to be sure...get it on sale and you can't lose.

I was really pleased with the flavor of this coffee. I usually buy whole beans and grind in my coffee maker/grinder just prior to brewing. It was only available on sale pre-ground, so I went for it. The flavor is smooth, full and rich. I'm very happy with it, and would buy it again.

After about a week from when I placed my order, I was checking it's location. I didnt worry to much about it because I still had some time till it's due date. When I placed this order, I ordered something else and that came. I was happy that my one order arrived but was wondering what happened to my Seattles Best Coffee. Needless to say, I said "this will probably be the last time I order off of Amazon" but when I checked my mail box it was placed in there. I went back in and made myself a cup of coffee and my oh my, it was worth the wait. Next time I may get Level 4 though not to say 3 wasn't good but just to try.
I love these cheerios and it is a really wonderful value.  I will continue getting this cereal as it is a regular in our home for breakfasts.
I BOUGHT THESE CEREALS FOR MY PARENTS. THEY LOVE IT. IT HAS THE FIBER, TASTE, AND VERY HEALTHFUL. THIS ONE ESPECIALLY, MY MOTHER EATS IT LIKE A SNACK.

If you use these raw, then be aware each bag had pieces of broken shells. I use them in hot cereal and salads and have had the less than joyful experience of biting down on a hard shell piece.

If you care about your teeth, you may want to buy them whole and break them up yourself. I've never found a shell in the whole ones.

Summary: Not for medium to large breeds, even as little puppies.
Text: I bought this for my 12 week old German Wirehaired Pointer puppy, thinking she had a little mouth so I should get her a little toy.  She ripped it to shreds in days.  Perhaps this toy in this size is for small breeds?

Summary: I really wanted to like this stuff. I really did.
Text: Unfortunately, it didn't have much of a chocolate taste, had a very strong chemical aftertaste, and didn't dissolve well. Ultimately, I gave it to my wife, who made chocolate muffins from it. (The baking seemed to evaporate the funny tasting chemicals, and a healthy dose of additional cocoa gave the batter more of a chocolate taste than the syrup had.) Wouldn't use this for drinks, though. Neither the consistency nor the taste is appealing.

I have tryed all the sugar free syrups and sauces for my mochas and like this one the best. It is thick and gives a good chocolate flavor without overwhelming the coffee. A sugar free chocolate product will always lack a robust chocolate flavor but you will love this sauce especially compared to Torani.

Summary: Great for what it is.  Use with caution.
Text: I think xylitol is great.  But... I gave my daughter a little in solution in the concentration tested and said to be tolerable for toddlers in a New England Journal of Medicine article.  Still, my daughter began vomiting everywhere almost immediately.  She never normally vomits.  I think the intense sweetness triggered a kind of protective response in her body.  Perhaps she thought it was poison.  Anyway, don't be dumb like me and try it on your toddler.  Reserve this product for older children and adults.

I am not a happy camper. This website says "pure xylitol". What did I get? A box of packets that say "Xylitol Plus" which is Xylitol and Stevia. And, most of the time, I find Stevia to be nasty. So now I likely have to throw this whole box away and I am pissed. This seller is not worth your time. Go to your local health food store where you can hold the box you want in your hands.
Amazon made it so easy to compare prices and order the Xylitol.  Quick ship as well.  Very pleased with entire transaction.

Just was I was looking for to get me off sugar.

Thanks,
Terry

When I bought this I was really going out on a limb. I like to read reviews for all skin care product before purchasing. This cleanser has a surprisingly cooling effect on the skin. Reminds me of a mixture between Noxzema's foaming face wash that was discontinued and the Clean & Clear Morning Burst (which dries my face out beyond belief). I love the smell, and it cleans my Mac foundation off way better than Cetaphil. Great product!

I like the idea of a chemical-free cleanser (especially if it smells good). But it didn't. The first day I used it, I got PAINFUL acne! I've never had painful acne before or since!!! It broke me out big time and it smelled like rotting pineapple. Gross. Please save your money and don't think twice about this product.
This cream moisturizes very well without feeling heavy or greasy. It works well for a night or day lotion. Plus it smells great!

I'm not a salt eater since it makes me retain water but when using this salt I could care less!  It is so delicious on the fish I use for fish tacos or just an entree for that matter.  Just remember it is NOT iodized if you are concerned about your Thyroid/goiter.

I was skeptical- but had to stop giving my dog rawhide because of a health problem and sweet potato is one of the things he's allowed to have, so figured I'd give it a try. He likes regular sweet potato just cooked and mashed ok, but isn't terribly enthusiastic so I was afraid he'd be the same with this. No, he absolutely loves them! Doesn't take him as long to eat as a rawhide but they're still pretty substantial.

Summary: My dog has spoken: these are GREAT treats
Text:
Better than leather or rawhide and very manageable scent and clean up wise. But that's what I think. What my dog thinks is "I love them!"
Who am I to argue with her?

Summary: The cafe you can carry in your pocket!
Text: I love Java Juice--not only for the way it tastes, or that it's certified organic or even kosher, but that I can take it anywhere. When it first came out, I took it on an AIDS ride. You could tell all my friends in the photos afterwards. We were the ones smiling and ahead of the pack. (Everyone else was DYING for good coffee. We just pulled into fast food places or gas stations and asked for hot water.) I ran out of my supply at dinner that night, because everyone wanted to try it. I think a lot of riders got hooked. I've also taken JJ on trips to London, Portugal, Italy and Israel (not that the latter 3 don't have extremely good coffee in cafes, but when you're out sightseeing in the country, it's not always so easy to find them). But probably the time my JJ came in most handy was on a trip to Great Smoky Mountains National Park. The park is so beautiful, but after we left Asheville NC there was like NOWHERE to stop for anything. Good thing we brought some bread, cheese, nuts, Java Juice and a thermos of hot water!

Summary: The flavor lasts a long time
Text: I first bought this gum in Florida but can't find it here where I shop in Chicago, so I continue to buy it online. The flavor lasts a long time without getting yucky, and the gum retains its consistency. Love it!

Bakerella recommends these in their cake pop book.  So much better than Wilton's!  No bleeding at all, bright colors, like using a magic marker.  I noticed some inconsistency in wetness/dryness between different colors; the purple and pink don't work as well as the others in the bag.  Don't know if it's characteristic of the color or inconsistent product quality.  Would definitely purchase again.

I got these markers to occasionally decorate something in my boys' lunches.  So far I have only done hard boiled eggs.  They were thrilled when they opened their lunches!  The tip is fairly firm, but writes very easily.

Summary: Great if you like it sweet!
Text:
I recently bought myself a Keurig, and we've been going a little nuts with purchasing all the different flavours to sample (wouldn't it be great if variety packs were easily come across?)

This one is one of my favourite flavours. I will buy it again

It is sweet tasting, and great with milk/cream. Sugar is not necessary.

This flavour is NOT recommended for someone who doesn't enjoy sweet coffees.

This is the best tasting coffee on the market. I have tried several different types and always go back to Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee. Can't wait for the decaf K-cups of Butter Toffee to hit the market.

Gloria Jean' Butter Toffee coffee is simply the best. Rich mellow flavor is perfect anytime. All of the Gloria Jean's coffee's that I've tried are great, but this one is my all time favorite. Give it a try, you won't be sorry.
I love this vendor: decent price and quick delivery.  Also, I got free shipping.  How great is that, having coffee delivered free to your door step?
Excellent sweet caramel back flavor.  Good coffee flavor, no bitterness.  I will order this one again and would recommend it to a friend.
Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee is one of my top 5 favorite flavors.  The bulk packaging and convenient shipping make it easy to always have these K-cups on hand.

Summary: smells a lot better than it tastes
Text:
we bought this based on the high recommendations on reviews. i think it is only fair to add that my wife and i give it a "meh".

we were super excited when we first brewed it as it smells wonderful, however, drinking it didn't measure up to expectations.

we prefer the hazelnut offered by same manufacturer.
This is the only coffee my wife and I drink with our Keurig. The butter toffee has a very mellow taste. The flavoring is not too over-powering, it's just right!

Summary: Smells great but tastes like water - no flavor
Text: This stuff smells great but it tastes like water.  I will not order it again, and I do not reccommend it.  I remembered it being better in the sample that came with my coffee maker.

This coffee doesn't smell like butter toffee, it just smells like "flavored coffee" which to me all smells very similar no matter what it's supposed to smell like--pecan praline, blueberry cream, amaretto, even "Norseman Grog" which is a combination of vanilla, rum and caramel.  They all smell pretty much the same to me, even different brands.  I was hoping this one would be different because of the high reviews, but it isn't.  I gave it two stars because the coffee itself is good and not bitter like some.

This is a great flavor! First, my husband likes lots of cream & lots of sugar in his coffees. One day I saw this in the store & bought it because the name made it sound promising - my husband LOVED it. He barely puts any cream in his coffee because he says it tastes so smooth.
My neighbor also has a Keurig & we swap flavors to get more of a variety. I gave her some of this, and she was sold! This is all she drinks now, too!
Because this stuff is so great, we obviously buy in big quantities. This packaging is great! Just one box w/ a bunch of Kcups thrown in. We don't have to mess w/ the plastic over the two boxes, etc. etc.
My boyfriend loves this coffee. He drinks it black without cream and sugar. It has just enough flavor without being bitter. It's also great with creamer for me.
Buying coffee this way saves money . Everyone in the family likes this coffee. It is a medium blend with excellent flavor

This butter toffee has become my favorite k-cup flavor. Though I usually prefer unflavored coffee in the morning, this is an exception. It has just a hint of flavor and makes getting up a bit more tolerable. My daughter-in-law introduced me to it and, when my gift box was gone, i was glad to be able to replace it at a reasonable price at Amazon.
I love this flavor of coffee, and amazon makes it very easy to get large amounts cheaper.  Shipment was shorter then expected. I love amazon!

Summary: A 4 Week Wine Very  Drinkable in 6 Weeks

This dulce de leche was so delicious.  I used it to fill pumpkin cupcakes at Thanksgiving and had nothing but rave reviews.  For taking the lazy way out this is the best product to still make whatever you make taste homemade.  I just did not have the time or inclincation to make the dulce myself and I honestly don't think it would have tasted as good as this product's!
Not only is this a delicious tea, it smells wonder, too. This makes for a very tasty tea experience and one that brings comfort any time of day.

I was very pleased with this item I purchased and will order it again. The tea is most delicious and I really love the tin it is packed in. I found the Amazon pricing the most economical.

Leah M. Barone

Summary: The Great Taste of London Cuppa
Text:
I grew up in Scotland in the 1930's. The three daily meals were called breakfast,dinner, and tea, in that order. Yes,tea was so important that the last meal of the day was called tea.
I've lived in the USA for over 50 years. It's been great but finding an easy source of good tea has been a chalenge, until now. That is until I found London Cuppa and an easy and affordable source via Amazon.com. The taste is rich and very smooth; the best tea I've ever had.
If you'll love York Peppermint Patties, then you'll love the International Delight York Peppermint Pattie Creamer! Every sip tasted just the the candy!

Summary: Great Little Snack...But only on sale!
Text: In my opinion these are better tasting than your average "100 calorie pack" and ten less cals. They remind me of rice crispy treats, with a little more body and a little less crunch. The drizzle on top adds a nice flavor note. At regular Amazon price they're quite pricey.

Summary: Health Valley Organic Soup, no Salt added
Text: This soup is really great and good tasting for the person who is not able to eat salt.  It would be nice, if there were more food products without salt.

Since I have begun to use this cocoa, my family and friends rave about the difference in my baked goods, my chocolate cake has been declared the best they have ever eaten. Recently I baked my chocolate cake with a cheaper dutch cocoa and my husband immediately could tell the difference. Sorry guys, pay the price and enjoy the best!!!!!!  Donna

This is a very dark, rich, unsweetened cocoa from Italy that has a great fat content (20-22%) with the added touch of vanilla beans. It is like no other cocoa you have ever cooked or baked with. It is Dutch processed. It has the most intense, immediate chocolate flavor when you smell it, so you can well imagine what it does for all your recipes.Treat yourself and keep this cocoa powder in your repertoire.

I feel so lucky to work near the ChefShop store. A few years ago I was there, shopping for Christmas gifts. They had a hot chocolate machine going and I helped myself to a cup - it was so delicious and amazing! Well, there was no better sales pitch for this cocoa powder. Though the bag looked generic and unpromising, I bought 2 for gifts and one for myself. Since then I won't buy any other cocoa powder. Yes, it makes incredible hot chocolate but maybe even more importantly, dramatically transformed my chocolate baked goods into sublime, luxurious treats. The intense chocolate flavor is well balanced, with no bitterness whatsoever. If you like sea salt's purity of flavor, you'll probably like Pernigotti Cocoa. It seems a little expensive but a little goes a long way and is a great value. Just try making your favorite chocolate cake recipe with it and you might find it as indispensable as I do.
This is a nice way to use the amount of tomato paste you need and still save the rest for later use unlike those little cans where the leftovers rapidly spoil before you need to use them.

When you see a diet soda, it usually implies a funky taste.  However, sucralose sweetened beverages such as this Hansen's don't have such a problem.  As an added bonus, the ingredients in this soda have a quality taste to them.  A premium soda that doesn't sock you with a lot of calories that may come back to haunt you.  If you are a fan of root beer, try this one for sure!
Green beans came in a very good package, are debris-free (no sand,etc.)and roast up fine.  Taste is fine, a little carmely and "dry".

I've tried canned gumbo and boxed mixes for years and this is the best. What I do is put in a can of cut okra, 3/4 link of smoked sausage, one rib of finely diced celery in a microwave bowl with about 6 cups water. render sausage first then, put in celery and microwave about 4 more minutes. Then, put in mix and water and cook for 25 minutes. Be careful after about 10 minutes if it starts running over, you may need to cook it on 70% power. If gets too thick just add water; or if too thin, you can add some of that jarred dark roux you can buy in walmart. Its called Kary's dark Cajun roux, but drain the oil first, only use the flour.

Summary: Apples, Cranberries and Cinnamon without Fattening Nuts
Text:
The graphics on these bags are very enticing -- cereal, cranberries and apples falling onto a spoon, looking cool and fresh. I'm not a big fan of granola so when I opened the bag, I assumed it would taste like granola with chunks of crunch. Instead, it's like a marriage of crisped and flaked cereals of assorted sizes and shapes, with a bonus of dried cranberries, apples and cinnamon. The cranberries and apples amply satisfy the sweet and chewy texture which is popular in cereals offered by Familia, and the lack of nuts like almonds and hazelnuts reduces the fat content. This Familia Swiss Crunch Muesli is a high fiber cereal but it is not a reduced sugar cereal.

I was concerned because the ingredients did not list the coconut which was the buying point for me personally. I contacted the company to inquire and received a response within hours. The cinnamon which will be described better on future packaging is really what gives this cereal a little boost, not coconut which is listed in the current description. Future packages will read, "cranberries, apples, honey and cinnamon." Additionally, the current ingredients list "cocoa powder" which will be corrected to read "coconut powder." Although I was disappointed in the lack of coconut, I still think this is a 5 star cereal, tasty, balanced, packaged well and produced by a solid company. If I want to increase the fat content in my portions, I can add a little dried unsweetened coconut.

I prefer this foil packaging, especially in smaller portions like the 11 ounce size because I have a Tupperware container that holds it perfectly. One can, however, simply use the attached tab and seal the bag without putting it into another container. Since each bag contains 6 servings, a larger size family could conceivably never need to seal the bag. I've had this muesli only with skim milk thus far, but I will next be having it with either low-fat homemade or Fage Greek yogurt. I also intend to use this in a recipe for muffins and top them off with a drop of fresh berry jam or almond butter. This wasn't exactly what I was expecting, but it's a fabulous cereal nevertheless and I'll buy it again.

I never enjoyed coffee the way most people do. It just didn't taste good to me. This has turned me into a coffee drinker.

I got some samples of this recently, but waited to try them since I assumed they would be too sweet for my taste. The mocha was just ok, but the caramel flavor I loved. This one also is delicious.

I like the way this foams a bit on the top to add to the creaminess. I had tried Cappuccino once at Starbucks and didn't like it but this is delicious. It tastes like desert to me, or something to drink with desert. I appreciate the fact that this isn't overly sugary. And, unlike the mocha flavor, in this one I can taste the rich coffee flavor.

Nescafe has a winning product here. It's hard to imagine anyone not liking these. If they can turn even a non-coffee drinker into a fan, they have hit a home run with these beverages.

Summary: I can't wait for this to hit store shelves!
Text:
I tried this product at a recent conference expo hall (BlogHer in NYC) and I freaking love this stuff! I honest to goodness even Instagrammed and Tweeted out because I was out and so sad that I couldn't find more (was told it would be in stores next month though!)

The thing about this product is that it's meant to be a light, frothy drink - a little momento away (ha ha). It's not a hardcore coffee so if you want that - drink a cup of coffee. The Cappuccino flavor is by far and large my fav as it has the most coffee flavor. My friend tried the Mocha flavor and really loved it - I felt that it was not 'coffee' enough for me.

I'm new to the food allergy world. So when I found these at my local Whole Foods, I figured it was worth trying.

Unlike some of the Enjoy Life cookies, these chocolate bars don't taste "special." They taste like regular dark chococate. The consistency is normal and not weird. They're not overly sweet or bitter.

The bar is scored into 4 pieces. I usually break each piece in half so it provides 8 perfect bites.

Nutritionally, it's only 200 calories for the entire bar. Sometimes, I find that 1/2 the bar is enough... so it's a perfect 100 calorie snack.

They are a bit pricey but so are regular premium chocolate bars, so I guess it's not too bad. Here's a tip, if you buy them from Whole Foods, you can buy the box (12) and get 10% off. They seem to run about $2 each everywhere.

You wouldn't be able to tell the difference from this chocolate bar versus any other piece of dark chocolate!  Our son has multiple food allergies.  He is even allergic to rice so we can't do alot of the Enjoy Life products.  He however loves these bars.
Again, this is a great product and company. Other brands of this type do not come up to my standards, and this actually tastes good.

I ordered this product for combatting caterpillars on my brandywines, and it did the job.  Unfortunately, the bottle design is pretty terrible - the product comes out in clumps, and I found myself with patches of really white tomato plant that were impossible to dust off.  Next time, I'll definitely order a liquid spray.

This is the Only pancake mix we will eat in our house.  It is very, very good! and the best tasting we have ever had. I have stopped making "homemade" pancakes as everyone likes these so well. Great for hurried mornings or quick supper too.

This is the first time I've had this brand and I must say it's excellent. Lots of well cooked and flavored meat and it is moist. I'll definitely be buying more of this!

I'd also like to add that the shipping was fast and the item was well packaged. My only complaint is about the price. It is rather expensive but still this will be a nice treat every now and then.
My 2 year old daughter LOVES them!  She is super picky when it comes to food.  She loves these bars, I tasted one and it tastes like a fruit roll up but is thicker and better for you!

Summary: good tasting treat but at a high price
Text: These are great. Supposed to be sugar free but you would never know it. The only thing when ripping them apart they do not separate easy at times and I tore one and it started leaking all over the place. There is not too many of them and they go too quick. Each one is ~.50 cents a piece. I thought this was a tad bit high. Flavorice is good stuff though. Watch out for cutting your mouth on the plastic as well. It is a little sharp or can be. I want to buy them again but I think they cost too much.

Summary: Awesome flavor -- better than the salty kind
Text: Even my family now prefers this over regular bouillon. I use it to season many dishes--eggs, meatloaf, stews, soups, as a replacement for canned chicken broth, etc. I even mix a little into melted unsalted butter to give vegetables a little extra zip. If you don't eat salt or don't want added salt, this versatile  bouillon is for you.

Summary: EXCELLENT food! However the only con is...
Text: it's unfortunate that the prices of this brand (all the formula's) went up DOUBLE. When it first came out it was very reasonably priced. You might want to check Tractor Supply if you have one in your area for a little less. Other than that, this is really a great brand for dogs with allergies. I have a German Shepherd Dog who is highly allergic to a handful of things. This has definitely made her stop itching and reduce yeast infections. Her coat is very soft now. If you have dogs with uncontrollable itching and there's no fleas involved, it's definitely the food you're feeding him/her. Do some research and you'll find that grain based kibble can cause itchiness, hot spots, yeast infections, and reoccurring ear infections. Grain-free kibble is the best way to go. It's worth a little extra money to avoid vet costs.

Summary: Fantastic for dogs with skin allergies
Text:
I started my 5 year old German Shepherd (and myself) on a grain free diet this year. He has always had terrible, flaky, dry skin and I always thought just supplementing his diet with fish oil would help. That was only part of the equation. I had him on (what I thought was) a premium dog food all of his life, and while he would eat it, he was never THAT excited about it. Since I have had him on Taste of the Wild his skin has cleared up, his coat is shinier than it ever has been, and he has TONS more energy.

Make no mistake, dogs are omnivores but their biology is still stuck in the days when their ancestors ate meat as the staple of their diet. They shouldn't be eating grain. This is a quality, affordable, grain free food. If you are thinking of switching your dog to a grain free formula I would strongly consider this. My dog goes wild for this stuff, going so far as to start eating it as I'm transferring it into the storage container. I'm so glad that I can order this from amazon and have it delivered to my door. Its super convenient.

I love this food and so do my dogs! High quality and great nutritional value is what first attracted me to it and my dogs love it too. I have always fed my pups high quality dog food so I can't say that their coats look better or that they have more energy than before I was feeding this brand but I can say that they are healthy and do have beautiful coats and a ton of energy :)

Taste of the Wild just came out with a canned version of this item which I just recently tried and was VERY impressed with. Nice chunks of meat, gravy, and veggies! My dogs love this stuff even more than the dry food. The wet food is pretty costly though so I like to mix a can in with the dry food every other day or so.
Switch to this food and my dog became very sick. Go online and lookup this dog food and you will not purchase when you see the 100's bad reviews.

My dog loves this food! It's always nice to have a dog enjoy the food AND have it be good for them. My dog is a 40 pound beagle mix. Summary: Never Received Product- Starbucks Poor Customer Service!
Text:
After enjoying Passion Iced Tea at Starbucks brick and mortar stores, I was excited to make some at home with the filter bags. I would have never ordered it if I knew that it would cost me not only $27 but hours of dealing with customer service with no resolution, no filter bags, and no refund.

In short:
At the end of the day, only purchase from companies you can trust. Starbucks is no longer in my list of go to trust-worthy companies. I now purchase Mighty Leaf Teas instead.

The full story:
I purchased two starbucks products the Passion Iced Tea Filter bags (PITFB)and Earl Grey Tea Bags. I received the Tea Bags but not the Passion Iced Tea. I inquired with Starbucks to follow-up on the missing merchandise. Starbucks advised that the PITFB were mailed out in a separate box from the Earl Grey bags but in the same shipment. I advised that I only received one box with the shipment. At first Starbucks emailed me that the me that I would receive a subsequent shipment.

"Thank you for contacting Starbucks Online Ordering.
We apologize for the inconvenience you have experienced with your order.
After further research, all of the items shipped out but separately.
Please allow 5 to 10 business days to receive the remaining part of your
order."

When no new order ID generated after 10 days, I called Starbucks and was told that they would not send out a new shipment. Starbucks advised that they checked their inventory and because their "counts matched", a replacement would not be sent and they could determine that the passion iced tea had been mailed.

I asked for the tracking number that was associated with the PITFB so I could investigate further. Starbucks stated that they sent two separate boxes but with one tracking number. Starbucks insisted that I file a claim with the carrier. I spoke with the carrier who stated that each box should have a tracking number. The one tracking number that was given with the order was delivered (the earl grey tea bags)so UPS could not honor a claim on the second box because there was no second tracking number on the missing merchandise. Starbucks response was that because UPS would not honor their claim (because Starbucks didn't only used one tracking # for 2 boxes) that I was out of luck and nothing further could be done.

Starbucks, a company that I have traditionally enjoyed doing business with, has discouraged me from purchasing their products again...on Amazon or otherwise. The customer service agent and his supervisor's inability to address the shipping department's error and take no responsibility for seeing the transaction through is incredibly disappointing. I expected more from a company that is praised for its customer-centric attitude when in reality Starbucks neither offered to replace the unreceived merchandise nor refund the cost of the PITFB.

I have attempted to obtain a refund through Amazon's A-to-Z Guarantee Program on June 16. As of 09-02-11 and several inquiries to Amazon, I still have not received a credit to my Amazon account nor a refund to my credit card.

This has been my worst Amazon experience to date.

Summary: The commerials are true! Feel like working out for a change...
Text:
My friends think I am crazy when I rave about it, but my husband and kids know that this stuff has been life changing for me! For the past 15 years the only thing I drink 99.5% of the time is water because I prefer to eat my calories. :) But I see these 5 Hour Energy bottles EVERYWHERE, so I wondered what was the deal? Then I saw the tv commerial and figured I would at least try it, because I am an avid runner always trying to get my 5k time down, so how awesome would it be to FEEL like running rather than dragging myself to do intervals sometimes. I've been drinking it for the past 3 months and it has worked wonders for me! I'm telling everyone about it.

I found for best results I drink half the bottle around 11am and the other half around 4pm usually after eating a snack or drinking a protien shake. This gets me through an tough afternoon workout, and once I get home from work I have the energy/motivation to cook, clean, do laundry, or whatever tasks I would normally just lay around and wish I had the energy to do. Even more amazing I can stay up about an hour later each night, but still wake up early, feeling refreshed and ready for a morning workout. I always drink some about 30 minutes before a race and usually before a hard workout.

Cons....Well, I did find that if I drank it on an empty stomach I would get some pain in my right side. :) But I'm still sold on it! I sometimes just drink half a bottle all day and don't drink it on the weekends or on vacations because it's not good to be addicted to anything (but Jesus) :), and you don't want to get immune to it because you want it to work when you need it to plus it is kind of expensive...

Honestly, I haven't found anyone else who loves it as much as I do, but I still say TRY IT!

Summary: Awesome Product, Wish I Could Buy It In Stores
Text:

She's a forty-pound mutt, and I give her one-half of a Checkup after breakfast and dinner... if I wait too long to give her the treat, she starts whining and moaning until I pull one out of the container on the kitchen counter. Then she runs to her bed and waits not-so-patiently for it... yeah, she's a weird one. :-)

Like many other reviewers, I used to buy these at Costco for about half the price, but had been unable to find them at either of our local stores. I contacted both Diamond Pet Foods and Costco about it. Diamond said that Costco rotates the availability of many of is products, discontinuing items for a couple of months then bringing them back. They suggested I let Costco know that we liked product and wanted to see it on a permanent basis, but in the mean time that I could buy them from Amazon. Costco said the item had been discontinued, making no mention of it being a rotating product, but that they would pass my message on to their buyers. If you want to see these back on the shelves in Costco, send them an e-mail or drop in a note in the suggestion box at your local store about it. The more customers they hear from, the better the chance they will bring them back.

Diamond also suggested another one of their products, Bright Bites, which are similar to Checkups. They come in three flavors -- peppermint, wintergreen, and cinnamon -- and are available in retail stores (you can find a list on their web site) and Amazon. I don't know if our dog would dig the flavors, or if switching to them would be any less expensive than continuing to buy Checkups from Amazon, but maybe I'll try them out some time.

Summary: Nice treat.  Cleaning teeth?  Not so much.
Text:
I appreciate the ingredient list in these Checkups, with no wheat, gluten, or corn, no added sugar. We have 2 shetland sheepdogs, and one of my shelties has epilepsy and it seems gluten and corn are possible seizure triggers so we avoid those ingredients.

Zoey (28 lbs) & Bailey (21 lbs) would each get one Checkup once or twice a week, and didn't have any problems with throwing these up or getting runny poo. But they would eat them by breaking off a piece with their molars (which was easy for them to do), then work the piece around in their mouth to soften and chew it, and swallow. Gone in less than 10 minutes, even for Zoey who is a "lady-like" eater and thoroughly chews everything, never gulping. The problem spot on my shelties' teeth is their canine teeth, they get plaque buildup near the gumline. These Checkups don't do a thing for front teeth because my dogs only use their molars to (briefly) chew them.

My vet recommended instead to get raw (not cooked!) beef knuckle bones or marrow bones, because the shape and size of those encourage the dog to use their front teeth to get in there and pull and pluck at the meat and marrow, in addition to using their molars to scrape off meat. The raw bones don't splinter and are soft enough that they won't crack my dogs' teeth. (FYI: After trying both knuckle and marrow bones, my shelties get more chewing with knuckle bones and they each get to chew on the knuckle bone for an hour every other day on a mat in the garage... chewing makes them happy and tired, and my vet is very happy with their teeth.) My vet said for teeth cleaning we need scraping action, and these Checkups don't provide it, nor do any of those "dental rawhides" you see in stores.

These Checkups are a nice little quick treat for my small/medium size shelties, but not for teeth cleaning. 5 stars for the good ingredient list, but 1-star for teeth cleaning action... average of 3 stars. Perhaps if you have a tiny little dog and the idea of raw knuckle bones grosses you out, these Checkups might be a good option, but I won't buy these again as they're just not what I need.

Checkups Ingredients (from the Checkups website):
Potato flour, rice flour, glycerine, water, natural flavor, gelatin, canola oil, titanium dioxide, monoglycerides of edible fatty acids, flaxseed oil, citric acid, magnesium stearate, tetrasodium pyrophosphate

Summary: Mallomars are my favorite cookie. But mail ordering them has its problems.
Text:
Mallomars are my favorite cookie. But mail ordering them has its problems.

I love the combination or dark chocolate, marshmallow, and cookie that is a Mallomar. The taste combination is wonderful. Like Oreo sandwich cookies, aficionados tend to develop ritualistic ways of eating them. Do you nibble off the chocolate dome? You do bit through all three layers? Do you pull off the cookie bottom first? Any way you eat it, Mallomars are a great cookie.

Ordering them mail order is not the best way to get them. They are a fragile cookie and are very temperature (heat and cold) sensitive. The ones I received were fresh, but a little banged up. The slight white coating on the chocolate typically means they were subject to cold. They were not melted at least. Melting kills a Mallomar, which is why they are not sold during the warmer months.

If you can't find them locally (they are seasonal and regional), then ordering them makes sense. Otherwise, it's best to buy them locally.

We have 2 dogs, both mini aussies, 30 and 50 pounds. We were going crazy letting them in and out, and the last time we went on vacation and had a pet sitter come over, they chewed things all over the house waiting for her to come by to let them out. So, my wife said, "We have to get a doggie door." I began researching the field.

We didn't want a traditional "flap" door because of the likely HVAC leaks and the potential for animals to enter our home. So, I decided we needed something with an electronic sensor and lock. The only other electronic door that has any sales volume is the Pet Safe door, but reviews for it were not at all favorable. That left the High Tech Power Pet door as the only good option. We had to buy a new patio door to install it (because our existing one was all glass), but decided it was worth it based on reviews.

The reviews are correct (you can read many, many at[...]). This is the best solution for anyone wanting to let their pet out when it wants to go out. Our dogs learned immediately how to use it. Now we can go to bed at night knowing that if Pepper or Dusty want out, they can go out. And squirrels, etc. won't be able to get in. The only problem is our two cats feel left out. But they lose their collars, and the sensors are expensive.

The only negative is the sensor. I know we are going to have to buy more of these, and at $35 a shot, that is going to add up. Also, they come with a simple thin strap that goes around your pet's neck. There is no easy way to attach it to a traditional collar. They should make an attachment that permits this. The good news on sensors is they are light weight. They are also directional, so if your pet walks by the door but doesn't face it, the door most likely will not open. If your pet stands there in front of the door, it will stay open, waiting for the pet to go through. It's basically a Star Trek door for your pet.

The best part was Amazon Prime. Not only was the door cheaper than ANY PLACE else, we got it in 2 days. I love Amazon Prime!

I follow a vegan diet, use veggie stock often, make soups frequently, and had tried other veggie broths with no success.  Savory Choice is by far my favorite!  Then, by chance, I discovered the same product at Trader Joe's and I was really happy.  Last year Trader Joe's discontinued this product, and Whole Foods no longer carries it. While the others range from bad to very good, none of them come even close to the taste of Zing Zang in our opinions.  I love it with either Tequila (Bloody Maria) or the traditional Vodka. So, why is it so expensive here at Amazon?

Summary: Stash tea can vary batch to batch
Text: I have, in the past, positively reviewed other Stash flavors, Ginger Lemon and Holiday Chai.  Had a problem with the Double Bergamot tea once, but then a second shipment was excellent.  But this Double Chai Spice has a strange chemical flavor. Tried mixing it with regular black tea because the chai seems to be lacking a tea flavor.  I have tried other brands of chai and have made my own.  There's something off about this - it's got a strongly astringent, bitter flavor.  I wonder if it's because the spices are ground to a powder?  The best chai is made with whole spices.

My wife loves this tea. More than that, she love this brand of Chai Tea.  We tried to find it in are grocery stores and no one keeps it in stock.  The scent is really what does it for my wife but it tastes good and has just the pick-me-up you need.

Stash Premium Chai Spice Black Tea can be hard to find on the local shelves, but is never more than a few clicks away on Amazon! The price is great and delivery is always as promised. Enjoy your tea from Amazon.

I have been a tea drinker all my life, and Stash has some wonderful flavors! I think I got primarily hooked on the finer teas when my parents drove us to Canada as children every year.  I primarily drink Earl Gray teas because they are a deep rich teas, but not overpowering.  When you drink Earl Gray, you feel like you drank a fine cup of English tea.  The Double Bergamot added to the Earl Gray is even more superior!  Bergamot is also relaxing.  This is a wonderful blend and very difficult to find in stores.

Summary: The Best Earl Grey Tea I've found
Text:
Stash 'double bergamot' Earl Grey tea absolutely is the best Earl Grey I've found, and I've tasted quite a few of them both here in the US, and while traveling in Europe. The regular Earl Grey in this brand is also excellent, but the 'double bergamot' variety has a little more flavor than the Stash's regular Earl Grey. I highly recommend both, and if you are curious like I was, treat yourself to one or both of these, and you will probably never want to purchase any other brand.

I'm not sure the reason, but the other brands I've tried just do not taste as good. Whatever Stash is doing with this tea recipe, it works.

Summary: Pretty good & refreshing though I have had better Spice Chai
Text: Good stuff but not great.Better than the other brands I have tried so far.It probably needs a little bit more caffeine & spice kick to make it more flavorful.Next time will try the double spice chai..

Summary: different ... not like chai to me
Text: This tastes nothing like my two favorite chai teas, Celestial Seasons and Allegro. It reminds me of Constant Comment (an old Bigelow tea, I believe).

Oddly, the tea bag wrappers are paper instead of the usual foil used for the very same Stash tea when purchased in the supermarket.  We assume that this will have a negative bearing on tea leaf freshness.

I don't understand anyone claiming this fine tea lacks strong, rich flavor. It's the best bagged black tea I've discovered, though we've enjoyed PG Tips and Yorkshire teas. This "Irish Breakfast" tea is strong, without being overly tannic or sour. It's not like loose Lapsang Souchong, being a far more mellow smokey experience. If you crave an authentic, comforting tea that reminds you of being far from the maddening crowd, perhaps in a safer environ of Midsomer than Badger's Drift, than this is the tea for you. We like it with milk & sweetener, though it's wonderful with honey or sugar.

Sometimes more is NOT better.  In this instance, however, double the bergamot IS FAR superior to regular Earl Grey tea.  Stash found a good balance and actually improved on what a basically good thing (Earl Grey tea).  If you have not tried this I highly recommend it.  You will never look at tea the same again.

Summary: My favorite tea - very fragrant and spicey
Text: I like my chai tea strong and spicey, and this tea is perfect.  I have tried other brands and this is by far my favorite.  I look forward to drinking this relaxing fragrant tea every day when I get home from work.

Summary: An enjoyable way to start the day
Text: I drank the regular strength Stash Chai for more than a year, and I liked it very much, although I always found myself wishing for a spicier version. When I learned that Stash also makes a Double Spice Chai I picked up a box of it at a local coffee/tea shop and decided it was actually closer to my preferences. When I had a chance to order a case of the Double Spice Chai on Amazon I made my purchase and have been happily drinking it at breakfast for the last couple of months. I make a large double-sized mug-full using two tea bags and I drink it fairly sweet and with a considerable amount of milk or Half and Half, since that is closer to the traditional way to prepare chai as I understand it. I do like it a lot, but I have to agree with the reviewer who commented that the double spice tends to overpower the strength of the black tea component and that Stash would do well to use a heartier variety of black tea in their formulation of this product. Nevertheless, I am still generally content with my Double Chai and am continuing to enjoy my morning brew of it.

I know instant noodles aren't considered to be a health food, but I can't see any reason for some of the ingredients in this soup, unless it's to hide other poor quality ingredients. Most of the ingredients are chemical sounding names that I had never heard of, so I looked them up. Among them, propylene Glycol is a colourless viscous hydroscopic sweet-tasting compound used as an antifreeze and brake fluid (WTF!!!), and most of the others I couldn't find (even using Google). Then there are the 8 -- that's not a misprint; I said eight -- times sugar in its various forms are mentioned in the ingredient list: Sorbitol, Sucrose Fatty Acid Esters, High Fructose Syrup, Glucose, sugar (listed THREE times), sweet cooking wine. Then after adding all that sugar, they added an artificial sweetener (Sucralose).

I don't care how easy this is to make -- or how good it tastes! With all the sugar it contains, anybody who is the least bit sensitive to sugar (for instance, diabetics or hypoglycemics) would really experience major sugar overload from eating it!

Summary: "For those of you who like this kind of thing, this is the kind of thing you will like."
Text:
For those who really know nutrition, protein bars are a nightmare. Often filled with multiple sugar sources and nasty additives, protein bars run the gamut from truly healthy to downright bad for you. "Pure Naturals" Chocolate Almond Bar lands squarely in the second tier: Simple, semi-organic, some nutrition and reasonably tasty.

NUTRITION: If you're looking for a lot of any one thing this ain't the bar for you. There's 7 grams of protein (albeit from organic rice protein instead of chemically extracted), which is nothing too spectacular but decent. 5 grams of fiber, again not bad. 10% of your iron and 320 mg of potassium but negligible on other nutrients. Sugars are 17 grams a bar; I've seen much worse. Chia seeds will give you a small amount of healthy fats and organic agave is the only sweetener. Downsides? The first two ingredients are not organic and they make up most of the bar. "Natural flavors" are used, never a good thing, and the cocoa is dutch processed which eliminates some antioxidant content. Other than that no real complaints. Nutrition grade: B

ALLERGENS: Made on shared equipment but labeled as gluten-free. No soy-derived ingredients that I could spot (watch out for those "natural flavors"). Obviously if you have a nut allergy you'll have to skip this line, but other than that the ingredient list is pretty straight-forward and clean.

TASTE: This is easily the best tasting of the "Pure Naturals" series. It tastes like a gluten-free brownie, let's put it that way. Heat it up with a little coconut milk ice cream and you got a decent dessert. Not as yummy as the Zing Chocolate Coconut Bar, but better than a lot of the Larabars. Taste Grade: B/B-

There you have it, hope that helps those of you desperate for a new bar that will work for your diet. Overall not bad tasting and decent ingredients. Happy snacking!

FINAL GRADE: B/B-

Text: These brownies are really good and it's hard to believe they're fat free.  If you're trying to watch what you eat, but still want a sweet chocolate fix, these are great.  I make them as directed and they turn out moist and delicious!

I had just started weight watchers and my friend introduced me to this product. They were so good! They were the perfect combination of soft and chewy. I've served these to family and friends and they really enjoyed them too (they had no idea they were fat free)! Serving them with strawberries is the perfect combination!

One tip - just don't put them in the frig to store. They will be come slightly hard - easy fix - put them in the microwave for 5-10 seconds and they'll soften up!

These taste great but not so great that I can't control myself with them. I can have 1 or 2 and be done for the day. I make them with 8 oz. of yogurt. I have tried cherry yogurt and I have tried vanilla and put coconut extract in the mix. I like to play around with extracts and yogurt flavors. I am pregnant and so far went from 120lbs to 150lbs with 3-5 weeks left. I wanted something natural yet satisfying and sweet to help get me thru without going overboard. No pudge did the trick! I think they are much better than that and with only 100 calories and being natural, they are great!

While, we wouldn't have blind tasted picked out the idea of Mozzarella for these, the flavor is still cheesy and good. Everyone in my family enjoyed these. A light flavor that left us all fighting over the to the last bite. Definitely going on the grocery list.

I found these snacks to be very good. They're very tasty and most importantly they're
not very salty which was my main problem with the original Cheeze-It favor. While I
wouldn't buy the traditional flavor, I would definitely get these.

Summary: Review for Cheez-IT mozzarella cheese flavor
Text: I liked these Cheez-ITs. They taste like mozzarella cheese compared to the usual cheddar ones. They also don't get your fingers orange like the original flavor does.

Summary: It Won't Replace the Cheddar Cheez-it
Text:
These are good, but not as good as I'd hoped. My daughter liked them quite a bit. Even better than regular Cheez-Its. She likes the mild mozzarella flavor, and, though, this may not be what Kellogg was going for, she felt that the milder flavor didn't make her breath stink as much as regular Cheez-Its.

As for me, I didn't like the initial smell and taste. Kind of...I don't know...sour? Or too sharp or pungent. Once I ate them, the taste was very mild, and not at all like what they smelled like, so, that was a plus. But while these were a nice change, I find I still like Cheddar Cheez-It's best.

I am a serious cheese cracker eater - all brands, all flavors...this is a cheese household. These new Cheez-It Mozzarella flavor crackers are pretty good. They have a faint flavor at first, very light, almost no cheese flavor initially. The after taste as you swallow the crackers packs more of a flavor punch. I could discern the mozzarella flavor and it's very smooth, no bite like with the Cheddar version of Cheez-Its. We'll probably buy these again, but the better flavor is still the original.

Summary: Quite tasty but high in fat content
Text: As is unfortunately the case more often than not, if a food tastes really yummy then it's probably not very good for you. These crackers have a nice, creamy taste to them and they pack 7 grams of fat per serving. Yes, that is fewer grams than potato chips, but for a cracker I think that's pretty high in fat content. The taste, however, is very good and these would make a good snack if consumed in moderation. One concern for me was the state of the crackers I received. I tasted these as part of the Vine program and the box I received was very smashed up and the crackers were partially obliterated. If I were buying these crackers, I would have been upset about their smashed-up condition. Perhaps it would not be a good idea to buy these in bulk until you can verify that shipping of these crackers won't damage the product.

These were advertised as a pack of 4, but they were just one big box. I am not sure getting the from Amazon is the best idea because they were pretty well smashed up by the time we got them.

I really like the taste of them, but my wife said she will stick with the original flavor. I really like them in chili.

I will by these again, but from the grocery store.

Summary: And old favorite with a new taste
Text:
I have been a fan of Cheez-it crackers since my teen days when I enjoyed the cheddar cheese Cheez-its. We used to sit in front of the TV with a bowl of Raspberry Apple Sauce and a box of Cheez-its. Today I just received a new box, this one is Mozzarella Cheez-its, wow these are really a treat. The flavor is much the same with a little subtle flavor of Mozzarella.

Cheez-its, are made with 100% real cheese and you can taste it, the flavor is very fresh and creamy.
I do not detect any MSG, although it is in there, and I find that the sour taste that was noted is not (to me) sour but a bit tangy, it gives it the zip you would expect in a nice cheesy snack cracker. We all have different tastes and I find this one is a winner for mine.

I love them.

Serving size: 25 crackers
Servings per box: 13
Total fat 7g with no trans fats
Poly. Fats 3.5g
Monio. Fats. 1.5
Cholesterol: 0
Sodium 180
Total Carbs. 19g
Sugars 0
Protein 3g

All in all I think this is a very nice baked flavorful crispy snack cracker.
I am enjoying them very much, and I think you will also.
My only problem now is to stop shoveling them into my mouth.
Enjoy

Summary: Has a good taste but maybe too much added sugar
Text:
I enjoy my coffee but I normally add only a touch of sugar, if any at all to my coffee. When I do add sugar, I would put no more than a 1/2 teaspoon of sugar in my cup of coffee. I also will generally choose a dark roast coffee, like French Roast or Sumatra.

This illy Caffe coffee drink is an Italian Roast coffee. It has a decent taste in my opinion. I was expecting some sort of "canned" taste but didn't sense that at all while I was drinking it. But I did experience an aftertaste that I can only describe as somewhat metallic.

I usually drink the dark roast coffees but was surprised to find that this had a really nicely balanced coffee taste without the pronounced bitterness usually associated with the bigger, bolder dark roasts to which I'm accustomed.

It was the added sugar that I don't really care for. The serving size is 6.8 fluid ounces and that contains 10g of sugar. A teaspoon of sugar is approximately 4 g which means this 6.8 oz can of coffee has the equivalent of 2.5 teaspoons of sugar. Even if I did put sugar in a cup of coffee, I'd only put in a single teaspoon. So for me it was way too sweet. Knowing that many people do sweeten their coffee, I'd say that many people would not find this as overly sweet as I did. You'd probably like it if you sweeten your coffee.

I find it convenient to be able to have with you on trips or travels, a good quality cup of coffee. This tastes much better to me than your typical gas station swill that is passed on as coffee. So for trips or commutes it would be a great choice. Just be careful if you are diabetic or have sugar restrictions because there is quite a bit of sugar in a serving. Other than that it tastes pretty good to me.

Summary: Surprised This Had Sugar And Calories In It......
Text: My impression of this coffee is it is probably of very high quality and also very strong.  I was surprised to see sugar had been added to the product and that the can contained 50 calories as I had assumed it was almost pure coffee.  I had to add a bit of skimmed milk with the ice cubes to make an enjoyable iced coffee for my taste buds.

I've tried Illy cappuccino and it was tasty, creamy and a bit sweet. Having Illy espresso in the fridge to try I was ready for refreshment and some kick in taste and energy. This coffee drink went down the drain after 2-3 sips. I love lattes and I could drink hot fresh espresso, but this was just unbearable. VERY bitter, despite of having sugar it (and I don't sweeten tea and coffe). Also there is 50 calories in the can, not 45 (small difference), but fot many that count calories might matter.

Anyway I wouldn't recommend Issimo espresso, unless you love very very bitter coffee.

Summary: I liked it; I still prefer black, hot coffee, but this could be an occasional switch
Text:
I have tried a variety of chilled coffee/espresso drinks, and while I like them individually, I have yet to find any drink that I would go out of my way to try repeatedly. Maybe this didn't amaze me, but I liked that it was an adult coffee drink.

I drink black coffee with no sugar - and I drink a lot of it. The good thing about this brand is, like another reviewer said, the coffee is the star. I tried it right after a cup of my normal hot coffee, and it did not pale in comparison.

I drank the Caffe chilled and it was not bitter or over-sweet like so many of these drinks. I normally drink high-end coffee, and this tasted pretty legit in comparison. So I think quality ingredients were used.

It's a little stronger than my normal coffee - which it should be, since it's an espresso drink.

Another review thought the sugar overwhelmed the flavor. It's funny - I didn't get that at all. It IS a little sweet (and sugar is the second listed ingredient), but it wasn't something I noticed that much.

Bottom line - good ingredients + adult taste = solid quality.

If you're a black/hot coffee fan like me this probably won't change your habits, but for a hot day this might be a good switch.

I had recently tried the illy Cappuccino which had a slightly flat taste.  The Caffe flavor was a big improvement to me, with more sweetness and a richer coffee taste.  It wasn't the same flavor as I am used to from Starbucks but I liked the easy serving size which can be transported to drink anywhere.  The sweetness of this drink is just right, especially for those who don't drink coffee unsweetened.  I found the caffeine in the illy Caffe wasn't excessive and didn't make me too "wired" throughout the day.

Summary: Great for those times when you are on the go
Text:
I found myself in a situation where I had to be in three places at once, and I needed a flavorful boost without the hassle and cleanup of making my own espresso or the wait and expense of getting one at my local barrista. Right there in front of me was a can of illy issimp Caffe coffee drink. I popped the lid and took a sip. This brew is dark, bold and bitter. I added a packet of stevia-based sweetener and it was much more palatable. My wife took a sip and we both agreed that we should order another pack of these.

Bottom line - an enjoyable, high quality coffee drink. It is not as sweet or decadent as a "double shot" can, but it taste more authentic.

I am reviewing this just for the coffee flavor, which is excellent. It's a flavorful intense coffee flavor, but not too strong. Just right. There is no milk or creamer in this; it is essentially a black coffee drink. Since I like my coffee light, both hot and cold/iced coffee, I did add some half 'n half to this and the result was excellent. But if you don't drink your coffee light, then you'll probably like this right out of the can.

Summary: Delicious, But Too Rich, Kaffe Drink
Text: If you like your Italian espresso to be very dark and bold in taste, then you can't miss with Illy Issimo Caffe . Like its "cousin", Illy Issimo Cappucino, this is an exceedingly rich Italian espresso style coffee drink, but it isn't nearly as rich as the cappuccino, which I have tried recently. However, I thought the coffee flavor was still rich and decided that it needed some improvement by diluting it 50% with fresh milk. I am surprised that a drink as rich as this one is has only 50 calories per can; it's also low sodium too with only 20 milligrams per can. Anyone who is diet conscious will appreciate both salient facts. While I can recommend this to anyone who wants an imported Italian espresso drink from Europe (Denmark), those seeking freshly ground beans, will find Starbucks' version a far more delicious coffee drinking experience.
I found the sugar taste wasn't blended in with the drink well, it tasted like someone had put table sugar in terrible tasting cold coffee.  Not good and expensive.

Other than the benefit of caffeine, this really is not a very good drink. If you compare it to other competitors (namely the at-home Starbucks drinks), it's vastly inferior in just about every category. The taste is mediocre and not pleasant. The smell keeps its metallic odor even after pouring it into a different glass. The value isn't there, either.

Overall, it's a very disappointing drink.

I liked this, very smooth tasting with no aftertaste from being sweetened
and left in a can...amazing. I added some 1/2-n-1/2 to thin it for this
American palette and still enjoyed it a lot. If you purchase this, note
it says do not shake...unlike the Starbucks products you better shake or
leave 1/2 of the product at the bottom.

I really enjoyed this coffee drink.  It has a dark, rich espresso flavor perfect for a hot summer's day, but what I really appreciated the most is that it's not too sweet like many coffee drinks out there. It has just enough sugar to make it tasty and refreshing.  The servings are small in a 6.8 fl oz can so it disappears quickly, but makes for the perfect iced drink and caffeinated pick me up.

I'm so glad I discovered this illy product. I dislike canned coffee with milk--and this is basically just espresso and sugar. And good quality espresso to boot. I highly recommend this product if you like espresso and want a can of it to go.

I was a little reluctant to try this one. Usually, my cold coffee drinks come with mounds of whipped cream. However, I like the idea of something I can keep in my fridge and throw into my purse when I hit the road.

I must say, from first taste, this was delicious. The flavor is smooth and there was no discernible aftertaste. The caffeine kick was good and it kept me going this morning at work. The pricing is less than my usual coffee drinks and I can definitely see making this my summer go-to coffee!

This one is a winner! I'll be keeping my fridge stocked.

BTW - The can says "do not shake". I have no idea what happens when you shake, though. :-) I'll leave it to one of you to experiment with that!

Summary: Great energy; sweet flavor to start, metallic to finish
Text:
I buy illy coffee and espresso grounds on a fairly regular basis, as it is one of my favorite brands of coffee, so I was excited to try their issimo Coffee Drink, Caffe. The first thing to hit me was the sweetness, which was a little unexpected, since I don't normally drink coffee quite that sweet, but it wasn't too overpowering. The overall flavor was actually fairly robust, but missing that fresh-roasted bite, and had a somewhat unpleasant artificial/manufactured aftertaste (perhaps from being housed in a can?).

I did, however, get a big energy perk from the coffee, which allowed me to focus and bolstered me through my morning work.

Overall, I think I'll stick with fresh ground illy, as there is no beating fresh espresso in the morning. But, if I'm ever in a pinch and need a quick pick-me-up, I might consider grabbing a can as a quick substitute.

This is rather like the illy cappuccino in a can.  Kind of bland, vaguely metal.  I'm not sure if this was supposed to be refrigerated or at room temperature, but then I'm not sure it would matter.  I wouldn't call myself a connoisseur of coffee, but still, this just didn't interest me.

Summary: Drink isn't bad, but the Caffè flavor isn't to my taste
Text:
I like coffee, and although I don't really drink it every day, sometimes I just really crave the flavor. I might tackle that craving with a regular cup of coffee, some coffee flavored ice cream or a cold coffee drink.

I occasionally like a latte or espresso drink, but usually have them hot. I was interested in the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè flavor when I saw it and decided I had to try it.

While I like a nice hot espresso, I have to say I don't much care for this drink. It definitely does remind me of a cold espresso, but apparently I don't much like my espresso cold.

I don't think this is a fault of the way the drink is made - more likely it just doesn't suit my taste. I should mention that I have also tried illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) and liked it better than this Caffè flavor.

While I don't necessarily care for it, I think it may appeal to others. If you like strong coffee drinks that aren't sweet and think the flavor sounds good to you, I'd recommend giving it a try. If you prefer a milder coffee drink that is sweeter, you will find the cappuccino flavor more to your liking.
