Text:
I was very pleasantly surprised by the Issimo Caffè canned drink. at 6.8 ounces it's about the right size to drink right out of the can or to split in half to make Ice-blendeds. I tried it both ways and found the cofee taste to be strong enough for my taste but free of any bitter aftertaste or metal "can tatse" that I sometimes get with Starbucks. With 10 grams of sugar, it is a little sweet right out of the can but I'm OK with that. I liked it better mixed with some nonfat milk and unsweetened dark chocolate powder dissolved into hot water and made into a reasdy-made syrup I keep in the fridge. It whipped up nicely and at a much lower calorie and sugar oad than a Frappuccino.

I've been looking for a new canned coffee item to keep in the office and at home for some time since Amazon stopped carrying the Cinnabon Lattes in cans. This has about the same amount of suagr but 20 or so fewer calories so I'm pleased. I can see myself skipping trips to Starbucks and/or Coffee bean & tea leaf and saving myself a signficant amount of money! Hey, I like that! Give it try. It's pretty much straight brewed espresso with some usual preservatives and of course the sugar. No added oils or thickeners or colrings like the Crushed bettles in the strawberry Frappucinos from Starbucks - so what you see is what you get. What you get is a nice, smooth cold Espresso that you can pound down instead of a nasty red Bull or sip slowly and enjoy the taste. Issimo makes canned Cappuccinos as well.

To me the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffe had a very bitter taste to it. I was not smooth as I expected it to be. It also has an after taste which I did not like. It is strong like Coffee and Expresso sould be, but I don't think it should it be bitter.

Generally, I love coffee. I prefer hot coffee made from fresh ground beans and I drink it black. I've tried many of both iced coffee beverages and coffees with espresso shots from the big chain, and I've found them completely delightful, though expensive. Unfortunately, this canned, low-calorie Italian espresso style coffee drink is a no-go for me.

I'm assuming this is to be served cool from the refrigerator, although I'm certain my reaction wouldn't be any different had I drank it at room temperature. The texture is unsatisfactorily grainy. The flavor is unpleasantly off, either from beans that aren't bold enough or from a mixture of ingredients that ruins the flavor of a good bean - either way, I didn't enjoy it.

It's a 50 calorie beverage; with a low 20mg sodium and 12g in carbs, so it balances out nutritionally for a coffee drink. The beet sugar is where it gets its 4g of fiber, its 10g of sugars and likely the peculiar graininess.

This is a convenient on-the-go option for someone who likes coffee, but I like coffee, and I do not like this.

Okay I am not a hot coffee person. But iced coffee? I am the biggest snob there is.

Illy is the big company that makes most of the restaurant coffee products that you see in good quality Italian restaurants. And this is clearly one of their products: the drink has a silky texture in the mouth and that right coffee punch without bitterness or 'dregs'.

If you like iced coffee, give this a shot! The can is small but wow is it good!

Summary: Iced or hot - horrible both ways
Text: I tried half the can over ice, the other half, hot. Not as strong as a true espresso, especially after the ice starts melting. Also not as strong as a real espresso heated with no ice. When heated, the coffee became bitter and metallic-tasting. Not worth spending 50 calories and 12 carbs (10 grams sugar) over a bad-tasting coffee drink. I couldn't finish this, I tossed it down the drain. If I'm drinking coffee away from home, I'd rather have a non-fat McCafe Mocha from McDonalds.

****

First, this drink, illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè, 6.8-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), definitely tastes like coffee as opposed to, say, tea or ketchup or turkey gravy. Also, because I'm a bit of a coffee connoisseur (grind my own beans, ingeniously mix various varieties, use a Chemex 10 Cup Classic Glass Coffee Maker, that sort of thing), I think I stand on pretty firms grounds here when I say this no standard brew haha. It is much nearer the bitter end of the scale.

Yet it is also sweet. I don't know about you, but, first, to me the very idea of adding sugar to coffee is like adding honey to tea or ketchup to a bratwurst or turkey gravy to a filet mignon. I like it!

Speaking of which, according to the description on the Amazon page this product is "sweetened with beet [sic] sugar." First, I think they mean "beaten" sugar, not "beat sugar." That would be like saying molt lava instead of molten lava. Also, they spelled "beat" wrong anyway. Sheesh. I don't subtract any stars for this, I just thought it was worth noting.

****

PRICE ERROR

As of this writing there's another error in the description. You get 12 6.8-ounce cans for $24.13, which is said to be 29 cents per ounce. But if you do the math you get quite a different result.

Oh heck, here, let me do it for you.

6.8 ounces time 12 cans equals 81.6 ounces. $24.13 times 100 equals 2,413 cents. 2,413 cents divided by 81.6 ounces per 12-pack equals exactly 29.5710784313725490196 cents per ounce (*where the least significant 16 digits repeat, and also which the decimal portion of which is equal to exactly 233 divided by 408, which as if you didn't know).

As we round that number to less and less precision we discover that the 7 in the hundredths place forces the 5 in the tenths place to round up to 6. And if you round 29.6 cents to some integral unit you are forced to round up to 30 cents; you may not round down to 29 cents.

First, this is just plain false advertising. I find it interesting, nay, suspicious, that the error just happens to be in the manufacturer's favor. If you were to order a million cans of illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè, 6.8-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) that difference would make a difference, and here's the proof.

A million cans at 6.8 ounces per can = 6,800,000 ounces. At the incorrect stated price of 29 cents per ounce, the total would be 197,200,000 cents, which is $1,972,000. But in fact, as I'm sure you'll remember, the price is 29.5710784313725490196* cents per ounce, which results in a total price for a million cans of $2,010.833.3333.

[ 29 + ( 408 / 433 ) ] * 6,800,000
= 201,083,333.333 cents
= $2,010,833.33

That's a difference of a whopping $38,833.33. I don't know about you, but every time someone asks me whether I want a discount of nearly $39,000, I always say that I very much do.

Now, I'm not saying that if you place an order for a million cans of this product and promise to pay up front in cash the manufacturer won't consider offering you some sort of deal, maybe throw in a free Coca-Cola mouse pad or something. I'm just saying that the price per ounce as stated on the Amazon description page is incorrect, and I'm curious as to why. Whatever the answer is, I don't see how it can be satisfactory. So first, if you find out, let me know by composing a Comment at the bottom of this review.

****

CAFFEINE

According to the Mayo Clinic web site, an 8.4-ounce can of Red Bull contains 76 to 80 milligrams of caffeine, which I will hereby fearlessly average to 78. 78 mg divided by 8.4 is 9.2857 mg per ounce. The product under review contains 155 mg of caffeine per 6.8-ounce can, which works out to 22.7941 mg per ounce, so the percentage by which illy issimo is more caffeinated is calculated like this.

(22.7941 - 9.2857) / 9.2857
= 13.5084 / 9.2857
= 1.455

So, despite what any previous or future reviewer might putatively or may allegedly say or have said, this illy issimo contains about 145% more caffeine per ounce than Red Bull.

But first, maybe we should be more interested in the total caffeine per can, not per ounce, because most people aren't going to choose between drinking all of a 6.8-ounce can of illy issimo on the one hand and, in, er, ON the other hand, drinking only 80.95% of an 8.4-ounce can of Red Bull; most people are going to drink all of whichever can they happen to have at hand. If that's what we're measuring, here's the math.

(155 mg - 78 mg) / 78 mg
= 77 / 78
= 0.98717
=98.7%

98.7% is so close to 1 that what this means is that you get the same number of milligrams of caffeine from a can of Red Bull as from a can of illy issimo.

****

THE NAME

Speaking of which, the name illy issimo is multiply confusing. First, it doesn't have any capital letters, which I secretly regard as presumptuous but for which I subtract no stars, although in a better world I would. It begs a typical speaker of English to think the first part of it refers the word ill, which means you're sick, i.e., you have some medical condition you wish you didn't have, which seems like a poor choice for the first name of a product designed for the sole purpose of being ingested into the body.

The whole word "illy" is indeed the legitimate if somewhat unusual adjectival form of that word ill. Illy means poorly or badly, as in, "Her review of that product was illy received by the manufacturer" or (more or less literally depending on how you interpret it), "He performed illy on his first autopsy."

That first word illy, especially because it is uncapitalized, begs native speakers of English to fill in a first letter, and the choices are billy, dilly, filly, hilly, and silly. I'll tell you that the first possibility that popped into my own personal mind was silly.

With all these problems potentially in English speakers' minds, I my own personal self would have voted against the choice of the word illy to headline the name of this product or any other, if I had been asked, which I wasn't, which is no doubt why it is named what it is, which is no good reason to subtract any stars, which I won't.

Still.

****

KOSHER!

illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè, 6.8-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) is declared to be "Kosher Certified." First and most important, that means if you restrict yourself to cans of coffee that have been kashered, you may safely drink this product without risking any bad outcomes that would arise if you didn't.

I don't know about you, but I don't want my diet controlled by centuries-dead people -- people who couldn't possibly have had access to all the information that's now available about foods and nutrition -- who espoused antediluvian rules that proscribe meat that comes from "any animal that has cloven hoofs and doesn't ruminate," which excludes from their prescribed diet such extraordinarily useful food as pigs. That so many people in 2012 refuse to eat pork products is astonishing to me. And I don't want my diet controlled by a rule that dairy products and meat may not meet, which I'm pretty sure 100% rules out a properly prepared cheddar cheeseburger, which I'm pretty sure I will never rule out of my life as long as I can operate an outdoor grill or a simple stove. I'm sure I should, by which I mean I'm sure I should forgo the cheese, but not for illy and capricious reasons but rather for health reasons, but the point is that this product IS kosher, so if you care about that then you have my blessing to go nuts.

I award 4 stars because this product delivers what it says it will unless you order a million cans, in which case you're out $38,833.33.

****

Summary: Great flavor, convenient, but has MSG and nitrites
Text:
We love pesto sauce on pasta, and on nights when I can't make my own from scratch I love having a package of the mix waiting for me.

This sauce tastes good, and has recognizable pieces of basil in it, but I won't buy it again because of the ingredients. Pesto sauce is supposed to be basil, olive oil, garlic and salt, and not much else. This product has "Beef, Mechanically Separated Chicken Water, Salt, Corn Syrup, Flavorings, Dextrose, Paprika, Hydrolyzed Corn Gluten, Soy and Wheat Gluten Proteins, Sodium Nitrite, Lactic Acid Starter Culture." Just the words "mechanically separated chicken water" put me completely off of this product. Hydrolyzed corn gluten is a fancy name for MSG It also has 480 mg of salt in each serving - each package having 3+ servings.

I like McCormick's spices, but I'll be looking for a more natural pesto sauce mix next time.

Edited 27Apr2012 to add: Thank you to Jonathan (see his comments below my review) for suggesting Simply Organic Sweet Basil Pesto. I bought it and love it!

I have had this on a regular monthly order for probably a year now, & we love it. For the two of us (1 to 1 1/2 pots a day) 4 cans last about a month. GREAT price & GREAT coffee. If they ever stop this on regular delivery, I will be one sad person. If you haven't tried auto delivery on products you use all the time, it is the cats meow. I live in a semi rural area, & it is easier to have it delivered regularly & not have to think about it.

For those who want the added spank of strong caffeine, Classic Lite is a welcome change, a break away from the "spike" of heavyweight coffees. I like my coffee on the strong side but Classic Lite is so tasty and mellow that I would simply add two more spoonfuls to the coffee machine on top of the usual load and, voila, I got a cup of delicious, "non-aggressive," extremely pleasing coffee. I always take it with agave. Classic Lite also tastes great with flavored creamers; my favorite is French Vanilla. I discovered Classic Lite after I reviewed Amazon's coffee offerings and decided to taste. I've made a note and will be making sure Classic Lite is always available in the house. Thanks, Melitta!

Summary: great brown rice pasta - by far the best!

very good and filling, perfect for a quick snack or when you won't be able to eat a meal soon
Excellent alternative to most snacks, and the fact that it has 5g. of protein is a plus.

It is awesome to find a product still exists from when you were a child.  Quaker Oats Grits have been around for quite some time and are still as wonderful as ever.  These grits do take 45 minutes of cooking time and stirring, however, the outcome is well worth the time and trouble.  These oldfashioned grits, I think, are much better than the quick variety. Summary: Great Mustard from England at a Good Price!
Text: If you enjoy mustard with good flavour and a bite to it - Colman's is quite hot but different from Chinese hot mustards - then you'll like this product.  And it is at a good price if you can order in this quantity.  The secret to getting the best taste is to mix it with COLD water, and then wait about 10 minutes to let the flavour develop.  Due to the heat you will only use it in small quantities, you don't spread it on sandwiches or burgers or hot dogs the way you spread American yellow mild mustard.  Spread thinly is my advice.  Just a touch!
This stuff is getting increasingly hard to find. Thank you for making it available and for fast shipment at a great price.

Tazo's Passion Herbal Infusion is a somewhat tart, deep, flavorful (hibiscus-y tasting) tea. It is not berry-like in taste, although it is red in color. It's difficult to describe what hibiscus tastes like, but I find it a most pleasant taste. My husband says it tastes like pomegranate to him. Although Passion contains licorice root it is not sweet.

The ingredients in Passion are: hibiscus flowers, natural tropical flavors, citric acid, orange peel, licorice root, cinnamon bark, rose hips, lemongrass and red poppy. It is caffeine-free!

Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for a super premium tea.

On the paper tea packet, Tazo writes, "A tantalizing deep red tea made from hibiscus flowers, exotic herbs and natural tropical flavors." On their web site, Tazo describes the flavor profile of Passion as "berry, juicy, wine-like, merlot, sweet, earthy, dense". Tazo describes the aroma as "sweet, juicy, red fruits".

I would rate this tea, and Tazo in general, as very good---better than premium teas like Stash or Celestial Seasonings---but not as good as other teas such as Numi, which is why Tazo Passion gets only four stars.

I was so surprised when I figured out that wild rice has protein. Good source of fiber, too. This rice is a bit more expensive than your standard white or brown rice, but it's worth it in terms of nutrition. And it tastes good.

A mix of short and long grains, with two kinds of black, two kinds of brown, and a red rice.  Lots of texture and a pleasant, nutty (I hate it when they say that but in this case I think it's accurate) flavor.
This rice is very tasty and wholesome. I used to get it locally but the grocery stores have stopped carrying it. Thankfully it is still available online.

Delicious and easy to cook. Works wonderfully in the rice maker. Great side dish to any meal. Also cooks well in soups and in the crock pot. Out of the case, two bags had live bugs in them. But I did get a prompt refund. I ordered a second case with no problems. Nutritious and delicious. The kids even love it. Another awesome gluten free food that everyone can agree on.

Lundberg makes the yummiest rice products I've ever had. I eat their brown rice cakes and now this brown rice/wild rice mixture. The brown/wild rice smells fabulously while it cooks - very nutty smelling and tasting.  Their brown rice has a distinctive Lundberg stamp taste to it. Until trying the Lundberg Blend of Wild and Brown Rice, I was not a fan of brown rice but now am happily converted!  I did rinse the rice before cooking it in the rice cooker with a splash of oil, a few extra tablespoons of water and additional cooking time until fluffy and tender.  Five stars for flavor, texture, quality, and simple to prepare.  After just one serving of Lundberg Wild Blend of Wild and Whole Grain Brown Rice, I am happy I ordered a pack of 6 bags which were well packaged and arrived within two days after I placed my order.

Summary: VEry healthy substitute for white rice
Text: I grew up in a culture that rice is an indispensable part of the daily food. We usually cook white rice but this wild rice mix is absolutely a better substitute. Compared to white rice, this rice a lot more fiber. Each pack gives you 2-4 meals, provided that you eat it with a piece of fish or chicken.

I've been into Brown rice for the last few years for the health benefits. I got a little bored and tried this Brown and wild rice blend.
It is probable the tastiest rice I've ever had. It has a sort of nutty flavor and aroma that plain rice can't match.
Just looking at it on the plate compared to plain rice it looks so much more impressive.
I use a rice cooker and when it's cooking it smells so good. In my pressurized cooker it seems to require less water than
I'm used to but with some fine tuning I made it perfectly.I always wash it first to avoid it being sticky.
I can't imagine going back to plain rice any time soon. I had company over and couldn't wait to see their reaction to this rice.
They loved the smell and the taste. I had to share one of my bags with them. I will definitely reorder before my last bag is done.
For years we avoided brown rice because it wasn't very tasty, but after trying this, we'll be eating brown rice instead of white. Lundberg rice is delicious, nutritious, and fun to eat.

These just arrived, and I was first taken aback by how small the jar is (perhaps a squat half-gallon size), and it it is a scant two thirds full, not full to the top, as shown in the picture of the product (I am aware of the issue of settling, but trust me, you can't shake these enough to come close to the volume shown, in fact it is closer half full now). It is difficult to tell from a photo, but somehow I thought it was one of the large jars you you see in convenience stores; not even close. The silver dollar size is near accurate, each round is slightly larger than a silver dollar (this is a ground and formed beef jerky, not a natural muscle meat product, so the item size is consistent). The lid bears a large red label marked for retail sales at four for a dollar, which means that for the price I just paid ($18.82 for one jar), for the purchase of the entire jar, you are getting a bonus of about four of the little rounds off the full retail price if sold individually, or just under $.23.5 per bite size round. Curiously, there is a blank where it clearly shows the product weight should be listed, but I would estimate no more than a pound, tops. As to value for the price, I'd give it maybe two stars.

This is a smoked, peppered beef jerky product, and I can see what appears to be pepper in the formed meat, but the flavor is quite mild on both counts. It isn't bad, but it's nothing to write home about, either. In all fairness, I like peppered meat, so I was looking for very peppery flavor; if you like a very mild pepper flavor you might be quite pleased. There is no natural grain to the meat, so it is sort of an odd leathery texture(much like fruit leather does not retain the original texture of the fruit). To me, this tastes about like a less salty than usual traditional jerky, which usually has some pepper; but being advertised as a peppered product, to my tastes, it falls short. I would give it a three on flavor; it tastes alright, just not a great spicy, peppery jerky.

Over all, it doesn't taste bad, and I'm not going to throw it out, but it wasn't what I expected, either value or taste wise; I wouldn't buy it again.

I have been using Willingham's BBQ rub for years on ribs, brisket, pork chops, chicken, shrimp, etc.  It is incredibly versatile and adds wonderful flavor to each dish.  The key to the effectiveness of any rub is the freshness of the spices and one whiff from this jar will convince you that you can't get generate any more freshness other than to make the rub yourself.  I have done that too and I couldn't find a recipe that has produced as many consistent compliments as Willingham's.  WARNING...ice cold beer must be consumed while cooking and eating when using Willingham's!

I use to live in Memphis, TN and actually was handed a free bottle of seasoning by the creator and owner of the company, at that time just starting. I have used this product ever since, and make sure that i have extra bottles in my cabinet. If you rub this on your ribs the night before, and put them covered in the refrigerator the night before, and then put the ribs and some additional rub in a large stew pot and cook the ribs slowly; you're in for a wonderful experience.

If you love BBQ sauce, after you take the ribs out of the water put them on a large cookie sheet after dipping them in your BBQ sauce. Cover with foil, and bake 200 degrees for 2 hours. If you really plan ahead, dipping in BBQ sauce the day before and allowing the sauce to melt into the ribs only enhances the experience.

NEVER add BBQ sauce to any meat on an open flame. The sugar will carmelize when removed from the open flame and seal the rest of the BBQ sauce flavoring out of the meat.

my favorite chocolate since young! loved it and it came early too!

This green tea is very different to all those that I have had before. It has a very delicate mix of green tea with a most delightful undertone of citrus flavor making it currently my favorite green tea.

Summary: You really need to like pepper for this product...
Text: ... and I do.  I'd never expect that black pepper and cashews would go together but they really do.  I recommend gently chopping a small handful and sprinkling them on cottage cheese!
These are tasty nuts in a convenient canister.  My only complaint is that they are a bit too salty for me.  It's hard to screw up nuts, I just wish everything wasn't so saturated with salt.

Initially the first few cashews were lightly salted and had a definite kick with the pepper that was different but still enjoyable. As you continue to munch out of the container, the salt and pepper are much heavier and totally masks the cashew flavor. I normally don't use much added salt although I do like spicy foods. I decided to rinse them off, let them air dry and then they were tasty. Mine were not oily or any of the other quality complaints I read in other reviews. I've tried other Emerald products with varying quality issues that somewhat reflect other reviewers' complaints. Amazon will replace a faulty product within 30 days which gives peace of mind and wallet when purchasing them here.

Summary: Very tasty, a few at a time.
Text:
My children and husband and I LOVE nuts! I was worried these would be too strong for the children, but the 6 year old liked it, but didn't want another. The 4 year old ate an entire handful, and said he'd like more, but only with water, and the 3 year old ate about ten before she said, "These are REALLY pepper-ish!"

I really enjoyed the strong taste - reminded me of beef jerky or something. But I could only eat a few - the taste is QUITE strong, but a very good taste! So, if you'd like some nuts that will hang around the house for a few days, these are great! Very fresh, good texture, and delicious, and you can't down the entire box in one sitting for sure.

Sra. Gose
Author of Spanish Fun Activity Calendar

Summary: Too salty and peppery for me
Text: I personally would give these a one-star rating because I thought they were awful. A friend, however, really liked them. I was disappointed after trying the cocoa flavored nuts by the same company (loved them!). These were way too salty and too peppery for my taste and left an unpleasant aftertaste.

Nuts are good for you, at least that's what I keep hearing. Cashews, I dare say, are a bit high on the fat side, but the taste is great. I like the Emerald products, not just the cashews, which are great, but also the almonds and mixed nuts. Unlike other brands, these cashews are all plump and fresh, not those sad little cashews that are used as filler. I like the salt and pepper flavor, which is delicious and just strong enough to deter one from eating too many in one sitting. These are premium nuts.

We opened and tried these cashews, and they were soon gone! The predominant flavors of the sea salt and black pepper complement each other well. The sea salt presents a more rounded and subtle salt sensation than ordinary table salt, and the onion, spice and natural flavor listed on the ingredients list no doubt to the excellent finish.

If you eat the contents of a whole container in one sitting, as we did, you may find them a bit to salty. This is not noticeable when eating just a few.
It's not that salt and pepper are a bad idea but too much is really bad.  These cashews are almost in the inedible range.  I can not recommend these at all and I really like cashews.

When you're in the mood for something savory, these really fit the bill. You get the richness of cashews contrasted with the bite of black pepper. It's a unique combination, and I give them five stars.

Sea salt, pepper, cashews---are any three words, together, more capable of evoking images of love and desire? Emerald knows just how to combine them. These cashews are so delicious I can, while eating them, close my eyes and feel I'm lounging on a divan in a pasha's fragrant tent, fanned by eunuchs as a breathtakingly beautiful member of the royal family whispers seductive parables in my ear!

Open a canister, close your eyes, and see where you're transported!

I love cashews but often steer clear of anything I haven't tried (yep creature of habit) however, when 'Emerald Sea Salt and Pepper Cashews' came up for review I figured - what the heck - might as well give them a try. The pepper is just enough to add an enticing spiciness to the nuts without overpowering them and the seasalt is perfect.

I figured I'd snack on a few and save the rest for later, well I'd eat a few close it up and minutes later open the container right back up to nab a 'few' more.

Will this replace my standard flavors - no, but I definitely won't overlook them and assume they aren't going to be to my liking anymore - I now know better.

Of course my husband is laughing at me because he's been eating salt and pepper potato chips for about the past year and I refused to even try them.

I was not expecting to like these, but was surprised to discover I had absent-mindedly eaten almost half the container while working at my desk for a couple of hours after first opening the package. I took the container to the kitchen where it managed to last a few more days.

These are an interesting variation on the traditional salted cashews. I would not buy them instead of traditional cashews, but would be happy to have them as an occasional change of pace. One star off because the onion leaves a mild aftertaste.

I think these would have been better without the pepper -- or maybe just a little less pepper. It creates a very overpowering taste. I can only eat 2 or 3 at a time.

The cashews themselves are soft and delicious. The packaging is nice -- resealable and recyclable.

So if you like salty nuts, you may like this. I prefer my nuts lightly salted and with just a little pepper.

Summary: Purchase only if you have more willpower than me
Text:
This is the easiest review I have ever written. I am in love with a nut (my spouse is too...and both of us really like these cashews).

I like cashews plain or salted...I like salt & pepper potato chips. So I couldn't say no to this product when I saw it on Amazon (I have yet to see it in my local grocery which is probably a good thing). From the first taste, I really was in snack heaven. I very easily could have eaten the entire canister. They are lightly salted & lightly peppered with just a hint of onion. There is very little pepper-burn that some aggressive chips can have. If you stick to the serving size (difficult) they're only 120 calories. Fantastic.

I don't give many five star reviews, there's always room for improvement. At 4.75 a canister, I guess these could be cheaper...but that's comparable to lower quality grocery store cashews & they taste much better.

They're also available at a slightly higher price point (per ounce) in 2 oz. packs. If you DON'T have more will power than me, I would suggest buying them that way to avoid overindulgence...but who am I to talk? I'm having a little baggie of them for breakfast right now!

Nobody likes salt more than me.  And I love cashews.  So it really means something when I tell you these are too salty.  Sorry.  I was ready to love them but it just didn't happen that way.  Seriously, I'm someone who finished a bag of pretzels and then pours the remaining salt and crumbs right down my throat.  I like salty.  But I could only eat a few of these cashews before feeling like I was baking in a kiln.

Summary: WAY too much seasoning, both pepper and salt!!
Text: I tried to like these, but they were just COVERED with salt and mostly pepper, way, way, too much.  I ended up using them in stir-fry and didn't have to add any salt and pepper to the dish!!  I don't recommend them at all unless you REALLY like lots of seasoning (and I THOUGHT I liked salt!).

Summary: A strangely exotic treat that grows on you... but bring water!
Text:
Okay, it's almost impossible to screw up cashews. So, that'll net three stars right there. The idea behind these seasonings had me worried, though. It was so obvious that someone must've been avoiding it for a reason. After enjoying them, I'm not sure why this wasn't done a long time ago. In short, the snack works. I had seen the Emerald Robert Goulet ad and knew that the company was being run by mad geniuses, but I could never find the brand. Until now. A quick breakdown...

THE BAD:
They really lay on the "sea salt." And I find the idea of "sea salt" vaguely pretentious. It all tastes like salt to this Philistine. Anyway, there's a lot of it here. Make sure you have cocktails (these go very well with martinis, gin & tonics, or scotch), sodas, or water to mitigate the mouth-puckering amount of salt.

THE GOOD:
Great container... for one person. Easily fits into a car or movie theater cup-holder. (Of course, the squatter Planter's containers double as nut bowls, but then, they're useless on the go.) If you're on your own, you can pretty much "drink" the snack out of the container. If you just lick the seasonings off the nut before biting in, as a friend of mine did, you won't get a fair idea of why they're good. The flavors -- salt, pepper, and the buttery cashew taste -- only work when you've chewed them together. At that point, food chemistry takes over and the mix takes on a sophisticated zing.

Overall, an oddball snack with an air of hoity-toity, cocktail-hour sophistication. This is the eccentric, world-traveler uncle of snacks. A wacky-yet-bland idea that works best after you've melded the flavors for a few bites. And I commend Emerald on one other point. Nuts are my favorite snack, and I tend to stick to the traditional brands -- Planter's, Diamond, Mauna Loa. These were of an equal quality -- large, not broken into pieces (mostly), faintly sweet, and very fresh.

PS --
Since writing this review, I found a similar product at World Market. The Emerald brand is far superior.

I like this tea, but I wouldn't say this is the best tasting tea.  I have had teavana chai teas and they is amazing, but pricey.  I would say you get what you pay for with this tea.  I will finish the tea but will never buy this flavor again.

This tea is my absolute favorite, I drink at least one cup every day. It's soothing at night and a delicious treat in the morning. I like the balance of the chai flavor, not too overpowering like some teas. I also feel good about my purchase because it is both fair-trade and organic. The 16-oz bag is huge, much more than I expected. All in all, I could not be more pleased. I will definitely buy again!!
Peanuts and roasted red chilli peppers.  Definitely spicy, but not unbearable.  Great flavor.  I highly recommend, you won't be disappointed.

I bought these candy rocks for decorating a dinosaur cake. They were so perfect! I used the larger jelly dinosaur eggs as large rocks near the dinosaurs, and the small rocks looked so real around a water area. They also taste great! I would use these again for sure if I make a cake with that kind of look again.

I was able to try this product yesterday and it is amazing.  Doesn't have any weird aftertaste or texture.  Just mac and cheese like you remembered when you were a kid.  Good!  Delicious! The texture is smooth with a great cheese taste.  It's super easy to prepare, just add water, heat.  Easy to take when you are traveling, need a meal on the go for your child or yourself?  Just add water and heat in any microwave, instant meal.  Most gas stations have microwaves as well as hotels and restaurants.

I bought this as well as the Pantainorasingh Thai Tea Mix on a quest to save money by making the things I like at home. This tea is very close to what I've gotten in Thai restaurants, but the price is outrageous...especially after shipping. I bought these two teas before venturing to my local Asian food market - stupid, I know. But when I got to the market, I found the price on thai mixes to be between $2.50-$4. So it's not even the shipping that makes the price high. It's good, but not enough to warrant paying the extra cost.

And if you're looking to make Thai Iced Tea, don't follow the recipe on the label. I found a recipe online that works out very well - 6 cups water, 1 cup sugar (or splenda), 1 cup tea.

Por Kwan was really quite good. I used about 3/4 cup of leaves into the coffee maker with a full pot of water. Add almost a cup of sugar and throw it in the fridge. Top with half and half and you've got exactly what they're serving in most any thai restaurant. I will order this product again.

This is by far not only one of the best gluten free pastas I've had , but one of the best pastas period.  Meaning I would pick this over most glutenous pastas.  Has a very great taste to it and will continue to buy this pasta for as long as it's around!

Summary: I LOVE this gluten free pasta
Text: I had this in Italy, loved it. Delighted to find it on Amazon. It tastes great, is not mushy or slimy.  Boil for about 8 min.

Summary: Best Gluten-Free Pasta I Have Tried
Text:
Most of the time, going gluten-free because of a recent celiac diagnosis has been fairly easy to do. You just have to remember to be vigilant, ask a lot of questions and read all labels and ingredients lists. Realistically, who is going to actually MISS crappy fast food (most of which is loaded with gluten)?

A couple of weeks ago after peppering my favorite neighborhood Italian restaurant with questions about their gluten-free preparation methods, I decided to roll the dice and order a gluten-free pasta dish.

Wow. It was so good, with the taste and consistency of regular semolina pasta, that I was extremely nervous that I had blown it. Needless to say, I was wrong and felt fine after enjoying the meal.

After trying countless gluten-free pasta types and brands: rice, buckwheat, quinoa, corn, etc. etc... Le Veneziane is absolutely hands down THE best gluten-free pasta out there period. I cannot recommend it highly enough.

The owner of the restaurant gave me some to take home and then the hunt was on to actually FIND some in a store. Then again, why bother when you can buy it by the case and get free 2-day shipping?

Summary: I thought it was French Roast...
Text:
I've bought the three pack of Taster's Choice several times. However, in my haste I bought this Original Blend rather than the French Roast. One cup and I knew something was wrong. For me, this is way too weak. I have to double the coffee to make it right.

So, why 4 stars? My wife loves this stuff (she hates the coffee I brew). She thinks the strength is just right. She also thinks I bought it just for her.

I shut my mouth, give this 4 stars, and order French Roast.

My dog loves these and they're my training treats of choice. I've only tried the chicken flavor.

They're semi-moist, not messy, and pretty small. They're not scored, but can still be halved or quartered with a sharp knife or a long fingernail. Each piece has 3 calories. For med-small dogs, you can cut them down into really tiny bits and still make a dog happy. If you quarter them, you could give 20 rewards during training and only be adding 15 calories.

The bag has a reclosable seal, and you'll need it because they dry out and get hard and crumbly if left exposed. If I take some with me away from the house, I put precut treats in a snack-sized zip bag to keep them fresh.

They also come in a larger sized bag which is more economical.
These are also a great treat to share with other dogs and is used as a training tool for my service dog
My dogs love the Zuke's treats especially the Salmon and Peanut Butter.  They work great for training purposes.  They go nuts over them!!

I have been buying these treats both on amazon and at my local pet stores for almost 2 years now.  They are the perfect size for a training treat, they fit nicely into some treat dispensing toys (like the artichoke one that Planet Dog makes), and my dog loves the taste! They are moist, but they have a tendency to get dried out if you don't reseal the bag after opening. They are made in the U.S. and don't have any wheat or corn products in them.  They're also only 3 calories each, and perfect for training since they don't completely fill my dog up!

These are perfect for training or to use inside a tipsy kong puzzle toy.  I recommend them... just be sure to properly close the bag so they stay soft (not like it mattered.. the dogs liked them either way).
My dogs love these treats, because they are so small a bag lasts a long time. It's a great value for the price.
My dog loves these. They are very small pieces so I think that is why my fifteen pound dog loves them so much
My dog loves these! I really like the tiny size of them which make them perfect for training. We will definitely be trying other Zuke's treats too!

These are softer treats, and small. But I love them because I can cut them down even smaller for training our puppy so they last a lot longer. If we keep them sealed, they stay soft. Don't leave them open. I usually put several in a smaller container and keep the big bag sealed.
Win-win solution for training treats when I forgot to make a new batch.  These are semi-moist so the dog doesn't have to chew them, and he loves them so they do make working worth it for our dog.
My dog seemed to like these, but not as much as other snacks he's been given.  And, I definitely didn't enjoy smelling the gas which was emitted after he ate these.

My two ECS eat salmon dog food and it's hard to find a salmon treat and one that is affordable when you do find them.  These are PERFECT for agility, obedience, conformation-- you name it.  They do smell strong of Salmon (which, my boys love) and like the other reviewer, they will dry out pretty quickly if not kept sealed.  That being said, my boys will not hesitate to eat them if they do get dried out from leaving them in the bait bag.  At the 4-for-3 promotion price, you can't go wrong!

This is a great treat to put inside the Premier Busy Buddy Tug-a-Jug Treat Dispensing Dog Toy.  My 60 pound 6 year old "puppy" goes nuts whenever she gets this treat/toy combo.  It is one of her favorite treats, it has a (moist treat) smell to it (which I think is tolerable and is what makes the dogs smell it from a mile away).  This bag barley lasts a month and I don't even give it to her every day.  One you open the seal, your dog will keep asking for more. Bag is resealable to help treats fresh.  Great for training too!

Just have to say that the treats are great for training. They are small enough that they don't fill up your small - medium sized dog and allow for enough time to work on a couple of tricks or actions each day. I choose peanut butter just because I know my dog loves it and we don't have to get really messy with something like a kong or anything. The overall training has been going really well with these as I can take a handful and have more than enough left for each training session. I will say that the one thing is that they are small enough that you sometimes worry that the dog is going to bite your hand and not the treat so make sure to palm feed your dog and not try to pinch the food between two fingers.

Summary: Dog Loves Treats but Bad for His Teeth
Text: My dog loves this treat and it's great for training and teaching tricks.  I would not recommend them if you have a small dog prone to dental decay.  After going through many bags of these treats I learned that small dogs prone to dental problems should not have soft or sticky treats because they may promote dental problems. I did not know this and he recently had to have 7 teeth pulled.  I don't think it was entirely the fault of this particular treat but a combination of problems, but I think it could have been a factor. Overall, these are great for training.

During training of Kaylee, our 75 lb. German Shepherd, we found that she does not like anything (treats or food) in large chunks. She is just a "dainty" eater and even the smallest Milk Bones dog biscuits were too big for her liking. When my neice gave her a bag of Zukes Mini Naturals for her 1st birthday she went crazy for them! They are PERFECT for training and she responds wonderfully. I highly recommend these if your dog is a "dainty" eater (I've never had one before) and even if they will swallow a hot dog whole (like my last dog, a Lab) these Mini naturals will be loved.
Bob
My dogs definately give this product a four paws up! These tiny bits of salmon are great to use for training. Healthy as well as tasty (apparantly), a good combination.

These treats are really small (maybe a quarter-inch square), so I can give them frequently to reinforce behavior.  My dog goes nuts for them, much more so than for any larger treat I've given her.  They keep well in a sealed container, although they do dry out if you leave them open for a long time.  The dog doesn't seem to mind, though.

We purchased these based on a pet shop owner recommendation and was not disappointed. My two chihuahuas really enjoyed these treats. Actually preferring these over the chicken. Nice bite size for training and rewards.

This is one of the few brands that have treats appropriately small enough for my Chiuaua-mix. But, having been the owner of a large dog, these would also be great for training large dogs.  Dogs don't really have a sense of size- they're as happy with a small bite as a much larger treat! And you don't want you're dog to be too busy chewing when you want to keep his/her attention and repeat a behavior.  These treats are just the right size!

Sadly my dog is NOT fond of these even though she does like salmon and anything smelly! She will eat them (the first treat she rolled on as she'll do if I give her lox) but she won't do tricks for them and acts as if they were a run of the mill dog food instead of a treat. Both my mate and I found the smell rather unpleasant similar to old B vitamins or really old liver treats, not like salmon..
(FYI My is dog is medium sized black mutt.)
UPDATE:My dog seems to be getting used to these to some degree she will now do some tricks perhaps she prefers them a little dried out (they are still soft)or even maybe she was addicted to other treats though I usually only give her wheat and gluten free treats like freeze dried liver and dogswell treats..Perhaps she's stil not crazy about them because these treats do have natural gluten in the form of malted barley and ground barley (Not that good for me in terms of cross contamination as I am gluten sensitive and perhaps she is too?) Left a message for Zukes' but never heard back from them.. They are convenient in that they are small

Summary: First Ingredient: Peanut Butter.... My Dog Loves Them
Text:
WOW. NOTE: No Wheat, Corn, Soy, Artificial Colors, Flavors and no Added Fat or By-Products. On the Label, the first ingredient is Peanut Butter. Made in USA.

My chihuahua loves these things. Although they are small, they are not as tiny as the berrybuddies we tried first (I don't even know what to do with those, they fall out at alarming rates from the buddy-toys hole).

These - - he can chew, it's like he's eating peanut butter for a moment. He doesn't just woof them down - he actually eats them. I give him one at a time, and he sits and chews it for 10-20 seconds - much like peanut butter I would imagine. They fit perfectly in the KONG toys (but not the busybuddy ones, they are smaller holes).

The chicken ones were a bit too flavored for him - so I pinch them in half and add a few to his food - then he loves it - mixed with his food & warm water. I want to try all the flavors!

I also like that the company supports a cause with each bag purchased. Very natural, very chewy little things, and my dog LOVES them. Very good value. Will be keeping these around for sure.

the ingredients and reviews for these treats seem great, but they gave my dog the runs.  (peanut butter)  Every dog is different, I guess.  These treats are also not grain free, if that's important to you.
my finicky dog (small yorkie mix) just loves these little peanut butter snacks. so glad that I came across these!

This product is great for what it is, it is better than the KitchenAid one and better than the hand crank devices which are also grinders. The problem with this which in my opinion isn't really a problem is you get a little air in the tube when you pack the meat in there. Also, it is sometimes difficult to get the casing on the nozzle but again considering what it is and how much it cost these are problems that plague almost every stuffer in my experience. The nice part about this stuffer is the amount of control you have, no machine is cranking it out faster or slower. You also know exactly how much meat will be forced out with each pull of the trigger. There are better stuffers out there but this is a perfect in between the ones that are $100+. Avoid the KitchenAid for stuffing, I used the KitchenAid for grinding but then use this stuffer. Great quality and easy to clean.

The reason for the poor review is that there was NO safety protection for this herb.  No plastic wrapping, no safety seal.  Who wants to use food products that are not protected?  Did someone buy this, decide they didn't like it and pawn it back off on someone else?  This is a definite safety concern.

Summary: Great tea, would make a nice gift
Text:
All the flavors are very rich and make a large mug of tea. I typically make a 14-16 oz mug with a single bag and let it steep a little longer than usual. There was no one flavor that was outstanding relative to the rest, they are all great. I had previously tried the black tea from tea forte and I did not like them as much as they did not have as much flavor as these.

The box is quite nice and I plan to keep it when I am done with and use it to store items in (perhaps use it to take a collection of other tea bags to work).
This mix makes cookies that are so good it's not worth making them from scratch anymore. If it weren't so expensive, I'd give it five stars.

This is a great strong roast, my husband and I drink it daily. We were drinking the Maxwell House morning blend, but we prefer the richer flavor of this one. There are no better prices on T-discs than on Amazon!
This was a great deal.  So much Clamato! The bottles are big, but the value is unbeatable and they all shipped quickly and are delicious. Perfect for bloody marys or smoothies.

I ordered the 6paxk so I would be able to play around with the flavors. I figured I probably would not like the eggnog or the chai but I was wrong. Okay- so the chai won't be my favorite but I know my friends will like it.  What's great about the Amoretti  6pack is each bottle comes with its own pump. They are pretty concentrated so you won't need but half a pump per cup of coffee or whatever you use it for. The customer service is awesome -I received my package 2day !!!  I had ordered the peppermint along with my 6 pack but instead received a Hazelnut.  I contacted customer service and they responded very quickly and were extremely helpful in correcting the problem !! Shout out to Paul  for your help. !!! Oh- and before I forget, each flavor is true to what it's suppose to be and not a flavored sugar syrup !! You will be happy that you ordered this !!!
With these flavorings there is no need for me to add sugar.  I just add some of whatever flavor I am in the mood for.

As I have always said, Anchovies make everything taste better and thats
never been truer than this awesome combination.

Leave it to Goya, the Number 1 purveyor of Spanish food products in the
US market, perfect hand-picked Manzanilla olives and minced anchovy loins
in a really cool pop-top can. Just rip off the lid and pour them in a
bowl for your friends to chow down on. The thing about anchovies, and why
Lea and Perrin's tastes so good, is because they are blessed with a magic
extra 5th flavor that always leave you wanting more.

Four olives = 25 measly calories so don't listen to your health nut friends
that tell you "olives are fattening"...they aren't. And a couple of these
in your martini will make you kick yourself for not having discovered these
wonderful olives at a younger age.

I got hooked on the House Blend at a gas station near the house. When I found out they had it in the k-cups I immediately stocked up. It's not too acidic (like Columbian) and not too weak (like a breakfast blend). It's my go to coffee for just about any time of the day. Definately worth a try if you have never had it!

Summary: Nice, Smooth Medium Blend. Good Cup of Coffee
Text:
This Van Houtte blend is a nice, smooth solidly medium blend. It is not acidic at all. It is slightly stronger with a touch more flavor than Wolfgang Puck Breakfast in Bed (Medium Roast), 24-Count K-cups (Pack of 2) and is comparable to Coffee People, Donut Shop K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50).

Not too weak, not too strong. Solid medium blend. Recommended for those who like medium blend coffee.

Once again Van Houtte scores as my favorite coffee brand. I usually like flavored coffees but decided to get this for friends and family that want "real" coffee. This has a full bodied flavor that is very good.

My very favorite brand of k-cups! So much so I signed up for automatic delivery , which results in free shipping and an unbeatable price. It is a nice medium roast, no bitter after taste. Just like a fresh brewed pot of coffee in every cup.
This was my first time buying this one and I LOVE IT!  YOu won't be dissapointed.  Smooth and not bitter at all.  LOVE IT and will order again!
This coffee is okay, it's not the best tasting, but it's not the worst.  I would buy it again.

I would buy the snack pack during my flights on United Airlines just for these delicious olives. After a long wait and numerous attempts at contacting the company directly to buy the Oloves, I'm soooo delighted to hear they are available on Amazon.

I use to like eating olives, but I now love eating Oloves.
I love shockers and usually buy them a target, this was a really good price and i gave the second box of rolls to my daughter when she moved into her dorm.

I totally agree with the reviewer that said that this was their favorite candy but their order from Amazon was stale. I love these things and hoped for a different experience. Unfortunately the Shockers I received are super stale and take a lot of effort to chew.
Best cookies ever. Bought these for my Dad as a birthday present. Try them and you will be hooked. Arrived fresh and in a very cool box.

On cold winter evening my husband and I enjoy drinking hot chocolate while sitting in front of the fire watching a good movie. This is the best hot cocoa mix we have tried yet ... it is delicious! Of course we also like to add a bit of Bailey's Irish Cream, which makes it even better. YUM!
I was given these as a gift and immediately went to the net to find the other flavors available.  It's some of the best hot chocolate I've tried.
I love this mayo and it is one of the healthiest mayos available at this time. I highly recommend it.
Very good product.  Shipped quickly.  My cat is 19 and needs renal food.  She likes Neo a lot, especially the gravy.

love these popcorn. i cannot stop eating them! I would consider these popcorn as an upgraded cracker jacks, but organic. my fiance also agrees on how delious these popcorns are and he says "these are addicting".
This is a superb olive oil for salads. It is very pricey however. So it is to expensive to use for cooking.

Summary: Flavorful! Arrives in good shape. No peanuts here!  Repeat buyer.
Text:
Nice to have a source for this great Chex Mix. It hits the spot!

Chex Mix of old had peanuts. No longer, so enjoy this without fear of peanut allergies!

I was satisfied with this product. Being a food item, for using in recipes, not much to say either way on it. I need it for gluten free baking and the packaging and delivery were as expected. Sweet Rice flour adds a but of dough enhancement to hold it together a bit better than just white rice flour. I am always pleased with the quality of Bob's Red Mill products.

Summary: Delicious by the handful, or as a cereal.
Text:
Dark chocolate and berries is one of my favorite flavor combinations. I have a weakness for healthy snacks like granola and trail mix. Except they aren't so healthy when you finish a whole bag in a single day, a handful here, a handful there. I decided to avoid doing that with the Love Crunch Granola by treating it like cereal.

I served myself 1/3 cup of granola (which is more than a serving) and poured a little 1% milk on it. It's perfect! There is a good balance of smaller crumbles and larger chunks in the chocolate-flavored granola. The dark chocolate squares and dried berries are just right ... enough to be savored without overpowering the granola. The granola stays crunchy in the milk without being difficult to chew. (I have TMJ and sometimes crunchy granolas are hard and bother my jaw.)

It was a decadent snack and I will enjoy the bag. Hopefully I can savor it over the course of several days and don't give into my compulsion to sneak handfuls throughout the day. Hopefully I can enjoy at least one more bowl before my teenage daughter discovers it's open and finishes it off for me.

This granola did not disappoint me in any way. It was deliciously perfect!

I really like granola, especially the Nature Valley bars, but this Love Crunch Chocolate Berry mix is beyond delicious!! It is so good, it can be very, very dangerous for those (like me) trying to watch their weight. Granola is good for you, but can also be high in calories, which makes moderation key. This product is kind've high in calories considering the serving. It's 140 calories a serving, but a serving is only 1/4 cup (30 grams). Please see my pictures of an actual serving of this granola. That's not very much when it comes down to it. Thankfully, it packs a lot of flavor, so a small amount goes a long way in yogurt, cereal, or pudding. I can't wait to mix some with Chobani. I think this would also be great in baked goods likes muffins or breads. It wasn't dry, like many granola mixes I have tried. And I was pleasantly surprised at the amount of chocolate pieces. There are plenty so that you really do get some in every serving. I would have liked to have more fruit pieces, but there was enough in the bag to give a noticeable fruity flavor boost and a good contrasting texture. I truly wish they offered this in a single-serve size bar.

The bag is a good sized 11.5 ounces, and the Amazon price for 6 bags is quite reasonable (less than $4 a bag as of this writing). Having 6 bags in the house would be torture for me, so I'll stick to buying this one bag at a time in a supermarket. But, I WILL buy it. For a family, the bulk option is a good deal. The bag is also ziplock, which is great for staying fresh longer. I keep mine in the freezer to maintain freshness, and because chocolate is just so much better cold :-) Overall, highly recommended!

Summary: Very goood, much better than expected
Text:
I was really pleasantly surprised with how good this granola was. I am not usually a granola eater. Yes, I know it is supposed to be good for you - but whenever I had eaten it in the past granola just tasted dry. Tasting this and wow - this taste really good! The rolled oats have a nutty flavor with just enough spice. Okay - evaporated cane juice is the second ingredient on the label - so I am sure the sweet flavor is what is really doing it for me.
The dark chocolate chunks have a really good flavor - not as bitter a taste as I normally find with dark chocolate.
The freeze dried fruit has a nice sharp taste, but this is where my only complaint comes into play - there just aren't many of the fruit chunks in the bag. I was surprised that there were more chocolate chunks than fruit chunks - almost at a ratio of 3 to 1. While this doesn't kill the product for me, the nice contrast you get with the fruit chunks is nice so having more would be good. My young kids also like the sour "pop" they get from the fruit chunks so having more for them to munch on would be a bonus.
A serving size is 1/4 cup (a little small, this is good and I can eat it by the handful)
140 calories per serving
55 calories from fat
6g total fat
2 g dietary fiber
6g sugars
2 gram protein

Nothing in the ingredients worries me - I can pronounce all the words and even the oils and sweetners are okay in my book (evaporated cane juice, soy oil). In addition to the rolled oats there is also spelt, flax seeds, and dried coconuts - things I just wouldn't eat otherwise. Another bonus - Non GMO verified which I am very happy about.

The bags are a good size (11.5 oz) with about 10 servings per bag. Since you get 6 packs I would think it would take you a while to get through all of these unless you eat it every single day. I think the price is fair for what you get and I would actually purchase these for the family and feel good eating them. I must admit, I am still shocked about liking granola!

I have to admit I never tasted Granola before in my 63 years. But after a heart attack I had spent the past 2-3 years as an avid juicer, plus bought a Vitamix & use it faithfully as well. Now this isn't the most healthy of snacks given its 140 calories in a single serving size of 1/4 cup.....but that 1/4 cup goes a LONG way in satisfying any "treat" cravings you may have. In the long run it will SAVE you calories as it honestly stops a lot of cravings. I have my serving with a cup of decaf coffee and find I don't even feel the need for breakfast, PLUS feel like I just plain start my morning on the right foot. Kind of nice to begin my day every single day rewarding myself and not feeling like I do it with junk food.

If it had not been for the Vine program I admit I would have gone to my grave never having ever even tasted granola. Now as it turns out I will be ordering this and plan to continue using it as my guilty free snack. Not sure why but I never feel like I am forced to watch my portions since while 1/4 cup sounds small in theory, when eaten it completely satisfies and I never feel like I "need" more. This is now one of about a dozen items I have tried on Vine that I end up buying on my own to continue. Even more rare, it EARNS an honest 5 out of 5 stars.

In general I advocate against consuming grains or cereals. However "Love Crunch" is made with reasonably good ingredients (the primary ingredient is rolled oats) and blended to an enjoyable chocolate flavor. Spelt is one of the healthier forms of wheat, it's far more desirable (nutritionally) than modern wheat.

The sugar to fiber ratio is three to one (six grams of sugars to two grams of fiber per serving) which isn't the best of all cereals but it's reasonable.

You've got to love all the healthy ingredients: chocolate, flax seeds, coconut and fruit.

For a "processed food" this one isn't too bad.

So, I opened the bag just to have a quick taste to see if I would put a little sprinkling of this granola on my homemade yogurt in the morning..... Yea, hubby and I couldn't keep our hands out of the bag. Well, what is not to love, dark chocolate and little freeze dried berries and nice big pieces of granola. Delicious! Nutritionally, you are getting 140 calories, 55 from fat, 6g of total fat, 1 g of saturated fat, no transfat, no cholesterol, 55 mg sodium, 2g fiber, 6g sugar and 2 g of protein, 2% vitamin c and 4% iron. Serving size is 1/4 cup and the bag serves 10.

Likes-organic, 33% of your daily omega 3's, delicious chocolate, sweet berries, tasty granola in nice big chunks. Oh, did I mention a nice little serving of whole grains? This food is Non GMO-I believe this is non-genetically modified. A portion of the proceeds of the sale go to food banks which is also way cool in my humble opinion. I also like reading the ingredients and not seeing a bunch of words I can't pronounce and wouldn't want to put in my body. Just good old normal ingredients that you know.

Dislikes-um, the bag seems small now? Really, can't seem to come up with a con on this one. I have never purchased from Nature's Path before, but if I happen to see this I would definitely buy. It is delicious and I normally make my own granola, so I'm a bit picky and used to a really natural granola.

All said, great product that I would definitely buy and would recommend to others.

About 30-40% of the population of Central Europe has trouble digesting fructose. If you have trouble digesting fructose, it can cause a lot of unexplained abdominal pain.

This is almost 100% fructose.

Personally, I spent about two months with very bad, mysterious abdominal pain that seemed to be everywhere. After several weeks of doctor visits, discussions about IBS, and an abdominal ultrasound that came up normal, I started thinking about what was different in my diet: I had been using agave nectar in my tea several times a day. After throwing out the agave nectar and looking online for a list of lower fructose food, I changed my diet, a little.

The pain went away in a matter of days, and hasn't returned.

If you're using agave nectar and you have suddenly started having digestive issues, try getting rid of the agave nectar. For some people, this is really bad stuff.

Note to gluten-intolerant folks: fructose malabsorption can go along with being gluten sensitive or intolerant. If you're wondering why you're still sick if you're following a gluten-free diet, this may be the culprit.

Summary: A healthy and natural hairball remedy that's hugely popular at our house
Text:
The senior cat in our fairly finicky 3-cat household has a foot injury that's taking a very long time to heal, so I've had to close off feline access to the patio where my cats like to graze. Hairball upchucks ensued in short order. The Cosmic grass seed from the pet store was a big hit, but it's been out of stock for weeks now. Which is how we came to try this. Was a tad worried about how quickly my guys would do away with the contents of such a wee small garden-in-a-bag. But the crop it produced is much more dense than other kitty grasses we've tried and is still going strong after a couple of weeks on the floor next to their water dish--despite heavy use. It often gets tipped over, but since nothing ever spills out, that's not a problem. My cats, for some reason, won't eat snipped grass scattered over their food. They will only chomp greenery straight from the source. This product is perfect for that.

Update 11/30/11: First batch lasted a full five weeks. Have ordered more.

Summary: GREAT DEAL, GREAT PRODUCT, GREAT HEALTH SNACK!
Text: I believe in Sun-Maid raisins :-)... it is one of my all time favorite snacks since childhood. Lately I was passing it by because of the high price in my local stores.  Buying it from this site is the best deal anywhere. My order came quickly, the raisins came well packaged, and was soft and fresh. Also very reasonable priced for a fantastic amount.  I'm "raisin" everything now, from oatmeal cereal to cookies and fruit cakes. They are simply delicious! I will definitely be re-ordering.

Sun Maid Raisins provide an excellent snack for persons on the go who want quick energy; they are also healthy for just about anyone, too. They are fat and cholesterol free and they don't have sodium. Raisins contain dietary fiber as well. Moreover, just 1.5 ounces equals one serving of the fruit we need to have in our diets every day. Excellent!

The packaging allows for easy transport and the stay fresh reclosable zipper works well. If for some reason the zipper on your bag doesn't work then use a tie from a loaf of bread or something similar to keep the package closed.

Moreover, Amazon correctly notes that these raisins are delicious with yogurt and cereal. They can be used in salads and numerous other recipes, too. I add them to hot oatmeal in the morning to give the otherwise bland oatmeal a natural sweetness that wakes up my taste buds big time! SMILES

Unfortunately, raisins contain few vitamins and they do contain some carbohydrates. Amazon also notes that these raisins "may contain an occasional grape stem or wood piece." Consult your doctor if this concerns you. I wish they contained vitamins; this disappoints me so I will take off one star to make this a four star review.

Overall, however, Sun Maid raisins provide us with a healthy alternative to candy bars and junk food when we need that snack or burst of sugar energy. They help us get the fruit we so badly need in our diets and the packaging allows us to carry them around easily.

Okay, so I read all of the negative reviews, and was SO hesitant to order these noodles. I am thankful for the negative reviews however since they had me expecting the worst. I was so pleasantly surprised to find that following some of the positive reviewers recipes, they were a godsend for someone like me, following a low carb diet. I've included one of my own concoctions at the end of this review.

Fishy smell? Yeah, but like others have written, if you rinse them it goes away, and after drying them off (I dry them off on a hot frying pan with no oil) the smell is completely gone. The smell wasn't really an issue for me though, since I don't mind the fishy smell so much.

True, the texture isn't exactly like the texture of traditional noodles, but I have to agree with the other optimists...It's an awesome alternative.

So, my favorite recipe is for one serving, and a total of 5 net carbs. This includes an entire package of the Fettucini style Miracle Noodles (yes...I eat the whole package. hahaha):

Get the following ingredients ready before throwing the noodles on the hot frying pan
2 tablespoons water
2 tablespoons unsweetened heavy cream
2 tablespoons Campbell's Cream of Chicken and Mushroom soup
1 teaspoon of a low carb Szechuan seasoning (they're not listed as low carb, you just have to find one with a low to no sugar content. The one I use has less than 1 gram of carbs per teaspoon)
50 grams (1.8 ounces) of raw broccoli
30 grams (1.1 ounces) of raw spinach
113.4 grams (4 ounces) of chopped chicken (I like to buy the already cooked, rotisserie chickens from Costco)

Rinse the noodles, and then put them in a hot frying pan to dry off
Once the noodles are dry, add the Szechuan seasoning until the noodles are coated,
add the heavy cream, the Cream of Chicken and Mushroom soup, and then the water followed by the chicken.

Allow the chicken to warm up before adding the veggies.

I add the broccoli and the spinach last, but just enough to get them coated with the creamy sauce, 'cause I like my veggies crunchy. :-)

As of 5/28/11, it is substantially cheaper than the standard Guayaki label. The San Mateo label also seems to show less yerba stems and seeds. The reason I deducted one star is the presence of (even still) too many stems and seeds as well as the uncompetitive price. Guayaki badly needs to filter their Yerba leaves in their existing products or offer a different label with pure, refined leaf. Other yerba mate' vendors offer this and it is a gaping hole in Guayaki's product line. Even though this product is more affordable than the rest of the Guayaki yerba mate' line, it is still very expensive compared to other organic and traditional yerba mate' labels from other companies. An adjustment to competitive pricing as well as attention to filtering the yerba leaves would give this product 5 stars.

Summary: Lovely delicate green tea - which just happens to be decaf
Text: I adore this Celestial Seasonings Decaffeinated Green Tea! Before this, I had been drinking Stash Premium Green (with caffeine).  I had heard bad things about the taste of decaf teas in general so I was hesitant to try this decaf version from C.S. But, WOW, am I glad I did. This tea has so much more flavor, is so much more delicate and lovely than Stash could ever hope to be. And this is decaf! Remember when you brew green tea - it is best to use water that isn't quite hot enough to boil - that keeps your cup of green tea from getting bitter. (Conversely, black and herbal teas are best made boiling water) Also, do not brew it too long - meaning, don't go longer than the recommended time noted in the box flap - or you'll release more tannins and experience slight bitterness. Personally, I brew mine on the weak side (3 minutes) with not quite boiling water, I add 1/2 tsp of sugar, and milk .... pure heaven in a cup. Lovely fragrance, taste, and aftertaste. Others might say milk overpowers green tea, but I enjoy it. I believe this tea only contains 5 mg of caffeine per cup (decaf is never 100% free of caffeine) so you may drink it at night without worry about staying up all night, or if you doc recommends cutting down on caffeine, or if you simply want to give your tummy a break from irritating caffeine - this is the ticket. Enjoy!

Summary: Not the real thing in my opinion
