The best thing about these cookies is that they do work. The first time I used them, I lost 13 lbs in 5 weeks! With no exercise. And that was without following the suggested plan exactly. Instead of eating all 6 cookies + dinner and nothing else, I ate 4 cookies during the day, a sensible dinner (probably around 500 calories, but I wasn't really counting), and had a cereal snack bar with hot chocolate made from skim milk for my evening snack.

I stopped with the diet cookies at Thanksgiving 2009, and ate the holiday junk all through December and January. Now (March), I am back on the cookies. I had gained back 8 of the 13 lbs I had lost, but have now lost 2 lbs in 3 days on the cookies. This time around, I am exercising too, but very carefully, since my caloric intake is so low.

When I started with the cookies, I was very nervous about the taste. I am VERY picky about how things taste, and diet cookies just didn't sound very appealing. They really aren't bad. I mean, don't get me wrong, these aren't Oreos. If they were, I'd eat the whole bag in one meal, which would completely defeat the purpose! But they are edible. I have only been eating the blueberry and the chocolate ones (I don't like bananas or coconut, so I figured a diet cookie with those flavors would be even worse), and they actually taste like blueberries and chocolate. There are actually blueberries in the blueberry ones. The chocolate ones smell kind of funny, a lot like protein. But they taste much better than they smell. In fact, my 3 year-old daughter is always asking to "share Mommy special cookies" because she likes them so much (she gets a little bite off of one every so often).

The cookies are kind of small, but are surprisingly filling. I can eat one cookie every 2 hours, and not be hungry in between. In fact, I can almost set my clock by my hunger pangs. As soon as I feel hungry again, I eat another cookie. The cookies are very dense, so they also take me about 10 minutes each to eat. They are a tad dry, but that probably lends to the desire to drink more water, which I do. In fact, I usually hate water, but when I eat these cookies, I crave it, so I drink probably 8 times more water eating the cookies as I do when I don't eat them, which is an added health (and diet) benefit.

They are also great in that they help me get over my emotional eating habits. These cookies are not "comfort food"; I eat them so that I'm not hungry. Over time, they cut down on my desire to be emotionally fulfilled by food. It actually took me almost one full month to go back to my emotional eating habits when I stopped eating the cookies the last time. Since these cookies are not intended to be a forever diet, this separation of emotions from food is a very good thing. Now that I am aware of it, I will just need to be more careful once I reach my desired weight goal and go off the cookies to make sure I don't allow my old habits to once again take hold.

They are a bit pricey for my liking, but most diet food is. And they last me a while, since I have 2 cookies left over every day.

Overall, I really like them. They get an immediate result, which motivates me to keep going. I am working on getting sick of them, but that's a problem I have with any food I eat a whole lot of (I miss pb&j sandwiches, but I overloaded in 5th grade). I doubt many other people would have that issue.
I couldn't find these locally.  The flavor is perfect and roasting made them a woderful addition to Christmas baking.  I'll be using the rest for some main dish recipes.

Gorant's pecan tootles are just awesome! There is just something special about this combination of Gorant's subtle chocolate, a really chewy carmel, and perfect pecans. We've moved a lot and tried many other brands, but keep coming back to Gorant's.

We spare no expense in sending these across the country to family that has moved away from the Youngstown area but still craves these special treats. Try them and you'll understand why.
This seasoning is amazing! I didn't even have to add any salt, and the flavor of my greens were as close to that of my late great aunt as any I've tasted.
Wow! My mouth was on fire! I think I need to call an ambulance when I pop a couple of these hellish nuts in my mouth.  Looking for Hellfire and Damnation with a side of Brimstone?  Look no further!

My son is very picky about deodorants.  He doesn't like the smell of most.  He had been using a particular product that did not have a scent; however, it wasn't working very well.  I am so thankful that he finally found Axe Dark Temptation.  I'm not crazy about the way that it has been marketed, but he likes the product and it works for him!

I ordered these for some family members and they were delicious (or at least that's what I heard). One person even told me it was the best jerky they'd ever had. I would definitely buy these again - they make such a wonderful gift for the person who has everything.

Seems like a very average shampoo....

Item arrived a sticky mess as it leaked out during shipping. The smell is pleasant, texture creamy and perfect consistancy. I've used on my hair for over a week without any noticeable changes for the better. I agree with other reviewers that it doesn't appear to make it fuller, but instead feels slightly more fly away. I am also using the matching conditioner.

Overall it's worth a try when switching up from your normal shampoo, but it's not going to be my new every day shampoo.

This pleasant-smelling shampoo goes on sleekly and washes out completely, leaving no residue.

In addition, the container is very shower-friendly. I have a small space, having to keep everything in one small hanging caddy. This shampoo has a tall slender shape, taking up very little space compared to other bottles.

I received this item via the Amazon Vine Program to test and review and I must say that I am happy so far with this shampoo.  I have fine hair and after shampooing, my hair feels and looks great, better results than from the other shampoos I have been using.  This shampoo has a light, pleasant scent and lathers very nicely.  I am happy thus far with this shampoo ... It works great, leaving my hair clean and healthy. I would recommend.
I usually prefer shampoos without sulfates, but this product left my hair soft and shining and smelling good!  A nice shampoo that is "nourishing", as it claims, and left my hair in nice condition.

This shampoo is a cream shampoo that claims to nourish the scalp, but the second ingredient, sodium laurel sulfate, is a known scalp irritant. The shampoo is also tinted pink, as is the matching conditioner. I don't like using hair products with dyes because they stain my hair. It is also heavily scented. I won't use it again, and I wouldn't recommend it for anyone else.

Summary: The Best Colombian Coffee you can get - from Starbucks!
Text:
Having tried many Colombian Coffees including Specialties; there just isn't any that comes close to the one that my old Colombian friend who resided here for awhile while attending University and as Hospital Intern before returning back home; having tried Colombian Coffee from her own homeland. I just couldn't find anything that came closest except Starbucks Colombia which is only a Medium Roast Blend but close enough to what I had drank from what she bought over from her own Country in Colombia.

I was surprised to learn from her she was disgusted here in "Americas" of what they had deemed as Colombian coffee when it was merely a mixture of this and that, showing me the labels; that was when I began to start reading coffee labels. Furthermore, she even indicated that while they do grow coffee beans in Colombia, but a small percentage of them are actually pure Colombian. So much did I learn what the Colombians did, With her being gone, no idea if she has returned back to the USA or is stuck in Colombia. But one thing she taught me that I never had forgotten was "READ THE LABELS". I was even surprised by some of the expensive, imported 100% Colombian coffee were not, but rather a mixture of this and that with Colombian coffee being at the very bottom of the list! I guess the saying still rings true, "if it's too good to be true, it prolly is..."

Not so with Starbucks Colombia Coffee!

Whenever I drink this, I remember her brothers, her families, and of course her - whether I am at Starbucks or at home. To some, might find this rather strong, but I never use the exact dosage, I use less for that reason - for it is so rich and full of flavor, there is no need to waste it. I keep mine sealed, and yes, in a Freezer Zipped Bag to keep its freshness.

I also use this for Iced Coffee as well during hot summer dog days of the months, it is refreshing.

14 out of 24 cans arrived dented, due to inadequate packaging (boxes were shrink wrapped to a cardboard tray and then thrown in a shipping box with a small amount of butcher paper). Dense material like canned goods should be surrounded with packing peanuts in order to arrive undamaged. Needless to say, I will not order canned goods again through Amazon.

This is not the end of the story. Amazon's standard policy on damaged food is 10%, or 20% maximum discount. In this case, 58.3% of the food arrived damaged--and no way was I going to pay for what I won't use. After 1/2 hour on the phone, the customer service manager granted me an "exception" and allowed a refund of 58.3% of my purchase price. But I should not have had to waste so much of my time insisting on it.

That said, Harmony Farms dog food itself is a great product. The reason I'm willing to pay almost $2 per can is that it's made in the USA (no danger of melamine, etc.). So there you have it. Good product, but you'll probably be happier if you find a place to buy it locally.

Summary: Creamy, pleasant shampoo -- leaky bottle detracts
Text:
I used CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Shampoo for about a week. It's a very creamy shampoo, and a little goes a very long way. I have long, thin hair, and I like shampoos that don't weight it down, but make it feel fuller and lusher. This did that. There is a floral scent, which may or may not be pleasing to all users. I found it stronger in the bottle than on my hair, which was left gently scented after blow drying.

I did use this with the companion conditioner, CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Conditioner, 12.7 Fluid Ounce, so I can't comment on whether or not the shampoo on its own works to "volumize" hair. The label does suggest massaging the shampoo into the scalp (to nourish the roots) -- I did this, but whether it works or not will be determined over time.

The leaky bottle seems to be an issue with most of the reviewers here. The shampoo arrived wrapped in plastic, and then in bubble wrap. The bottle has one of those push-down lids, which is simply too loose to seal properly for shipment. I didn't lose as much of the product as some reviewers did, but the bottle was a sticky mess that had to be cleaned off before using.

Bottom line, this is a serviceable shampoo that left my hair feeling soft and full.

I received & reviewed the dandruff formula version of this shampoo prior to using this. I loved it and got great results; however, I was no fan of the overpowering scent. Happily, the fragrance in this one is far less overwhelming, and the results as just as good if not better. I love this shampoo. It is my current favorite, and I intend to buy this well after my freebie runs out.

Speaking as someone with fine, oily hair which must be washed everyday in the summer, this leaves my hair clean without feeling stripped. It also does a good job removing product build-up. It's truly better than many of the salon brands I have tried. Overall, a winner.

Summary: Great Product and Even Better Design
Text:
Having turned the product over to the women-folk for their analysis, it received a positive review. I honestly don't know much about shampoo and usually just use the soap from the dispenser at the gym, so my level of expertise in this area is less than zero.
However, they like it for several reasons. First, it seems they like the over quality, fragrance, and all that stuff. Second, the design is great. The bottle can be stored with the tab at the bottom so that you don't have to shake the living daylights out of it when it gets half full.
It's nice to see a bottle of shampoo that hasn't been squeezed so hard it looks like it's been mangled by a bear.
Points for quality and design. I'll be picking more up soon.

Summary: Worked fine, won't replace my usual
Text: The Clear Scalp and Hair Beauty etc. shampoo worked fine to clean my hair, (medium length, very fine, very naturally curly), and it left my hair soft and as manageable as curly hair can be in a humid summer climate.  However, I noticed my hair and scalp felt slightly grungier than usual the day after shampooing.  This made me suspect it may not rinse out as cleanly as my usual brand (Pantene Fine Hair Solutions Volume Shampoo). The shampoo is very strongly scented,  somewhere between fruity and floral.  I didn't care for the fragrance, but I didn't notice it once my hair was dry.  Presumably it is being packed differently when shipped to retailers, as I, too, had shampoo all over the package when I opened it.

Was excited to try this shampoo due to the volumizing claims. I have very thick, heavy hair that just hangs there, so am always on the lookout for something to pump up the volume! Maybe it would work on someone with finer hair, but it did not give me the hoped-for results.

It arrived in an envelope, with the bottle wrapped in plastic. Sending shampoo in an envelope seemed like a strange choice, as mine had leaked enough that I needed to wash the bottle off. The shampoo has a pleasant scent, and comes out of the bottle thick and creamy. Lathered up nicely and was easy to rinse out. It cleaned my hair, but did nothing more after several weeks of usage, so don't think I would buy it.

I really like this shampoo. Not a lot is required for a full head of suds, but more importantly is the softness and shine it gives your hair.
My hair is very fine and has thinned over the years. I'm not quite sure this product makes my hair look any thicker, but it does appear to have more body.

I will continue to use this product.

Thank you.
MEF

This shampoo is supposed to volumize and nourish the hair. I'll have to use it more. It smells good, suds are very thick and rinses clean. Doesn't make my hair dry. The one problem I had was the way they shipped it. It leaked in the envelope and the plastic bag they had it in. Wasted half of the bottle.

Summary: Just so so.....shipping issue as well
Text:
My shampoo was shipped in a bubble envelope and when I opened it the inside was a wet, goopy mess. The shampoo bottle was place in a plastic bag first, and then into the bubble envelope, but there was a slit in the plastic bottle and I list about 1/4 of the product as a result.

Once I rinsed the bottle, I put it in the shower to try the following morning. The shower seat was a goopy mess as well. Apparently there was a second leak from the bottom somewhere.

I decided to try the shampoo anyway. I have very fine hair, but quite a bit of it. My hair tends to look good when I wash it and dry it, but then go flat within an hour. I was unsure about how this would work as it felt more like a cream rinse when I applied it than a shampoo. I found it a bit hard to rinse out, and although my hair looked fine when I blew it dry, I did not have any extra volume like I was hoping -- based on the advertising.

It wasn't awful in any way, but it isn't one I would buy again. Plan to stick with eith my Paul Mitchell or Redkin favorites for now.

Summary: Really does add a little volume
Text: I have super straight, baby-fine hair that has been my despair all my life.  Mess with it much, trying to give it volume, and you'll give it distress, which it shows by becoming yet more fine and breaking off.  So I was very interested to see if this shampoo could help.  And it really did give my hair a little extra bounce.  Not a huge amount, but there was a discernable difference.  It has a nice fragrance, too, and my hair feels really clean without any residue on it.  My only gripe is the bottle.  It's smaller at the bottom than it is at the top, and shaped oddly, too.  That's fine when it's in the little pocket holder in my shower, but when I get it out to use it, it's very easy for it to get unbalanced and fall over.  But, it's not that big a deal, overall.  I plan to try the conditioner, too.

I have straight fine hair, so I am always looking for ways to make my hair look more full. I can usually tell after a week of use if a volumizig shampoo really works or not; thankfully this works better than the Pantene for Fine Hair that I tried.

The lather is rich, which feels great when shampooing, and I get about as much lift as I do with blow-drying my hair upside down. I was pleasantly surprised at how the lift lasts most of the day.

The only thing I didn't like was the scent - too perfume-y for me, but my husband & son told me they thnk it smells nice like flowers. :)

Summary: Did Get Some Volumizing + Curls Seemed to Last Longer
Text:
I have fine hair so even though I have lots of hair, I do like to find products that increase the volume.

I used this product for about a week and it did seem to make my hair look thicker. I just HATE hairspray plus I think I used my fair share back in the '80s so I never use the stuff now and after using this shampoo and curling my hair with hot rollers or my curling iron, it did seem like my curls lasted longer than when I use my normal daily shampoo which is not volumizing.

I thought the scent of this shampoo was fine - not overpowering at all and it dissipated quite a bit after blowdrying and styling so that by the time my hair was fixed, I hardly noticed it. I also like the texture of the shampoo. It's really creamy and thick, almost like a cream rinse.

The only downside to this shampoo was that for me, it's an absolute necessity to use either cream rinse or a leave in conditioner/detangler with it because after shampooing, I could hardly get a brush/comb through my hair without adding back some "moisture". However, the times I didn't use a conditioner or detangler, though it took a long time to comb out all the tangles, it didn't seem like my hair was fly away or damaged looking after it air dried but it did seem that it had more static in it without the detangler when I blew it dry.

Overall I would give this shampoo 3.75 stars for the volumizing and the fact that my curls seemed more bouncy and lasted longer than when I use my every day shampoo.

I also tried this brand in the "Damage & Color Repair" version and I think I prefer it over this one but I'll keep this one to use when I want to use my hot rollers.

I have short very fine hair.  I was hoping that after chemo it would come back with a better texture, but I think it is even finer than before and even a little thin.  This shampoo did great!  After using it and drying my hair it actually had some body. It wasn't just lying flat to my head.  I have used it several times with the same results.  I like it a lot.  I don't know how it would work for other hair types, but for short fine hair like mine it is good & I will continue to purchase it.  Instead of using gels etc. to give my hair body I use the shampoo, blow dry & then use Aveda Light Elements shaping wax.  They work great together! I am so happy that The Vine Program had this as a choice and that I chose it to review.

Summary: Seems very good though not cheap
Text: Well, I can't say anything negative about this shampoo except that it is more expensive than a lot of good shampoos. That said, it smells nice and my hair seems OK after using it and feels good when I run my hand through it. About its claim of volumizing the hair, it does seem to do that. So, overall I am satisfied with this product, but for me, cheap shampoo works fine and will remain my first choice. But, for those seeking what this shampoo claims, I do recommend it for those who are interested to at least try it.

Summary: Fabulous stuff.. can't put it down!
Text: I have a glass of crystal light with me all the time.  The berry flavors are the absolute best on the market.  Kudos to them for a great product!

Summary: Tastes Good and Stains well too!
Text: I like the taste of this one.  It's sweet and refreshing.  Very berry tasting which I enjoy.  This deep red color will stain and also give you that Joker (from batman) looking red smile from cheek to cheek.  Overall it's one of the better tasting flavors out there and it says it's good for you, so can't go wrong on this one.

I drank one of these at least once a day for 3 months, I  usually get sick from my coworkers on a monthly basis, but not while I was drinking these.  I recommend these to EVERYONE!  Very great taste, I would still be drinking these if they hadn't caused me to experience heart palpitations, bummer for me.  Maybe if I drink less :(
We stopped drinking sodas and use Crystal Light on the Go instead. It is very good and the packets are easy to carry and easy to use. Just put them in 16 ozs of water. A healthier alternative.

Summary: The Best Macaroni and Cheese ever!!
Text: I absolutely love this mac and cheese it is different from any other 'squeeze cheese' style of mac and cheese i've had as the cheese is white. The cheese is soooo good. I highly recomend this pasta. And i really know my macaroni and cheese i consider myself something of a macaroni and cheese conesiur ( i've tried nearly every kind of macaroni and cheese there is and this is by far my favorite. This is excellent and i've turned my friends onto this macaroni. Now when they go to the store they are also buying it. Just give it a try you won't regret it.

Summary: just like i used to eat...
Text:
...when i was young -- always loved that puff pastry, crispy-crunchy on top and smooth-yummy underneath! can't wait to try the others!

one correction on the description -- the suggested serving size of 4 would be quite small (besides, who wants to share such a delicious pie?! i know i won't)

I purchased this plant in order to add a little color to my office. When I received delievry of the plant and opened up the box I found a plant that looked like it had lost the will to live. I wasn't too surprised though, because after all it was a mail order plant. That said, as soon as I watered the soil and put it in its spot the plant has been growing very well and is flourishing.
Yummy!!  These are the best shortbread cookies that I have ever eaten!  They taste like homemade!  Please get them back in stock soon!!!
We used to buy at trader joes.  Since they ran out of crystallized ginger, with no supply on the horizon.  We bought from The Ginger people and will continue to do so.
Wonderful soft nuggets of baby ginger. Just enough spice. Enough sugar to feel like a treat but not too much! I love em!

I LOVE crystallized ginger. It is really good for digestion.
The taste of this ginger is amazing .
If you like ginger try this one.

We've been buying Alpen for years as the closest product we've found to a Swedish whole grain museli we loved while visiting in Stockholm.  Very low sodium (15 mg), 6 gr dietary fiber, 7 gr protein, and 3 gr fat in 2/3 cup -- a half a cup serving is enough for me eaten as next described.  This has sliced almonds, hazelnuts and raisins and is absolutely super with any sort of yogurt (I prefer plain no fat, my husband likes low fat Yoplait fruit varieties), some skim milk and, if available, your favorite fruit -- fresh or canned.  Or, add some additional dried fruit; we like cranberries in the winter.  Best of all, Amazon's price with automatic shipping has been much cheaper than the grocery store (where it's about $5 a box and hard to find as well.)  We eat about 6 boxes a month as we have it most days.  Do try this!
This is not what I expect from a french roast.  Not a very dark roast, not much oil evident on the beans, and it makes an anemic cup of coffee.  My supermarket carries better beans than these.
My dogs loved this, and chewed on it for about 4 hours. It's not terribly everlasting. They killed the treat in roughly four hours. It's a reasonably inexpensive treat though, so it's not too bad.
This stuff didn't take long to ship, and was packaged well. I tried it for the first time tonight on turkey burgers and it was amazing! The best tasting rub!

Summary: Clears dandruff, leaves hair light and fluffy
Text:
Tried this shampoo since I have a persistent dandruff problem. Like any other dandruff shampoo, it is a temporary relief and you need to keep applying this about once a week to keep dandruff away.

The shampoo completely clears dandruff and left my hair light and fluffy.

This lightly scented clear shampoo is highly concentrated. It does not look, feel, or smell like a dandruff shampoo! The clean crisp odor that lingers just smells like clean hair. When compared to Head & Shoulders, there is little in common. Dandruff doesn't not exist. Only healthy scalp and great looking hair remain.

Bang for your buck? Costs more than some but a little bit goes a long way. Smart purchase!

CLEAR MEN SCALP THERAPY Anti-Dandruff Shampoo contains the same active ingredient (Pyrithione Zinc) as found in Head & Shoulders and other popular dandruff shampoos. It appears be reducing the flakes and itchiness of my scalp, and I appreciate that it does not have an obnoxious aroma as some other dandruff shampoos I've tried in the past. (In fact this particular product has no scent that I can detect.)

I can't vouch that the "Strong & Full" properties of this concoction made any appreciable difference to my hair - but I admit to being a skeptic about most claims made of hair products.

But since this has the necessary ingredients to control dandruff and no off-putting scent, I'd suggest that it's worth a try if you are unhappy with your current dandruff control shampoo.

I found this shampoo to be a big improvement over the most common brand for dandruff. It seems to have completely eliminated the dandruff and at the same time made my hair more manageable with more body. On top of all this it has a very pleasant masculine smell to it. I will definitely by more of this brand in the future. I also like the easy to use bottle that it comes in. It is very easy to open pour and close with only one hand.

I have a problem with dandruff and I don't know why. My doctor called it "cradle cap" and gave me a prescription shampoo that made it much worse. So I don't think he knows.

I've tried a variety of over-the-counter shampoos that have a slight effect. This Clear shampoo does more to help me than any of them. It's not a cure, but it gives me relief from the itching. I've been using it once a day; maybe I should try twice a day.

Amazon's packaging for shipping was poor. You need more than just a padded envelope to protect a bottle of liquid. The leakage was contained by the additional plastic bag Amazon wrapped the bottle in, but it needs to be shipped in a box.

I see someone complained about the fragrance. I don't understand that--I can't even remember what this shampoo smells like, that's how mild the fragrance is.

Overall, I'll keep using it until I stumble onto something better.
I liked this shampoo. It cleans the hair well and rinses out easily without leaving a film. It does not seem to interfere with any other hair care products.

I just received these refills and opened the box to find that they are stale. I've purchased these in the past from a pet store and they've always been firm, but still chewy. The ones I received from this order are dry and most have cracked into pieces. They are not out of date and the packaging was intact (as far as I could tell), but they are definitely unusable. I gave this 2 stars because my experiences with this product when purchased at the pet store have been okay.

These little packets are just filled with flavor. The crisp strawberry and banana pieces just melt in your mouth!  Perfect for that afternoon snack when you're feeling tired and sluggish. I keep a box at work for my convenience, but they are easy to pack in lunches. I love that fact that even when strawberries aren't in season, I always have them to snack on. Best part is, no spoilage. They also provide 1/2 cup of your daily fruit requirements.  Try them, you won't be sorry.

If you are looking for a healthy, delicious, handy snack...this is it!

These snacks are so delicious that I cannot have enough. My sons gobble them up in droves. It is a wonderful thing to have boys chow down on something other than junk.

I love them also...they are a perfect serving that gives you flavor and the oh so important satisfying crunch.

Highly recommend every flavor!! Buy a good amount they will go fast.
Everyone in my office loves these -- I think they taste like styrofoam.  Everyone's tastebuds are different, so I recommend that you try them for yourself.

The overall flavor is pretty good (esp. for being vegetarian) and the texture was fine but, the one I tried, "original wild" was just TOO (spicy) hot! I don't mind a little heat but this was rediculous.  My mouth was burning for an hour afterwards.  This may be "fun" for some but not for me!  And I will give the "mild" a try - just to be fair).

The product I bought from amazon was old and moldy.  When I called the company (Luman Soy Foods)they replaced the old product and took care of me.  The product is great, just get it from the company directly!

Summary: There isn't to much I can say . . .
Text: So far STonewall's Jerquee is the best of this sort of item I've found.  I always have it on hand.

Summary: Not as good as the "Wild" flavor
Text: These are tasty but not nearly as good as the "Original Wild" flavor. They were also quite stale when they got to me.

This is a great substitute if you're vegetarian. The problem is, when it is stale, it's very hard to chew* (but still tastes good). When it is fresh, it is absolutely awesome. Stonewall's is my favorite brand of vegetarian jerkey. I like mild best, and teriyaki is my second favorite. Both of these flavors are safe if you avoid spicy stuff like I do. If you like things hot, try some of the other flavors!

*Edit: Someone suggested heating in microwave for about 10 seconds to soften it, and that works beautifully!
These have the best taste of white cheddar popcorn I've ever had, they are just a little too chewy to be really good. If you don't mind the chewiness of them you will like them.
This is my favorite chip dip. I like to substitute miracle whip for mayo, and eat it with ranch doritos or tostitos. Delicious!

This soda is absolutly amazing, one of the best drinks I have ever tasted. The Coca-cola company should really start to produce it here.

(ps. if anybody knows a place in the us where this is sold, please comment.)

Summary: I need a way to get this wonderful stuff in the US!
Text:
I am not a pop drinker. I average two or three a year. But I had Lemon Fanta when we were on a trip to Europe, and it's part of my very fond memories of that vacation. It was even worth room in my luggage to bring some home. I am drinking my last bottle as I type. I was shocked that I couldn't get any back home. I need a source soon, and if Amazon can't come through for me I think I'm in trouble.
Desperation is setting in.

Sometimes I think mangos are my favourite fruit. Then I remember watermelon! Sweet, juicy watermelon - oh yes! Both of these fruits can share the spotlight - but only when they are ripe, juicy and flavourful! Why did I pick some of the messiest fruits to be my favourite?

Luckily, the only thing that gets messy when I whip up a cup of this matcha is my cup and whisk! (...and my white shirt. That's a story for another time) But hey! Virtually mess free! At least it's not all over my face... although this matcha is delicious enough that I wouldn't mind sticking my face into a huge bowl of it. Oh yes, can you tell that I am happy with this matcha? So happy! The flavour is sweet and true watermelon flavour! I like watermelon candies, but I hate watermelon jolly ranchers (too chemically), so I was very happy that this flavour lies between a watermelon flavouring and a real watermelon. That doesn't really make sense, but I guess you'll have to take my word for it lol.

Making this hot with a sprinkle of sugar takes it into treat territory! Seriously delicious matcha that has me drooling just thinking about it! Another great summer treat. Chopping up some watermelon to make a watermelon puree to go with this matcha (and a splash of vodka) is definitely on my to-do list.

I prefer my watermelon fruit straight from the fridge and icy cold, so it goes without saying that my favourite way to prepare this drink is ICED. I still haven't gotten into the habit of just mixing matcha with cold water - so I mix it up double strong with 170 F water, add ice cubes and top with more water. This gives me a perfect result every time - no clumps (if I drink it right away!) and smooth as the rind of an in season watermelon. Oh yes, I went there.

For an extra treat, I experimented with cream and tried a "watermelon and cream" dessert tea. It was delicious! Let it be known - any fruit + cream = wonder! Too bad most flavours stick to strawberries&cream or peaches&cream, because I think I'm on to something here ;)
This also went well with vanilla soy milk and plain almond milk! I'm not picky - I always buy almond milk when it's on sale because it's so delish, creamy, and doesn't affect my acid reflux! That's the joy of these flavoured matchas - delicious flavour minus the calories! They don't need milk and sugar to tantalize my tastebuds - even the basic matcha is smooth, grassy and even creamy!

I am LOVING this... I finished my first bowlful really fast and am contemplating making another, and I probably would if were not 9:18 pm, and I wasn't worried about it keeping me awake all night! (Matcha does give a serious boost of energy!)

The flavor of the watermelon is perfect: sweet and very true to the fruit. It tastes like watermelon. But it also tastes like Matcha. The watermelon does not overwhelm the Matcha, which is vegetative, creamy and sweet. It feels so rich and smooth on the palate.

I've tried a lot of tea - a lot of Matcha, for that matter - and even quite a few flavored Matcha... this is one of the very best I've tried. If you like watermelon and Matcha... putting this in your cart is a no-brainer. You'll love it.

I just purchased these beets and couldn't wait to get them home and try them.  They are the worst beets I have ever had.  I love pickled beets and have been eating them for years.  These tatse like a musty basement smells.  I'll stick with Greenwood Beets or Joycie's Beets both are delicious.
Quality product, good value for the money.  Great for lemonade and cooking.  I would have preferred a "pour" cap rather than the "squirt" cap the bottles comes with.
Man, this is hard to believe! You can get this same thing at Sam's Club for $4.88. I am very disappointed.

Summary: Lipton Blackberry Energize Tea To Go ...
Text: In an attempt to steer completely away from carbonated drinks, I started drinking the powder sticks added to water in all different brands and flavors. I am not a lover of sweetner aftertaste so I went through alot of flavors before finding one I really loved.  Lipton Green Tea Blackberry Pomegranate is by far my favorite. Summary: Good for allergies, terrible for hairballs
Text:
While I prefer wet food for my cats, one of them will only eat dry food. And he has a food allergy that causes flaky, itchy skin and a dull coat. I wanted to try this as the Felidae canned food is high quality and this food is supposed to be good for cats with allergies or sensitive stomachs.

We've been feeding this to our two cats and our foster kittens for a couple weeks now and please explain to me why my 7 year old cats suddenly have terrible hairballs. Every day they dry cough and choke, especially my cat with allergies who will only eat the dry food and therefore consumes the most. Even the 10-week old kittens who are short-haired are coughing a little bit. My adult cats are vomiting hairballs now too. Not only is this alarming, but it necessitates the need for a hairball remedy. I should also include that IAMS indoor hairball dry food is what I was feeding when my cat showed symptoms of allergies to food. I am not even sure I will get through the rest of the bag, I might just throw it out. I don't wish all that coughing on strays, shelter cats, or rats.

The reason I gave two stars -- this food has helped with my cat's allergies. His coat is shinier and his skin is not flaky. But in our case, these benefits are far outweighed by the suspiciously new and sudden coughing/hacking/vomiting.

I have 3 dogs - a Grey Hound, a Boston Terrier, and a Chihuahua/Rat Terrier mix.  They all love various kinds of treats, and will also chew on generic rawhide when I purchase them sometimes. Both the Grey Hound and the Boston Terrier will carry their FunBites around sometimes and guard them, but they will not chew on them.  They've had them for over a week now, and I have even left a FunBite in their kennels for them to chew on whenever I have had to leave them in there.  All the FunBites are still intact.  Therefore, I cannot recommend FunBites MiniCongo Digestive Support, since my dogs will not chew on them.

Summary: Maggie the mostly lab loved them!
Text:
Now I will confess, I'm not quite sure how a human reviews a dog treat. But I will tell you that Maggie my mostly lab (pound puppy of some questionable lineage) took to these like they were candy.

When I buy this sort of treat for her, I'm looking for a few traits:

They last longer than 30 seconds. Maggie's a big girl and she has very powerful jaws. So most treats are here for a blink of an eye. But she had to work on this one for a bit. I'm not saying they lasted an hour -- but it took her a good 5 or 10 minutes to eat the whole thing.

They don't come back up. With just about every dog I've owned my entire life -- some treats, like rawhides, seem to re-appear within a few hours. I want my pet to have a treat she can enjoy once...not have it come back up again because it irritated her stomach.

They don't stink. Maggie (and most of my previous dogs) loved the cow hoof shavings. But the stench is so unbearable, I had to stop bringing them into the house. These are odor-free.

Overall -- these were a big hit with both of us!

Nice package, looks good,looks tasty but dog wouldn't eat it.  Our dog is not generally picky on what she eats but for whatever reason she didn't like chewing on these or want anything to do with them.  Not much else to say.

These are a strange shape, and my dog couldn't quite figure out how to eat them.  We keep her lean, not feeding her much, and she always scarfs up any little molecule that happens to fall.  Not so with this.  She carried it around for a while, and then finally crunched it down.  Not the best treat.

Well, the dogs (basset, golden and retriever) loved these! It took them about 30 minutes to completely finish these. I liked the quiet in the house. The bad part, these are not super nutritious and these contain grains, which can cause problems for dogs. Now, if this is for digestion, I wonder why all three dogs had the worst gas ever. The only thing different in their diet for the day was these FunBites. They are not normally gassy. This leads me to believe it was caused by this treat. Beware.

Summary: My dog gobbled it right up...
Text: So they must be good! They are a nice substantial weight, I was thinking they would be thin but they are quite wide. I have a boxer and he gobbled it right up when I gave him one. It seems like a pretty good value for the price, there are similar treats out there that are a bit more expensive (for only a couple in a package) so I would probably buy these over the other kind!

I have 4 cocker spaniels, 3 male, and 1 female weighing over 30 pounds each.  I gave them each a Funbites peanut butter flavored minicongo.  First of all, I don't give my dog's whole treats of this size.  Normally, one of these would be cut in half and I would make two treats out of them.  However, I couldn't cut through the white rawhide with gardening shears so each dog received their own minicongo.  My picky male promptly took his off and I didn't see him for 2 hours.  He busily and happily chewed all that time.  My female spent all her time growling at the boys and would never chew hers so I ultimately had to take hers away.  She wasn't upset; she just lay down and went to sleep.  My oldest male growled and barked over his for an hour but then eventually ate all of his and foraged pieces from the youngest one.  The youngest male spent 20 minutes so excited over it, he ran from room to room and then outside hiding it then going and getting it and he finally took it to the couch and chewed on his for the next two hours.  The dog treat is said to contain papain which I looked up on Wikipedia and it is an enzyme present in papaya used to break down tough meat fibers and is sold as tenderizer.  It is also used in small amounts in toothpaste as a whitener.  It's not just good for their teeth, but will whiten their teeth, also?  Just kidding.  I haven't noticed anything with the digestive system yet. The only problem I had with them was they were messy and small pieces came off as they chewed but they eventually cleaned all the pieces up.  The price is $22.15 for a 4 pack which is by my calcualtion $5.54 a pack and I think that's a bit much for a package of dog treats. All in all, my dogs loved them and I would buy them.

Family dog loves them...what more can I say. Smells pleasant enough for we humans to handle to feed to our furred loved ones.

He can be a little bit of a stinker sometimes so something that helps his breath goes a long way. Also, he's getting a little older and I think this helps his digestion.

Summary: Snowball turns up his nose....  Not a peanut butter lover?
Text:
After our experience with other Funbites treats, I thought our dog Snowball would really enjoy these treats, but despite giving him these on different days, under different conditions, when he was hungry and when he was full, Snowball just wouldn't do more than sniff at them.

Why? I suspect that it must be the Peanut butter flavoring. He's always eaten meat or vegetable flavored food and treats, and the peanut butter must be throwing him. I may give the treats to a neighbor to see if their dog will eat them, but since these reviews are all about our experiences, I have to give this One Star - Snowball, a dog that I would think would eat ANYTHING, just won't give these a chance.

That said, I'll have to buy another Funbites flavor for him to see if he'll like these. He just loves the FunBites FlatSticks Calcibone, 60-Count (Pack of 5), so it isn't the outer "crunchy shell" - it's got to be the nutty flavor and scent.

I have an "I will eat pretty much anything and I will eat it quickly" whippet. I was pretty sure he would take to these treats but wasn't sure how well he would do after the taking. Whippets, especially pups (he is 8 months old) sometimes have trouble with high protein foods and we have had a few issues in the past.

Well, naturally the pup loved the bars. They were a good size for him, about 3 inches long and 1 inch wide. He seemed to be really excited about the treat on day one and was still amped up when I launched the treat across the room for him to fetch on day three. We have had no digestive upsets so far and I really like how long it takes him to consume the thing. I can actually sit down and eat my lunch while he works at the bar. (Generally he likes to wolf-down his milk bone and then make sad eyes at me while I eat a more leisurely lunch.)As the packaging says, these are a soft beef hide outer chew with a peanut butter flavored inside. The pup ran off and ate his treat under the dining room table on my cream white carpet (of course) and I found no evidence of staining.

I just put in a subscribe and save order for more of these things, so I have to say:

Recommended

Summary: Tasty Chews for a Picky Dog
Text: My lab will eat any type of food he can find but is very picky about "chews."  There are only a few types he likes, and I've tried dozens.  I tried these recently.  This is now one of his favorite chew treats.  He really enjoys them, and unlike some other chews, he doesn't finish them off in a few minutes.  They last a good 15 - 30 minutes, which for my dog is a long time.  These are supposed to be good for his digestion, but unless I ran some type of controlled scientific experiment I'm not sure I can tell if this is true.  The ingredients seem reasonably healthy, although it does contain some artificial flavorings, which is not good. Overall I'm satisfied and  the dog likes them. Although they are a little pricey, I will probably buy more.

I have one siberian that will eat anything, including a small horse if it can fit in the dog's mouth, and the other siberian is such a princess she just licks and licks until she's full, which is usually very quickly.  So I was happy that both dogs liked these treats.  Unfortunately, both of them had diarrhea the next day and were high tailing it out the back door pretty fast several times in the same afternoon. This was the only thing that was different in their diet unless they got hold of a neighborhood toddler I do not know about. I hate to give a treat a bad review, because I know the people work hard to make a good product and no one sat around and said, "Well, so what if it makes a few dogs barf! We're rolling in money, hahahahahaha!!" but I have to speak the truth here, and the truth is, they appear to have given the dogs some pretty awful diarrhea. Sorry. They did eat it though and did not die, so 2 stars.

Summary: Great product, they need to work on the packaging
Text:
Two jars of Nutella arrived in the box, bound together by some shrink-wrapped plastic (that looked like it was from the factory) After cutting them apart and opening one jar, I found the foil seal was broken. I don't know if this was from the jars being compressed during shipping, or changes in air pressure during shipment, but it does give one pause when a food product doesn't have all the safeguards intact.

Now for the product itself, the Chocolate Hazelnut flavor is the bomb. It tastes like a nutty chocolate frosting, only smoother and creamier. You could use this for toast, on top of brownies, or my favorite, on graham crackers with a glass of milk.

The product I give a 5. But, the since the seal was broken on one of the jars, I reluctantly gave a 3-star review overall. Another reviewer had the same issue and gave the product a 1 rating. I suspect it has to do with handling during shipping, but still the packaging should be able to take it.

Good product, however the adhesive on the foil-sealed top needs to be made more robust. BTW, don't buy this product if you're on a diet. It's soooo good, you'll find yourself spooning it out of the jar.

I just want to say that I'm eating Nutella right now, and it's nothing short of amazing. You pay about the same as a jar of peanut butter (another favorite of mine), and you get the equivolent of that stuff inside those gold foil ferrero chocolate things. I'm a runner for the University of Pittsburgh, and it's the one thing I never forget to bring to meets. Don't get too much of it if you're prone to gaining weight, however. While it's really good, it has 11 grams of fat per every 27 grams of nutella, making it over a third pure fat. If you're already fat, and you know that those Subway walks aren't going to make you into the next Jared, however, get some of this stuff. It's like Ben and Jerry's, only spreadable.
