Summary: Better to make your own... Not bad but not as good as home made
Text: Anyone who has a food processor can make far better... And you can make better by using real bacon!  For what this large cannister of bacon salt cost me I could have fried up 3 lbs of lean crispy bacon, bought a cannister of salt, pulled all the fat off my crisp bacon and tossed that bacon in the food processor with the sharp blade until it was pulverized to a fine powder.  Then I add the salt and pulse it a few times to incorporate as I think that salt probably isn't the best for my sharp metal blade.  Instant bacon salt and way better!  Want the other flavors?  Add a few drops of hickory liquid smoke to pick it up a notch.  Jalapeno bacon salt?  Buy some fresh jalapenos and dry them in the oven then toss them in with the bacon when you pulverize.  This isn't rocket science and I agree with other posts... if ya want to know what this tastes like just buy a bottle of bacos and smash them into a salt like substance to sprinkle around.  I am not a fan of bacos as they taste like all smoke and salt with a fake bacon taste you burp up for the next 2 hours.  Home made is way better but I got to hand it to the inventors of this... they are getting rich!  Great Idea!  Maybe someday they'll add a "natural line" made with real bacon.

Summary: No additives, good size, good price
Text:
I've tried quite a few coconut waters - all of the major brands found on Amazon in addition to imports and the like. Most canned, "affordable" coconut waters (generally, what you find at the Asian and Indian supermarkets) have a preservative in it which really affects the taste. No chemicals here, and yet they still manage to keep the price competitive versus the average $2.79 for 11-12 oz at the grocery!

Judging by past personal experiences, I don't think you'll find a consistent taste in a coconut water unless the supplier mixes it all together in a giant vat or something. It's a natural product, so slight variations are to be expected. That said, I've never had a coconut water from this brand which tasted "bad". Just different.

The green can has pulp, which I prefer. One reviewer who gave this a low star rating cited the inconsistency in the pulp texture - some was soft, some was harder, chewier. If you've ever cracked open a young coconut after drinking the juice to scrape the pulp out, you'll have experienced the same variations. The pulp layer within is very thin and both textures are to be expected. I don't mind it that way - it seems like more of something to expect than something to be shocked by. Don't order it expecting the pulp to be like that of oranges! Coconut pulp is its own thing.

Great for doing yard work, sports, and as a substitute for pedialyte/gatorade when someone's ill (though this does have some natural sugar content).

We have sampled a good number of different coconut juices from different companies and these Amy & Brian juices are the best, hands down. A number of the other brands had a bitter taste and/or after taste, or seemed watered down (lacked flavor). Amy & Brian's juice is sweet through and through, no nasty after taste, and reasonably priced.

The only thing I think they could do better is to package the juice in a better container. It is somewhat annoying to drink the juice from the can due to the "tinny" taste and because the pulp pieces zip through the small opening, which is disconcerting. I just pour it out into a glass and enjoy it fully that way. Another brand we tried had a glass, wide-mouth container which was easy to drink from and cool because you can see the pulp pieces suspended in the drink. If Amy & Brian adopted packaging like that, it would improve the product by a lot!

Still though, despite the packaging, this is THE BEST coconut juice out there that we have tried.

Grove Square Coffee, Dark Roast, K-Cups for Keurig Brewers 24-Count (Instant Coffee) (Pack of 2)

Arrived Early

The site says it all. Good Price. I would do this again anytime.

Thank you

I have not been this incensed in a long time about a product's misrepresentation.  The primary advantage of a Keurig is not that it heats water, which can be used to make tea, hot chocolate, etc., it is that it can make real, BREWED coffee by the cup.  This product advertises itself as dark brew coffee, at an attractive price.  It is instant coffee and should be labeled as such!

When I saw this product on the shelf at Wal-Mart, I instantly tossed it into my cart (both medium and light roast).  I like to have a supply of different coffees on hand.  I immediately made a cup when I got home from the store.  Actually, I love the flavor.  It is easy on the tongue, and leaves the mouth refreshed.  I thought there was something odd about the K-Cup itself, different sound when shaken, and appeared to be empty after use!  I did some quick surgery on the Cup and realized that I have been duped.  While I would still drink this had it been advertised honestly, because it has great flavor, I do not care to reward dishonesty and deceptive advertising.  It seems that rather than conducting any research to find the best combination of flavors, they chose to use word-tricks and lies.  Shame on them!

I was very disappointed with this purchase, it is not fresh coffee, like I expected. It looks, smells, and tastes just like Folgers instant freeze dried crystals!!
If you like freeze-dried instant coffee, then this is for you, but I got my Keurig machine because I like real, fresh coffee and this just doesn't do it for me.
Absolutely the worse coffee ever. Instant coffee in a K-Cup.  And it doesn't even flow through correctly in the machine.

I bought this to try out when it went on sale for $15/box here at Amazon.  The flavor is decent, but it really is just instant coffee with a few grounds packaged into a K cup.  For way less money and packaging, you can get instant coffee and just use the Keurig to heat the water.

Just had my first cup of this coffee. It is strong, just how I like it, and has a nice aroma. Because this is micro-ground it comes through the brewer much faster than the regular K-Cups. I am not a coffee snob but do enjoy a good strong cup in the morning to get my motor running, this fits the bill just fine. The price makes it a deal breaker, I just ordered more to add to my collection of different varieties of coffee. I am well satisfied and hope you will be too.
____UPDATE from my original review. After using this for several weeks, I will have to agree that this is not up to snuff with regular K-Cups---I don't think it's as bad as some think but is not as good as the regular ground coffee. Some people drink instant coffee and have no problem with it and others just don't like it. This will wake you up in the morning, but does lack the flavor of the regular ground varieties.

It has a delicious, creamy taste. Sweet. Really good, and tasting very much like cheesecake.

YUM! The creamier texture and flavor that comes from using milk instead of water is really beneficial to this cheesecake flavored Matcha. All the flavor remains intact - it is not masked by the milk - and it tastes creamier and richer ... and let's face it, when you want cheesecake, you want that rich, creamy flavor and texture.

This cheesecake flavored Matcha is rich, smooth, and sweet, with the distinctive tangy taste of cream cheese and even a hint of buttery pastry. As for the fish, I've tried several and I found that swai works the best. I've yet to try salmon, though. The most prep you'd have to do is lightly season the fish even if it's just salt and pepper. I don't know how exactly this changes the flavor notes, but when I skipped this step, it wasn't as good. The fish didn't take to the curry as well. I don't add anything extra to it, but if I'm feeling adventurous I chop up a fresh tomato and toss it in about 2-3 minutes before serving while it's still simmering. Then I garnish with finely chopped cilantro---Let me stop. I can go on about this stuff for HOURS o____o.

I bought these recently for my two kitties that eat a grain-free diet.  I thought these would make a nice treat and boy, I was not disappointed.  They love these so much they refuse to accept any other treats I offer.  As another reviewer said, these are too big to be bite-size for a cat, so I cut them up (which is kinda gross, but better for them).  They're a bit stinky to me but they store easily and one package will last a good while for my two cats.  They absolutely love these.  As soon as they see me grab the bag and head for the kitchen shears, they come running.  They purr as they eat them, and then they come over and thank me with plenty of rubs and more purrs.  These are definitely unbeatable, and I'll be trying out a few more of the other varieties as well to see what they like best.  A bit pricey when compared to cheapo grain and cheese snacks, but well worth the extra expense to feed them something better suited to their diet that they love.

These are not only a great deal, but very delicious, too!  And, they are a low-cal, guilt-free treat when you wrap them around broccoli slaw with mung bean sprouts, sesame seeds, lime juice, a little chili oil, cilantro, sugar or Splenda.... Great way to get creative and hands-on with your food!  The kids loved it!!  We dunk them in a little sweet chili sauce.  One thing to note: I think it says to soak them in water for 30 seconds or so.  Really, it only needs 5-7 seconds.  It might seem like it's not soft enough yet, but take it out anyway!  It continues to absorb the water and soften for the next few minutes.  The wrapping technique takes a few tries to perfect, but you don't feel bad about eating your trial runs!!  We ate them fresh, not fried or baked.  Although, I'm sure that would be delicious, too.  I bought the 3pks.  There are several in each pack, and they're shelf stable.  So, at this price, go for the 3pk!  You'll want to wrap these babies around everything!  Leftover coleslaw is what we're wrapping today!

A friend gave me a bag of these to try - the chocolate flavor - and I was very skeptical because I am pretty much a chocolate snob and thought there was no way these would compare.  But I instantly liked them and now keep a bag in my car, in my office, and even by my bed. They have a cocoa essence, a nice crunch, and I love the texture and taste that the sunflower seeds add.  I decided to see what my housemate and friends thought so I had them try them too.  Everyone so far has immediately liked them.  They don't take the place of a nice dark piece of chocolate, but I used to snack on cheetos or baked lays, and now I have a snack I enjoy more and is much better for me.  I just ordered the pack of 6 of all different flavors and won't be surprised if I like the other flavors too!

I am a lowcarb high protein dieter, and sometimes I crave a crunchy snack. The sunflower seeds up the protein and give them a healthy punch. They are handy portable and yummy.It is not like chocolate candy, more like a little cookie/cracker/granola.For me it gives me the sweet and salty I crave. I also like the sea salt , and sante fe salsa flavors. I use the subscribe and save program and always have some on hand.

Summary: These little nuggets are so addictive!
Text: These little crunches are so addictive! I bought them at Wholefood when they were on sale for $2.50 each at the store. Ever since I could not stop munching on these things. Who knew a little bit of seeds could go such a long way! Wow....

Summary: A MUST TRY for mango lovers
Text:
I have had this since childhood and wasn't sure if anyone from the mainland would enjoy it until I gave it as a gift one day among other things "Hawaiian".

My hosts were converted on the spot! I am not a licorice fan and was surprised to see it in the ingredients, but this does not taste like black licorice at all.

I love love LOVE these cherries!  I was visiting friends in Davison, Michigan (just outside of flint) and they had these cherries in their grocery store. I would always stock up when I visited (5 hours is a bit of a drive). So, when I found out I could order these cherries, I was so excited! Four easily portable containers come in the box and they're absolutely delicious.

We love this!  We've purchased all the ones in the market like Vita Coco, Taste Nirvana, ONE, C2O, Amy & Brian and found that this one tastes the freshest.  It's the closest in taste to drinking right out of the coocnut.  I also wish there is subscribe and save for this.  Would love the additional savings and the auto ship on this.

I bought this, lured in by the price and organic nature of the product.  It is awful.  Very bitter taste, with a acid finish.  From first drop to last, it just isn't good, even with cream and sugar added.  Look for Jeremiah's coffee instead.  Much better.
Got this on an Amazon deal...ended up with 6 pounds of organic coffee for less than $4/pound.  SHoudl have bought more...it is a great coffee.

I used to purchase liquor-filled chocolate bottles for X-mas for quite a few years.  They were excellent and hoped to get them THIS year.  The product web site was being upgraded so I had to 'settle' for these.  What a nice surprise to find that they truly were NOT 'second best'  These 'bottles' were much larger than the ones I used to get, hence, more liquor filling.  I'm not that familiar with all the true tastes of the different 'spirits' but I felt they were all very good.  I'd recommend these to anyone.
From time to time I buy similar small liquors for friends, usually at Christmas.  I discovered these during a random search on Amazon, and now have a superior product available.

I ordered this set as a Christmas gift for my family. As a poor college student, I needed something cheap that everyone would like. I'm definitely glad I chose to bring this home. It was a big hit with my family, even with my picky diabetic mother. The price was definitely worth the buy as well, which only made the product better. It makes a great gift for any chocolate lover, and anyone who's picky about sweets. Two thumbs up!

We had purchased the liquor infused chocolates for two or three years from Costco at the holidays. Then last year they didn't carry them, nor this past holiday season. So I went online and searched, found them and they were sent within two or three days, just in time for a party! Great job!

not really recommended if you or the person you're buying these for don't really care for the taste of real liquor because of the strong liquor taste these chocolates have/leave in your mouth.  The chocolate that these confections are made out of is really good, and I was pleasantly surprised.

Summary: No GMO's Sprouted Delicious Bean Chips!
Text: Got these at a coop in a town I was passing through.  They were awesome!  Packaging label is marked No GMO's: stone ground corn, high oleic sunflower/and or safflower oil, organic sprouted black beans, organic sprouted flax seed, organic sprouted quinoa, pure sea salt.  Yippee!!!  A rare find!  Now . . . to get my local coop to carry them. . .  :-)

I usually have a box of granola bars in the car for after school activities, just to tide the kids over until we all get home and can have a better snack or dinner. I wanted something with less sugar so got these, thinking they would be more "wholesome" or something, or at the very least less sugary. The first time my kids unwrapped their bars, the disappointment was palpable. These things are TINY. They are also not much more than some oats (maybe) some rice krispy things, and itty bitty chocolate chips, all stuck together with a minimally flavorful sweet stickiness.

Considering that I feel like I paid a little more for these compared to other brands on the market, it made these weak little granola bars seem even more pathetic. I found a good recipe and will be making my own, with some good things included -- like nuts, seeds, and flavor.

Plus they come seven to a box. 7. Really? I could only divide this box up evenly if I had 7 kids.

Community Coffee is consistently excellent coffee.  It is difficult to find Community Coffee in Oklahoma City and even more difficult to find the New Orleans Blend with chicory.  If you love coffee with bite this coffee is the way to go.  It's actually less expensive online and delivered to your door.  What could be better?  I'm off to brew a pot.

Summary: If I could give it SIX stars, I would!
Text: My wife and I fell in love with coffee with chicory when we lived in New Orleans.  Now that we're back home in Texas, we get the best of both worlds -- living in Texas and drinking New Orleans coffee!  :)  This is the BEST coffee and chicory to be found.  The folks at Community Coffee KNOW their stuff and always get the perfect roast on the beans and mix the perfect amount of chicory with it to make the perfect blend of rich, deeply flavored coffee.  Not bitter at all.  Got to warn you though, if you're like us, you'll be hooked on it and will feel like kicking the TV when you see an ad for watery coffee substitutes like Folger's, Maxwell House (we used to drink Master Blend but this is WAY better) and all the rest of the big commercial coffees.
I love Community Coffee...only one I will drink here in MA  a taste that is unique, and also a reminder of my all too brief time in New Orleans

The choice of Community Coffee is easy, been a favorite for years.  Whether or not to buy  it in bulk was not as easy.  Is ten too many, How often should I have the order renewed.  The flexibility of Amazon to change the delivery schedule if necessary was the clincher.  I get how much I want and how often I get it.... thank you Amazon

Summary: Community Coffee, New Orleans Blend with Chicory
Text: My wife and I have used Community Coffee for years. When they increased their prices and reduced their package size we felt we could just go back to using Folgers even though we did not enjoy it as much. When I found this buy on Amazon, we quickly decided that the buy was an answer to our problem. We ordered the 10 pack and it arrived, all packages maintaining their seal and now we are back to drinking Community again. It is great!

Summary: Lego theme Party Candy....kids loved it!
Text:
The kids at my son's 7th Birthday loved these sweet-tart flavored, stackable, Lego-like candies.

My Son had a Lego themed B-day party and as the kids stragled in I sat them at the table and gave them a bag(labeled with names) of these block candies. They busied themselves with building and eating. When everyone arrived I set a timer and had them build the talest stack of candy they could by the time the buzzer went off. The party started off with the apparent Lego theme, an activity, a game, and leftovers for the goodie bag! Would buy them again....I did not buy from this company.

I bought 3 lbs of these candies for my two youngest boys Lego birthday party.  They were a great hit with all the kids... ages 5 to 15.  The kids liked the taste (similar to a sweet tart), and the fact that they could actually build with them was a BIG plus!  We had a contest to see which team could build the tallest tower.  Lots of fun...

Summary: BAKERS AND CHEFS NACHO CHEESE SAUCE
Text: Love this product, as close as it gets to ball park nacho sauce. I usually dice up more jalapeno to add a bit more spice to mine. makes great nachos or just add to anything you like

Summary: Weruva Pumpkin Jack Splash pouched cat food
Text: The cats do love this food and I feel good feeding it to them because it is high quality food. Read the ingredients and you may forget you are looking at a pouch of cat food, no ambiguous contents like "poulty by-product meal" here. My only caveat is the cost. Yes, I know you pay more for good quality cat food but I have read that even a lower quality wet food is better for your cats than the best dry food any day. I feed my cats wet food once daily and they have "grazing priviledges" with a bowl of high quality dry food (Solid Gold Indigo Moon Holistic Cat Food) that I typically have to fill once a day. I may buy this once in a while as a treat but they seem to enjoy the less expensive leading brand just as much.

I bought this tea yesterday. I was a hot day and since I'm pregnant, I've been avoiding regular and diet soda, and I think water, at least here in Akron, tastes terrible, so I've been making sun tea. I drink almost an entire tea jar every day. But the delicious red tea I'd been drinking was getting tiresome and I was looking for something new when I saw this tea. It is SO refreshing as an iced tea. I'm SURE I'd drink it even if I wasn't pregnant because it tastes so delicious. As far as the "claims", who knows... the ingredients like raspberry leaf, etc, seem harmless.

Summary: REAL Italian Pasta for Lasagne, made the old fashioned way!
Text: These are authenic Italian lasagna noodles, not at all like store bought! You will notice the difference the first time you use them. First of all, they are 100% semolina (the best, most expensive, pasta flour) - then they are carefully made the way they were 100 years ago: drawn thru bronze dyes and dried slowly to bring out the best flavor and texture. The bronze dyes leave a rougher surface which makes the pasta easier to handle wet, and the cheese and sauce cling better, so you get a firm easy to cut and serve lasagne. The flavor and quality of your dish will be noticed by everyone. There are ten packages in this case, but the pasta keeps well for two years or more, so that is not a problem at our house. PS Still, if you prefer a less expensive lasagne noodle, a good American brand to try is Muellers: Mueller's Lasagna, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12).
I bought this last month for $39, big price jump to 50. I just checked for local store online and it's 41. Guess it's to Petco for me.

Summary: Tastes like the Big Red Gum
Text: This is a nice dark red tea.  Not like most herbal teas which normally do not get very dark.  The flavor is very robust, as I said, almost like the cinnamon gum or cinnamon candies.  No need for milk, just use honey.  It is delicious, like having a dessert.

I started our feeding my pup Royal Canin. It was a hit or miss, some days I tried adding chicken broth, warm water or soft food just to make it appealing and he would sniff and walk a way. I started getting concerned because he was refusing at least 1-2 of his 3 meals a day. I also didn't like the fact the it had corn in it.

Finally I decided to switched to Blue Buffalo. He has never missed a meal since and I've had no problems with his stool.

Everyone is happy!

I am writing this review to warn other dog owners of Blue Buffalo for dogs and what it has done to my  5 yr. old Miniature Dachshund named "Calla".  Back in late October 2011 I switched to Blue Buffalo after it was recommended by a family member. By mid-November Calla started to cry out at night.  We thought it might be a back issue and our "Three" yes three Vets agreed that it could be Intervertebral Disc Disease.  We had blood work done in November and everything looked fine with the exceptions that she was a "little" dehydrated. After months of treatments, with little to no improvement we thought it might be a stomach issue and I started to think about the timing of the change to Blue Buffalo, then I went and goggled "Consumer complaints about Blue Buffalo Pet Foods" and started to really connect the dots.  Yesterday she was diagnosed with "Pancreatitis" and needs to be in the hospital for days for treatment.  I have spent over 3K to this point and do not know if Calla will ever recover fully from this.  She was a completely healthy dog before we changed to Blue Buffalo and since have been living in Hell with nighty episodes.  Please read up on this issues people are having with this product before you buy. I wish I could give a product -minus 5 stars!!!!

Certainly the quality of this dog food is very good.

The Wellness Lamb and Sweet Potato is by far their favorite canned food. It has protein content of 37% and a fat level of 23% (which is a little higher fat level than I would like but...). I use an independant dog food advisory site when considering any dog food I buy and the Wellness canned dog food was rated a 4.5 (out of 5) stars and was highly recommended.

I feed my dogs dry food (consistently the same), but for their evening meal I split a can for my 2 large dogs.

The bottom line for me is it is a very good quality dog food and my dogs love it.
If you enjoy cinnamon this is an excellent coffee. It is smooth but leans toward a bold roast packed with a cinnamon kick.

I use this soup mix as a base for pot pie filling. I purchased it first at Costco and was sorely disappointed when they discontinued carrying it. Finally, I searched Amazon and viola! It is good even by itself on cold days, though I add spices for a pop. For my pot pies, I add a variety of things like cooked and diced chicken, veggies, white pepper, fresh minced garlic, minced onion, etc. Line little pie tins with dough from scratch, fill with prepared  soup concoction, top with dough, press finger marks along the the edges and it's ready to pop in the oven or freezer for future use (from freezer, great for home cooked last minute meals). I highly recommend this soup mix.

Summary: you won't believe it's gluten free
Text: The best gluten free cornbread mix by far. Just add eggs, oil (or butter) and water.  It's not dry like other gluten free mixes I've tried. We almost always use the cheese cornbread recipe (on the bag).  I really like the low fat version - then I don't feel so guilty adding the cheese!

I've been buying these for my family for awhile now. The taste is great,and I like the fact that they are organic. I hate giving my kids fruit chews because of all the artifical ingredients. These are a great alternative. They're very portable too. I store a couple in my purse for a quick snack.

These were on one of the Amazon Friday sales and I decided to give them a try. They're tangy and sweet, I quite like them. The 3 flavors all have a core taste to them though, which makes sense if you read the ingredients. The core of this product is apples in all 3 cases... and it's there in every bite. Fortunately, I like apples, but if you're looking for variety in flavor you'll be disappointed here.
These are really good and it tastes like fruit!  No sugary or bad after taste like some other fruit snacks!  Glad I found something healthy to give my kids!
This is a quality product. Kids love it and it is good for them. I also have not been able to find it cheaper.

I like Clif products because they always use mostly organic ingredients. These fruit snacks are my wife's favorite. Normally our trip to Whole Foods we make every couple months (70 miles away) is when we buy them and try to stock up. This a very good price for it though, and should last longer. My wife likes these flavors, especially Strawberry and Mixed Berry. Although there are some other flavors that she likes, this is a good deal for these flavors.

Summary: Excellent product, hermetically sealed for freshness
Text:
Recently purchase this product in bulk (5 lb bag) for 12 because I was tired of paying almost 3 bucks for a tiny box of pearl/Israeli couscous at the local grocery store. We used the couscous over the weekend in my husband's ground-lamb-and-mint recipe, and it was fantastic. In his recipe, you cook the couscous and lamb separately, then stir them together before serving. Honestly, I could have eatten the entire pot of couscous without even adding in the lamb component, it was so good! That's saying something, as my husband's recipe is a crowd pleaser. Couscous just needed a little salt, and it was delicous on its own. I may ask my husband to create this dish again this week...

BTW, I stored the remaining couscous in an extra large glass Bormioli Rocco Fido jar with a rubber seal to keep it fresh. It is attractive in the glass jar, and I don't have to worry about keeping the dry couscous fresh.
I love papaya and it's rather difficult to find prepared papaya without sugar. This is a great snack or breakfast item. I took two cans with me to solarfest.

These figs are very small pieces....and that was ok.  But upon putting a few in my mouth, my mouth began to burn.  There is some coating on these figs.......way too much.  I have 5 pounds, and I will throw them away.  The dates are the same.  I buy figs and dates at the grocery store and they do not burn my mouth.

Good-tasting tapioca, but definitely not the size for boba tea. You can maximize their size by letting them soak for several hours and then boiling them (or the opposite order); this size is acceptable for boba tea, but not optimal.

I was surprised and greatly pleased to find that I could buy it on line from Amazon.com. This bag of dog treats is pretty much worthless. The "buffalo bites" are soo freeze-dried that they are literally feather-weight, mostly air, and that has the consistency of packing peanuts. Now I remember why I loved Kool-Aid as a child. This drink is simp;y delicious and sticky free. (no sugar) It is a great break from the carbonated drinks. Good,Good,Good.

I too have noticed it not showing up on shelves. I was at woodmans grocery store in Beloit Wisconsin and cleaned off their shelves at 3$ for a container. No one is selling the sugar free anymore, and the sugar looking aid is just too sweet anymore! Does anyone know if it is being discontinued?

it is great to have sugar free koolaid available you cannot find it in grocery stores i get tired of plain water to drink so this is a great drink option being diabetic variety is important this fills the bill so to speak

Summary: Excellent, but wish packaging was environmentally friendly
Text: Great product. Enjoy it with breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks. Low calorie. Low mess. Wish it was in cardboard though instead of plastic - like it used to be - so it would be more recyclable.
The marshmallows arrived stuck together and moist. They would separate only with difficulty.  The sell by date was October, but the product was unsatisfactory.
This is the best tasting and best eating gluten free spaghetti I have ever had.  I really look forward to spaghetti again.
This teapot set looks amazing, and is the perfect size. The only problem I had with it was it didn't come with the metal strainer. Other than that, excellent tea set!
We have been using the Badia garlic and Parsley spread for some time and we like it.  I wiil recommend you to try it.
Everything was good - The product arrived on time and was of good quality. I ordered just a few days before Christmas so I was worried that it wouldn't arrive on time but  luckily all went well.

Summary: They are organic but just ok
Text: Happy that these jelly beans are organic but taste and texture could be improved.  I found them to be a little on the crunchy side and found the flavors limited.  I've picked up some other natural (albeit not organic) jelly beans from my local natural market and there was no compromise in variety of flavors or texture you'd expect in a jelly bean.  Again, happy these are organic, but I think they could do better.
The plant arrived in short order and was very large. The plant is beautiful!

Summary: What a joke - Do not order!
Text: This company is a huge joke. I ordered two plants from this company.  The first plant was dead on arrival.  We paid for expedited shipping and it still never arrived in time frame specified.  No wonder it died. I called the company and could bearly understand the guy.  They said they would send a replacement and it still hasn't arrived.  The plants are nothing like what is pictured in the advertisement.  The second plant is so small, it didn't even have one bloom on it.  I ordered it for my son thinking he could feed it right away and was VERY disappointed in the product.

Summary: Not Horrible, Gets the Job Done
Text:
These aren't the most delicious things you'll ever eat - the taste is a little bit off and chemically.

But they're certainly better than tolerable. And that fact that you're going to want to wash them down with plenty of water? That's a good thing - you're working hard, and you could use the extra H20.

Best of all, these get the job done. They keep me from bonking during my workout..the carbs are great and the caffeine can't hurt. Amazon's price is good, too.

I like PowerBar gel more than most other brands, mainly because of the viscosity/consistency. Competing brands like Gu are way too thick for eating on a run I think - especially in cold weather. The formulation I think could use improvement - it's a little sugary for me, and my stomach feels a little upset after consuming 3 or more on a long run, but it's not too bad (I don't know of anything better at the moment).

The Banana strawberry flavor is one of the best, and has just the right of caffeine (1 shot), if you're looking to consume many during a long run. Vanilla (no caffeine) and Tangerine (2 shots caffeine) are also among my favorites as well.

Product came very quickly; I'm happy with the purchase.
The overall taste of this gel isn't too bad. Its overly thick consistency makes it a little hard to go down without a chaser.

Summary: good quality item, fast delivery 100% recommended
Text: This product is part of my training routine to improve my physical performance, if you want better results try this product ... 100% recommended

Summary: Probably works well. Taste... well not so good.
Text:
I like trying various kinds of energy drinks, foods and such, so I purchased a box of these based on the reviews.

If you are running a race and need a boost, it would probably do the trick.

As for taste, it's not "bad" persay, but it's not good either. The taste is exactly as you would imagine if you mixed strawberry jelly with artificial banana flavor and added a bunch of salt.

Which leads to often, a pack of warm sweet and salty goo.

While appealing to some, it never ended up appealing to me, as such I still have most of the box in the drawer which it will probably stay.

I received the product in a few days.  My only complaint would be that the "best buy" date was 7/10/10 and I purchased the gel on 7/12. I wonder if that affects the product?  It probably was ok, but why are you shipping expired products? Unfortunately, I didn't notice it until halfway through the box.

I have used several different types of these energy shots and have had various success. After reading some of initial reviews, I thought I would give Red Rain a try and even subscribed to a 12 pack of orange.
Unfortunately, the Red Rain product had little to no effect. Tried one of the more known brands the next day and all was right with the world.

Canceled my subscription and would not recommend.

I am subscribe & save customer and buying this brand for about 3 years now.
Prior to finding this product I tried about dozen of other brands, but didn't find anything even close - this ginger is delicious, has consistent quality, and I think it is the best out there.
Hope, it always will be available - the thought that one day it might become discontinued makes me scared.
Yes, it has rather strong natural "Gingery" taste, natural color (not pink) and might not be for everybody.
Also, compared with many other brands it appears to has lower sodium.

I love this Italian seasoning I will recommend this every one I love how the food cooks with this seasoning it gives it great flavor. thank you amazon for allowing me to taste this best seasoning that i ever had.

Summary: Can be hard to find, but it's a classic ingrediant in many of the "tiki" rum drinks
Text: Tell your local liquor store to stock it, seeing it mixed in more and more drinks out and about. I learned originally about if from the Beachbum Berry books: Sippin' Safari: In Search of the Great "Lost" Tropical Drink Recipes... and the People Behind Them and Beachbum Berry's Grog Log.

I am a great fan of the k cups and have tried many flavors. My husband encouraged me to get this and I am not sure what I expected but it was definately not for me. Had a harsh bitter taste and was only made better by adding sweetner. I had orginally ordered it on subscribe and save hoping it would be a winner. Cancelled the subscription immediately. Coffee is such a matter of taste and one should not be put off trying something new becasue someone did not like it. Others giving reviews loved it so it is a very subjective thing. One reviewer stated it had a chemical taste to it. I may describe it the same way but the bitterness came through strong for me. To each his own... Try it you might like it. The hazelnut is so much better!

Much more flavorful and smoother than others brands.
Can make a great travel size mug of coffee with one K-cup (and not have just water like green mountain provides unless you use 2 K-cups).

Great price, Great coffee.... My choice by far.
This is my favorite coffee to drink in the morning.....  I just love it.  Perfect way to start the day!
Gloria Jean's Coffees makes a French Vanilla Supreme for the Keurig that is out of this world. If you like french vanilla try this!

I love vanilla coffee and after reading reviews of the various options for use in my Keurig Mini, I decided to give the Gloria Jean's French Vanilla Supreme a try. The "vanilla" flavoring is a bitter almost chemical flavor. Although it smelled good while it was brewing, the taste could not be helped much even by adding milk and sugar. Very disappointed in this one. Next time I will definitely order in a sampler pack before getting such a large box of one flavor. So far the only other vanilla I have tried was Timothy's which seemed a bit better. Timothy's World Coffee, French Vanilla for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2)

Summary: Kahlua and Gloria Jean's Vanilla Coffee Pods are Favorites
Text: We got the Kahlua and Gloria Jean's Vanilla coffee pods to try. I drink the Kahlua; my wife the vanilla. Both are mild blends with no bitterness. I get a hint of the distinctive Kahlua taste more from the coffee's smell than its taste. It has become my favorite. While I can't speak to the qualities/characteristics of Gloria Jeans' vanilla, I've noticed it has become my wife's favorite.

In the past I have preferred Van Houtte over other brands. Not this time. I could not discern any Vanilla like flavor in the Van Houtte French Vanilla but I could taste the vanilla here in Gloria Jeans. Not over powering though, but it was apparent. So G.J. you win this round.
Always trying to find a bargain and with Super Saver Shipping, price for Keurig K-cups can't be beat anywhere!  And when you need your coffee, speedy delivery is a must!

My wife and I do a lot of entertaining and serve either a caviar pie or caviar cups and have been using another brand for years; the other brand is no longer available therefore we switched to 'Season Brand'. It surpassed our expectations!

Absolutely all the cans, (eight in total) were received smashed and dented....ALL OF THEM!!! I was expecting to get maybe one or two cans smashed but not all of them. So sad that I spent my money on this product. Next time will get my cans from a supermarket for sure. As the product quality, I didn't have the chance to taste it, so can't say anything.
The gravy amount was substantial for the packet  size. Just don't follow the instructions on how much to use. Using half the amount listed as recommended might actually solve my problem.

I enjoyed and plan to buy more of this product.  So far I've only tried the savory herb.  Cooking it is simple and it thickens to a perfect consistency.  For me the flavor is too subtle so I have to use it along with other seasonings plus olive oil and yeast flakes.  Leftover gravy turns watery but is still useable depending on what you are putting it on.

I love Tea Forte teas. I have the African Solstice...smooth, creamy, lovely hints of vanilla. I also love the Winter Chai. I like the fragrance of the Raspberry Nectar. However, upon brewing it then tasting it, it's very sour. That's my only comment.

I travel for work, and have long enjoyed Coffee-Mate's French Vanilla creamer in many forms, none of which are nearly as convenient as these single-serve, dry packages. No mess, no measuring, no fuss, just add to coffee and enjoy!

I shall be purchasing more of these, from this seller, in the future.

Summary: Not very big but rather "fun size" packets
Text:
The quality of the product was superb. The snacks themselves are very tastey, soft, and chewey in a variety of fruit flavors. I don't want my following comments to reflect negatively on the great flavor and quality of the gummies.

That being said..... the size of these pouches is VERY SMALL. There are about 8-10 gummy pieces in each pouch. This is by no means a "snack" and is very much like what you would give to a trick or treater I also compare the portioning of the pouches to a snickers "fun size" candy bar. "Fun size" candy is usually a tiny piece of the product and is not really a true "portion". (And for that matter, what's so "fun" about less candy???) If you want to hand these "pouches" out as trick or treat items, they are well suited for that. If you want a REAL SNACK to tide you over until dinner, grab about 3-4 of the pouches and take them with you.

They're in decent sized individual packages (each containing 80 calories, 0 calories from fat) and they absolutely delicious. Much better than any other fruit snacks I've had in a long time. They're made in the USA (and/or Spain? [says that on the packages]). It does contain gelatin, so it's not vegetarian friendly. It doesn't say it's vegetarian or organic on the box either, so it's not misleading in any way.

NOTE I get this box (same size, same amounts, etc) for about $10 at Costco Wholesale... So if you live near one, this is definitely a more economic choice.

While Welch's fruit snacks are great and tasty, they are easy to go through as it takes about 20 seconds to finish a bag. These vanish very quickly and really arnt worth the 20.00 it costs to buy 80, should be more like 5-10 dollars

Summary: Great Gravy at a GREAT Price!
Text: Went back to order this again and realized that it has been almost a year ago that I placed my last order. I love the 24 pack and you can't beat the price! We eat country fried chicken/steak a couple of times a month. We had been looking for another white gravy since being a southern girl living up north that is the only way to eat it. Unfortunatley it is harder than heck to find white gravy in the stores here. We gave this product a try after seeing the others reviews and have to say we all were happy with it! That is quite an accomplishment with 3 picky kids. We usually use a couple of packs each time when our whole family of 5 is eating. I joke with my kids when they "drown" their food in this stuff that they might as well take the whole bowl and eat it with a spoon! ;) Anyway we love this stuff and hope that amazon keeps selling it!

The reviews helped convince me to try this product, as I was looking for a really good quality packaged country gravy. I like country gravy from time to time, but seldom want to go through the trouble of making it myself. This is definitely the best one I have tried by a large margin. I don't think I could make it better and I cook very well.

The flavor is very rich. The consistency is smooth and velvety. I didn't even add one spot of salt...that was amazing in itself as I was sure that I would need to add salt! What I did, that was ever so slightly different from the instructions, was to go ahead and get the 2c of water boiling. Meanwhile, I have one of those Tupperware shakey things and put the other cup of water & the mix in that and shook it up. It blended up super well. Then, when the water boiled, I got a whisk and slowly poured the mix into the boiling water while whisking. It only took a minute to return to a boil and come up to the proper consistency.

The thought of buying 24 of these super-sized packages was a bit daunting, but I put them in airtight containers in the freezer and I think that should keep them even past the expiration date on the packages.

What I do, since each package makes so much and I am usually just making a little something for me only, is to freeze the remainder of it in single portion sizes then I can vacuum seal each one separately with my Foodsaver and take out one portion at a time. That works best for me, as I have found that if I just put country gravy in the refrigerator to use over a several day period it gets kind of gross and separatey, even in airtight containers. It freezes and reconstitutes VERY well if stored properly.

Yummy my boyfriend is a diabetic and since he was diagnosed 5 years ago I have been searching for frosting to make a cake and this was perfect. He loved it and low and behold I did also. Our son did to he is 9 and couldn't tell the difference. He had no clue it wasn't real cake icing.

I think this product deserves 4 well deserved stars for several reasons. I bought this and the chocolate cake mix, which you should read my review to, and I believe that this was pretty good quality. For sugar free products, it's very hard to find something that's tasty and to my liking. I am very picky. This product was for my father who is a diabetic, but I wouldn't give my father anything that I wouldn't eat myself.

The frosting was very easy to make, just add some water and swirl in a circle and BOOM you have frosting. What I loved about this product was, just like the cake mix it was a bit of a surprise. When I opened the package, the box was very light and both the cake mix and this frosting were very powdery almost too powdery to my liking. They were both "Just Add Water" products, and with both of them I found myself very hesitant to add water to them because I thought I might dissolve this powder, however after just a half of cup of water and a few swirls, I got some good tasting frosting!

Now, To be 100% honest, the frosting has a little funny taste, but it's not a terrible taste. But being that the product is a sugar free product, you do have to take into consideration the fact that that's what's going to be expected from the product. However, the after taste wasn't so bad that it over powered the frosting, it was like a light minty feeling to a chocolatey frosting. It's not completely to my liking, not something that I would eat regularly I prefer the real chocolate frosting over this one, however, when you eat it with the chocolate cake, it's almost like you're not missing anything. My suggestion to you, is if you MUST get the icing then YOU MUST get the sugar free chocolate cake with it as well because it's soo much of a treat. I think it was worth it. Fast shipping, I made the frosting in under 5 minutes, the cake baked in about 15. You can have a sugar free cake in 20 minutes! I would buy again.

Summary: So Good why isn't it Bad???
Text:
After a couple of days to try out these 2 Peanut butter substitutes (the regular and chocolate versions) I can say I'm a convert. I LOVE peanut butter, for me it's a trigger food. If I eat it, I tend to want to eat half the jar at once and it can lead to wanting to eat other things I know I shouldn't. I've worked damn hard to shed 170lb this past year and half and indulging in PB is something I very rarely do anymore. I'd all but given it up. So actually finding something like this, which will allow me to enjoy the occasional PB&J sandwich without the feelings of guilt and remorse is a godsend!
The reg. version of PB2 does have a roasted peanut taste to it, so it's not quite like regular PB, you don't get the salty sweeter taste of Jiff or Skippy. JUST the roasted peanut taste. But it's quickly adapted to. And the Chocolate version (which I was more skeptical of) was even better! You can eat either one right after you mix them with water, but I think they're best when added to something else.
First of all I like to mix a base of reg PB2 with the chocolate version since I prefer a bit more of the nutty flavor to the chocolate. When just eating the chocolate my first thought was this would be great on whole wheat with a smear of marshmallow creme. And I don't even like marshmallow creme. But I will probably try it out one day to see if I'm right.
Either spread works great on fruit. I've tried apples and bananas so far. I also tried a PB&J with reduced calorie jelly and it worked very well. Good enough to replace the high calorie reg. PB&J sandwiches.

It might sound strange but one combo I REALLY like is to scoop a bit of the powdered PB onto a fat free potato chip (I use Pringles fat free sour cream) and no there wasn't a taste clash or anything. I'm sure you could use the reg Pringles fat free, I just happen to think the sour cream ones taste better. Anyway turn the chip upside down and scoop a bit of powder into the "bowl" of the underside and eat. The salt of the chip is the first thing that hits your tongue and then the PB powered crumbs. And the combo is just....yumm!!!! Like that, it really does taste like any PB you could buy. I tried it with the chocolate version too, and there it's really like eating a peanut butter cup. And surprisingly the salty chip and powered PB isn't dry in the mouth. Quite the opposite actually. Now on the other hand, I tried adding the powdered PB2 as a topping to my skinny cow ice cream as I do on occasion like some melted PB on my ice cream, but there it DID dry out my mouth completely. Very strange. So I decided to try and mix the PB2 with water then heat it up in the microwave to see if it would melt like reg PB. It didn't. It got hot, but ended up dry like the cookie dough for peanut butter cookies where you can basically ball it up in your hands. I guess without all the fat the PB2 can't melt like standard peanut butter. So as for ice cream topping, at least so far, it hasn't worked.
I am looking forward to seeing what else these 2 powdered products would work with and am already planning on ordering the larger sizes as I'd like to try some baking with them too.

All in all, I highly recommend them!

Edit; Okay so it DOES work as a melted peanut butter substitute on ice cream. The key is to start with a base of water and gradually add powder to it until you get a very creamy consistency that will run off a spoon, just like melted pb *then* heat it up in the microwave. My first attempt with this method I used far too much water so be careful there. I kept adding bits of powder including the chocolate version for fear I'd use all my pb2 up. But it was so much water I couldn't thicken it up enough and decided to start over. However, rather than just throw it all out, I decided to try it out as a drink. And you know, heated up, it was like a super rich cup of cocoa....delish! Even with no added sweetener it was sweet enough. And as a plus, since it's just water you can save those calories there. Not to mention, if you're lactose intolerant like me, regular hot chocolate is out anyway.

Now even though this stuff is 85% less than regular peanut butter it does have some calories and fat, so I wouldn't over do it. But as an occasional indulgence, I'm so happy I found this!

PS: I just want to add since purchasing PB2 from Amazon I've found a site called "netrition.com" and I highly recommend buying food stuffs from them. Amazon is great for pretty much everything else, but they are way over priced on their food.
I bought the large 16oz pack of PB2 from netrition for only 7.99 per bag. the same price Amazon charges for the small 6.5oz size! They don't have free shipping like Amazon, but they only charge $4.95 flat shipping fee no matter how much you buy. So it's not bad. Maybe because I bought so much, or it was my first time ordering but they also sent me a free low cal. quick cook cake mix. They were also way WAY cheaper on PB2 peanut butter crackers and everything else I ordered from them.

So like I said, Amazon is great for most things, but when it comes to food, Netrition is a whole lot better!

My husband likes his coffee dark and strong, but not too acidic.  I usually drink decaf, but occasionally have a cup of regular.  Of the many k-cup coffees we've tried, this is a favorite of both. Bold, with good aroma and smooth flavor.  Perfect for my husband on the smallest cup setting, and for me on the larger.
From the several makers of K-cup coffees I've tried, Black Tiger makes the best tasting cup of coffee!  It's robust, yet not bitter or acidic.  It's the perfect morning coffee for me.

I have had a K-cup machine at work for a year or two; and one at home for over a month; I am an addict for strong coffee/ we have a club at work (not k-cup related) and we get PEETS' coffee/ its really bold and rich.

I have had most every extra-bold roast for the K-cup machine. In my opinion, the Black tiger is a great tangy bold coffee with enough earthiness too but nicely powerful and flavorful. A great combination. A double dose of this in the travel mug and its heaven. If you are like me and like dark coffee that actually still has flavor... You will really love this one.

This is definetly a keeper in my pantry.  I tried the Donut Shop and the Black Tiger and by far everyone prefers Black Tiger. Donut Shop tastes, well like a cup of coffee from a Dinner, or McDonalds. But Black Tiger has a strong taste without any of the bitter undertones.

The Coffee People Bold Black Tiger Dark Roast is by far the best K-Cup I have tried.  I have had my Keurig brewer for about a year now and I have bounced around from brand to brand sampling the different coffees to find one that really speaks to me.  The Black Tiger may be that coffee.  I like a strong cup of coffee, but I don't want it to be bitter or taste burned.  The Black Tiger has no bitterness or over-roasted taste to it.  It is very smooth and full bodied.  I have also tried the Timothy's Rainforest Espresso and this coffee is far superior in texture, body, flavor, and strength.  I keep 3-4 different types of K-Cups near my brewer and ever since I bought the Black Tiger it is the only coffee I have drank!

Coffee People K-Cup Extra Bold Black Tiger Roast is an exceptionally robust, bold flavor without even approaching bittnerness.  And, it avoids the 'greasy' richness of some other brands, which for me at least, can cause a queasy stomach.  This is my favorite!

Summary: If you like your dark roast coffee, this is the best we have found
Text: We have had our Keurig about 6 months now.  Overall, we think most of the coffee selections brew pretty weak coffee.  If you know anyone from Louisiana, this is not going to cut it. We like our coffee dark and heavy.  With that in mind, we have tried just about every dark roast coffee available.  This is by far the darkest we have found with bold flavors that live up to the larger cup size.

I got a good deal on this from the Amazon warehouse, so I jumped on it. I'm not at all disappointed. While it's not the best coffee in the world, it's what I consider to be a very good dark roast. I would compare it favorably to Starbuck's dark roast, but maybe not quite as bold.

I'm not much of a coffee snob, so I can't really give much more of an in-dept review, aside from it's a good dark roast.

This coffee is burnt tasting. Like burnt toast. The burnt taste overpowers the other flavors that may be there. Not much coffee flavor detectable, reminds me of and old fashioned large percolator, after several hours, only more burnt tasting. I have not had this problem with any other K-cups. This one, Black Tiger, stands out as the worst tasting. Adding milk added will not mask the overwhelming sour, bitter and chalky flavors. I have tried it several times over the past 2 years, so I think I have sampled a few representative "batches." My wife, who prefers the darkest roasted coffees, consistently complains about the taste, and drinks it only as a last resort. She drinks a lot of coffee, and I see her point.

Try any other brand, Donut Shop, Dark Magic, French Roast, any other brand is much more drinkable. Maybe some folks appreciate the burnt taste. If you like the taste of burnt toast, then you might like "Black Tiger."

Summary: fixed the grinds problem; great coffee!
Text: Jet Fuel is nice and strong coffee with excellent flavor!  Once in a while the kcup releases coffee grinds into the liquid. I contacted Green Mountain Roasters, who make Jet Fuel, and they suggested this fix:  when inserting your kcup into your coffee machine, push the kcup DOWN onto the little puncture needle until it is sitting firmly in place.  Then continue as you normally would for your Jet Fuel cup.  The grinds-into-the-coffee should not happen again.  Reason: pushing DOWN releases some of the pressure in the kcup which prevents the problem.  This has worked for me and I haven't encountered the problem since.  If you have a problem with quality, go to the Green Mountain Roasters website and send customer service an email. They were very responsive when I emailed them!  They'll want the lot number on your Jet Fuel, so be prepared!

Summary: Grilled Tuna Treats by Petite Cuisine
Text:
Ok, so my cats aren't really "petite", well except for the one, but I think they still enjoyed these snacks. In fact, 4 out of 5 cats in my household enjoyed these treats. There are some really great things about this brand, and some not so great things though.

We'll start with the good. This tuna smelled so fantastic that I was half tempted to take a nibble myself. You could tell they used quality fish and judging by their packaging, they were smart in their harvesting of the fish too. Its got the dolphin safe logo and the eco-safe sustainable fishing stamp as well. They go on to say that they take a break four months out of the year so that the fishing population remains intact. I'd say that's a pretty good way of doing things. Its also advertised as a natural product. So that's pretty cool in a earth safe kind of way. The only ingredients are tuna (wild caught) and water so that's impressive as well with all the additives even being added to pet food anymore.

Since I gave all the cats in the household (and that is again 5 between my mother and I) I was able to see the reaction of many different types of "personalities" to this food. The one that doesn't think she's allowed to eat in front of us, went straight for it and started nibbling, but then snubbed her nose. The old senile cat immediately ate it and then started eating the blanket she was laying on thinking there was more. The bully cat ate one piece and then looked broken hearted when the smallest cat (who bullies the "bully" cat) hoarded the rest of the food. That just left the one other cat who gobbled it up while meowing her pleasure and then started looking for more. Overall it was pretty successful.

Now on to the not so good things. My first complaint with this product would be the packaging. Upon opening I immediately got squirted with tuna water and had to go change my shirt as I didn't want the cats trying to eat me (and you know the old senile one would try). The plastic was tough to rip at the seals and that could have accounted for some of the problems, but it also didn't have much of a lip for pulling apart either. Next problem was the size of these things. It came in three large slabs and I used one slab and broke it apart for all five cats to share as a treat. And they still got plenty that way. I'm not sure what they're thinking when they call this food a "treat." And since there's only three slabs, I'm going to get honest here and say that for the price, you could buy quite a few cans of tuna packed in water and have essentially the same thing as what came in this package. Even if you bought them at whole foods you could probably get three cans for the same price. So I'm not sure if this is quite a deal even if it is a eco-friendly product.

The cats liked it though and if I were feeling in a generous mood I might get it for them again. It just wouldn't be a regularly scheduled treat.

Review by M. Reynard 2011

Summary: As good as instant coffee gets!
Text: I've always been disappointed by instant coffee. But things have changed with VIA. But, when i tried the Starbucks Via Columbia I had no regrets. Far superior then any instant. I'm not big on Starbucks, i have never ordered coffee from Starbucks. In fact, i'm shocked they got this far with the prices and silly names for sizes, etc. The entire experience going into a Starbucks makes me roll my eyes and leave everytime. But anyway, this instant coffee has great roasted taste and aroma. I'll def buy this in bulk from amazon. The 50 count for $29 breaks down to about 60 cents per cup, which the best way to go. They make great coffee, quick.

Shame on Amazon for enhancing their financial facts (list price $50) on this product. First, Starbucks list this item for $35.95 so there is no $21.05 savings. Next, add in the shipping cost and your saving is further erroded. The bottomline is that Amazon is not rewarding you with a 42% saving....With that said, I love brewed coffee and drink my coffee black. For an instant coffee VIA brand is probably one of the best on the market. The Italian Roast is labeled "extra bold" by Starbucks and indeed it is. This is not a very smooth coffee and has a robust taste. If you like a medium taste (ex. Colombia) you might want to give thought before buying the Italian Roast. Even though the Columbian is medium this coffee still has a rich flavor. An if you prefer a strong coffee (as I do) this is not the one. Last thing for those who drink brewed coffee (and especially black coffee) every morning. The VIA is NOT a substitute brand for your every morning coffee. This is fine as an emergency when freshly brewed coffee is not possible. Oh yes, I have purchased the VIA direct from Starbucks and the grocery store, the "use by" stamp on the coffee has been from four to eight months (grocery store). So, the shelf life the buyer sees depends on how long its been on the shelf of the seller and when you make the purchase. Would I purchase this product? Yes, but I would compare prices (at the grocery store-no shipping cost, Starbucks, etc.) before I purchase from Amazon.

Izze is onto a pretty good idea here - sparkling water fortified with vitamins and flavored with real fruit juice. Summary: Sparkling Juices That Beat Ordinary Sodas . . . Hands Down!
Text:
When I heard about IZZE drinks, I went looking. The way I figured it, in my small town, I'd be lucky to find anything other than the highly advertised, obligatory sodas I stopped drinking several years back. I found IZZE in only one store, but, happily, it was on sale. It seems that nobody around here has heard much about IZZE so the store wasn't selling a lot.

I predict that's about to change.

Here's why:

1. IZZE products contain 70% fruit juice and 30% sparkling water. Period. No added sugar, no artificial flavors, no artificial colors to send your kids up the wall. Just the good stuff, just the real stuff!

2. IZZE's delicious. I tried blackberry, pomegranate, and clementine - all great tasting!

3. IZZE comes in cans containing only 8.4 oz, so you don't load up on sugar and carbonation. Think portion control.

4. IZZE (in cans) is fortified with vitamin C, niacin, and B6 in small amounts. At least you're getting a dab of nutrition along with the taste of a very good soda.

5. IZZE flavors vary in sweetness. Blackberry is very sweet, but pomegranate is more on the tart side. There's something to suit most tastes without the cloying sweetness of kids' juice drinks.

I predict IZZE will soon appear on the shelves of my regular grocery store. It's that good!

I ended up ordering 3 cases of it from Amazon and it was shipped free to our door within a week. The whole process was easy and convenient.
A wonderful flavour and the 8.4 fl oz is enough to quench my thirst on most occasions.

NO REFINED SUGARS, NO CAFFEINE, NO PRESERVATIVES, 70% PURE FRUIT JUICE WITH A SPLASH OF SPARKLING WATER AND FORTIFIED WITH VITAMINS.

One can is one serving and contains 90 calories.

I had a case of the Sparkling Blackberry but it tasted more like grape soda to me. None the less I found it tasty and the carbonation level was just about right. If I were concerned with the calories (I am not) I could see cutting it with some water.

I feel good about recommending this product to Amazonians.

Summary: Blackberry has good flavor, but what's up with the fizz?
Text:
I am not a fan of the fruit-flavored sparkling waters sold by so many soda and water bottlers. If you are going to carbonate a beverage, why not really carbonate it instead of the halfway carbonation of sparkling water? Izze has the light "fizz" of those sparkling waters, but the flavor is much better because it is 70% juice.

Overall, I enjoyed the taste. I keep a supply in the refrigerator and, although I do not drink it every day, I find that it is a nice change from water or soda. The 8.4 oz. cans are just right, and they chill quickly. As others have pointed out, the flavor is much better cold than at room temperature.

So would I buy it again? Maybe. My husband and I both thought it was "OK." We liked drinking it, but would not go out of our way to buy more. And we do not feel any sense of urgency to try other flavors.

If you are looking for a somewhat healthier soda replacement, Izze may be a good choice. For juice, I will stick to plain, old-fashioned juice.

4 stars only because I think they're too expensive, however, it is an effectice and convenient product - easy to use (the yellow flags have a small area on the edges that aren't sticky, which makes them easy to grab and bend in half to fit onto the stake - you'll learn that quickly, as grabbing the yellow flags in the sticky area is something you'll want to avoid)

If using insecticide, these are a great aide/indicator as they'll let you know if the plant is free or still infested. When I used these to catch white flies, I staked all my plants. Within days, the flags in the two plants that were most infected were full - letting me know which soil(s) were the ones that needed complete repotting.

Then, after using insecticide, I checked the flags each day to see if more flies were getting trapped and thus still present.

If you think you have an infestation these flags will catch the little ***kers and help you determine if more insecticide treatments are necessary.

These do catch fungus gnats as advertised, and they are relatively inexpensive.  If you have more than just a few gnats I would recommend you get some of the larger two sticky sided traps available from amazon and elsewhere.  They cost a bit more but are a much better value.  These traps are small and one sides, and are quickly filled up and no longer of use.  Most double sided commercial versions are about 3 times as large or larger, and have sticky material on both sides.

This is one of my favorite veggie stir frys.

Bok Choy

Ingredients

1 tbsp vegetable oil
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 tsp freshly grated ginger
1 lb bok choy, sliced
1/4 cup water
2 garlic cloves, pressed or minced
1 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
1/8 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, optional

Directions

Cut end off bok choy, keep stalks together and slice. Keep white stem pieces separate from green leafy pieces. The white pieces need to cook a little longer than the leaves. Keeping stem pieces and leaves separate, rinse and place in a salad spinner. Or rinse and drain in a colander and pat with a paper towel to remove some of the water.

To make the sauce, combine water, garlic, oyster sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and red pepper flakes, if using, in a small bowl and set aside.

Heat a 14" wok or large skillet over medium high heat. Joyce Chen Traditional 14-Inch Flat Bottom Wok Set Combine the oil in a small bowl. Add ½ of the oil mixture to the wok and swirl around to coat sides. Stir in ginger. Quickly add white stem pieces to wok and stir fry 2 - 3 minutes or until pieces start to turn a pale green color and are slightly softened or are of desired tenderness. Stir or toss the pieces frequently.

Add remaining oil to wok and add the leaves. Stir fry 1-2 minutes or until the leaves are wilted. Remove from heat and place bok choy in a serving dish.

Pour the sauce into the wok. Cook over medium high heat 3 or 4 minutes or until the sauce is slightly thickened. Stir constantly to keep the sauce from burning. Pour over bok choy and serve.

Summary: Read the title people...this is "100% Chicory."
Text:
First off, I'd just like to state that most of the negative reviews of this product are unwarranted. The title says that this is 100% Chicory, and that's exactly what you get. There is no coffee in the mix, just "100% Chicory" meant for blending with the coffee of your choice. This is reiterated in the product description. If you feel misled, then you didn't take the time to read either.

Now, as for the product itself, Community Coffee Private Reserve Medium-Dark Roast, 100% Chicory (that's a mouthful), it's good. It's 100% chicory root, which you blend with whatever coffee you'd like. Each person is going to have their own preferences, so experimentation with your coffee-to-chicory ratio is key. I've blended it with a few Community Coffee coffee varieties, as well as several other, cheaper coffees, and I've found that a 3-to-1 ratio is best (my wife prefers 4-to-1 or higher, if she's going to use chicory at all). We use a French press, but a drip coffee-maker will work as well. Don't use anything for making espresso, such as a moka pot. I don't know this from personal experience, but apparently the chicory is much more water-soluble than coffee is, and it will really gum-up the smaller holes in those devices.

All-in-all, this is a great product, especially at the Amazon Subscribe and Save price. At 6 bags per order, you'll probably want to share, as even after giving a couple of bags away, you're getting much more than if you bought it from Community Coffee directly (while they only charge $3 per bag, shipping kills it at around $7). Blending your own New Orleans-style coffee with chicory is a much more economical and better-tasting way to do it (brands like CDM are overpriced).

Product did not work.  I have worked with starter for years/  I decided to buy something new.  I followed all of the directions--exactly as written--3 days later--nothing!

In the process, I got myself a nice glass jar (formerly a Clausen pickle jar) punched holes in the lid. I made sure to use wooden utensils when mixing. I went to the baby aisle of the grocery store and got a bottle of distilled water to make sure there would be no chlorine present.

Everything worked as described all over the place...very active starter...somewhat slow rising...pretty good bread texture...just no sour flavor.

So I purchased this product.

I followed the instructions carefully, feeding every 12 hours, using a glass container, stirring with wooden chopsticks and using distilled water. It took three days to activate and another day or two to get very reliable...and at that point it was....indistinguishable from the local starter. No sour aroma or flavor whatsoever.

In other words, a packet containing 1/2 tsp of ordinary flour would have worked equally well.

Summary: A nice change from your average sweetener
Text: For those of us with glycemic (blood sugar) issues this is my favorite sweetener for my morning cup of tea.  More subtle than honey and by far more pleasant than table sugar.  I love honey but the texture and flavor of this agave is wonderful.

I am very excited to have found this wonderful sweetener. It tastes great and is very versatile. I use it to sweeten beverages, for baking, and as pancake/waffle syrup (I put in a tiny bit of maple flavoring and just a little bit of real maple syrup). I love it-the kids love it-and the husband loves it. Agave rocks!

We love this natural sweetner.  It has a very low glycemic index so it doesn't raise your blood sugar and then make you crash like processed sugars.  We use this agave mostly for our teas in the morning and in our raw desserts when they call for a sweetner.

Wholesome's Organic Raw Blue Agave is a healthy alternative to sugar that does not raise your blood sugar level.  Great in tea, cereals, and easy to substitute for sugar when baking. My family loves it!
Agave nectar is very low glycemic. Excellent for diabetics. Nice mild taste & just the right amount of sweetness.

Agave is so much better for you than sugar. Even though the calories are the same, the low glycemic index makes all the difference in the world. Too bad more Americans don't know the importance of the glycemic index. We'd have a less obese society....
Organic Raw Blue Agave has a great flavor & consistency!!
I highly recommend this product!!!
I use this in all my baking instead of sugar and also use it as a syrup on oatmeal etc, very tasty and bakes fine

Summary: It's not gourmet, but it's tasty and easy for weekday nights!
Text:
Having been gluten free for most of my life, I was really excited when I found Mrs. Leeper's packaged meals. I never imagined that I would ever be able to have the gluten free equivalent of "tuna helper" or "hamburger helper." When I tried this boxed meal, I knew I had found a winner, and my (non GF) husband agreed. The corn noodles are very tasty and we both enjoy them equally- and the creamy, cheesy sauce is simple but goes very nicely with the tuna. I usually add some kind of fresh or defrosted vegetable- peas, green beans, etc. to the dish while it is simmering and then serve it with freshly chopped tomatoes and red or orange diced peppers on top. I doctor mine up with some freshly ground pepper and vietnamese hot sauce, but my husband likes it plain. Very, very good. My husband likes to make this when it is his night to cook, and I'm all too happy to let him. It may not be the most gourmet food product, but it's not horrible for you if you use lowfat milk, and it really is tasty for such a quick, easy GF meal.

-happy GF pasta chomper

PS I do have to say that this is my favorite of the Mrs. Leepers meals, perhaps because we don't eat meat or chicken. However, I do think the corn pasta and cheesy sauce is a real winner and superior to the other sauces and pastas. (For example, her chicken alfredo box meal is based on a rice pasta... it's ok, but seems a little lacking...)

Summary: Quick, delicious & easy go to meal...
Text: One of the best semi-prepared gluten free products in the market. You only need to add some milk, butter and tuna - though I add some frozen peas at the end as well. I can whip up this creamy and satisfying meal in a skillet in less than 30 minutes. The noodles cook up with a nice firm texture and the sauce is very flavorful...except for some fresh ground black pepper and a bit of salt it doesn't need to be "doctored" at all. Any leftovers reheat perfectly in the microwave (just add a teaspoon or so of water first). My non restricted husband loves this too. Amazon's subscribe & save program makes this boxed meal very affordable.

We use flavored syrups (such as Torani) to make Italian Soda or Seltzer with sparkling water. We like the light taste better than soda and are glad to be reducing our intake of sugar and sodium. I just received my Amoretti Cherry flavored Syrup. Let me just say, this is DELICIOUS. I absolutely love it. I cannot wait to try the other flavors we received. Also, the company provided AMAZING customer service!!

One helpful hint when using these syrups: If using them in cold drinks, such as soda, first place a small amount of the sparkling water in your glass. Add the syrup and stir until dissolved. THEN finish adding the sparkling water to fill your glass. Also, it is better to start with less syrup than what you need, then add a little at a time to taste.

I love the Amoretti bottles. They are very attractive and I don't mind leaving them out on the counter at all. Plus they are made of plastic, so if the kids knock them over, I don't have to worry about them breaking.

Then you've noticed that they aren't that common in the stores any more. I can never find the Tropical Fruits and they're my favorite. These ship fast, you get enough to last a while, and the price is right.

Amazon does have a great price for this item though... I paid $1.79 for one packet at a major chain!! That's insanity.

Not a big "dried fruit" lover by nature, THIS has changed my thinking.  Fresh fruit flavor in nicely dried form. Not at all leathery, very light texture. No additives is a big plus! Easy to grab and go, great for snacking or taking the edge of a "sweet" craving!
