Text:
Love these treats! They're chewy enough to take about 30 seconds to a minute to eat per piece, and have a great zesty orange flavor with a fiery ginger kick at the end that really stays with you (like ten minutes of slowly diminishing pleasant heat on your tongue from eating just one or two pieces). They don't get stuck in your teeth like some chewy candy does. And they're allergen-free (but made in a facility that also processes peanuts). No corn, no dairy, no soy, no gluten! They come individually wrapped, so there's no need to worry about eating them all fast once you open the bag.

If you're looking for more awesome, allergen-free candy, try Surf Sweets Gummy Worms, 2.75-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12). Not only are they delicious, but they even have Vitamin C in them! They also make Surf Sweets Gummy Bears, 0.9-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24) and Surf Sweets Organic Fruity Bears, 2.75-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12), which are sugar-crusted and chewier--in other words, they're basically gummy bear-shaped gumdrops. They're all great!

I first found these delicious little chews in a TJ Maxx and after tasting one, I am hooked! Not only are they sweet and spicy, they really help with motion sickness. Now I've found they are a perfect solution to my morning sickness as well. If you love ginger, I'd definitely recommend giving Chimes Ginger Chews a try. The orange and mango flavors are the only 2 I've tried so far, and both are fantastic!

Summary: Thrilled to find organic lasagna noodles
Text: No grocery store in my area carries organic lasagne noodles so I ordered these online. The price was good, and the lasagna noodles are fantastic. They're shorter than some other noodles, which is easy to work with, and they're a little thinner than others, too. I usually do a double layer criss-crossed to compensate. Especially since it is made with all whole grains. And this price on Amazon is $1 per bag cheaper than in the market. The mushrooms are cooked (as is pretty much everything in a can) and seasoned perfectly - not too salty so that when you add them to recipes you can adjust with your own soy sauce. These straw mushrooms are tender and perfect for last min add ons to any semi-home made meal!

this bar is delicious and filling.

the best thing about it is the subtle mix of chocolate with the tang of orange and cranberry. it is also moist and very chewy to boot. there is also the presence of some oat and nut pieces just to remind you that you are chewing on something good for you.

since receiving them, i have been snacking on them between meals or right before a four-hour rehearsal. after eating one, i feel full and my energy is well-sustained for the entire rehearsal.

this will be on my list of purchases for my summer trip to teach at arts camp!

Like some of the other reviewers, I like to eat nutrition bars for breakfast, or as a quick snack.

Unfortunately, these bars taste pretty bad to me. And the nutrition value doesn't make up for the poor taste.

They have only 4g of protein and a lot of sugar, so they don't make for a very filling breakfast. Also they are very dry, need to have a drink when you eat them, so that makes a poor choice for a on-the-go snack too.

I thought it was OK as pre-workout, perhaps because of the sugar giving me a little energy boost... but still, I'd rather just eat a cookie if I want a sugar spike.

Also, the Orange Cranberry flavor has no noticeable cranberries or cranberry taste. Though it does have a strong orange flavor, it tastes like orange extract, a little bitter and tangy.

I found the maggots when i rehydrated the mushrooms and strained the liquid through a paper towel to remove grit.

I ordered these last week and when they arrived I took a quick look at them and they seemed fine. This morning I opened one package as I was planning on making a nice mushroom sauce for my pasta later. I set them to soak and when they re-hydrated the first thing I noticed was that this particular package is mostly stems with very few caps in it. While all dried mushrooms include stems I was surprised to see more tough stems than caps, usually the mix of stems to caps is about equal, not so with this package. The flavor and aroma of them after reconstituting was fine. Guess I'll keep looking for a better quality dried mushroom.

I have been eating your product for years. It was one of my fovorite things. I would save my money just to buy a box. So this time I buy 2 boxes and to my ABSOLUTE dismay you have changed! I hosted a Moscow Mule party last year.  During that party, we tried several different brands of ginger beer (Fever Tree, Gosling's, Sioux City, and Cock 'n Bull).  Of those four brands, Cock 'n Bull was the unanimous choice of all of my guests at the party.  That vote includes drinking it straight and drinking it as a mixer in the Moscow Mule.  It has a distinct ginger punch that is lacking in the other brands (a punch that is needed to stand up to the fresh lime juice in the Moscow Mule), yet it is palatable enough to be served on its own.  This is a great mixer, and a great soda.

Dorothy Lynch is a fine salad dressing however $15.95 for a single 16 fl. oz. bottle of it is way too much.  This sweet/peppery condiment is one star at $1/fl. oz.  At $.30-$.40/fl. oz. it is probably a solid three star product.

I'm thrilled to have finally found a vitamin that provides essential nutrients and a much liked texture with a yummy taste that my children (& I and my husband) love!  As it says on the bottle, "for adults and kids alike"...so we can all take them!

Nordic Berries are perfect for picky and non-picky kids and their parents.  Our whole family takes them and takes them happily and I never have an upset stomach afterwards like I do with other vitamins. My kids think that are the best vitamin that we have ever purchased.

Summary: Is the sour coating really necessary?
Text:
I have been using Nordic Naturals products for years, way before I got pregnant with my son - so when it was time to choose a vitamin for him, I went straight to the Nordic Berries. Unfortunately, the sour coating made them completely unpalatable for our child. My husband and I have been gobbling them up, but the one who really needs them won't touch them. I have to wonder why they would put such a strong-tasting coating on a children's vitamin - judging from the reviews, mine is not the only child totally put off by this.

Total bummer, since these are the best around as far as manufacturing practices and purity of ingredients.

Summary: One Star is Too Many Stars
Text: The coffee was horrible. It had a bitter acidic flavor to it and the beans had a strong unmistakeable rancid odor to them. No date on the package as to when it was filled, but I would guess that the beans sat around for quite a while before being sold. They claim on their website that the beans are freshly packed, but nothing stating how long the product sits in a warehouse afterwards.

I've been drinking green smoothies for a while now, and decided I would try to improve them by adding even more nutrients with Amazing Grass. I opted for the berry flavor because most of my smoothies were made with berries anyway, so I thought it would go well. I also decided to go with Berry because it costed a few dollars less than the original. Next time, I will pay the extra few dollars. The taste reminded me of cherry cough syrup or something medicinal. It unfortunately ruined the taste of my green smoothie. Now I have this entire container to go through, I will probably just mix with water and gag it down. It's too bad, I was excited to use this product.

I think the berry flavor is far better than the veggie powder as far as taste goes but I don't mind either one.  I add this to some juice, kefir, some coconut oil whatever, but I always add stevia with it.  I think this is a very cheap insurance to staying or getting healthy.  I battled with my health my whole life.  I try now to stay as natural as I can with my health care now.  It leads me to `well' a lot quicker. I was one of those DES babies you may or may not have heard about.  Our mothers took DES which was a drug to prevent a miscarriage but what happened was it caused problems with the baby and left a compromised immune system.  This is why my whole life it has been one thing after another.  Well, THIS powder is fantastic.  When I take this consistently I have far more energy and I just seem to stay well.  When I get lazy about it and stop taking it I have no energy, I get foggy brained, down in the dumps.  Big difference. I figure if I take this in the morning, the rest of the day is covered as far as my fruits and veggies are concerned.  What I do eat on top of this is a bonus!  If you `really' really can't stand the taste then add the stevia, add fruit, juice whatever, it so worth taking this powder!!  Personally I have no problem with the flavor. Five starts from me!
I don't eat enough fruits and vegetables.  This is a good way for me to get the nutrition I would otherwise be missing. The taste is OK and the ingredients list is impressive.

This is my favorite of all the k-cup coffee I've tried since buying my new Keurig coffee maker in Nov. 2005.  It's got great flavor and is smooth to drink.  It's the only kind I'm buying at this time!

After trying many different "natural" sweeteners or sugar substitutes, Z Sweet is the best out there. It has no after taste and works and tastes just like sugar. I highly recommend it to anyone who can't take sugar and doesn't want an artificial, man made substitute.

I have already gone through 2 lbs. of ZSweet, and I think it's the best sweetener I've tried.  I don't like Stevia, and the common ones-Aspertame and Saccharin- are just too controversial in perhaps causing health problems. I am a member of Weight Watchers, and have always used Sweet & Low in foods such as oatmeal.  Since using ZSweet, I'll never go back to S & L.  Zsweet is terribly expensive, but I believe it's worth it, since they claim to have no chemicals in it. I do recommend it, if you want your sugar substitute to taste just like sugar.
I use in my coffee every morning instead of sugar.Plus I use it instead of sugar, to make a sugar free low calorie deliciou vanilla custard for desert instead of ice cream.

I use the black arlic in amost all my recipes, it adds a mystery flavor to everything I cook.  Everyone wants to know what the flavor is, when I show them the black garic they can't believe its garlic.

A lover of Keemun teas, mild but smokey, piney and deeply satisfying, unless I happen to have a specialty tea from Peets like Lion Mountain Keemun, this is my daily tea. With the prices of good teas going through the roof, this tea is moderately priced. It is also very consistent-- tin to tin and batch to batch-- so I get a very reliable cup every morning.
This makes a very satifying snack and a suppliment of protein to a meal.  I like that it is low in fat and calories.

I started a low carb. diet and have been trying different brands of turkey jerky.  Golden Valley Natural Turkey Jerky "BLACK PEPPER" was by far the worst I have ever tasted.  I've never left a review about any product I've purchased, good or bad, but I had to say something about this. It literally tasted like candied meat. It has 6 grams of carbs per serving (all from sugar)....double that of any other I've found.  Why would any company put so much sugar in a turkey jerky labeled black pepper?  They should have just called it brown sugar turkey jerky.  I threw it in the trash and got a refund from Amazon.  Amazon truly is an incredible company and I will continue to make purchases via their venue, but this turkey jerky......?

Ok, I know this is turkey and not beef.  It tasted really good but there isn't much actual turkey jerky in the pouch.  You could finish an entire bag as a small snack.  The product is advertised as 4 oz but the bags I received were only 3.5 oz and I question if that included the weight of the bag.

Not the biggest of mate drinkers and I've never liked any brand I've tried before this, but I keep trying because I like the IDEA of mate.

This stuff was downright drinkable - I actually look forward to a cup. Possibly it is a bit on the powdery side for folks who want their tea strained clear of bits, but I've never cared about a little roughage in my tea, so it seems fine to me. I had no difficulty detecting the added spices and I enjoyed them. This stuff is definitely worth a try if the idea of a flavored mate doesn't send chills up your spine.

I've purchased a few things from Davidson's over the past few years and I appreciate the no-nonsense packaging and the promptness when shipping. Never had a problem with the vendor.
I've used it to make icing for cake, and to make glaze icing for doughnuts and cinnamon rolls, it works great and it tastes wonderful.

I had a good time with this soup, I mixed it with a pasta mix and added some extra chicken, this made it a larger meal and it was very good. The soup by its self makes a good quick bowl of soup with great flavor.

Got these here once when they were on sale.  Great nuts!  They weren't available next time I wanted some, so got a large bag at W-M.  Difference was devastating.  These are so much better, fresher, tastier it was amazing.  Find the container and size you want and just plan to keep them in stock.

Summary: Doggie Diarrhea!  Back to Blue Buffalo Wilderness...
Text: Our three dogs have been grain free for over a year, and we were feeding them Taste of the Wild almost that whole time.  However, they had TERRIBLE, persistent gas everyday, so we decided to try a different brand of food.  We transitioned our boys to Blue Buffalo's Wilderness line (grain-free), and they did wonderfully for about four months - very little gas, healthy coats, and minimal dog-doo, too (which is a big deal considering we have a Mastiff, a Boxer, and an Alapaha Blue Blood Bulldog).  Amazon didn't offer Blue Wilderness for Prime (free shipping), so I was going to the store and lugging heavy food bags at least twice a month.  First we decided to try Nature's Variety Instinct (grain-free line), which gave them slightly more gas and couldn't be purchased locally.  We like to buy on Amazon, but sometimes, with three big dogs, we run out faster than I anticipate - having a local store for emergencies is pretty important for us.  We went back to Blue Buffalo for a couple months, and then next we decided to try EVO - all of my research said this was the absolute BEST.  Well, as the title of this review indicated, all three of our boys got miserable diarrhea.  We transitioned our boys slowly, but once we went over one-half EVO, all three of the boys filled the yard with 100% liquid stool.  Poor guys!  We transitioned them back and once they were below fifty percent EVO, their movements went back to normal - but only after two days of constipation.  Our boys are back to feeling good, and we're back to buying Blue Buffalo Wilderness.  You don't know unless you try, I guess, but I feel terrible for putting the boys through that.  Good luck to everyone searching for a new favorite food.

Golden flax seeds taste better than the brown variety. I grind them and add them to oatmeal, shakes, cereal, etc. They are a good source of anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory compounds including ALA which may get converted to EPA and DHA (Omega-3s). This is especially good for vegetarians and vegans who don't eat fish but want to get more of these healthy fatty acids in their diet from a whole food source, vs. supplements. They have a light but unique taste that might be described as nutty, grassy or vegetal taste. The texture is noticeable and somewhat gelatinous when  ground and mixed with liquid. They also work well as a vegan egg substitute and thickener. People sometimes add these whole to baked goods, but you don't really digest them or benefit from them unless you grind them. I think grinding them fresh is probably more likely to give you the best benefit vs pre-ground or oils, but don't know for sure. This is a lot of flax seed, so keep the unopened packages in the fridge and they'll keep for a long time.

I have been using these flax seeds from Bob's Red Mill for about 6 months. They are absolutely fantastic! I use them in everything - in baking as an egg replacement, mainly, but also for smoothies and cereals occasionally. I keep them in my cupboard, and grind them in a coffee grinder as I need them.

They come fresh and packaged beautifully. They do have a lot of natural oil - Omega 3s anyone? - so when I grind them I sometimes have to use my finger to make sure they all come out of the coffee grinder.

Summary: Part of my Starbucks replacement recipe
Text:
After getting somewhat addicted to Starbucks White Mocha Frappe's, I decided I could probably save a lot of money and make my own. I bought this and Torani's White Chocolate sauce. I also like mine with a pump of Sugar Free Hazelnut, so I also bought Torani brand through Amazon.

For coffee, I bought 2-lb bags for French Roast beans at Costco. I grind and then make a strong pot of coffee (14 heaping teaspoons per 10 cups of coffee). After the coffee is made, I pour it into ice cube trays and freeze them.

The recipe is to add about 1 ½ cups of milk (I use 1%) in a blender, about two tablespoons of the White Chocolate Frappe mix, one "squirt" of the white mocha sauce, and one pump of the SFH. Last, I add eight coffee ice cubes. I blend it all up, and it makes about 20 oz. of Frappe.

Both my wife and I like it as much if not more that Starbucks, and of course it's much cheaper. By using both our Prime membership and the Amazon Subscribe and Save, it's even less, the supplies are always on the shelf.

The only little annoying downside (why I didn't give it five stars) is that the instructions say to add one scoop to make a frappe. Unfortunately, they don't include a scoop in the bag, nor can I find a definition of a scoop. So I just experimented until I liked the taste.

Summary: Smooth and drinkable but not outstanding
Text:
I am glad it is organic, and it looks as though they have put a lot into making their packaging materials healthy and earth-friendly.

The flavor is mild and the amount of caffeine is very low. This is probably because there is very little green tea in this mixture. The flavor mostly comes from the toasted brown rice. This is a nice enough flavor, but it is not really like a more traditional genmaicha which has the flavors of both the toasted rice plus the green tea.

I prefer either the Yamamotoyama or the Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf company versions of genmaicha for commercially available sources. The best tea would come from specialty importers, but that would be quite a bit more expensive.

I have been avoiding tea bags and go for loose leaf tea whenever possible because the taste tends to be better. Most tea in tea bags does not even taste like tea and most people do not even know that until they have tasted real tea! After reading some good reviews on this I was willing to give it a try and I am glad I did. This is the most aromatic tea I've had in a tea bag. I actually love genmaicha and it compares pretty well to some of the loose leaf varieties I have. I also like the wide range of flavors they offer and the staple-less bag is a nice touch. Only drawback is the price though.

I became a regular green tea drinker during the years I lived in Japan, and although I prefer loose-leaf tea I wanted some tea bags that I could drink at work. Genmai tea is one of my favorites, and I tried this "Choice Organic Genmai" thinking it might be an affordable, convenient way to brew up some of that delicious roasted rice flavor.

Like many, I found these tea bags to be drinkable but weak. I wasn't expecting it to be as good as the loose-leaf tea I buy, but I also wasn't expecting it to be so watery. You can get a decent cup of tea out of it if you make a small cup, but I really wish it was more robust.

I will keep drinking my way through the box I bought, but I don't think I will go back for seconds. There are probably better tea bag Genmais out there.
I love this tea; the toasted rice adds so much aroma that really is a treat
The product of course is wonderful, the price is fair and buying bulk is so much better than buying those small bags.

These "White Fudge" covered Pretzels are very good and make a good sweet snack since the white fudge covering is fairly thin, just enough to make it tasty but not enough to be overpowering. These get eaten up fairly quickly by my teens if we leave them out, so we generally put out one or two bags at a time.

Recommended!

CFH

Summary: good, but could be better in the chocolate department
Text: These are good, but the chocolate coating is a bit waxy and the chocolate could be more chocolaty.  The chocolate kind reminds me of a heftier version of the chocolate coating that Hostess or Little Debbie cakes have as an icing on their products.

Summary: Some of the best licorice I have ever had.
Text: I enjoyed the individual wrapped pieces of licorice as this kept them fresh until they were enjoyed. I also enjoy the other varieties of Panda licorice; all of their product is great.
If you like licorice this is the real stuff not some plastic HFCS with artificial flavors. This is honest goodness and delicious.
This is an excellent old fashioned snack with pure flavors.  A great pick me up and folks that say they dont like licorice adore this!

Almost 50 years ago when I was a young child, my Mom used to buy this cake mix. It is the best ever! Over the years I have never found another as good. It is strong gingerbread taste. My Mom used to frost it with homemade butter cream frosting. Such fond memories.

I got this product, and thought wow that's not a lot. Then I realized; it is!
I moved the powder to a glass container from that oh so classic container in the Spice rack from Bath and Beyond. This filled the container, and mixed with warm water makes a great paste! I suggest this on popcorn, sushi, in rubs, and whatever else Wasabi is good for

I'm writing this after almost 1 year of my 3 black and white cats being on this diet. We had tried so many different diets due to them leaving piles of spit up all over my floors/carpets. At the time I resorted to Diamond naturals, we had experimented with canned and dry food.

I'm giving the product a 4-star rating due to some spit up (less than 1 time per month). I'm very excited to at least find something that works!

It's not awful but it does not have the smooth green tea taste that untoasted tea has. I love strong teas and often use 2 bags per cup, but this one is too woody tasting for that. I'll drink it but won't buy again. Mixing with cranberry juice helps a lot.

Summary: At least the ingredient list is better than most
Text:
My cat has been on special prescription food, for his liver, for about the last 8 years. He hasn't been doing well, and is getting (at 14) pickier. I went looking for something that wasn't just corn, and found this. It is up there with the healthiest ones I could find.
And he loves it.
for a store bought product, this is not a bad choice, my cat seems to like it, at least for now...LOL thanks.

This is probably the best tasting nutrition shake that I've had, and I've had many.  It was a decent bargain when it was under $15, but now at nearly $19 for only 6 cans it is way over priced.  For less money, more protein, and nearly as good of taste, I would suggest Syntha-6 instead

I don't suppose there is any reason that this shake should not be delicious. Gatorade used generous amounts of sugar, fat and protein (along with natural and artificial flavors). The total calorie count here is 360 which is probably about right as a "bridge between meals" which is how it is intended to be used.

Bottom line--it is pretty much what you would expect from a chocolate shake (with some added protein).

I can never get enough of Taco Bell sauce, so it's been great having an extra bottle around! This sauce has just a little bit of kick - not too spicy - and adds a great flavor to meat, chicken, etc. As far as nutrition goes, this sauce is not your friend, but then again, neither is Taco Bell! (but it's good to indulge once in a while) Just to give you an idea, there are about 11g of fat per 2 tablespoons.

While this was a nice change from salsa and sour cream on my taco, it was not spicy enough. When it says spicy, I want spicy. If you normally use only salsa be aware that because this is a cream sauce, it has 10x the calories of salsa. But if you add sour cream, then it's comparable.  I esp liked that the bottle had a squeeze top so one could more easily control how much was used. I can't say that I"ll be buying this regularly but my kids liked it enough that I'll buy it if on sale or I have a coupon.

We had tacos tonight and I tried out a couple new sauces from Taco Bell. One of the sauces was the Bold & Creamy Spicy Ranchero sauce. I liked the sauce on the tacos, but would have liked it better if it were hotter with a stronger spicy taste. I like really hot and spicy food, so I found this pretty mild. With that said, it had a good flavor and I liked it.

I could see it being used on a variety of foods the same way you would use a ranch dressing. The main ingredient is soybean oil and 100 of the 110 calories in a 2 Tbsp serving size are from fat, so this is not a diet or light dressing.

Bottom line, I liked the taste, but would have liked it to have been hotter with more of a spicy kick. It is fattening, so don't load up on it. For a light different kind of ranch taste on top of your tacos or other dishes, it is a good sauce.

I like the idea of a creamy spicy sauce for Mexican food available in a bottle.  Unfortunately, I felt this missed the mark.  The sauce was nice and creamy, but the flavor was just off.  It had a weird taste that made me think of horseradish, which I can't stand.  None of my children liked the sauce either, and my husband just thought it was okay.

Have now tried it on a number of different things including tacos and burritos, turkey burgers, cheeseburgers and as a veggie dip. In all cases, so-so. It is essentially a spicy mayo without any great character - about what you'd expect from Taco Bell, I suppose. In fact, I liked it best on the turkey burger where it took advantage of the turkey's natural blandness to stand out some. The creamy texture is nice, but all in all, I pretty undistinguished addition to the condiment world. Not terribly bold or spicy, but it got the creamy part right. A safe bet if you're looking for something to put out for company you don't know very well. Perfectly edible and forgettable.

Summary: Taco Bell taste right in your own home
Text: I tried this on a taco salad and it was great.  Be advised that a little goes a long way.  I found it was perhaps more bold than spicy, but tasted very nice and left a great after taste.  I eat often at Taco Bell anddon't recall them having this in the resturant... they should because I think it would become a favorite quickly.  I recommend this sauce.

The Taco Bell Bold & Creamy, Spicy Ranchero Sauce didn't have as strong of a ranch flavor as I expected, but it was still really good.  The blend of spicy and creamy is really different and will make a nice change to your tacos and even wraps and toasted grinders.

It really doesn't "fit in" anywhere. I can't imagine this processed stuff is going to be better for you than natural spices or peppers. Its kind of zippy but I felt there was a strange after taste. I can't describe as anything more than "artificial".

It tastes ok and puts a little zip into an otherwise bland meal.

I wouldn't go overboard with it.

I prefer tabasco & natural peppers & spices to this.

Your mileage may vary.

This is a decent sauce but it isn't spicy or bold enough for me. It is fine as a veggie dip, can be used with quesadillas, and even as a salad dressing, but if you love really spicy sauces, this may have you reaching for hot pepper sauce to kick it up a notch.  My kids, however, think it is plenty spicy.

Summary: Best of the Taco Bell sauces
Text: This is by far the very best tasting of all of the Tack Bell Sauces. While it doesn't really give you that from a Tack Bell stand taste, it has a very smooth and balanced flavor that enhances rather than overpowers what you put it on. I particularly like it on scrambled eggs, soy cheese, green onions & lettuce, wrapped in a whole wheat flour tortilla. While I haven't been a fan of the other Taco Bell sauces, they hit a home run with this one. I'm now a loyal fan of the Taco Bell Bold & Creamy Spicy Ranchero Sauce. ENJOY!

I was expecting this to taste like Taco Bell's Ranchero Sauce, this does NOT!  I realize it's probably more like a traditional Ranchero Sauce, but when labeled by 'Taco Bell' you expect it to taste like theirs! Highly DISAPPOINTED!  This has a bland chili powder taste...don't waste your money on this one.

Summary: Not Sure What I Expected, But...
Text: ..we really did NOT like the flavor of this sauce.  I haven't tried any of the other flavors, but this sauce (to us) has a very artificial, unappealing taste - enough so that we pitched the bottle after it failed our first two taste tests with tacos and steak & cheese quesadillas.  Definitely would not spend money to purchase this sauce again.

This is probably the best of the available Taco Bell Sauces, but that's not really saying much. I doubt I'd use ANY of them again, but if I absolutely HAD to, it'd probably be this one. The taste is a weird cross between Ranch and a Mayo-diluted jar of Taco Bell's Fire Sauce. The spice totally overwhelms the Ranch, and while I'm generally in favor of extra spice, the flavors just do not mix well. I'll stick with the little packets of Fire Sauce that you get in the restaurant, thanks.

This sauce is spicy enough..just doesn't really taste that good.  The texture is creamy as advertised, but I wouldn't pour it on my taco or tortilla chips..ever.  Might be good as a sauce over boneless skinless chicken.  Somewhere in the taste, it makes me feel like mayo has been added..or something I can't identify exactly.  Make yr own salsa, you would be better off.

Summary: Great product, wish I'd bought this sooner
Text:
I've had a recipe for Fattoush Salad for years. Every once in a while, usually after making a batch of pita bread I'd think about Fattoush and wonder where I could find Sumac (one of the essential and authentic ingredients). Finally, it occurred to me that I could order it, online! Duh! Sometimes I'm slow, so then I looked around, a lot of the other vendors on here were offering truly hugemongous amounts of Sumac and my recipe calls for just one teaspoon, what would I do with a pound?

Also, I wasn't sure if I would like the taste of sumac. The descriptions I read for it said it was 'lemon-y, but not bitter, sherbet-y (sherbet flavored herbs??) anyways, I just couldn't be sure if it would be tasty to me and I wasn't willing to risk much on a bottle of herbs that I might end up tossing.

Well, from the moment I opened the bottle, I knew I liked sumac. It is a little citrus-y smelling, but I also recognized the smell, it is mouth puckeringly familiar, it smells like A-1 Steak Sauce to me, or rather, the one ingredient I could never completely identify, tart, savory with a fruity punch. I don't mean to go all smarmy-foodie about this, but I am feeling rather enthusiastic about this, new-to-me, spice.

Okay, so onto product packaging. my spice came in a plastic bottle, not a resealable bag. The bottle was sealed and the seal was unbroken.

This popcorn is great. I got a popcorn machine this past Christmas and have struggled to get the "theater" popcorn I've been wanting. I tried different brands of popcorn including Orville, but just couldn't get it just right. Either the popcorn would be too crunchy or too chewy. Nice and crispy, not crunchy, and not a bit chewy in the middle. Well, I'm here to tell all you people having similar issues, TRY THIS POPCORN! Not saying there aren't other brands out there that will work, but this one has done it for me.

By far one of the best food purchases I've made on Amazon in a long time. My kids have been loving air popped popcorn but the store bottles are so expensive! This is a huge bag that's lasted us over a month of popping nearly every day and we still have over half the bag left. Summary: Inferior to what Peet's used to produce. Try a local roaster.
Text:
When I lived in the San Francisco Bay Area, I discovered Peet's coffee. At that time, it was still a small, local roaster. I loved their "Viennese Blend," and used to drink it daily and serve it to guests; it had a wonderful aroma and rich, almost chocolatey flavor. I moved away, but continued to buy that coffee when I was on the West Coast and order it by mail... until one day it disappeared from the Web site.

I then found out what happened: Peet's was attempting to transform itself from a high quality local roaster into a competitor of Starbuck's, to be carried by major supermarket chains such as Safeway. Maybe the Viennese Blend required an extra penny to make, or took an extra second of time, or wasn't suited for huge mass production. But for whatever reason, the company was discontinuing its best coffee in favor of inferior alternatives such as this one.

"Major Dickason's Blend" is roughly on a par with some of the better Starbuck's blends you also see in third party stores. This coffee isn't horrible, but it's just nothing to write home about. It's not worth a premium price. If Amazon had half stars, I'd rate it about 3.5 out of 5. I've switched to a local roaster where I live who is willing to take the time to duplicate the care and effort that Peet's put into its products back in the day, before it went all mass market.
Pretty good stuff. It's a French Roast, but not as strong as "Dark French Roast". Don't be afraid to try it.
Price and quality are always good.  Hearty, rich coffee flavor without over- or undertones.  Consistent.  Recommended for first cup of the morning - save the subtlety for later.
we have buying our coffee here for over a year. it comes quicly. there have been no problems. more impotant i still have the morning coffee. thanks

I love genmaicha tea, so I was happy to find some in tea bags for drinking at the office. Unfortunately, the roasted rice flavor in this tea is very mild. I find myself using two tea bags to get a decent mug of tea.

I've been eating flax seeds, using the oil, and the meal for nearly a decade and know exactly what it is all supposed to smell and taste like.  I've tried many brands and ground it myself as well. I bought this kit for a friend. We brewed it. It was alright. There are definitely better things to make beer out of. For starters, I don't like using malt extract out of a can. I've tried it a few times, and it's never really been good. Drinkable, but not very good. I'm also not a huge fan of powdered extracts. When extract brewing, I prefer to buy from my local home-brew shop. A local home-brew shop will likely have a bulk supply of fresh extract that they can sell to you in a food-grade plastic container. Personally, I feel that this does affect the taste of the finished product.

Next, the hops pellets. Okay, these things can go stale and produce off-flavors. Any good home-brew store will keep their hops and hops pellets in a refrigerator to preserve freshness. This is not something you can do with a kit in a box.

Finally, the yeast...does what it is supposed to do, I guess. While there are some really decent powdered yeasts out there, I have been happier with the beers I've made using liquid yeast from White Labs.

In short, yes, you can brew beer with this product and yes, it will have alcohol in it and you can get drunk off of it, but seriously, if you are into home-brewing to really make a great beer, then you should probably pass on this product. You owe it to yourself to go to your local home-brew store and spend a few extra dollars on a good recipe with fresh ingredients.

Hidden Valley Ranch Dressing have MSG. Well here are a few others taken straight from a review from The Observer:
When you next grate parmesan cheese onto some dull spaghetti, what you will have done in essence is add a shed-load of glutamate to stimulate your tongue's umami receptors, thus sending a message to the brain which signals (as one neuro-researcher puts it) 'Joy and happiness!' Supper is rescued - and your system has added some protein and fats to a meal that was all carbohydrate.

Ripe cheese is full of glutamate, as are tomatoes. Parmesan, with 1200mg per 100 grams, is the substance with more free glutamate in it than any other natural foodstuff on the planet. Almost all foods have some naturally occurring glutamate in them but the ones with most are obvious: ripe tomatoes, cured meats, dried mushrooms, soy sauce, Bovril and of course Worcester sauce, nam pla (with 950mg per 100g) and the other fermented fish sauces of Asia.

So, I am keeping my Hidden Valley Ranch products. Thanks for making my life easier and better since I now know what is going into my dressings because I had 90% of it myself.

Will not prepare from scrath again. This is just as good if not better.
We love it!

I have tried several different types/brands of organic coffee and this is one of the best! Although, it does stink when I brew it (not sure what that is about); it tastes delicious though so I don't mind the mild stench. Would recommend this to family/friends.

Summary: the BEST sauce I ever had!!!
Text: I have never written a review before...that's how much I LOVE LOVE LOVE this sauce! I have never liked red tomato sauces of any kind and I've tried many. I usually make a white alfredo sauce for my pasta which is not exactly low fat and not the best choice for my slim down program. I was excited to find and try this sauce because I really like the taste of butternut squash. I didn't tell my husband what is was before he ate it because he's not a vegetable kind of guy and hesitates to try anything new. After I knew he liked it I told him. This is a great way to eat healthy (only 4 grams of fat per serving) and sooooooo tasty with just the right amount of sweetnesss. Amazon also has the best price on this sauce. Don't hesitate to try it...you won't be sorry. It's really a treat for me when I find a new food product I like. It's even more of a treat to find out it has good quality ingredients so it's good for us too!

I purchased this on a whim after eating a butternut squash pasta dish at a very nice restaurant. I am  VERY leery of canned/jarred pasta sauce and almost always prefer to just make my own from scratch. However, this sauce is just divine! It has a very robust taste and is pleasantly sweet. I paired it with cheese ravioli and it was just perfect. I think that it would be great with just about any pasta. It is a pleasant change from a tomato based sauce and is very satisfying. I highly recommend!

Summary: H O T sauce with FLAVOR
Text: Like most others in the reviews, I discovered this wonderful HOT sauce while on vacation in Saint Lucia. This is not your ordinary, run of the mill, so called hot sauce. It has a nice yellowish color, with red specks of goodness, (peppers) and is somewhat thick in consistency, as opposed to what you would expect to find in your typical hot sauce (Tabasco, Franks, Etc.)  This HOT sauce is H O T and has a LOT of flavor and character that seriously sets it apart from the afore mentioned sauces, no disrespect to them intended, I still love and use my Franks/Tabasco! BUT; Barons West Indian HOT Sauce is completely different: it is rather thick,(reminiscent of cheese dip) super tasty, and SUPER HOT! A little bit goes a  long  way! If you want just a touch of heat that is different from 'the red stuff', try Barons. If you don't like heat at all....STAY AWAY! If you don't mind some heat and are looking for something new to flavor your: tuna salad, cheese dip, pasta salad, mac & cheese, pizza, spaghetti, eggs, and the list goes on and on..... Barons West Indian hot sauce is woooooo....H O T.... but so good.

I have a Koolatron KWC-4 Coca-Cola Personal 6-Can Mini Fridge at work and bring these to work to eat. I like my tuna and peaches cold, always have for some reason. I have one in the mini fridge, for when I get in my office in the morning; and bring an extra to put in for tomorrow. I love these along with a small juice pouch.

I like the whole set: the tuna salad in the can with an easy open lid, the sweet juicy peaches, crackers for the tuna, and a cookie to top it off with. Yum! They go great with juice. This kit helps me avoid the community fridge, so I don't have to worry about the sorry excuse "I thought this was anybodys food in this fridge" when my tuna ends up missing.

Luckily enough, I can shove the kit and pouch in the tiny Coke fridge of mine. For the price of this kit it's awesome! Plus it keeps me from the community fridge, it pays for itself right there!

Yeah, this tuna deserves 5 stars! For the price and convienence, it's a steal. All the food is very good and full on flavor. I recommend this to anyone who loves tuna. Unfortunately Amazon no longer ships these 8 packs. I wish they would, cause it's a great combo.

I also have a comment about one user complaining about it coming with some peaches; is it really that hard to toss those away? Plus, deduct 2 stars from a 5 star product just beause it gave extra accessories? I mean really, come on.

I fell in love with flowering green teas from our local tea shoppe, but I was very dismayed with the price ($4/ball!!!).

I was elated to find this listing since it amounts to about $1.50 per tea ball and it tastes great, better than what we get at the fancy store. It has a light delicate flavor that doesn't get bitter at all! You can make five pots of tea without degradation of flavor or any increase in bitterness.

Highly recommended!

The Juice doesn't taste good to me. I think my expectations were way too high. I recently purchased a premium acai juice that cost 100$ for four bottles that tasted amazing. I'm not sure if antioxidants are the same as getting actual vitamins? It is only 93% juice and It tastes more like cane sugar. I got a cold shortly after drinking this product. Not sure if it was related to drinking the juice.

This is one of life's pleasures. My wife uses it every morning in her coffee--a little stirred in and then a drizzle atop the steamed milk. Delicious and worth a few extra calories. Torani's is not available everywhere and even those stores that carry it can't be relied upon to have it available at all times. So finding it on Amazon was wonderful. By setting up a delivery every three months, we got a nifty discount. Now, we never have to worry about finding it in the stores. Thanks, Amazon.

Summary: Yay my favorite Yerba Mate is on here!!!
Text: I've tried different types of Yerba Mate and Eco Teas Unsmoked Yerba Mate is by far my favorite.  I like it's flavor and I actually feel all the health benefits that Yerba Mate touts is found in this particular strain of Yerba Mate.

Summary: Delicious cookies!  Good quality and great flavor.
Text: I like ginger snaps a lot, especially with tea.  Recently someone gave me some of these as a gift and I loved them.  So, happy to see them here on Amazon and especially a money-saving "Subscribe & Save" product.  As the other reviewers here indicate, they are thin, crispy and delicious.  These are not as hard as the more common "American" style ginger snaps and a bit more refined as far as flavor.  I like both, but these make a nice change of pace.

Good stuff....the real honey in quality like others that are not watered down. Yes, the flavor is
distinguished unto itself as original....have fun.
I thought I was getting 3 MIO water enhancer but only got 1 and for the price it was a total rip off.

I didn't realize that these had artificial sweeteners in them. When I tried one, I knew right away because it left that nasty after taste like artificial sweeteners do. I didn't really like the flavors too much either. They were too bold and unnaturally sweet for me. I wouldn't buy these again.

Summary: EXCELLENT product, but this price is excessive
Text:
Cascade Sparkling Ice is fantastic! It has zero calories and zero salt. In fact, the only thing it has is a ton of flavor (people have "taste", food has "flavor"). I detect no after taste at all.

However, you can buy this exact same variety pack at Cosco for about $11.00...and no shipping. Supermarkets in my area frequently have it on sale for .88 a bottle and, a couple of weeks ago, as low as .67 a bottle. That makes 18 = $12.67.

I love hot food.LOVE IT! I have finished a bottle of the regular Melinda's and two bottles of the xxxxReserve Habanero Sauce. The Naga Jolokia sauce is hot and delicious.

I was suprised that it wasn't hotter. At first I just tried a dash or two but quickly realized that I could handle quite a bit of it.

Don't be scared by the name, If you like hot food, you'll like this sauce.

I should of bought two bottles of Melinda's and saved on shipping because I have been putting this delicious sauce on everything.  Not as spicy as I thought it would be, but it taste great with a good burn.  It burns much more than any store bought sauce I have tasted.

I absolutely love graham crackers and these are just so cute. they come in packages of small squares. i put them in my purse for work, and i went overnight on a little trip and kept a package with me just in case i coudn't get a meal, my sugar woudln't drop. the flavor is perfect, they were crisp, fresh and just wonderful.
i liked them so much i tried to find them in my store and they didn't have them.
i think i will just order them from Amazon.
they are absolutely wonderful
the packaging is what makes them. instead of you breaking the normal graham crackers, they come like they are already broken in half. the perfect size

Summary: Great for travel and snack, not anything special for regular eating.
Text:
This is the perfect size and amount for packing a small snack while traveling or for school.
I did for some reason think they had a different taste, maybe it was just my opinion, but they did not seem as "fresh or crisp".
My kids still enjoyed them without complaint.

Summary: Perfection in a single size pack.
Text:
Love, love, love Honey Maid Grahams and this is the perfect thing for my household since I'm the only one who eats them. The small packages are great and perfect for the one sitting without having the rest of the package get stale. It will work lovely this summer when it's humid out. Nothing worse than soft soggy grahams cause of the humidity.

These are also perfect size for lunch boxes. Great healthy snack for the kids and adults alike in perfect size pack that doesn't need to be stuck in a baggie getting all mushed up. I don't know what else I can say to being lucky enough to live in an age where things are making life so much easier. You gotta try these.
The little portion packs were great for smores at a campout and for putting into lunches without the need to open up the box and reseal it to keep the crackers fresh. I would definitly buy this again

Summary: Same delicious graham crackers, with less mess and breakage
Text:
They're Honey Maid Graham Crackers. You've probably eaten them before. Slightly grahamy, delicious, and a huge mess since they're typically about 2x the size that any rational human wants to hold and eat.

Thankfully, those marketing geniuses over at Nabisco heard your cries, and released Fresh Stacks. They're graham crackers pre broken in half. That's it. They come in smaller packs with enough crackers for a really hungry person, or two slightly less hungry people. I appreciate that, since they're not getting stale or gummy like the normal ones do when I can't eat 15 oz in one sitting.

For normal people, you'll love them. If you're Andre the Giant sized, stick with the original.

Summary: Great for moms on the go
Text: My son LOVES graham crackers. In fact, they are a staple at my house. These fresh stacks are a great size for throwing in a purse or diaper bag. The smaller packages keep the crackers fresh and are great for busy moms on the go. We've really enjoyed them at my house. My son gives them two thumbs up! I keep a pack on me at all times. :-)

Summary: The Way It Should Have Always Been!!
Text: These graham crackers have an extreme advantage! They are packaged better than any other. These little blocks of 8 square grahams (which equals 2 servings according to the Nutrition Facts label), stay fresh and unbroken, and are very easy to use. The packs are small enough for a lunch box, desk drawer, or purse, and have perfect portions for eating in one sitting without having to worry about what you will do with leftovers. For those of you who love peanut butter on grahams, you could take along one of the little Jif To-Go peanut butter cups and you have a perfect little meal/snack! This Honey Maid Grahams Fresh Stacks packaging is so long overdue for graham crackers. It's perfect all around, and it goes without saying that these grahams themselves are a tried & true classic that are always delicious!

Summary: Graham Crackers Cut in Half and Packaged in Smaller Packs
Text: These are exactly the same Graham Crackers Nabisco sells in the traditional rectangular form, but cut in half. The smaller pack size is nice if you use them slowly as there is less chance for the unused crackers to get stall and soft. Other than that, they are just like the originals. I wouldn't pay more per ounce for these than for the traditional ones unless you frequently end up with stale, soggy graham crackers due to slow use rates.
These are fairly typical graham crackers, which I enjoyed well enough.  Conveniently, they are wrapped in small packs, which is nice for packing lunches, etc.

The new packaging of the graham crackers into smaller stacks is a great idea. I always just broke the cracker into two for my son anyway and this saves me that step. Also, there are fewer crackers per package so they stay fresher longer which I also love.

The graham cracker is...well...a graham cracker. You've had `em, they're tasty.

So, these crackers are primarily about packaging and convenience. The change in packaging is nice (as explained above), but is the convenience fully worth it? Depends on the circumstances I suppose. But they are tasty.

Summary: It is a graham cracker after all
Text: Honey Maid must have a challenge. How do you improve on a graham cracker ? You don't. You simply provide the best tasting graham cracker on the market , and promote it as such ! With a dab of butter , these were the best on the market

We love Honey Maid's graham crackers in our family, especially having a toddler around they're practically a staple in our household. The Honey Maid Fresh Stacks are conveniently packaged, but still the same graham crackers we've loved. When I first saw the Fresh Stacks version the first thing I thought of was that these are perfect for s'mores! We will definitely be packing these for our next camping trip. (Or even our next trip to the mall, for that matter, my daughter will enjoy these anytime.) We're also a fan of making ice cream sandwiches with them, spreading Nutella on them, and adding them to desserts we make (s'mores brownies, anyone?)

As a mom, I appreciate the simply ingredient list - it's not full of scary looking words that I can't pronounce. Honey grahams can be the perfect snack and now Honey Maid offers them in portable, perfectly portioned little packs. Great for the lunchbox, the diaper bag, the carry on bag, you get the idea...

I never understood why graham crackers in such large sheets...like little sheets of plywood. :) These are the same graham crackers that you know but are packaged in a more travel friendly size.

Whether making smores, packing for a lunch, or just grabbing a quick snack this size of cracker makes more sense then the large sheet of plywood that you would have to break into a more manageable size only to have them break in an uneven manner.

Taste is great - they could win a grahammy!

Summary: Great Idea for Freshness, But Execution Suffers
Text:
Sometimes, there's just nothing else that'll satisfy a snack-tooth. Graham crackers and milk have been calming me since probably 1959, my first year in Sunday school. I'm a single woman, and a traditional box of graham crackers gets, maybe, 1/4th consumed in a year. The rest go stale and get thrown away. This idea of "snack sized" packs of graham crackers is super!

The box has six small packs of graham crackers in it, and the graham crackers are not the traditional "four square" size, but "two square" size. Doesn't matter the size to me, but the flavor of the graham cracker does. And these Honey Maids are, in my humble snacky opinion, the best graham cracker on the market. In each snack pack, there eight "two square" crackers in a fresh stack package. I'd call that a serving. Honey Maid calls that two servings, so watch the nutritional numbers.

I found the crackers to be, largely, crumbled and broken. Granted, I have never consumed crackers that have been mailed to me, so this could be a problem of shipping, rather than Honey Maid's problem. The corner of the Honey Maid box (not the shipping box from Amazon) was bent and crushed, so I will assume that the crackers don't normally run into this problem when you purchase them in the grocery store. The broken-ness of the crackers dented my enjoyment of the grahams, as I tend to like to dip them in milk for just a second. There wasn't much to dip at times!

Flavor=great. Idea of individual size servings = ideal! Nutritional breakdown on package = a bit misleading. Physical quality of mailed crackers = not so much.

That said, I'll look for them in stores, where I can monitor their transport from shelf to home. Thanks, Honey Maid!

Summary: Fresh, well packaged, just like I remember them!
Text:
These are almost just like I remember them when these were a treat growing up. The difference is, rather than having a large rectangular 4 section cracker to deal with - that never broke in half right, these boxes have 6 square packages in the box, each package has 8 square crackers. Each package is wrapped in a wax-paper-colored plastic bag, sealed well for freshness, but not sealed so hard that you get mad opening the bag. There is a slight scoring in each square cracker and if you are careful, you can break each in half, but in my case, that's not needed - a square at a time makes for a great treat. Goes perfect with milk!

Enjoy

Summary: Great snack item in a more convenient serving size
Text:
Great idea, providing SMALLER graham crackers in SMALLER packages. Ideal for packing lunches. More than a grade-schooler could polish off in one lunch, however, so you may find yourself breaking down even these smaller packages into zip-top bags when you're packing lunches in the morning. I like Honeymaid graham crackers better than the generic graham crackers in the market. This is a good idea, but I'd have made this box with TWELVE little packs of graham crackers instead of six.
---
My teenagers have DEVOURED these packets. They do not appear to feel that the number of crackers in each one is any kind of issue. Our last box of graham crackers lasted months. These were gone in a week.

Received this as a stand-alone item, so ordering them with something else might be different, but my box came completely crushed.  If you order this to be flavoring on top of ice cream, great, but as actual snacks, you'll only get about 2 out of each individual package that's not broken.

These graham crackers taste delicious!  Unfortunately, I just polished off one whole square package in a matter of minutes. :)  These are GREAT for snacks for the kids or to use to make a pie crust.  I do like that the individual plastic packages and crackers are the smaller SQUARE size (which is half the size of the original RECTANGLE size).  I always felt the HUGE rectangles were a bit too big.

My wife loves graham crackers and milk as a afternoon snack.  She taste-tested Honey Maid Fresh Stacks and said that they were good, very good.  "Why", I asked.  Because they add a little something to spice up the crackers.  What else can I say.

Summary: Good graham crackers -- the kids like 'em
Text:
There's not a whole lot you can say about graham crackers. They're exactly what you expect, the same old slightly-sweet, crunchy crackers that we remember from when we were kids. As snacks go, they're reasonably healthy, although I generally prefer to buy the low-fat variety. Yes, they have sugar in them, but they also have dietary fiber, so at least you're getting some good stuff along with it. My kids eat these several times a week and always enjoy them.

The idea behind the packaging of this particular variety is interesting: the crackers are packaged in smaller quantities, six squares per package. (Each square consists of two rectangular halves.) In theory, this is a nice idea, allowing you to grab a pack and bring them on the road or wherever else you're going. The problem is, six crackers is really too many for this purpose. If they were packaged in quantities of four, for example, I would find them a lot more useful.

Summary: A Great Snack in a New Size
Text:
Honey Maid Graham crackers are as good as ever - a great snack for kids of all ages. When my children were younger, we would go through the larger packages very quickly and never had a soggy or stale one. Now that just my husband and I are at home, the large packages get opened, we have a few crackers, and then the rest end up going stale and get thrown out. This happens even though we put the crackers in zip lock - can't figure out why!

With this new size, we are able to share a small package and keep the rest of the crackers fresh for the next time we want a snack. I can imagine taking a small package on a flight or a car trip (sometimes a little snack helps with motion sickness.) I like the idea and will certainly purchase more of the Fresh Stacks size. I hate throwing food away so paying a little bit more for convenience may actually mean savings in the long run as we are sure to finish the package. Buying cheaper doesn't always mean a bargain - it is only a bargain if you like the product and will use it up commpletely.

I got this 6-pack simply to round up an order to get free Amazon shipping.  The Cilantro does not have much taste or smell when sampled from the palm of my hand.  Maybe the flakes work well when seasoning/cooking a turkeyburger but my palate did not tell me so.

I did my research and ask my pharmacist friend regarding this product before I took the plunge to invest in such an expensive sugar - it just seems too good to be true! The only "bad" things I could find are bloated stomach or diarrhea, which didn't occur to us at all.

I first bought this from NOW Food. When I finish the 3 pounds, I order it from Prescribed for Life. Maybe it is just me, but I found both the taste and the smell are better than the NOW food one (I can smell watermelon). So now, I just reorder from PFL.

I have one little tip to share with potential users: although this product stated that it is heat-stable up to 160C or about 330F, I found that it is best not to bake with it. The best way to use it as a white sugar substitute is to stir in the food you are cooking at the last step to minimize the cooking, or stir in hot tea or warm water to mix with beverages. Using it to sweeten yogurt also tastes great. Bottom line is avoid heating it.

I am well pleased with the granulated erythritol as a sweetener for some of my desserts. Product was delivered in a timely manner and I feel it is a great value for the money.  I am diabetic and this can be used without adverse affect on my blood sugar readings.

These comments are for "Newtons Fruit Thins - Blueberry and Brown Sugar" sold by Nabisco.

The package states "crispy cookies" think the firmness and thickness of a graham cracker - yes that firm. These 3-inch round wafers come in a rigid plastic tray that slides into a foil-lined package. Nonetheless several cookies in the two packages I sampled were broken into several large pieces upon opening. Probably not typical but that's what I observed.

I found the cookies brittle; they had a tendency to break into several pieces after a bite. As an adult I could compensate be adjusting my method of holding the wafer but children will have a problem.

I found the blueberry and brown sugar cookie without much flavor. The package state "made with real fruit" therefore what you have are many small pieces of dried blueberries throughout the cookie. The consistency was adequate but the flavor must have been baked out during the process.

I was somewhat taken back by the work "Newtons" in large letters on the package. My understanding of this term is of a soft chewy fruit filled cookie like a fig or apple Newton. I do see the connection then again I am not in Sales or Marketing where these decisions are made.

I enjoyed these Newton Fruit Thins very much! They are crunchy, lightly flavored snacks that were perfect for the mid-morning break at the office.  These are not "fig newtons," though; they are not sticky (and are therefore great for work or school snacks), but they can crumble in a lunch bag.  My family has taken to these, and we now buy them regularly.  Recommended.

These cookies are very tasty! I not only enjoyed the flavor, but the crunch and occasional bit of fruit add an interesting texture. This great cookie reminds me of a fruit-enhanced shortbread. Hard not to eat too many at one time!

I have only had a pack of Newtons Fruit Thins for a few days, but unfortunately they are almost all gone. These cookies are really tasty.

When I originally ordered the Newton cookies, I thought that they would taste like Fig Newtons, only in a new cookie format. I was surprised when I actually bit into one of the cookies and it was a bit harder than a fig newton. I love the fresh taste of blueberries that permeates throughout each of these cookies. Furthermore, the cookies are not THAT fattening for you, as it is maybe 150 calories (I cannot remember the exact amount and do not have the bag with me at the moment) for three cookies, which is not too bad for this type of treat. I will definitely keep these on my shopping list when looking to purchase more cookies, as they are great!

Summary: Pretty tasty, and not your usual *Newton* cookie
Text:
These are very different from the old model Fig Newton cookies we grew up with, very crispy and no filling. You can smell the blueberry as soon as you open the package (which is very easy to open and seal back up again). The blueberry flavor is front and center and I also picked up on the brown sugar flavoring as well, but this is not an overly sweet cookie (which is great, as I don't like things heavy on the sweet factor). I picked up on a bit of an aftertaste, but nothing to deter me from trying more of these. The package was delivered to the office and I've shared it around with good comments from all.

This is most definitely a *crunchy* cookie and not a soft one. Several of them were broken up a bit, so I suspect the boxes they came in took some rough handling from the men in the brown trucks. I've noticed some other reviewers commenting about putting the crumbles on ice cream or spreading soft cheese on the cookies. Hopefully mine will be gone before I succumb to that temptation.

There is a claim on the packaging that these do not contain high fructose corn syrup, which is all well and good, but I did find "sugar" and "fructose" in the ingredient list. The nutritional facts state there is 8g of sugar in each three cookie serving size.

I have never been a fan of newtons, especially fig newtons; I never could understand how anybody can stand the texture.

I don't like blueberries either, in general. However, I love brown sugar; therefore, I had decided to give it a try.

I am pleasantly surprised.

It's aromatic with the blueberry flavor, but it does not have the gooey texture of the berries. It does have the nice scent of brown sugar. The texture is crunchy, with a slight burnt flavor on the edges (my favorite). It is a filling snack, but it is not overly sweet, and it's great with tea.

I shared this with my children and they all enjoyed it, and asked where they could buy it. I told them I got it from amazon; they hope to see it in the stores.
These cookies combine healthy eating with a crispy, crunchy taste. 3 cookies add up to only 130 calories, without sacrificing taste. Very good combination.

I found these to be disappointing.  I thought they might be soft and chewy, based on the fact that Fig Newtons have that kind of crust.  These were instead hard and crunchy, which isn't necessarily a bad thing.  They just didn't taste that good.  Kind of bland and cardboard-y, with barely any fruit flavor.  I won't be buying these at the store.

These cookies aren't like the traditional Fig Newtons/Fruit Newtonss I have bought in the past.  They look more like a thin cracker.  The cookies are also crunchy like a cracker, but definitely not as dry.  They are sweet but not too sweet, and very blueberry.  They remind me of the very top of a blueberry muffin, which is a good thing!  I'll definitely buy more of these for my family.

They are very enjoyable. My 4 1/2 year old daughter enjoyed them as well. They are not really really sweet like some cookies. They are the thickness of a graham cracker. The flavor of blueberry is not overwhelmingly strong, I think the taste is just right. They are just right for a light snack. There are no where as many crumbs that seem to come with regular cookies, which is nice if you have kids, and like I said my daughter really enjoyed them as well.

Summary: YUM!  like the taste and texture
Text:
I love these! Both taste and texture rank very high by my taste buds. The cookies are crispy,not too sweet, and the dried blueberries taste is very good.

One warning, they are addictive, you can't stop at just one. The "thins" name might make you think that they are light on calories, but when I compared them with the old favorite Fig Newtons, these thins have 60% more fat!

Fruit thins calories: 140
Fig Newtons calories: 110

Fruit thins total fat: 5 grams (3 cookies, 30 grams)
Fig Newtons total fat: 2 grams (2 cookies, 31 grams)

Fruit thins saturated fat: 1 gram
Fig Newtons saturated fat: 0 grams

Overall, very tasty cookie but don't let the "thin" name fool you into eating a lot of them at one time!
Yeah, I know, easier to say than do! My trick is to take 1 out and put away the box before I eat it, it is easier to resist the temptation then.

Ali Julia review

I picked these up on a whim. Something different to try. Boy, was I pleasantly surprised.

I have been trying to think of a good way to describe these - but the best way I can say it is; they taste like a crunchy blueberry muffin. The blueberry does not over power this wafer it's just right.

These are perfect for mornings, or in between meals. These are definitely something I will be buying more of in the future.

It's not really a "newton" at all.  More like a delicate French butter cookie with bits of chewy blueberries.  Quite nice actually but not what I was expecting. But very good nonetheless..the box lasted all of 2 nights.

Summary: Tastes good and healthy for you
Text: I was pleasantly surprised by how good the blueberry Newton thins tasted considering that it is a healthy snack. It is difficult to find the right healthy-tasty balance in snacks. I think they have struck the right chord with my taste buds and will definitely make this a regular in my grocery list. A great snack to keep at the work place too, when you are feeling pecky in the afternoon.

I can't exactly tell you what it was that I expected when I agreed to sample and review these, but they're definitely a lot better than I thought they would be. My reaction to things that are blueberry flavored varies a lot, and this is definitely one of the better products I've come across in that area.

They're not a super health food, but they're not meant to be. They're pretty reasonable as treats go. The serving size of 3 fruit thins for 140 calories is satisfying, and it's nice that there's a bit of protein and fat in the mix to help keep you from being hungry again 5 minutes later.

I liked these a lot and I expect to buy them from time to time in the future as a nice treat.

Excellent freshness and quick receipt of product.  A superb nutritional product that should replace much of coffee drinking.  The company INFUZION was easy to contact, very friendly, and very reliable, once it is realized the spelling is infuZion. Will always order from this vendor.
Used to make a brew and no effect: if even mild. Wouldn't waste $ on it even if it seems to be cost effective!

This brand name product has been around for quite some time and this product grade 10-15-10 is perfect. This has just the right amounts of nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium. Just gives houseplants that little extra zing. I would definitely recommend this product.

good tasting fizzy candy.
i love japanese candy and this was no exception. sweat with a fizzy center.

like warheads, but without the sour taste.

This is my favorite flavor, and I cannot find it in stores. I personally prefer my coffee less sweet, so I use 2 teaspoons of this Caramel Latte, plus 1 teaspoon of instant espresso. Is it as good as a coffee house latte? No, but I don't expect it to be. However, it is a great at home substitute without pulling out the espresso machine.

Summary: A must have for cat owners

Summary: Absorbs, doesn't track but heavy and unpleasant perfume.
Text:
In search for a non-tracking highly absorbent kitty litter, I found this Ever Clean product. The reviews sounded good so I ordered three boxes for the three litter pans in the house. The order came quickly with each box of litter in it's own Amazon cardboard box. The FedEx delivery man must have been annoyed at the weight because he left the boxes on the ground outside the deck box I have by the front door specifically put there and noted for package deliveries. It is a good thing it rained prior to the delivery!
Anyway back to the litter itself. I have a 16 year-old cat who was diagnosed with diabetes last spring. She is receiving insulin twice a day and is doing well but drinks and pees alot more then she used to. With other litters I have tried, the urine sunk right to the bottom of the pan becoming muddy and difficult to scoop. The Ever Clean litter absorbs and clumps well, but has a heavy coarse sand-like consistency. It also has a heavy (to me) perfume to it that I do not care for. After scooping the pans each night, I can smell the perfume throughout the house and on me. It is better than the odor of cat urine but is a very heavy floral, not a fresh smell at all. I have never liked litter that comes in a box because it seems like you lose a 1/2 cup or more of litter between the walls of the box. At the price of the Ever Clean, every bit counts.
I have since discovered Cat's Pride Fresh and Light which I have mixed with the Ever Clean. The Fresh and Light jug is much easier to handle weight-wise, absorbs well, doesn't track and has no odor to it. Eventually the Fresh and Light will be the sole litter I use.

I am not a nutritionist so I can not evaluate or judge beyond very general knowledge the claims made on the pouch about the natural antioxidant power of cocoa. Therefore, my review is purely about the product itself.

I find this to be a surprisingly interesting and different snack. The pieces are roughly triangular and the longest side is about 1" long, so these are fairly small. According to the package, the serving size is 46 pieces which come in at 130 calories. Of these, 45 are fat calories. The pieces are crispy-crunchy but "airy", almost like toasted cereal but again - surprisingly satisfying (and quite filling!).

I do not taste much of the cocoa, and the snack is also not overly sweet, which is probably why the manufacturer suggests such varied use such as in salads, with wine, or as a treat all by itself. I find the balance between sweet and salty quite well done. The ingredient I can taste the most is the sesame seed but it is not overbearing, just adds a nice hearty something to the snack experience.

For those of you who are interested in the nutritional information, here goes:

Total Fat 5 g
Saturated Fat 1 g
Trans Fat 0 g
Cholesterol 0 mg
Sodium 135 mg
Total Carbs 19 g
Dietary Fiber 2 g
Sugars 6 g
Protein 3 g

Vitamins: No A and C, Vitamin E 4 %; Calcium 10 %, Iron 4 %, Magnesium 8 %

Ingredients (listed already in the product description but...):
Brown rice flour; sun flower seed butter (sunflower seeds, sugar, salt, mono and diglycerides, natural mixed tocopherols, to preserve freshness); dried cane syrup; rice flour, cocoa, sesame seeds; whole oat flour; whole grain yellow corn flower; wheat flour; sea salt; calcium carbonate; monoglycerides; natural flavor (milk).

I actually did not expect this to be very good and stand corrected. I like it quite a bit and will buy again.

Summary: Surprising! Chocolate undertones, but sunflower flavor and crunch predominate.

The cocoa gives a rich undertone, but without the sweetness, the taste is not what I would usually describe as chocolatey.  I need to pour a half-cup or so out of the bag and put it away; otherwise, I eat too many of these!  They really are nice with red wine.  I haven't tried them on a salad yet, but that sounds like a good idea!

It's the kind of thing to savor while eating slowly. It's not a chip. It's not a cookie. But it is somewhat like both.

If you are in for a new kind of snack that is more subtle than anything else, give these a try.

Summary: Outstanding coffee with the smoothest of flavor
Text:
After having experienced the varied, horrible dark...and even darker roasts of coffee that are now widely popular because of Starbucks, I thought I had somehow lost my taste for coffee over the years. Literally, many of the iced coffees at Starbucks taste what I imagine dirty sink water would taste like with all the fermentation and settling. In a nutshell, it seemed like every cup I experienced was more and more bitter with headache-inducing, cringe-worthy bite upon each sip-----the kind of bite that no amount of cream or sweetener can undo.

Well, lo' and behold, my grandmother had spoken of how great coffee/chicory blends taste. Having never experienced chicory or a coffee/chicory blend for that matter, I dismissed the suggestion as yet another bizarre coffee variation a la the many flavored roasts that are so popular these days. While at my local grocery store, I decided to take the plunge and venture away from the Folger's, Dunkin' Donuts, and Starbucks varieties. Upon the first taste of this coffee, I was hooked. It is as smooth as can be with no bitterness whatsoever. It is as if someone took the smoothness of hot cocoa and infused it with the best elements of coffee flavor. Taken black or with milk and sweetener, the flavor handily beats any of the overpriced competitors. And, in all of this, you will find no sharpness, bitterness or ripe bluntness that is so evident in many of today's "scorched" roasts.

Please try this if you yearn for good coffee. This product will reacquaint you with what your taste buds have been missing for so long. Luzianne makes an excellent iced tea, and this product is proof that they can do equally as well with coffee.

Try it!!:) You won't regret it.

Just spoke to Muir Glen customer service (12-21-2011) and they advised that if the "Exp Date" on a can of their tomatoes is dated March 2013 or later, the inside can liner is probably going to be copper-colored, which means the liner is BPA free. If the Exp Date is earlier than March 2013, and/or the liner is white/clear, that liner is not BPA free. But there could be cans out there "Exp Dated" earlier than March 2013, which are also copper-colored/BPA free. If you're buying from a retail store that does not turn over products quickly, note that Exp Date. If it's somewhere in 2012, you may have a white-lined/BPA leaching can. I think it must be understood that Amazon may not receive these directly from the processing plant, thus Amazon may not control which product they receive. However, I received 12 28 oz cans MG Fire Roasted Crushed from an Amazon MidWest Dist Ctr 2-3 months ago, and all of my 12 cans had the good/copper liner. Regarding damaged/dented cans; I suspect that if you get any cans from Amazon that are dented, they were not dented from Amazon to you. I suspect the cans were dented from the distributor to Amazon. Also, MG customer service told me that Muir Glen will NOT label their cans BPA Free until they are sure there are NO white-lined cans out there - could be another year or so. When they are sure all the cans of MG products are BPA free, then they will label their products "BPA Free", as this will obviously be a very positive selling point.

Regarding rating these tomatoes, they are surely a 5 star if anything ever was. How could you beat organic in a safe container and great tasting? Muir Glen is to be commended for their approach to serving their customers with intelligence, honesty, and in a manner which encourages and promotes good health.

I have two dogs.  They love Lean Treats.  The price has skyrocketed locally, so I find buyting them on on-line is by far the best value.

Summary: How do you eat leftover rice?
Text: I eat a lot of chinese food, and always have leftovers. Since it is nearly impossible to reheat rice, I bring my leftover chicken to work with a bowl of GoGo Steamed Rice. After 90 seconds in the microwave, it tastes like freshly steamed rice. Yummy!

this rice is so good. it's better than I could ever cook, even in a rice maker. it's moist and delicious. it heats up in 1 min 30 sec. it's a good quantity. i put a little soy sauce and sesame seed on it and it's a meal.

Tried this, recently, (in all dry flavors) for my German Shepherd Dog. At first, he wouldn't touch it, but after about a week, he decided he absolutely loves it. The biggest problem is within the first month, he had gained 3 pounds, even though he was eating less than the recommended amount and less than he was previously used to eating. Also, he had soft, oily looking stools while eating this. He is an active, very healthy, well-exercised, older dog. He did seem to be more "chipper" and health-wise, he seemed to do fine, except for the softer stools and weight gain, but reluctantly, we had to stop feeding this, exclusively, as we were feeding less and less and he was still gaining weight AND seemed hungry all the time, looking for any other food to eat. Since he loves the taste so much, we have decided to give him only a cup or so a day, in his Kong, with his other food or as training treats and have switched him to another food. I'm not sure I agree with the "good for all life stages" philosophy either. In the old days, that was what one did, but now that we know much more about nutrition, I believe that different life stages do require different nutrient levels. Much as humans do. Sadly, for our dog, this can not be the only food he eats, but it will remain a part of his daily diet, since he loves it and did well, except for the fat content. Hope this helps!

Summary: The only bully stick  worth buying
Text:
