These have grown on me since I've bought them.  Pear/Peach taste/consistency with a bit of their own flavor.  They have lots of seeds, but they aren't intrusive;  like tomato seeds, they just slide right down.  They're sweeter than pears, but less sweet than peaches. Pretty good for the price, though I do prefer pears or peaches.  3.5 stars to be exact.  It's coin flip whether or not I would get these again.

Ritz crackers by Nabisco have always been one of my favorites. I remember eating them in kindergarten at snack time--I always wanted a couple extra! LOL These crackers have stood the test of time because they are very tasty and great to eat as a snack.

Ritz crackers are rather low in fat (4.5 grams of fat per serving) and they have almost no carbohydrates. They are cholesterol free as well--hooray! In addition, this product is kosher if that matters to you. The nutrition label indicates that there are no trans-fats but I did notice a bit of partially hydrogenated ingredients on the label--it may be that the amount of trans-fats this generates is negligible.

Ritz crackers can be eaten by themselves but feel free to get creative! They can help out when it's time to make snacks for company. Just put a bit of cheese (or melted cheese and ham) on them and you're serving up great appetizers or snack in no time! They go great with a little bit of butter on them, too.

Overall, Ritz crackers really hit the spot when I crave a snack before bedtime. I simply take a slice of two of regular cheese and place little bits of the cheese on top of the crackers and with a small beverage it's awesome!

I highly recommend Ritz crackers as one of the healthier crackers that will satisfy you, too. Great!

I purchased a canister of this raw coconut crystals at my local organic market. I think it is great! The local shop has been out for a couple weeks, and so I have come to Amazon to order some, as I can't wait until they get it back in stock. The price was similar.

I have been using this in my tea and coffee when I want it sweetened. Unlike some reviewers, I found that I need much less of this sweetner than I need of sugar. It does not tastes as sweet, but it has a taste/flavor. And maybe that registers with me and so I need less? I don't know. I am also looking to consume less sugar, and am gradually needed things to be less and less sweet as a result. This is a good think.

I was interested in the idea that it is lower glycemic compared to sugar, and that it has vits/minerals, is GMO-free and vegan. My doctor thinks I may be insulin resistant, so I am looking to drastically reduce sugar consumption. But I still love to bake and cook. As I said, I use this in my beverages, and I have also baked with it. I made some sprouted grain zucchini bread that was delicious. I substituted 1/2 cup of sugar for 1/4 cup of this coconut crystals. It was sooo yummy. Not super sweet but full of great flavor. I also used it as a substituion in some sprouted grain cranberry pistachio muffins that were divine. Again, I used half of the quantity of coconut crystals compared to sugar. Flavor was great. I am ordering here on Amazon because I want to try it with some cookies and see how they turn out. So far, I am loving it!

For those that are looking for healthier alternatives, I'd say give it a try. If you want the super sugary sweet taste, this may not be for you.

I am sooooooooooooooooo glad I found this on Amazon.  It is awesome.  The taste is wonderful - like brown sugar.  I put it in my energy drink and my coffee.  It can be used in anything that you would use sweetener in. AND, it's healthy! Try it and you'll be hooked!

Summary: I was skeptical, but this is INCREDIBLE.
Text:
I'm extremely sensitive to sugar -- I'm not diabetic (yet) but I'm in a risk group and feel healthier when I pay attention to my sugar intake. Unfortunately, I have a powerful sweet tooth and terrible willpower, so any resolute "avoid sweets!" ideal is more cerebral than actual.

So I decided to see if there was a sweetener I could use that wouldn't upset my blood sugar as much. I bought this and a box of stevia at the same time and thought "fine, I will experiment." The stevia is better than the equal I'd been using, but this coconut stuff? OMG is it amazing. Maybe this next admission is disgusting, but I eat it by the teaspoon. It's delicious. It doesn't make my heart race and I don't feel sick afterwards like I do with regular sweets. I'm so happy to find something that tastes awesome and is gentle on the body.

I'm always overly optimistic about these things! Yes, it is much closer to brown sugar as far as texture and it does have a molasses type after taste which I did'nt care for but, it was better than the chemically thing from other sweeteners. My husband found it "Not sweet enough" and felt he had to use more than he would use if it were sugar. I have to say, I used it twice when I first got it and haven't touched it since. It's on the shelf next to my full bottle of Agave Nectar!

Bought a box of these at BBB (for less than the listed Amazon price), and after the first sip I was completely grossed out. First, the artificial sweetener (sucralose=Splenda) aftertaste just killed it for me. I can taste that stuff a mile off, and think it's nasty. Also, even if it was sweetened normally, the chocolate flavor was very thin and weak. I'd have been better off just heating the hot water with my Keurig and stirring in some Swiss Miss mix.

Why isn't the sweetener mentioned anywhere on the box except for in tiny letters on the ingredient list??

Summary: Pleasant Joy in a mini Cup
Text: I bought this for a friend as a replacement for all the ones I drank using her one cup brewer. I drank them all, that's how delicious they were!

I see that other reviewers mention the sucralose in this cocoa. I don't know if that's what causes the unpleasant chemical taste I noticed but whatever the ingredient is, it makes both flavors of cocoa from this company very unpalatable.

This mix doesn't even start to compare to Carnation or Swiss Miss mixes, or those from Tassimo. Save your money. It tastes like it was made by a chemist, not someone who has ever tasted real - or even good instant - cocoa.
I didn't care for this pumpkin soup, it taste more like pumpkin flavored corn starch.

Just received our 5-lb. bag and my husband and I both love this soft and chewy product from Angelina's Gourmet Foods. We keep crystallized ginger in a sugar bowl on our table for "dessert" and/or to aid digestion. Although not labeled as such, I'm guessing this ginger is from Thailand, as most of the Australian ginger we've tried is very mild and often flavorless; not so with this one. It is spicy and hot and is what I expect from ginger; I don't have to eat a bunch to know what I'm tasting! I also chop it fine and add it to several recipes, including biscotti. We'll definitely order this again.

I really enjoy candied Ginger.  It not only tastes great, but it noticeably helps with nausea and is supposed to be great for digestion.  This brand is especially excellent.  I have tried a few different brands off of Amazon and not all were so good.  This one has a perfect blend of sweet and that ginger 'bite.'  Klein's 10 oz. tubs I thought were too sweet, but I did eat it all eventually.  Reed's 3.5 oz bags and Roland's 6lb can I just can't eat.  They're way too much - super strong and - just very different from Angelina's.  It may work for baking, but I don't cook with ginger generally.  This ginger from Angelina's is so good I've bought it 3 times now because of the taste and because of how it helps with nausea.  I also enjoyed the stuff from sweet gourmet (16oz).

I am a regular buyer of this ginger now. It is very soft and tender, but has that great ginger bite to it. I eat it plain and also put a few slices in my Chai tea along with cinnamon and cloves. I think this is the best value for bulk ginger slices. 5 pounds fills 4 quart jars with about a pint extra. You'd be surprised how many people like to be given a jar of these as a special friend gift!

I order this 5 lb. bag of ginger and sometimes it is REALLY hot and other times it's just right. This last time it was PERFECT.  Just like anything else in the food world, it won't be consistantly the same but I've had good more often than not so good.

The pepper is great and the grinder is easy to operate.  I did get the pack of six for less than ten bucks, which was quite a bargain.  I see now that it costs a lot more so keep your eye on the price.
Was delivered to a fruit starved soldier in Alaska in time for Christmas. Local produce is over priced and poor quality in the winter there.

Summary: Best Instant Coffee I have tried
Text: I bought 1 Jar of Bustello Instant coffee at a swap meet, and loved it. When I went back for more the seller had none. I looked in all the stores in my area and could not find it. I finally located it on Amazon.com and orderd the Bustelo Supreme Freeze Dried Coffee 100% Columbian Coffee Regular Instant Coffe 3.52 oz. Jars (Pack of 4) and could not be more satisfied. I will order more when these run out. This is a really great tasting coffe and handy for those times when you don't want to brew entire pot of coffe but like fresh brewed taste of coffee.

these are AMAZING in a vitamix - creamy and delicious, and the fiber (of which there is a lot) is very effective. great for warm sprouted oatmeal with coconut, banana, and raisins on a rawsome winter morning.

Cranberries taste good, but packaging has a plastic chemical smell.  It doesn't seem to affect the taste.  Not as fresh as other brands I've had.  I assume they've really just overdone it on the preservatives, though nothing is listed on the packages' ingredient list besides "cranberries, sugar" along with an expire date almost exactly 1 year in the future. Perhaps the smell is just the bag.  Mild tartness.  I may try again if I can't find another brand that is better, but I'm not blown away.

I planned to continue to buy this item, but on your web site it is now selling for $69.00 for one box of 7.  That is crazy to try to sell that cereal for that amount of money.  I've always been pleased with all the different products and purchases I've bought thru Amazon.com. But this price is rediculous.

I have fed this food to several of my dogs for years now with no problems. About a month ago, all the dogs on this food developed chronic smelly diarrhea. I couldn't believe it was the food since I'd fed it for years. After $500 in vet fees I pulled the food as a last resort. Sure enough, all dogs recovered in two days (after two weeks of problems). I tried feeding it again to my "Mr RockGut" dog (the one who can eat anything). The next morning he was back to runny stinky stools.

I went to Solid Gold's website to check for any recalls and found that as of January 2010, all dry food production for the western states had been moved from their CA plant to their MO plant. This was our first bag of food from the MO plant. You can verify that by visiting Solid Gold's website and clicking the "News" link at the bottom of the page.

If your pup is on this (or any other Solid Gold dry dog food) and suddenly develops stinky smelly feces, SUSPECT THE FOOD FIRST!!! Don't waste $500 in vet fees like I did.

Oh... by the way... an email requesting more information on our particular bag of Barking at the Moon went unanswered from Solid Gold.

If they had warned us in advance of the changes, it would have saved us a bunch of money.

We're off ALL Solid Gold products.
Sticky rice is glorious...and owning a 20 pound bag is a little ridiculous, yet deliciously comforting.  Good rice.

This isn't quite the standard use for rice, but my ferret absolutely loved this stuff. It's a great deal on product that just works - my ferret would dig through the rice for about an hour before he got tired. The rice absorbed a lot of smell, neutralizing it. It is sized perfectly so he never has issues with it getting in his mouth or nose, despite throwing his face in it.

All in all, a great product with an unconventional use. The rice looked so appetizing that I was tempted to steal a bit away for me to eat!

This "chowder" is simply dreadful and although I made an effort to eat it, eventually gave up and threw the first batch out. I am planning on donating the rest to a food bank, and feel mildly guilty subjecting anyone else to this slop. I am shocked that this is presented as something edible -- and it is expensive enough that the expectation of a good tasting soup with a noticeable amount of smoked salmon isn't unreasonable. There is precious little salmon -- it is mostly mystery fish chunks and a few potatoes. I used regular milk, not cream, in the amount stated on the packet and it was very watery with little substance. It was decidedly fishy in an extremely unpleasant way, and my husband and I both felt nauseous after consuming the small amount we ate before tossing it.  Save your money.
Comes vacuum packed in a foil package (inside wooden box).  Flavor is excellent and really couldn't be better.

Summary: had to disagree with the previous review
Text: i've never reviewed a product before, but i had to disagree with the previous review. this is the most intense earl grey you'll taste, with the possible exception of stash's double bergamot. a 'floral' earl grey usually implies lavender or something like that, but there's only a very intense bergamot added to this tea. tremendous flight, wonderful nose. i alternate between bigelow, the two stash earl greys, & this one, so that the flavours in each stay distinctive. sounds high maintenance, & it is, but this is tea! it's worth it.
Applied Char-Crust per manufacturers suggestion.Did crust and seal juices,but added little to no Hickory flavor to the burgers.Would not purchase product again.

Summary: consistency is a bit thin, decent chocolate flavoring, good in smoothies
Text:
Of all the non-dairy chocolate beverages, I like Silk Chocolate Soymilk Natural, 8-Ounce Aseptic Cartons (Pack of 18) the best with So Delicious Coconut Milk Chocolate Flavor, 8-Count (Pack of 2) being second. Pacific's hazelnut non-dairy beverage is my third favorite.

This product is sufficiently tasty, but seems to have a water-like consistency. The cocoa powder is mixed in so you don't get lumps of grainy powder in your glass (sometimes, so delicious coconut milk chocolate has this problem). There is a faint hint of hazelnuts but the chocolate is more pronounced than the hazelnuts.

I frequently use this product with PB2 Powdered Peanut Butter - 85% Less Fat and Calories - 6.5 Oz to make chocolate peanut butter smoothies as a delicious, healthful treat.

I recommend this product for those that are seeking a very good non-dairy chocolate flavored beverage.

Summary: Delicious non dairy, soy free drink
Text: This beverage is delicious and creamy but I wish that it could be lower in calories and sweetened with something other than cane juice.

Summary: Wish I could give more stars!
Text:
I am not usually driven to write reviews of the many products I buy on Amazon, and it surprises me that something as mundane as tuna would prompt me to take time out of my day to do so, but I was truly shocked by how wonderful this is.

I stumbled upon this brand after realizing with dismay that my regular tuna actually contains soy. Silly me to think that a product labelled "Tuna in water" actually consists of simply tuna in water. I ordered this brand expecting to have to give up something in taste or texture in exchange for the health benefits and environmental benefits. At minimum, I expected not to notice or care much about the taste. I could not have been more wrong. This is without question the most delicious tuna I have ever eaten and the difference is definitely noticeable. This is worth every penny. How often can you do well for your body and the planet AND treat yourself as well.

I keep reading about how we're supposed to have more fish in our diet. Well, okay, I can go along with that and I've been adding a few extra meals per week. Fish is hard for me to keep, so the kind I rely most on is canned fish and, to a lesser degree, frozen fish. As such, I was shopping at my local Costco store and came up with a pack of six cans (5 ounces each) of "Wild Planet" Wild Albacore Tuna. I just had some for lunch with wild and brown rice, baby carrots and celery. The cats went wild over the smell (a good sign).Very good tuna. Excellent taste! Well above most of the other brands of tuna that I've had. I'll be looking forward to trying it out in several casseroles that I make up. It's good to have stuff like this on the pantry shelves. It's so easy to make up something tasty and healthy too.

Gary Peterson

Summary: The way tuna used to be.
Text:
Good stuff. Just like canned tuna used to be like: firm, flavorful, meaty. Less packing liquid than basic brands.

Strange though - the can says caught in the USA and processed in Vietnam?!

Summary: Great taste, but not MSC certified
Text: This is excellent tuna, but I realized it was not MSC certified, which is important to me.  I started buying American Tuna which tastes just as good, and is MSC certified.

Summary: Flat cookies with very little candied fruit
Text: The tin was easily less than half full, looking nothing like the photo.  The cookies are smaller than pictured, had settled during shipping A LOT, and had all congealed together in the tin.  There was hardly any candied fruit in the cookies, and tasted mostly of the nuts that were sprinkled on top.  But since the cookies had melded into one giant blob, you had to just pull a piece off.  Way too expensive for what arrived.
I have used other brands with different labels, but this stuff seems to be the best around! I highly recommend this product to any baker or adventurous cook. Look no further, absolutely delicious!

Summary: The best ground coffee there is. Period!
Text: I drank community Coffee growing up as did most folks that I knew. Since moving from Louisiana years ago, I grind my own coffee beans since no ground coffee that I've tried compares. However, a brother sent me a bag of Community Cafe Special recently and it is almost as good as fresh ground bean coffee. In fact, it's so good that I am here at Amazon as I write this to purchase more. Bar-none, there are no other pre-ground coffees that come close to Community Coffee.

Have been buying Between Roast in 1LB packages, 10 at a time from CC.  This figures out to be cheaper per oz and the taste is just as good as the  Between Road.  Use it in my Keurig using refillable cup (Ekobrew)  Get Great coffee one cup at a time.  Can't wait until Community Club offers their coffee in K-Cups because I'm lazy.
Beware - I ordered this item and they sent me Salad Topping instead.  Will not be purchasing from this vendor again.
Good quality product. I'm paranoid of my pup choking, these are very safe, could be left alone with these and fits perfectly into the puppy kongs.

My cockapoo loves this!  we put in his kong toy and he doesn't stop until it's all gone.  For adding length of time, stuff kong toy, freeze, and it makes for a good 15 minutes of work.  Makes me feel less guilty about leaving him sometimes.

Summary: Best canned ham for its price!
Text: This is the best canned ham for its price.  Any time my wife and I want to cook some fried rice and cannot find any meats, we will simply open a can, chopped them into small pieces and used in cooking fried rice.  If we cook breakfast and cannot find any meat, we will simply cut it up into large slices and brown them both side in the skillet and serve them with eggs. It is so tasty and convenient and the price offered by Amazon is actually cheaper than that of our local Wal-mart.  I love it!

I love this seasoning! (Well, I love almost anything with garlic.)  I primarily use it in garden salads, pasta salads, and pasta sauce, but I also have put it in eggs.  I ordered it from Ozbo.  The product arrived on time and was just as I described.  Plus, the price was less than my local supermarket.  I won't hesitate to buy from Ozbo again.

We made this mix with ground deer meat and cubed beef, it was delicious and so easy to make! All we did was slice the deer meat into a couple pieces and toss in some beef tips. Then added a can of diced tomatoes and turned the slow cooker on low while I was at work. Dinner was ready when we got home! Love it!! This one is great too American Pioneer 21 Bean Soup ( 6/13 Oz)
For those of you who enjoy a true Italian desert with your coffee or tea, jovial cookies are amazing. Not sickening sweet like American cookies, but a cookie rich in flavor
I keep these at my desk because I get so busy sometimes I have to skip lunch and these are perfect - especially if you are on Atkins diet - they never go bad or get stale - very tasty.

I've tried most of the "English breakfast" blends readily available, and this one is among the best. However, I like my tea strong, and I find that I must use two of these teabags per cup. Tazo Awake brews a stronger cup of tea is my current favorite.

I'm disappointed in this product.  One review of it I read before purchasing it, said it was so much better than the cheaper hot chocolate mixes available; I disagree.  It is good, but not great, and I hate that it blends poorly, be prepared for lumpy drink.
This was a gerat buy .. and cheapest I could find on the web.  Was delivered on time and was the hit of the party.  I will be ordering this again!!
it has a terribly strong fishy smell, but my cat loves this so i continue to buy it.  yeah, it's a bit expensive - but it must taste great i can almost see my cat smile when he eats this!
My kitty, CheChe, absolutely loves these treats.  She know the cans and when they have arrived in the mail!

The product is excellent, that is why I ordered another batch. Unfortunately ,my cat decided she did not want any more, she still has not finished the first order.
That is why I returned this oner, there is nothing wrong at all, just cat preferences.
My cats love this stuff. They look forward to their morning taste and even know the sound of the can and come running no matter where they are.
We ordered a box of cherry hubba bubba squeeze pops and received a box of sour mix hubba bubba. My kids tried the sour and didn't like them so we ended up buying what we ordered from another seller.

I haven't had Orange Blossom Honey this good since we moved from Florida to Texas many years ago.  It brought back amazing memories and a very happy mouth.  If you are a honey lover and want the best tasting honey ever, you have to order a couple of bottles.  They were shipped timely, packaged very well (in a plastic bag besides the packing material) reasonably priced, and worth ordering.  This was my first order of Tropic Bee and it definitely won't be my last.

Summary: Just like when I was a kid....
Text:
We received our Orange Blossom Honey quicker than stated it would arrive which was a great surprise. The honey is in an easy-to-use bottle and tastes just like I remember when I was a kid in Florida. Living in Michigan, you can only find clover honey on the grocery shelves so to be able to get it this way is great.
We will be ordering this again!

I'm always on the look out for flavored marshmallows to use in krispie treats, which is hubby's favorite sweet snack.  When I saw these I thought they'd be worth a try.  Aside from just sampling them from the bag I've only used them for the treats.  They are a pineapple flavored marshmallow rolled in toasted coconut.  The only thing that I could say was a drawback is that my recipe calls for 10 oz. so I usually use a package of these then 16 regular size marshmallows to come to the 10 oz.  I also increased the butter from my usual 3 T. to 4 T. which gave them the usual consistency, otherwise the coconut will really make your mixture thick.  I've bought a lot of flavored marshmallows in the past but these seem to be the big favorite.  They make a pleasantly sweet coconut'y' treat that is out of the ordinary.  Keep them on hand because as we go into winter I'm guessing these will be sailing off into the sunset, just when you need them most.

I buy this juice at the local grocery store, and on the label it states NOT FROM CONCENTRATE as well as on the ingredient list. I just received these from amazon and they say FROM CONCENTRATE, but amazon advertises it as PURE NOT FROM CONCENTRATE. Just a heads up for anyone like myself looking for the real stuff, as from concentrate juice can be had for a fraction of the cost of the real stuff. Very disappointed.

Please, please be aware that when they say it is UNsweetened, they are serious. To me it is undrinkable, and I drink my coffee and tea black, so I usually don't mind unsweetened drinks.
If I could return the two unopened bottles, I definitely would!

I have a cup of peppermint tea most mornings and this is what I buy every time.  It has the best, cleanest taste for this type of tea.  No caffeine as it's just pure peppermint leaves.  Quality product.

This exceptional tea reminds me of running in the Rocky Mountains past fields of peppermint, fragrant in the afternoon sun. We drink this tea by the bushel-load, from morning to night. The flavor is exceptional and consistent, delicious during the summer, or warming you through Winter. Enjoy!

PS: Best accompanied by U.K. mysteries, like Midsomer Murders: The Early Cases Collection, and buttery biscuits, lots of 'em.

Summary: Why am I rating a toy?  This is icecream!
Text: First, this is not a toy.  I'll admit, the first time I tried it was when I was a kid and this and Tang were the in thing.  I tried this now because I'm going camping and thought it'd provide me with an interesting treat while hiking.  It's not bad if you're looking for novelty items, or historical items, or even icecream.  As it blends with saliva, it does taste like the three flavors of icecream.  Naturally, icecream is preferable, but this is great for a trail.

Mild tea with good flavor.  This tea is less bitter then most green teas that I have tried. Had best suggess using a large tea ball to allow more flow throuh the tea as the leaves are large.  I drink 2 cups of green tea every day the large (16 oz) bag lasted about 5 months.  I think it is a good value for the cost.  This is the second bag I purchased.

Summary: No Fussie Cats with Fussie Cat
Text: All my cats love this even the ones without UTI.  Perfect solution.  Less expensive and works much better than prescription dry food that is supposed to correct this condition.  Dry food does not work!

My husband has been drinking Folgers Decaf for years, and uses the singles in particular since I don't drink coffee.  Besides the convenience and savings, the taste is what he loves.  I have read other reviews about Folgers Decaf singles complaining about the bitterness, but hubby has tried several other brands and always returns to Folgers Decaf singles.  I suspect these people are expresso fans or want their coffee brewed.  It appears the majority of coffee drinkers are in concert with them as it has become more difficult to find Folgers Decaf singles the past couple years.  That is where Amazon comes in.  There was a period of time when I could not find Folgers Decaff singles anywhere.  Just out of curiosity I checked Amazon's website.  Not only were the decaff singles available, but cheaper than the store's price when purchased in bulk, qualifying for free shipping and handling.  So my review is a five star.  Thank you!

I am a stay at home person and sometimes I just like to have a good cup of coffee. Maybe one in the morning or the afternoon and I don't want to dirty up the coffee pot. So to be able to just have a nice cup of coffee is Great for me.

Thanks
jn

I own a Senseo machine and was using Senseo brand coffee for a full year before I found the Baronet coffees on Amazon.  I buy this Nutty Irishman and a decaf and they are delivered to me monthly at a price cheaper than the Senseo at Target (which is the cheapest I have found for the Senseo brand).  The thing that really sells this for me is the amount of coffee per pod - much more than the other pods on the market.  Not all Baronet pods are this super size...be sure to check the weight.  There is a good 30% more coffee in these pods than the other brands.

Summary: Nice and Chewy with a Wonderful Taste.
Text:
I like strolling the aisles of my local warehouse store because you never know what you might find. For example, last week I found some delicious dried cherries by Kirkland Signature in the snacks isle. I've always thought the KS brand was of the highest quality, so I snapped up a bag in an instant. They're a somewhat tart Montmorency Cherry, and they're excellent. They're nice and chewy and have a wonderful taste. I use them as deserts, pack them with lunches and take them along on camping trips. Plus, they're easy to store so there's good quality fruit around even during times when a trip to the local grocery store isn't possible. Excellent product.

Gary Peterson

I love dried cherries and part of the reason for that is that they have a bit of tang to them.  I bought some in bulk before I bought these, and I guess I expected them to be pretty much the same.  They're not.  These are monster mouth-puckering dried cherries.  And trust me, there's no way to tame a tart cherry. I wound up giving them to a friend because they made my mouth cry when I ate them.  But if you like really tart cherries, these are the ones for you!  The resealable bag is great, as long as you remember to squeeze out most of the air before you finish sealing the bag.  The cherries were soft and moist, which is a good thing for a dried cherry; so often they're cherry leather.  And each time I went back to the bag, they were still soft and moist, so the packaging is excellent for nibblers.  But remember, Kirkland has discovered the world's tartest cherries, so if you don't like them that way, don't buy these.  But if you do, run!  The price is great and the bag truly does keep them soft and most.

In the great British trifecta of British powdered drinks to be mixed with milk and sugar, Horlicks the most malty, Milo is medium chocolately and malty, and Ovaltine seems to be the most chocolately.

All 3 are basically comfort drinks when plain milk just won't do. All 3 are powders to which you add milk and sugar to get a sweet malty drink, the latter two with chocolate flavor as well.

I love all 3 drinks. But, if you are drinking this for nostalgia's sake, make sure you get the Milo from where ever your nostalgia springs from because Milo is made in different countries and they all taste a little different. For me, I love Milo for it's good mix of chocolate and malt, not too much of either, and a great comfort drink for cold nights.

Summary: A wonderful product, and a terrific present!
Text: This will be our third year purchasing fudge and truffles from the Brigittine Monks.  We give boxes as Christmas presents, and everyone LOVES it!  Our friends and family say that it is the best chocolate they have had in a long time, and we agree.  The monks are great to work with, and shipping was reasonable, especially considering the amount of fudge and truffles we bought!  Friends and family have gone on to order for THEIR friends and family.

Just YUM! great to have these on the go - I found at a gas station on a monthly 6 hour drive with my daughter. What a hit for us both. Sooooo good. And not too messy either -- but maybe not for less than 3 alone because the Nutella might be a fun dip for little fingers.

Summary: Rabbits are not to have dairy!
Text:
Rabbits are not to have any form of dairy, whether it be cheese, milk, yogurt, whey, casein, or anything else. Unfortunately, there are many companies out there that are only aiming to increase profits and have no knowledge about the animals they market their products for, and unsuspecting caregivers of the animals buy their products with good intentions, but end up harming their furbabies in one way or another. I've even found fish meal, yes, ground up fish, in treats for rabbits! Rabbits are herbivores! After being weaned, they survive and thrive on only plant matter.

Take care of your bunnies and do not purchase any "Yogies" or other dairy treats for them, and ask others to do the same.

We bought this meal to make healthy chicken nuggets, and it really tastes great. I like the nuggets even better than with breadcrumbs, and the kids loved them too. It really is more of a meal consistency, not like almond flour which is ground finer. To me this leaves a nice texture if you're using it to coat something. Great product.

Researched the company, and am pleased with what goes into this product. It is said to be good for allergies, that is why i purchased it. Although i have not seen any difference in my dogs, they enjoy their food more now. As far as the allergies, i have not yet given them the full dosage suggested, so this may be the reason. This product can be used also by humans, which makes me feel safe about using it.

Summary: Kitty loves it, and it's not nasty
Text: I like this food, and I always buy it from Amazon, because they have it cheaper than I can find it anywhere else in our area.  Also, it doesn't stink and isn't gross to scoop like the pate kind is.  Kitty never gets tired of this food, but we do switch it up with "Tasty Treasures" around the holidays, as a treat.

We used this mix today to make pumpkin bread.  The texture was mealy, grainy and unpleasant - almost similar to corn meal.  This might be OK for biscuits but I strongly prefer Pamela's gluten-free products.
My Yorkie LOVES this product!  He does little dances to get a "chewie"!  I only wish that they were sold in bigger packages!
They had such a "rancid" taste, that I had to send them back.  You could smell them the minute I unwraped the package.

Summary: The color is the only thing "movie Threater" about this
Text: Expensive, bad for you and no taste.  I was willing to accept the "bad for you" part if the taste was exceptional, but I would say this is just a heart attack in a jar.  I am going to stick with using peanut oil - Much better flavor!

Just like movie theater popcorn. I used an internet suggestion.  Melted a small amount of coconut popcorn popping oil in the microwave and filled a ice cube tray with the oil.  Placed in freezer.  Excellent idea, just the right amount of oil in the cube, without the mess of digging into the jar.
This makes great pop corn. There is a lot of it there. One gallon of this will last forever. Worth the price and shipping.

Summary: Great taste and smell -update ... turns rancid after about 6 mos.
Text:
Making popcorn using this will give the movie theatre experience at home. The aroma this coconut oil puts out when making popcorn just makes you hungry for freshly popped corn. Will order again when we are almost out. FYI this will arrive in a melted state after being in the delivery truck all day in the hot sun and after it cools down inside the house it then becomes almost a paste. It's okay like that and nothing is wrong with it ... just so you will know.

Updating this and now giving it a 2 star from 5 stars. This is my second batch and again I'm throwing this out because of the really weird taste and smell after having it for several months. These jars tend to last about 6 months then go bad ... or just taste really bad. At first the taste is great, but now ... it's hard to explain. I thought maybe my popcorn was going bad. Cooked up a batch with regular oil and the popcorn is fine so it's the Coconut oil. Would recommend this if the whole container would be used up fairly quickly. Makes many batches so unless you are eating popcorn every single day this container will turn on you. Maybe if the product were sold in smaller containers. That would be great if did and I would buy again.

I just tried this the other day, and the whole family loved it.  It's the best taste and texture I've found for gluten free pasta, and the only package with the proper cooking time in the instructions.  (Those of you who have cooked GF pasta before will know that the cooking times are usually too long.)  I can't wait till it's available on Amazon again so that I can buy it in bulk!
The powder itself is good, but the container is horrible.  I tapped the top to clear the dispenser and the entire bottom fell out!  This powder is not cheap...
I should have believed the other reviewer who wrote that these do not sprout. I was naive enough to think that I can 'make them' sprout. They do not, no matter what you do with them.

Summary: You Can Almost Feel The Fizz - Highly Recommended
Text:
These David's Signature Beyond Gourmet "Root Beer" jelly beans are perfect in flavor and are really great tasting. While I liked them a lot, my son went wild for these and claimed most of them for himself. These are also excellent when paired with David's Signature Beyond Gourmet Vanilla Bean Jelly Beans.

This flavor is from David Klein, the creator of the famous "Jelly Belly" jelly beans, so I was thrilled to be offered this in David's Signature Beyond Gourmet Jelly Beans Flavor Sampler to review since my family loves jelly beans.

I also really like that these jelly beans are made with natural flavors and colors.

Highly Recommended!

CFH

Summary: One of my favorite protein bars
Text: I think it is all a matter of taste.  I personally love those wafers.

I have been on a high protein diet for the last few years. I can say with a high degree of certainty that Power Crunch is one of the best products on the market. I HIGHLY recommend it to anyone.

My favorite flavors are Peanut Butter Creme and French Vanilla.
I loved the crunch in these protein supplements.  They are the lowest in calories from what I have been able to find.  Very tasty too.  Much like a wafer cookie.
Great tasting, but contain hydrogenated soy and/or cottonseed oil and PH palm kernel oil!

I love this protein snack bar. Tastes more like a candy bar than a protein bar and is easy to eat, easy to digest and a very quick & satisfying snack. I use it as a meal replacement or a fast way to stop my chocolate cravings. Love it.

I have had the vanilla, triple chocolate and PB versions of the power crunch bars and those are all very good. The cookies & cream flavor however tastes very strongly of fake sugar. For some reason the other flavors do a better job at masking this, the C&C does not.

I recommend having these with a hot drink, if you drink something cold while eating them you get a weird filmy coating to the roof of your mouth. All flavors work well at keeping hunger away for 3 hours and do not cause gastric distress like some low carb bars can. I prefer the other flavors over the C&C, but these are fine if the other flavors are gone and I need a quick bite with my morning coffee.

I do not crave sweets after I eat a power crunch bar; sometimes sugar substitutes make me want to eat more sugar, but these actually cut my sweet tooth off at the pass.

I have tried all of the flavors and have to say that chocolate is my least favorite. However, the vanilla, pb creme, and wild berry are all awesome.  The wild berry is almost like a strawberry birthday cake made into a wafer bar.  There is a pb fudge that is just ok. They should sell a variety box!  Also, get these shipped in cooler months. And I recommend storing in freezer. :)  And i forgot the cookies n creme.... Also delicious!

I really like all the power bars flavors.  Great for when you want a snack but don't want all the bad stuff that comes with other protein bars.  I also like the crunch. when I'm craving chocolate it really hits the spot and dulls my cravings.

Summary: Good dietary supplement for an older person...
Text: I worry about my mom not eating enough, and these are similar to a candy bar, but full of protein.  It's a great item for the fussy eater.  I ate one myself, and though the filling is a little powdery, it's quite tasty.  I just wish they'd mix a variety of flavors in the bulk box, but I would definately order again.  Price is quite reasonable.

Summary: Very refreshing with just a touch of mint
Text: This drink tastes like limeade with a hint of mint.  The rest of my family wasn't very fond of it, but I love it.  I also like the new packaging, or new to me anyway: a slim canister containing long skinny packets instead of cups of powder.  The powder mixes well and is a very light, subtle green rather than a neon Kool-Aid color.  I'd buy this again!

Summary: A drinkable, low calorie Mojito alternative
Text: Several of my friends have recently begun buying the low calorie flavored drinks you see in most grocery and convenience stores now. Cascade Ice is one brand that produces several based off of common drinks like, Lemon Drop, Pina Colada and Cosmopolitan. They then mix them with their favorite spirit and have a low calorie drink. They're good because they're pre-made and portable, but you are paying a premium for that. Either way although I've never been fond of these types of drinks, I was willing to give Crystal Light Moctails Mojito a shot. One thing I can say I immediately liked was the ease of making the drink, it would be great for when my girlfriends come over. Additionally because the individual packets are so small, it would be just as easy to take some to a friends house for the evening. As for the taste, it wasn't amazing, but not bad either. It definitely wasn't as good as an actual Mojito, but I wasn't expecting that. After my initial taste I did add a shot of Jamaican rum into my drink and that improved it greatly in my opinion. Overall I believe that Crystal Light has done a good job of providing a pseudo Mojito and I could see myself buying additional flavors to try out.

I found the Crystal Light Moctails Mojito Mix to be refreshing and delightful.  The mix has just the right amount of mojito flavor without the cloying sweetness that can often mar mixed drinks of this nature.  The colder this is served, the better it tastes.  Really tasty, really fresh, and no alcohol involved, unless of course, you want to add your own.

During the past month, I have become quite a fan of Crystal Light 'mocktails,' and found this flavour to be the best of all. Crystal Light products are a marvellous treat for those of us who need to restrict sugar or carbohydrates, and the Mojito is a first-rate contribution.

With all the 'bad press' about artificial sweeteners recently, I shall add that, with this or any Crystal Light product, I have never experienced stimulation of hunger, any other ill effect, or any detriment to weight loss. They are a true bonus for those who have to watch calories or sugar, and make it a much easier task. :)

Summary: I guess it's OK for a 5 calorie Mojito
Text:
In the interest of fairness, I mixed this according to the directions. Although when I mix powdered drinks, I usually mix them to suit my taste.
The first thing that I noticed was how hard it was to get the powder to dissolve completely, no matter how much I stirred. It did eventually dissolve completely. The next thing I noticed was the fluoresent green color. Mojitos are usually clear, so I don't know why they chose that color. The taste: very mild, with a HINT of mint.
I tasted it right after I mixed it, and again when chilled and poured over ice. This definately needs to be chilled.
If you're just looking for something low-cal, and palateable, then this is fine. If you want to drink something that tastes like a Mojito, then drink a Mojito.

Summary: Yummy- I will keep this stocked in my pantry
Text:
I am a mojito snob- I grow two kinds of mint in my garden, and wasn't sure how I was going to like this. I had some friends coming over last night and I mixed up a pitcher- slightly stonger than the directions- 6 cups of water instead of 8 since I was going to add crushed ice and rum. There are no directions for adding alcohol, I imagine this has something to do with liability and all that- but surely they had to know people were going to do this right? Anyway it was good- really good, and my friend liked them too. Since I am on a low carb diet, it was even better. It was not as good as my home-made mojitos with real sugar, but not by much, and it IS way better than my attempts to make a sugar-free mojito. And it was so convenient too!

It would never have occurred to me to serve mojitos without the alcohol, but since that is what the manufacturer intended I tried it that too. I mixed up another pitcher this morning and we had them with lunch and I made them as directed. They were delicious- the kids liked it- they were light and not too sweet, and had an excellent mint flavor. Very refreshing!

At first I was not fond of this product since I was comparing it solely to a real Mojito.  While a real Mojito sports a much more distinct, unique, minty taste, the Crystal Light Moctail tastes more like a typical pleasant tasting Crystal Light mix.  Nevertheless, if you judge the Moctail as a tasty lo-cal diet beverage that's easier to make than the real thing, the Moctail earns a clear A.  These Moctails have a good lime and mint taste that's very sweet (impossibly sweet in my opinion) without using sugar and containing only 5 calories per serving!  They also seem to taste better several hours after making them.  The Moctails are an outstanding diet beverage, just don't try to compare them to the real thing.

First off, let me express my disappoingment that Crystal Light is still using Aspartame as it's sweetener. I had hopes they had continued their move forward by sweetening this product with Stevia (as they have will some of their other newer offerings). That being said, although the taste of this drink is ever so slightly artificial (it's not "natural"...DUH), it is pleasantly refresing and does have more than a passing resemblance to a mojito (without the ETOH, of course). Because of the Aspartame, I'm not likely to buy this again, but if they changed the sweetener to Stevia or Stevia blend and kept the taste the same, I would definitely purchase regularly. If artificial sweetener choices aren't an issue for you, I recommend this product whole heartedly!

OK, as much as I loved appletini flavor is almost exactly how much I don't love mojito.  Perhaps I just don't like mojitos.  There is just something about mint being in any drink...I just don't like it.  So, if you are a mint fan, you probably would like it.  The flavors are certainly well blended and the mint is very slight.  Glad to have tried it...won't buy it again.

Summary: Interesting new diet drink, but heavy on artificial sweetener.
Text:
I think Crystal Lite did a good job of balancing the traditional lime and mint flavors of a mojito. Both are strong in this drink and it's surprisingly refreshing. However, the drink's biggest downfall for me was that it was very heavy on the artificial sweetener flavor. Admittedly I have a very sensitive palate for aspartame, but normally Crystal Lite beverages don't bother me. Unfortunately, these 'mojitos' left a strong artificial aftertaste in my mouth.

If artificial sweeteners don't bother you and you're craving a low-cal summer cocktail, drop a splash of rum into this mix and it's definitely the drink for you. If you're overly sensitive to aspartame, then steer clear.

It's not a bad drink by any stretch. But perhaps a little more time in the test kitchens would benefit the overall product a great deal?

This doesn't really taste like a Mojito on its own - perhaps if you used it as a non-calorie mixer. Adding alchol would add colories. Sadly, non of the Moctails in this line are worth a 2nd taste. Crystal Light Mocktails Margarita, 1.62-Ounce (Pack of 4)was poor as well.

I love Mojitos and that's usually my drink of choice so when this product came up to test it, I jumped at the chance.

For a low calorie, non-alcoholic drink, it's ok. However, if you drink mojitos and expect that true "mojito" taste, it's just not there.

It has a very strong lime taste and it is refreshing but it just tastes artificial. It kinda made me thirsty after drinking it. I'm not into the artificial thing and feel like if you want sweetness, just add natural sugar. However, if you can't have sugar for some reason, then this might be good for you.

I definitely had an aftertaste but maybe if you chill it real good, add some fresh limes or lemons, and maybe a splash of booze, it might pass.
For me, I would rather have the real mojitos.
I like Crystal Light products but I feel they all have the same artifical aftertaste and maybe that's why I didn't really care for this product too much.
My picky shih tzu loves this stuff, although not very nutritional, it does the job. May be cheaper at your local big box store though.

Summary: Great with corn and black beans in rice!
Text: I have these for lunch or dinner (sometimes left-overs for breakfast) at least two or three times per week combined with Libby's Organic Black Beans and Libby's Organic Sweet Corn mixed with Bob's Red Mill Organic Brown Rice. It makes for a great meal!
Ideal is the right name for this. Low Calorie - yes. Sweetener - absolutely. No funky aftertaste. Acts just like sugar, and tastes like it too.
I am a fan of all the ingredients in this tea, but the anise taste is too much. Blech, blech blech.

Summary: What I Ordered, But Not What I Got
Text: I ordered these snacks but ended up receiving a multipack of small bite sized biscuits. I am guessing the ingredients are the same, so I did not bother sending them back. The product I did receive - Hello Panda strawberry creme bite sized snacks - are delicious. Same company, same overall product, but different size and shape. That said I think these are likely just as good.

Summary: received a bag of melted chocolate
Text: I purchased this product for a friend. Instead of receiving chocolate covered beans I received a bag that consisted of melted chocolate. The shipping and handling was very high and I thought that the chocolate would probably arrive a little soft but this is just ridiculous. The bag looks and feels like it's filled with chocolate syrup.

I loved these little espresso candies - I keep them at my desk and when I feel like I want to nod off I pop a few in my mouth and can get through the day - the only complaint is they are a little gritty - but other than that - I love them.

Ok so this is candy but these are so cute- one of these a day is a real treat. So if you're looking for something to 'take away' from someone unless they do the dishes or whatever, this is a good treat.

This is a great, basic black decaf tea, great for any time of day.  It's much more full-bodied than your run-of-the-mill grocery store brands but not nearly as pricey as other "gourmet" ones.  My new favorite!

Summary: Convenient Way to Enjoy Chicory Beverage
Text: I gave up coffee about a year ago--not because of the caffeine (I still drink tea), but because of the acid which was playing havoc on my stomach.  I lived in New Orleans for a couple of years and remember that most of the coffee served there had chicory root mixed in.  You can buy ground chicory root from one of the coffee distributors.  What I discovered is that I like the chicory taste better than coffee!  I don't use milk or cream in my tea because I've heard it cancels out the health benefits of the tea, so I was looking for something I liked well enough to forgo the milk.  Chicory beverage tastes great with milk, but I like it well enough without.  I was really happy to find this instant version on Amazon--it's quick and you don't have to pull out the teapots and strainers.  And it actually tastes fresher than another imported brand I tried not long ago.  If you like the taste of chicory, this product is for you.

Bought this to use for a party and baked a loaf this a.m. as a test.  It's gone--an hour out of the oven!  Tastes great toasted with a little butter or all by itself.  Really, really simple and delicious.

Summary: Sticky, and doesn't do the job
Text:
Firstly, I must start by saying that I'm a woman. I'm pretty active and live in the South, where the heat is absolutely abysmal. Women's deoderants really don't work very well, and don't always keep me from smelling the majority of the time; I'll end up smelling like a mixture of must/sweat/and flowers/powder etc. So, I decided to swipe up a men's line and see how it worked.

This deodorant is very sticky, and it dries under your armpit too quickly. What I mean by that, is that it completely dissolves away within two hours and ceases to give you anymore protection. I put it on in the morning at around 9 a.m., and by the time I walked to my classes from my dorm and all over campus, I smelled awful. As another lady poster said, it was like an oniony type smell. In between one of my classes I HAD to go wash my armpits for fear that everyone would smell me.

I gave the deoderant two weeks, and it's still terrible and doesn't work well. Besides that, the armpits on my shirts that I wore when I used this product continue to smell terrible when any heat starts to develop under my pits. I can't even wear them anymore because this deodorant didn't do what it said it would! On to Dove Clinical Strength.
I tried these last night because i love cotton candy. I put it on funfetti mix and made cupcakes. they were delicious! Everyones taste buds are different so give it a try!

I have enjoyed much of Pure Alaska's product line, and I was going to try their no salt added Thinkpink when I saw this review, and I must respond! This customer must not be familiar with canned salmon, because the bones and skin, unless it is the fillet, is the standard for canned Alaska salmon. The Pure Alaska brand has just the right amounts of each, not too little nor too much. If one reads about the health benefits of the bones and skin, one knows that these are among the reasons to eat it. Our family has eaten canned salmon for generations, and we fight over who gets to eat those wonderful little edible bones while the omega -3 rich skin just mixes into the recipe and is such an important part of the salmon, from a health perspective. Those bones and skin are very nutritious--don't throw them out!

All of the salmon I have purchased from Pure Alaska is delicious and is of the highest quality. It is also important to us that Pure Alaska Salmon Company is owned by a functioning Alaska fishing family, not just some distribution company--so they put out the best product possible. This is a great food..I love the fact that it is a safer food to eat than other mercury-laden fish such as tuna. It's also more versatile - ever hear of "tuna pate?" This salmon also makes a marvelous pate to serve guests!
>

As far as flavor is concerned, La Victoria taco sauce is the best of the best! I live on the East Coast, having moved here from California, and no store in this area sells La Victoria anywhere. I was thrilled to see that it could be found here on Amazon!

The seller packaged this product extremely well and I was very pleased. I'll definitely be purchasing from them again.
Sunsational is made from sunflower kernels.  It tastes good and is a great source of fiber.  I don't use it as a milk substitute, but you can. I drink a glass with lunch every day.

This is the first "diet" soup I've ever tried. I bought a can at the local grocery store and have ordered more from Amazon. It's good. It does NOT taste diety to me.

This is just plain ol' good soup.

Notes:
* Campbell's seems to think it appropriate to only eat half the bowl in a single serving. That's crazy. Don't fall for the marketing illusion that the can is "only 50 calories" - No, you're going to eat the whole thing, but don't worry, that's still only about 100 calories.

* The label said it was only 0 Weight Watcher points. It should be noted that WW recently changed to Points Plus. Under the PP program this whole bowl (remember "2 servings") was 3 Weight Watcher Points Plus.

* It is not "chunky" - It is mostly broth, but it's got veggies and small little noodles too. My unprofessional guess is that the whole can would be worth a single "serving" of vegetables.

* It's got a mild/simple "herb" taste. There's no spiciness. And while it wasn't "too" salty to the taste, it did have the usual canned-soup saltiness. I sprinkled in some black pepper.

* I have no problems with the lid or in preparing the soup. No mess made here.

* Finally, what I like best about this is I can keep it in my desk drawer at work and if I get hungry between meals, it's a more filling/satisfying snack for 3 Weight Watcher Points Plus than say a granola bar or other treat. It also goes well with a light sandwich from home if I want to make more of a meal out of it and skip the bag of chips.

ok people just to let you know real Kopi Luwak sells for around $300 per pound if not more. this is a blend of beans. what they dont tell you on this page is youll be lucky if theres 3% Kopi Luwak mixed in with who knows what other beans. ive seen a similar posting like this for $50 using the same picture but it tells you its only 2% Kopi Luwak. dont buy this if you want 100% Kopi Luwak

In Indonesia you can find the brand "Kopi Luwak" in supermarket but for sure no real kopi luwak inside.
Anyways the taste isnt so bad.
I know a friend who taste the real one and she say the only difference is the smell of urine !!

Summary: Even better than the Italian Roast
Text:
As a solo coffee drinker, I've become addicted to the ease and tastiness of Starbucks Via. Instead of making a pot and drinking cold cups of coffee for the rest of the day, with Via I can have one fresh and hot cup whenever I want (these days, I only break out my 10 cup coffee maker for guests).

A dark roast fan, I've been drinking Starbucks VIA Ready Brew Italian Roast Coffee by Starbucks Coffeefor a few months when I spotted this limited edition French Roast pack of twelve. It's delicious. Stronger and deeper than the Italian, but still quite smooth. And delivery was exceptionally fast; I ordered it with two-day shipping and got it the next morning.

Hopefully Starbucks will decide that the French Roast Via is a keeper and start selling in the 50-count boxes.

Summary: Great idea for coffee tasting from Amazon
Text: This is a great idea when you're new to this whole Keurig thing (which I am) and I wanted to taste and test these brands before buying because this stuff is expensive.  I'm glad I purchased it but I must say that what probably works for most people doesn't work for me.  I like really bold and strong coffee and I found the coffee in this sampler to be "wimpy" which is to say it's probably great coffee for normal drinkers.  However, if you like bold and strong I recommend buying the Green Mountain BOLD or stick with Starbucks BOLD (any flavor) as long as you have the word BOLD.  Every other brand is too weak which is probably "normal".  I did determine in this experiment that I would only buy Green Mountain if I can't get my first choice which is Starbucks brand.

My sampler pack arrived the day after I ordered it, so kudos for quick delivery! Although I bought the 35 cup sampler, there were only 33 cups in the box, so the people packaging should be more careful. I would have made a stink about it, but since it's a great deal I thought it wasn't worth the time to complain. None of my cups were damaged.

On to the coffee: I received a nice sampling of coffees...I think I got at least one of every coffee shown in the picture. Many were doubles, which is fine by me, and I was pleased that there were 7 decaf cups included (including the half caf). I'm loving the medium roast coffees so far...we have found the light roasts to be a little on the weak side (especially the flavored coffees), and this is a great way to sample different kinds without committing to a whole box. I recommend this option if you are new to the K Cups or you're looking for something different to try.

So, overall, we are happy with this purchase. I would have given it 5 stars if they had given me all 35 k cups!

Summary: Tough to keep in Bonsai size
Text: If you don't constantly keep after the plant, you will be surprised with GIANT leaves and before you know it, you would almost kill the plant to get it back to a Bonsai size.  It was probably my fault because I have a couple Bonsai junipers, but this plant requires constant pruning.  I went on vacation, leaving the watering of the plant with a neighbor.  When I got back there were elephant size leaves.  I guess I should have purchased something lower maintenance.

This is such a great dog food! I have 4 dogs who were soooo happy on the food bought through Trader Joe's. Fast forward 4 mos and we're living far from a TJ's. Thank God for Amazon! Food is delivered every 4 wks and happy,gas-free dogs rule the world. Always my 1st place to search for my favorite things.

Summary: too little of a good thing
Text: Melissa's Dried Tart Cherries are very tasty for using in baked goods or just plain eating.  I would prefer to have the option of a larger package, though, rather than having to buy them in a dozen 3oz. bags.
Kittens love it and it doesn't have that stinky smell some brands have when you open them. Easily digestable for the kittens
This was a favorite for the kittens and mom liked it too. We were very happy that this was offered for our kittens.

I was craving brownies, but am not eating wheat, so I bought a box of Hodgson Mill Gluten-Free Brownie Mix to try.

You need to add a stick of melted butter, water, egg, and vanilla.

This mix is very thick (thicker than any wheat-based brownie mix I've ever had). Luckily I have a Kitchen Aid stand mixer, which powered through the thick batter with ease.

I used a cake pan so I'd have thinner brownies. The batter isn't the easiest to spread, but I recommend a greased spatula for easier spreading. The brownies will bake up looking just as the batter did when you put the pan in the oven. This means that if you have lumps sticking up, or if the batter is uneven, it'll stay just like that.

Definitely grease the bottom of your pan. Even so, they still tend to stick, especially if at all over-done.

As far as flavor, it's not bad. Nice and chocolatey, a little buttery, too. Nice and sweet.

The texture is what you have to get used to. These brownies are grainy and gritty. They're not chewy and gooey like a lot of wheat-based brownie mixes. Really, these are a great treat for those on a wheat-free or gluten-free diet, but for those who can eat wheat, stick with regular brownies.
Look at the crazy misleading prices....this seller is nuts!!!  This ad was never reviewd by anyone for validity. Where is amazon on this one???

This product is being sold for much more than it should be. I found the same yeast at a major chain store for $3.25 a jar. That's less than $10 for the 3 jars.

Since grocery items are not returnable, I'm stuck with this order. Check prices before you buy.

I bought this for my husband for Father's Day. My 3 year old son and I were looking at Amazon golf gift baskets, and we decided on this one. Upon arrival the bag all this came in was crushed. The bucket of golf balls is actually two big paperboard cut-outs that are stuck to the front and back of a regular gift bag with tape. I thought it was a bag designed to look like a pail of golf balls...no.

As for the items that came in this...not worth the $30. Some pasteurized cheddar cheese 'flavor', some Cajun mix, which I thought hubby would enjoy, but it was crushed, so it was more like Cajun crumbs. Some crackers, biscotti, sub-par coffee, and dry cookies. Overall, I say PASS. We were able to laugh about it and say 'It's the thought that counts!'...but really, this was just bad.

Summary: Thank you so much, Mrinalini Iyer!!
Text:
Had I not seen her review, I might not have ordered a six pack of this DELICIOUS spread, but I owe her big time!! This spread, jam or whatever you'd like to call it is a MUST for any ginger lover and I've even gotten a tip from my cousin that it can be used to make marinades for meats and poultry too - or in BBQ sauces!

GO FOR IT! If you're anything like us, you'll find yourself ordering another 6 pack FAR sooner than you think you would have. It's AWESOME stuff!!

I noticed when I went to Einstein's that Oregon Chai concentrate is what they use to make my chai latte, so I decided to purchase my own concentrate to make my own chai lattes at home and at a better price.  I found the "Slightly Sweet" version on Amazon and happily purchased it.  This chai has all the right spices (cardamom, black pepper, cinnamon, etc.) and (I think) a much better level of sweetness (especially when mixing with vanilla soy milk) for a tasty mid-afternoon drink. It is delicious. Buying it in a six pack from Amazon was convenient and economical.

Ingredients.

Pure cane sugar, vanilla extract with other natural flavors, potassium sorbate and sodium benzoate (preservatives), and citric acid.

That cane sugar is pretty strong. I suggest adding Torani Vanilla with some restraint, or you may mix up a cloyingly sweet beverage.

Nutritional Value.

Updated 7/8/2012:
On my second order of this, I got the dregs from the bottom of the case. It might weigh 1.5 pounds, but it's made up of tiny scraps of fish, all very thin. No full fillets. I'm very disappointed in the drop in quality and have dropped the stars rating to 4. BTW, they had 4 left when I bought 3 and now they still have 2! must have found more crumbs on the floor. These should be well-wrapped in white butcher's waxed paper, people, before shipping, and shipped in a box that is sealed, please.

Summary: Wonderful taste, great source & price for organic, shipped as promised BUT :(
Text:
I just found out through talking with a specialist moments ago that walnuts have a high number of bacteria/micro-organisms on them, the highest of all nuts.

Your body system might be able to handle them. Mine can't because of current health conditions.

If you are interested, here's how to do a comparison check on the degree of little critter infestation on the surface of different nuts...

Put the type of nut you want to test in its own cup and add maybe 6 oz of water. Add some cheap hydrogen peroxide purchasable at any large scale grocery store in the USA that is used for cleaner and let sit for a 5 minutes. (I used 2 tablespoons) Bubbling occurs in the water as the micro-organisms are killed off. (Eating the nuts afterwards is not recommended because this hydrogen peroxide is not food grade so has additives to stabilize the hydrogen peroxide.)

The test I'm doing as I type this review is compromised of organic walnuts and almonds, each in their respective cup. The almond cup had a few sparse clouds of bubbles at the top. The walnut cup has a 1/4" thick white carpet of bubbly foam at the top.

Even cleaning the walnuts with food-grade HP isn't workable for me :(. The good news is that Good Sense may start selling their organic almonds on Amazon.com. YAY! :)

Summary: Poll results: this one beats all others
Text:
I actually conducted an informal POLL of people's opinions of the best instant coffee over on Recipezaar's "Community" chat forum and 8 out of 10 cooks there opted for this one! There were many respondents, 30 or 40, to my poll. I, too, was of that same opinion, having tasted every major instant coffee available. "Taster's Choice" brand was a way-back second place winner. It IS good coffee but it's usually the most expensive brand at the average grocery store.

This is one of the few products which is not only the best in quality, it's also nearly the cheapest. I buy mine at The Family Dollar Store chain -- they always have it. The seven-ounce size fits nicely in one's cabinet and last a pretty good while, (I'm the only coffee drinker in my home, 1-2 cups per day). This is usually the size that I buy.

If you haven't tried instant coffee in awhile, you should give it a go because it has improved 100% over the years. The key is to make sure that your water is actually BOILING as it is poured into a pre-warmed cup, (just run hot tap water over it for a few seconds). Also, experiment with the amount of coffee that you use. I use one "slightly heaping" teaspoon, (which is a very inexact measure), but you will soon determine how strong or weak you like it.

Another tip, treat WATER as an INGREDIENT in any form of cooking! Don't boil plain tap water for your instant coffee -- use pure "spring (bottled) water". Read bottled water labels closely to assure that you're not just buying "purified" water, which usually originates from some polluted river source, (municipal water treatment), and which is a huge bottled water ripoff and a very widespread problem!

If you want to go to the ultimate extreme for excellence and you drink your coffee with cream, then use REAL CREAM. It will keep much longer in your refrigerator these days because the producers are now using a process called "ultra-pasteurization" for most brands. Reach into the very back of the cooler at the grocery store and get a good "sell by" date on your dairy products when you buy them. The best dates are always in the back of the inventory because grocers rotate their stock that way.

For sweetener, I often use "Pure Organic Tupelo Honey" which is twice as good as common clover honey. It can be obtained online from apiaries in the Florida panhandle.

Summary: Campbell's Beefy Mushroom Soup Is Still Made
Text:
I'm another one of those people who have looked for years, without success, to find Campbell's Beefy Mushroom Soup on the grocery store shelves. But, by searching on the internet recently, I came across the soup for sale on Amazon. Others, as well as myself, have wondered if the product was fresh stock since it's very hard to find. Well, I recently called Campbell's to inquire if the soup was still in production, and they assured me it was. So, last fall, I ordered 2 cases of the soup on Amazon Campbell's Beefy Mushroom, 10.75-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) and the expiration was in 2011 or 2012 (I forget). I've already used up all the soup and I'm ready to order more. When this soup first appeared in grocery stores years ago, the label had this YUMMY recipe on it, which I have used ever since. It is my husband's favorite hamburger dish. This recipe transforms ordinary hamburger into a delicious comfort food your family is sure to love. It's so easy to make, but ohhh sooo good! Here it is:

"Campbell's Salisbury Steak"

1 (10 3/4 ounce) can Campbell's Beefy Mushroom Soup
1 1/2 lbs ground beef
1 egg, lightly beaten
1/2 c. fine dry breadcrumbs
1/4 c. finely chopped onion
1/8 t. pepper
1/4 c. water

1) Add 1/4 c. soup, egg, breadcrumbs, onion and pepper to the ground beef and mix well.
2) Shape into 6 patties.
3) Brown both sides in ungreased skillet, over medium heat; not cooking them completely.
4) Drain off the fat.
5) Spoon over the patties the undiluted Beefy-Mushroom soup and 1/4 c. water.
6) Cover the skillet and simmer over low heat 20 minutes or until done, spooning the gravy over the patties occasionally.
7) Delicious served with mashed potatoes, cooked green beans and rolls with butter.

Serves 6

Summary: Probably the Best Microwave Pasta Meal I've Had.
Text:
"Barilla Mezze Penne with Traditional Marinara Sauce" is a 9 oz (255 g) single serving microwave meal that heats up in just one minute. Mezze Penne is smaller than traditional penne, and these have a ridged surface to better hold the sauce. The marinara sauce has a few chunks of tomato in a tomato-herb sauce. The sauce is in a separate container inside the oval serving bowl. Preparation is fast and easy: Peel back the film on the bowl to the dotted line to give it some ventilation. Microwave for 60 seconds. Remove the film carefully to peel it from the pasta bowl as well, where it tends to stick. Pour the sauce over the pasta, stir, and enjoy!

My experience with microwave pasta meals is pasta that is overdone on the edges and sauce that is cooked to the bowl in places. Separating the pasta from the sauce has solved some problems. This meal is both tastier, faster, and has better consistency than a frozen microwave dinner. I'm very particular about jarred pasta sauces. Rao's is the only brand I'll buy. Barilla does not make the best jarred sauce, but it is not bad. The sauce is flavorful. The chunks of tomato are few but have good consistency. The pasta was not quite soft enough for me, however. The instructions recommend adding 1 teaspoon of water and microwaving for an additional 30 seconds for softer pasta.

This Barilla Penne with Marinara Sauce was better than I expected it to be. It's easily as good as frozen pasta meals that are heated on the stovetop, yet this takes less than 2 minutes from start to finish, and it's convenient for one person. The bowl does not get hot, and it's easy to hold onto from one side that has a wider lip, so it would make a nice quick meal at the office or over a cluttered desk. You don't really have to put the bowl down to eat from it. It contains no preservatives, artificial color, or artificial flavors.

Ingredients: cooked mezze penne pasta (water, semolina, durum flour, olive oil, salt, natural flavors), marinara sauce (tomatoes, citric acid, tomato paste, water, carrot puree, olive oil, onion puree, tapioca starch, celery puree, sugar, salt, garlic puree, basil, oregano, natural flavors). Contains per serving: 320 calories, 700mg sodium, 58g carbohydrates, 5g total fat, 1g saturated fat, 11g protein, 180 mcg vitamin A.

Lapsang souchang has changed me from a "tea once in a while" to a "tea every day" drinker. My dissatisfaction with almost all tea was that it lacked "body". That is why a good cup of coffee is so satisfying, but a weak cup of tea is not. Now that I use Lapsang as part of the mix, my tea has a robust flavor and body that I find very satisfying.

One more thing: add some milk in your cup to your Lapsang tea made as above. It will mellow the smoky flavor in a nice way.

Without Lapsang Souchang, my tea consumption would go way down. Now I drink a quart of it a day.
DELICIOUS!:-P  Just the right amount of smokiness in a black tea. My new favorite.

I found myself craving halva rather than Little Debbies or other sweets.  I would buy this product again and definitely recommend it to other breastfeeding mothers!  One note though: this product will give you GAS!  Lots of it!  Buy a bottle of Bean-O at the pharmacy to help combat the gas - the increase in quality & quantity of milk is well worth the extra trouble.

Summary: No Nutrition - And Controversial Brewer's Yeast
Text:
I bought a pound of this Meow Mix Tender Centers for my cat at the local pet superstore near my house. And although she seems to like it, I have to give it a low rating. Here is why:

This Meow Mix Tuna and Whitefish Cat Food is like junk food for my cat as it tastes good but has little nutritional value. It has inferior ingredients in the top 5 of the ingredients list (listed below), as well as the addition of artificial colors and controversial brewer's yeast, so no matter how much my cat might like this cat food, I really had to give it a low rating.

To start with, the first two ingredients on the list are ground corn and corn meal. These supply no essential vitamins or nutrients to my cat's diet. Chicken by-product comes next, which is a less than ideal form of protein as it is made up of the bits of the chicken that are unfit for human consumption. Salmon meal and fishmeal do provide better forms of protein, but they are not the main ingredients and do not provide a satisfactory amount of protein for a healthy cat. Furthermore, the artificial colors are unnecessary, and the addition of brewer's yeast can cause allergies in cats.

Meow Mix, a subsidiary of Del Monte, could have come up with something better!

Top 5 Ingredients:
1. Ground yellow corn
2. Corn gluten meal
3. Chicken by-product meal
4. Soybean meal
5. Beef tallow preserved with mixed-tocopherols (source of Vitamin E)
