Goya Coconut Water has been around in local US tropical food marts for decades. A friend suggested coconut water to me ages ago for some issues I'd been having. I started out with fancy expensive CW and one day on a whim I bought some of the Goya brand in a convenience store. I wish I'd done so sooner! If you love the benefits of coconut water but can't stand the taste or get your kids to drink it, this is a suitable alternative. Lightly sweetened but not nearly at the same rate as sodas and other fruit juices with high fructose corn syrup. It tastes great and don't be fooled, it has the same benefits as the designer $3 a bottle coconut waters being sold in health food stores. I've been throwing my money away for years on other brands. Don't buy this can. With the shipping charges you may as well fly to Singapore and pick your own.

Make sure you're drinking regular water with this or any other coconut water. One of the things I noticed when drinking coconut water is that it has a diuretic effect. Since I was a kid I've had this unusual water retention problem though, moreso than the average person, and coconut water makes me flush out fluids like crazy. Despite the refreshing qualities of this water I've noticed there is a danger of becoming dehydrated. The added water in this product is a nice bonus but it's not enough. My guess is that the added water in this product is merely to allow Goya to offer coconut water to consumers at a lower price. It won't be enough to offset the effects of the juice so drink more water if you don't already.

Goya has cubes of raw coconut floating around in this juice so you've got a good source of fiber there. The coconut pieces may pose a choking hazard for really small children and you can't drink it from a straw because of the chunks. I took a star off for that. Also the can isn't the most environmentally friendly packaging either. Otherwise this stuff is the perfect refresher.

I have enjoyed this coffee for a long time. I now have it coming to my home on a monthly basis and this was a great decision. I don't have to worry about running out when I'm rushing to work. The flavor of the coffee is rich and satisfying. It smells great when I'm waking up and smells great from my mug. The taste is wonderful. If you try it, you won't be disappointed. The cost is one of the best on the market. I will continue to support Eight O'clock coffee.

Summary: Luscious Nathan's Hot Dogs for dogs
Text: The Nathan's treats a big hit in our neighborhood. All the dogs run toward me when they see me. They all love Nathan's.

My 5 dogs just absolutely love these. Was purchasing these at Walmarts but they stopped carrying them. I didn't realize that they were supposed to be refrigerated but it didn't matter since they don't last long around my house
with all the poochies anyway.
my dog loves these treats.he prefers these over any others that i have bought for him.

My dog loves Nathan's Hot Dog Treats. They are his favorite. One of our local supermarkets carried them for a limited time. When the promotion ended I was unable to find them anywhere. I was pleased when I saw them on Amazon, so I signed up for the monthly re-order.

WE HAVE BEEN EATING AND SERVING THIS DISH FOR MANY YEARS.  SOME OF OUR FAVORITE PAIR WITHS ARE: FAJITAS; WITH CHICKEN OR PORK KABOBS; AND WE ALSO LOVE IT WITH PLAIN YOGART.  EVERY TIME WE SERVE IT, EVERYONE ASKS FOR THE RECIPE. BECAUSE THERE IS SUCH A MIXTURE OF INGREDIENTS, PEOPLE ASSUME IT'S HOME MADE. WE USE A BIT OF OLIVE OIL INSTEAD OF SHORTENING, AND SPRINKLE A BIT OF FRESH PARSLEY ON TOP.  ENJOY AND IMPRESS YOUR GUESTS.

Although this product is amazing and tastes wonderful the shipping & handling was a little pricey but it came earlier than expected and packaged well so You definitely get what you pay for! I would recommend it to a friend!

Wow!! Great product.  We used this at Christmas to create some fantastic cookies.  It only takes a very little of the color to create very bright colored icing!! Would highly recommend this to anyone wanting to produce that "professional" look with their baking.
These colors are a great deal. I bought them to color macarons because I've had problems with liquid food coloring not staying bright after cooking. This worked great.

I love this food for my cat.  She has been on it for years and it's really the best for her breed.  If you own a Siamese cat you know that they love to eat quickly, and will usually toss up the food because of this.  This food is shaped so that they are forced to chew it and that slows them down.  Now, that doesn't mean that they will never toss up, but it drastically reduces it.  It's very high in protein and keep her lean and never overweight.  She has been very health all her life and her check-ups are always clean.  She has never had a UTI or other digestive issues.  The food is pricey, but it works so well.

Summary: Great for both my cats, even the non-Siamese.  Helps with hairballs.
Text:
I use this food for both my young Siamese and my older cat, a former stray (not Siamese). We have to watch the older cat's weight carefully. Both cats eat too fast, and this food seems to slow them down.

I recently tried to (slowly) switch them to a premium "all-natural grain-free" brand, and the older cat, who has medium-length hair, began to get daily hairballs no matter how much we brushed her. We switched back to Royal Canin Siamese, and she hasn't had any problems since. So the Royal Canin seems to help prevent hairballs also.
If you love the taste of Biscoff cookies, you'll love this wonderful spread! Light and creamy, perfect! We love it!

Summary: I keep the jar in the freezer, it's even better cold
Text:
Recently, I bought a jar of this after having dental surgery when I was limited to liquids and mush foods for 2 weeks. I had never tried Biscoff spread before but I wasn't disappointed. Lemme tell you, Biscoff Spread made the 2 weeks bearable, but I went through the jar in about 3 days, taking tiny amounts of it off a dull butter knife because I couldn't really open my mouth much. It doesn't have protein like peanut butter does so for me it won't be a pb replacement... for me, Biscoff is a dessert treat. A super fantastic treat. I'm going to buy these as stocking stuffers - If you like cookies and you like the consistency of peanut butter, this spread is very good.

Biscoff spread is amazingly tasty but it isn't health food, as I'm sure you've noticed if you've ever looked at the nutrition label. =) But everything in moderation, right? I'm one of those people who likes a bite of sweetness after a meal and this spread is a wonderful, rich treat.

*Update* I bought a 2nd jar locally the other day but this time it wasn't as thick and it was rather greasy feeling in my mouth, and it dissolved in a second so I didn't get to savor the flavor of it much. I realized that we were now keeping the house about 6* warmer than we were just a couple of weeks ago and this temperature change was enough to alter the consistency of the Biscoff spread... a 74*F house was too warm. I now keep the jar in the refrigerator (edit: I now keep the jar in the freezer, it's even better! and because I have to basically chip it out of the jar, it slows me down when eating it so I can't shovel spoonfuls of the stuff into my face), and found that I really like the spread when it's cold (I eat it straight off a spoon, I don't spread this on anything). So if you happen to try Biscoff spread and you think it's greasy and isn't as thick as you like, it may be because your house is a bit too warm... try keeping the jar in the fridge or freezer.

Black Market Hot Sauce is the best hot sauce I have ever had.  It is the perfect finishing touch to nearly every breakfast and adds an incredibly tasty kick to anything that it gets the opportunity to meet.  Have not let my fridge be without a bottle of this sauce since the first time I tried it.

Summary: Best grinder I have had bar none!!!!
Text:
This is the 3rd meat grinder I have purchased, and the best by far. We make our own raw diet for our cats, so a grinder gets
a real workout from us. We grind at least 40# of meat at a time when we use it. With the other two grinders we had to reverse the grinder several times because meat got hung up. Also, we would have to let it "cool down". With this one we have NEVER had to reverse it, and the motor stays cool. We do shut it down several times so we can crack the chicken leg bones with a mallet (we were told to do that by the manufacturer) and we do a bunch of legs at a time. I would recommend this grinder to anyone wanting a GOOD grinder that
doesn't hang up and have to be reversed or cooled down often. This grinder is a real worker, and I would compare this with a grinder costing 3-4 times as much money.
Great coffee and service. However, I am finding the same coffee at a lesser price at Bed Bath and Beyond.
this is sugar-free/sugarless but this has 37 carbs!! I didn't understand that. It's good, but still high in calories and carbs.

When I got these, I couldn't contain my excitement and I ate about a quarter of a bag. Scenes from the movie 2012 could have been filmed inside my gut. There would have been less pressure to make two winning free throws in the NBA finals than for gas to escape my bowels. After a few hours, I had an EXTREME build-up of gas with no relief. All I could do was lie on my bed and pray for a fart. That might sound funny, but when you've eaten something that has basically turned you into the blueberry girl from Willy Wonka, you're pleading for relief. Well, the farts came and I lived through it but I not only had a visit from the fart fairy, but the sales rep from Montezuma's Revenge stopped by and gave me a FULL demo of their services as well.

In retrospect, eating over a pound all at once wasn't the brightest thing I've done (but it also wasn't the dimmest). If I go back and finish the bag off, I'll probably leave a suicide note.

They're delicious, but after I ate a few handsful, a couple hours later I started to feel really sick.  I spent the whole rest of the day suffering painful gastrointestinal distress.  I believe this is an occasional side-effect of the sugar substitute (branded Lycasin(tm)).  If you don't have a problem with Lycasin, go right ahead and munch away.  If you don't know, I'd try them in small quantities first to make sure they don't cause you any problems.

Summary: great taste, just be ready for it to come out the other end!
Text: I guess I should have read the reviews before buying this for my sister. Just like all these other poor sufferers, by sister, her boyfriend and my mom all had severe diarrhea and stomach cramps just a few hours after eating some. This item should have a warning label: "Do not eat more than 10 in one sitting unless you you are constipated and need a quick and easy laxative." Too bad they taste so yummy. I'm going back to the sugar ones.

Summary: OMG! The taste is fantastic - but wait two hours - IT ALL COMES OUT!
Text: The Haribo Sugarless Gummi Bears I bought (the 5 lb. bag, of course)tasted EXACTLY like the fattening sugar gummi bears they make. I didn't bother looking up Lycasin to see if there were any side effects with this stuff - I would never have thought to do that - there was no warning on the bag stating that within two hours of eating a handful you will be literally RUNNING to the bathroom to expel all of those wonderful things you ate such a short time before. I have been chronically constipated all my life, but BOY this sure cured that problem! There is NO WAY you could go anywhere or do anything with this going on - it is that bad!!!!!  I don't know what to do - I bought two 5 lb. bags for $38 and will know they are sitting in my cupboard waiting for me to "sneak a few" even knowing what they will do to me. The reviews I have just read are SO FREAKING RIGHT - it has been three hours and my stomach still is rolling like I'm on a SHIP FROM HELL!  Seriously, if I were SMART, I would have eaten only a few, not two handfuls the first time to see how I would feel. Who thinks about these things when they need their Gummis??  If I can get the kind of reaction I got with my constipation problem, you can imagine what these will do to ORDINARY people. Handle with EXTREME CARE!!!!
Great price for this large package.  Hard to find sugarless candy.  Good taste but don't eat too many because you'll pay for it!!

The title of my review says it all. I have high blood sugar, so I am always on the lookout for sugar free or relatively low sugar foods and snacks.

I saw 3 stars on the product without reading the actual review, which I should have, and ordered these. I am not going to lie to you, these taste great, and that's where all the pros end. Ate about 30 of them and about 3 hours later, the merciless gas attack began. Gas-X, Imodium, nothing helps at this point.... just had to deal with the gastrointestinal pain, flatulence and diarrhea.

These would make a great prank candy..... if that isn't your goal, these delicious gas inducing candy isn't for you.

Summary: Pain Inducing! Forces You to Spend the Day in the Bathroom!
Text:
BEWARE!

So you've sworn off sugar and fat and this product seems like it could be your salvation. Think again...

This deceptive little gummi bear looks and tastes amazing. The flavor bursts in your mouth and you can't believe that this delicious treat could be sugar and fat free! Guess what: it's not. Lycasin has only a 20-30% lower glycemic index than sugar, not 0, like they lead you to believe. But you won't know this as you eat one after another of these tasty little fruity guys... A few handfuls later (maybe more...) you may notice your tummy rumbling. But these taste so good you may just keep snacking away. Even if you don't, it may be too late. Within an hour you are going to experience the WORST stomach pain you've ever experienced. Cramping. Gas. Nausea. Bloating. Diarrhea. Heartburn. Sharp, stabbing pains... Tight, twisting pains...

When something seems too good to be true it probably is. I ended up throwing 4 pounds of this 5 pound bag into the trash. I bet you will do the same if you make the mistake of buying it. I'm sticking to Good Ol' Fruit as a sweet treat from now on... No more of this chemically engineered "food" that wreaks havoc on your digestive system.

DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT UNLESS YOU ARE LOOKING FOR A STRONG LAXATIVE OR ARE THINKING ABOUT POISONING AN ENEMY...

OMG!  My mistake for not reading the review prior to purchasing these.  Whatever they put in these made me soooo sick!  The first night after I ate these, I was up all night with severe stomach pains(the likes of which I have never felt) and diarrhea.  I thought maybe I had a bug.  A few days later I ate some more, and the same thing!  For a good twelve hours after eating just a handful, I was in terrible pain.  Needless to say, I had to throw these out, since I don't hate anyone enough to give these away.  BEWARE!

I am a gummy bear lover and these are just as good as the regular ones without the sugar. I didn't experience the symptoms that others have commented on so I think it depends on how sensitive your stomach is. But hey, if you ever want a tasty alternative to a laxative...

I can't have sugar and was pleased to find that these candies were as close to the full on sugar gummi bears.  I did; however, have the same type of stomach upset reported by the other reviewers.  It was not enough to stop me from eating smaller portions, though!  I would recommend these candies.
These are the best gummi bears that you can get in the united states...

Summary: Should be "Lizzies Dipping Vinegar" instead of Oil
Text: I did not like this product at all....in fact, I tossed the other bottle in the trash. I was expecting a garlic-flavored dipping oil, but got more of a balsamic-vinegar salad dressing. WHERE'S THE GARLIC??  It was brown in color, with big black chunks of....something in it, maybe the vinegar? I am a very good cook, and sometimes make my own garlic dipping oil. This product was more vinegar than oil. I could barely taste garlic and saw NO slices of garlic in the product. I would not buy any of "Lizzie's Kitchen" products again, due to the fact that this one was so bad-tasting. I do not recommend this product to potential buyers.

This product has an ingredient called sodium tripolyphosphate, which is used to make fish look glossier and fresh, even if it's spoiled and expired.  It is a suspected neurotoxin according to the National Institute for Occupational and Health's Registry of Toxic Effects of Chemical Substances.  I would recommend reading more about this ingredient before serving it to your animal in canned pet food.

Summary: Good full flavored cup of dessert coffee
Text: This is definitely a dessert coffee.  It has a very mild blend of beans and the buttercream flavor lends its flavor to a very mellow brew.  Enjoyable and very palatable, but best enjoyed as a follow up to a meal or as a dessert accompaniment.
only tried the chocolate mint so far.  they're very tasty!  especially for something packed full of caffeine and other pep goodies.
We got these for our son's first birthday give away and were very happy with the freshness of the product.
OK, not bad but freshness was somewhat lacking.  Candy I received in the past has always been very fresh.  Not dissatisfied, just somewhat disappointed.
I think the gone fishing gift basket is a good idea, because fishing is a sport that could use a little class and refinement.

I first purchased this product because I love the flavored oatmeal that Quaker makes, but found the packets too sweet for my taste and too high of a sugar content for a healthier diet. I was really excited to find the lower sugar instant oatmeal until I noticed that they contain artificial sweeteners to compensate for the reduced sugar. As someone who deliberately avoids "low fat" and "diet" products to keep artificial sweeteners out of my body, it made me mad that they did not make it more clear that this was not a less sweet version of their product, but simply an artificially sweetened one. I just feel that people should be properly warned that the food they are purchasing contains chemical sweeteners, and wanted to let anyone thinking of purchasing this know. If you don't mind artificial sweeteners, then enjoy!

I also have this for breakfast every morning.  When I first started eating it, it seemed bland compared to the normal variety, but now the normal variety seems way too sweet.  Last time I checked, the lower sugar variety even had fewer calories than the weight control formula.  I wish it were available at a discount through "Subscribe and Save." Until it is, I'll just stock up when my store has its BOGO deals.

I like the lower sugar version because I don't normally add any sugar to my cereal. One time I went to visit an older cousin and her five children. She put more sugar on the oatmeal than I put on a whole month's worth of oatmeal breakfasts. She made a separate bowl and saw how much I put on. She was shocked as to how little I put on...maybe a half a teaspoon for the whole bowl at the most. I'm just not a sugar eater when it comes to any kind hot or cold cereal.

My favorite flavor is cinnamon and spice. But..there is only two packets of that flavor in the box. I'm not a real big fan of maple sugar and there are four of those in the box. The apple and cinnamon flavor is ok and there are four of those also. But..I'd like to find more of the lower sugar variety of Quaker Oatmeal in cinnamon and spice flavor. I looked on the web and there isn't any place that has just lower sugar cinnamon and spice Quaker oatmeal in it's own box. I found the regular version...but not the lower sugar version...in its own box. For that reason I only gave it four stars.

I ordered my plants on a Thursday and not only did I receive an email from the actual seller letting me know when he was shipping the product and some tips on keeping it alive, etc. on Friday, I got my plants in great condition that following Monday.  There is a review sheet that is extremely helpful and if you've ever bought some of these plants at Home Depot or Walmart, you'll know why they never survived for very long.  That's how it was for me in any case.  Overall, I will definitely be purchasing more types of plants from this seller in the future.

I was basically familiar with each of the cheeses. I bought them based through Amazon.com on the confidence in the product and the company. The service was exactly what you had said it would be. Our guests thoroughly enjoyed the cheeses and were amazed that they were all from Ireland.

Will definitely be back next year--if not sooner.
I purchase this as a gift. The receiver was very pleased with the quality, aromas and flavors. I'll likely send this assortment again as a gift. Very pleased.
I am just learning to cook with Miso.  This certainly adds omami.  No other miso product to compare it to. Yeasty. sort of like powdered Vegemite.

These beans had very few clinkers after washing.  Rinse and sort, then soak overnight (do only one batch at a time).  Next day, simmer (SIMMER) for 2-4 hours.  Let cool and then put into a container that will easily let you change the water.  Change the water EVERY DAY for 14 days.  NO KIDDING!!!  Every day for two weeks.  The last day, add about 1/4 cup of salt for every gallon of beans.  Let sit overnight and taste.  If too salty, change the water and replace with less salt.  If not salty enough, add a little more salt.  These bean are so much better than the already prepared ones I can get in the grocery for $4.00/6oz.  Well worth the effort.  Put a couple of handsful in a bowl and get yourself a beer.
I love this mix!  I get it from a warehouse club and it is just as good warm or iced.  It has lots of spice to it, even the kids love it!
Product arrived quickly and tastes great. We've already ordered and received a 2nd container and a friend wants some too.
My husband & I love our Chamba  Chai spiced latte.  We both  recommend it as a special delight for after dinner & for serving guests.  This is wonderful latte!!
OMG sooooo good and much cheaper to buy them this way.  They used to sell this stuff in the malls and it was several dollars a pound...  I am addicted

Ordered these because they were out of my favorite (sour patch exploders) - and was surprised by how yummy they are. Every flavor -even the orange which is usually my leas favorite candy flavor. Also - the candy smells and tastes fresh.

Summary: Great service and prices, crapy product
Text: I think a better description of all Non-Traditional, Gummy  Products as these are needed to eliminate confusion.  These Gummys, as the other Single Fruit Line are covered in Crystalised Sugar, and are more of a Sweet candy.  Traditional Gummbybears are aSoft in and out single source cansy, the one we had as kids, these are quite sweet and hard to enjoy.

I saw this at my local grocer and I love deep dish pizzas so I just had to buy this one.
I followed the directions to a tee and sadly........the heavy hulking pizza turned out to be a major turd.
The crust is way too hard around the edges and the inside of the crust...well have you ever eaten dough that felt like it started to expand in your stomach?
Ewww.
The sausage tasted like mouse droppings, the sauce was ok but nothing remarkable.
The only good thing was the cheese and really?
How hard is it to mess up the cheese?
All in all I don't recommend this pizza it doesn't cook right even when following the direction word for word.
If you want a good frozen deep dish nothing beats Davanni's.
For what you're paying you should expect a product that's........you know........EDIBLE.
You won't get that here.........unless you like rock hard crust with mouse poop sausage.
Not recommended.

The new package which indicates Microwave or oven bake for a 10 oz deep dish is a lie.  I followed the directions to the letter and the crust was so hard it couldn't be broken with a hammer and the center was still cold.  Since it would be absurd to turn on the oven to bake such a small pizza for 20-25 minutes to serve one person.  That makes both cooking methods impractical and therefore the product is essentially useless and a total ripoff.  I won't get my money back, but maybe you can save yours.

Ordered on Friday, received on Tuesday. Very efficent shiping. Also very good that they had the words Gumball "REFILL" in product description, some gumballs offered will not fit in the decorative gumball machines, but these were spot on. Thanks Candy Crate. Merry X-MAS to you!!!!!!!!!!

I have one of those little gumball machines and got these to fill it.  I can tell there are different flavors though the flavors aren't very defined.  Still tasty enough for kids and most adults to enjoy!  And if you take a few at a time you can get some good bubbles out of it.
I paid almost $20 for these as a Christmas refill present.  I thought there would be alot more Gumballs than there were.  I felt ripped off after I bought it.

I received this product which was to be a gift.  Upon opening the box, the gumballs were chipped so bad, I can't even use it for the gumball machine I bought them for.  More packing material would have saved me th money.
I hated this bubble gum. It did not hold the flavor for more than a few seconds. It also hurt my jaw as it is so hard to chew. I will not be purchasing this again.
I'm all for easy to make adult beverages, and this fits the bill.  The perfect amount of sweet, and the mint flavor is divine.  Makes a great gift too!

I consider myself an avid tea drinker and although I don't care for most Celestial teas I do love this one.
The flavor and aroma are really great and I like the hint of sweetness as well.
You can't go wrong with this tea!
So perfect on a cold day - or ANY day for that matter!!! Add a little English Toffee Stevia and have a perfect treat to enjoy and share!

Since my local supermarket didn't always carry Celestial Seasonings Honey Vanilla Chamomile tea, I was thrilled to be able to purchase it online at Amazon. It's a wonderful soothing & calming tea to drink, & I can drink as much as I want because it won't keep me awake like other teas containing caffine.

My little one has liked this one from the start; 7 months now and ordering the second box. The size is good too, as 2.5 onces of squash is about right.

There have been complaints of Earth's Best carrying BPA in thier lids, but this is in all jarred baby food (due to the canning process) and does not make it's way into the food itself. All in all nutricious safe and yummy!

Summary: Baby approved and BPA free lid
Text: This is a pack of 2.5 small jars, I don't know why I was expecting bigger jars, but my baby loves this squash and it's almost time to order another set. I was worried about all the reviews that mention BPA, I contacted Earth's Best and they confirmed that the lid is BPA free. I wish they made this into pouch though.

Earth's Best was the only company that I found that makes stage one organic squash. I insist on feeding the baby organic and wanted to make sure she had veggie options for stage one. Thank goodness for Earth's Best. There are lots of stage one fruits but few veggie options when it comes to organic so finding squash was a big deal. Also, only one store (Babies R Us) sells stage one squash around here. The two grocery stores I shop carry Earth Best, but the options are limited.

As far as the squash goes, no complaints! I like the fact that all Earth's Best foods are organic so I don't have to worry about looking at the label for the organic tag. I just wish they were less expensive or in bigger containers like Gerber organics.

These pistachio nuts were listed as LARGE - they are not.  Since thse nuts are in the shell they must be partially opened in order to get the nut meats.  Almost 3/4 of this package contained small, closed nuts which are impoosiboe to open. This package wasn't cheap and I considered I got ripped off.

Great hickory flavor.  Used it to make pulled pork for 20 people.  It has a rich, natural flavor, no chemical aftertaste.  Made the pork with only Hawaiian sea salt (red), black pepper, a little onion, some garlic and the Colgin Liquid Smoke.  It was gone in less than 2 hours!

The flavor of this product is so-so. You may prefer Wright's which in my opinion has a more intense smoke flavor.
The Colgin with its added vinegar has more tartness than the Wright's. Colgins has several added ingredients beyond just "liquid smoke". Wright's is just pure liquid smoke. However, sometimes I'm out of my preferred brand and can't find Wright's so I buy Colgin instead. Recently I purchased some and one of the bottles was missing the flip-top dispenser that the product label said it had. I wrote to the manufacturer to let them know. They acknowledged a production error. They offered to send me a flip-top in the mail. I told them never mind because I would just use the non-defective bottle first and reuse the top when the bottle was empty. I said I wouldn't mind if they sent me a coupon though. They wrote back and said "unfortunately the Manufacturer doesn't send out coupons, I do apologize for any inconveniences. Thank you for using Colgin Liquid Smoke!" That seems to be a little short-sighted in the consumer relations department in my opinion. Most manufacturers I've ever contacted with a product problem have bent over backwards to satisfy the customer e.g. sending you a coupon for a free replacement.

Summary: Lets kick supper up a notch.
Text: I've always been a fan of that smokey flavor, but never got around to getting myself a bottle of liquid smoke. It really adds a lot of flavor to pretty much anything you cook it with. First I was told that I should only use a drop. However, the serving size is like a teaspoon or something to that effect. I use about 5 drops in a steak marinade for one steak and it really brings out the smokey flavor of the grill. I put it in with some potatos and fried them up and it was amazing. It adds a nice toasty taste to an endless number of dishes, and I recommend it to anyone why is not afraid of savory flavors.

In ordering the Chrysanthemum tea I was surprised when a tea equal to the picture of it arrived.  When buying teas you usually end up with crushed non descript flowers, not with this tea company, these were whole flowers dried and sealed in an air tight package so not to mildew or spoil.  Because of the great quality of this item I doubt I will go back to crushed flowers, this is so much more decadent!Oh, and I forgot to share the packaging, these are definately something you would be proud in giving as a gift as they are packaged in a large clear tub as to not squish or harm the flowers.

Raisins are sweeter and juicier than those in Kellogg's raisin bran (seems like less sugar on them, too).  (You also don't have to support a company that dumps an olympic swimmer for minding his own business and enjoying some recreational chemicals.)  Otherwise, it's raisin bran, the cereal you've always loved.  At five big boxes for $20 on Subscribe and Save, how can you go wrong?

As Marco G. says, these Pernigotti brand Gianduiotti candies are first-rate, and Niche Imports cares enough about their products to add the cooler packs.  (You pay for that quality and the service, of course, but I think it's worth it.)  I disagree with Marco insofar as these are no more "real" than several other brands, except that Pernigotti *may* have been one of the first producers with the classic shape and composition of these smooth hazelnut chocolates.  In fact, if you go to a Lindt store, you can even find Swiss-made Gianduiotti!  Those aren't bad, but have more sugar, and taste, well, kind of like Lindt milk chocolate!  These Pernigotti use some combination of beans like in Pernigotti cocoa powder, and as a result have a richer taste.  Still plenty sweet, but less cloying than most.  (And no granules of hazelnut, as seems to be popular with some manufacturers nowadays.)  If you wanted to see what the fuss was about without actually paying shipping for a single bag, or to "risk" ordering enough quantity to amortize the shipping cost, you might try going to a Williams-Sonoma store and buying a tin of Pernigotti cocoa, and make hot chocolate with it.  Either you'll love it or hate it, and then you'll know whether or not these Gianduiotti are for you.  I feel the cocoa is way more complex than other brands, and that these candies are downright addictive -- they spoiled me against other brands, as Marco says.  I have only one minor complaint: Niche Imports takes whatever size bags and boxes the factory gives them, and never updates their listings.  So for example this product picture is a 200 gram bag, but the listing says 300 grams!  Are you being cheated?  Well, not exactly, but if you're the sort of person who gets bent out of shape about this kind of thing, e-mail them before you order.  Highest possible recommendation for this product!

Summary: The best ever - go get it!
Text: I couldn't agree less with the previous reviewer. I buy this sauce when I don't have time to make my own. It is meaty, robust, complex and full of true savory, rich tomato flavor. If you love a perfect tomato, you'll know what I mean. I have to stop myself from eating it by the spoonful out of the jar. Summary: Sweet but concerned about drinking a glass of chemicals
Text:
While Mio certainly is sweet, has zero calories, and is convenient to use and carry around, my concern is about what's in here. The primary ingredients are water, propylene glycol, artificial flavors, dyes (red 40, yellow 5, blue 1), and preservatives (potassium sorbate). You're basically drinking a glassful of chemicals with each use. There's no actual tea extract and it must be used diluted. The artificial sweeteners, sucralose and acesulfame-K, in particular raise eyebrows among those concerned with food safety. The taste is OK. It tastes like other diet iced teas on the market.

About the packaging: it's durable grey plastic, but type 7, which cannot be recycled in many municipalities. Kraft could've used type 1 or 2 plastic instead. The egg does not have an inner foil seal around the nozzle. Mine arrived covered with dried residue on the outside, likely from leaking during rough transit or handling. The liquid is staining, as you can see at the end of my video. My fingers got dyed a brown/orange color from touching the residue. Real iced tea is simple enough to make and cheap. I do not recommend this artificial concoction.

Summary: Several packages for the same yummy product
Text:
OK, so I'm used to drinking (and have a preference for) the cans that have the aluminum top you peel back--it's a teeny tiny frustration to have to, well, clean the inevitably dusty, traveled top of any can, whether with a damp towel, rinsing, or my shirt if I'm not feeling particularly energetic.

That said, the price through Amazon (at $2 higher than The Chef's Warehouse that charges $9.95 for shipping) is much better, and this is JUST the kind of thing that, while it's pretty near-identical the price of my local grocer, I appreciate not hauling far.

Now about the soda... I'm NOT a soda drinker. I abhor that corn syrupy colored mess called cola (though Cheerwine keeps a spot in my less than three!)... in general, my stomach, as I sort of banned this drink category for 360+ days a year at the age of 13, gets very upset when carbonated water is put in it, especially with caffeine in most carbonated things... and another interesting tummy woe is orange juice. Unless it's fresh squeezed and "normal" orange juice (not the awesomely rich Florida kinds of oranges), well, I'm sorta not able to handle that, not even after prilosec entered my world.

Now for the confusion. This stuff... it tastes amazingly fresh, the carbonation isn't excessive, with 18% juice, I get some natural vitamin C (pills are no good anyway, not for 99 thousand out of 99,001 people), and I'm not drinking pure buzzed OJ. I am also not getting mouth sores or anything of the sort that I recall getting when OJ was one of those everyday 12 ounces of it items... yeah, I wasn't terribly smart, but then again, metabolism of a hummingbird forgives just about all food habits... I'm older, wiser (don't use semicid), and this is that mature drink for me...

I think it is perfect for people who, like me, can't do straight OJ, who can't quite bring themselves to inhale pure sugar/corn syrup sodas, who don't want their drinks tasting like food coloring, you get the picture... it just tastes like a fresh citrus spritzer, like the bubbling of champagne with the juice content of a margarita and no alcohol. If you like tonic water, this could replace that kind of unhealthy addictive drink (for your eyes in particular, as quinine leads to blindness when used for more than a couple months). If you like margaritas or screwdrivers or want some fizz without it being fake Fanta fizzle, then this is what to drink.

It isn't particularly surprising (to me) that this happens to be my run-to drink when I'm eating cheesy Italian foods... it seriously was made FOR rich Italian dishes (seafood, I'm not so sure on--I think vino would be better for fish dishes)... plate me up something with creams, cheeses, maybe prosciutto and butter sauces, etc... and this somehow feels like its bubbling acid is helping my stomach along--maybe just because the most healthy of adult tummies still (well, when the diet has gone adult and is less saturated with fats, less gooey, less fried, less American in general) have some trouble digesting cheese on cheese on gooey awesome cheese with some roasted-in-olive-oil veggies, of course, and the occasional land mammal commonly consumed in Italy.

My point? If you're eating pizza, calzone, lasagna, or even other Euro-derived foods... or if you're eating some fried chicken, even, this drink is an amazing counterpart. If you take anything like proton pump inhibitors regularly (prilosec, aciphex, etc., or even zantac types of meds), then this could be that perfect add-on when you go off your healthy food diet and splurge for something you know might irritate. No, I'm not selling it as a medicine, though mmm this DOES remind me of when cola used to be good stuff (when it was just a bit of sugar and when real cherries were in the cup) and why they decided to put some things in such syrups to deliver more effectively... it's darn good stuff. It's NOT your everyday soda. To my knowledge, they are adamant against using corn syrup, and having had the stuff in blue, in pale blue/yellow, and in a couple other cans, also having had it in glass bottles (panna is also made by them, so you can imagine the quality of the water that goes into this drink!)... well, it's all been some water, some OJ, some sugar (but not a lot), some natural CO2, and ... maybe natural flavor? Hmm, would have to get off my currenly lazy rump (with a currently terrible signal to post this review) and check... but I do indulge in this one soda here and there, despite "knowing better" from years in med school and more years teaching integrated nutritional sciences alongside medicine (to try targeting the source of so many health woes, we really DO have to check in on our diets!)...

As long as it stays caffeine free and low on the carbonation (which is reckless and artificial in US sodas--really disgusting and rather harmful)... then I'll drink this... not daily, but maybe go through a 6 pack or 2 in a month, depending on just how often I do splurge on foods that my stomach feels just a bit... weighted down by... and I can even drink it on an empty stomach, meaning the carbonation is seriously low compared to our crazy sodas and "energy" drinks.

Mmm, I think my lazy rump might need a bit of sizzling refreshment in the form of aranciata san pellegrino... the healthiest soda I've found SO FAR that still keeps its cost around a buck with tax.

It comes from powdered aloe rather than actual aloe chunks in other drinks. But the benefits are still there. I would love to see this product be available everywhere as an alternative to sodas, especially if that means the price would become lower. I'm a foodie and consider this my greatest drink find of all time. Actually maybe it's better not to tell too many people. : ) Do a subscription to save, as you can cancel anytime. Cheers!
I have tried most of Dr. McDougall's soups and they are all delicious, easy to fix and very nutritious and filling!

The first two cases I bought were very satisfactory. I mixed the coconut milk into a shake, along with bananas and cocoa and drank it straight. It was great, very fresh. I could use it on anything: salads, etc. The third case I bought had a completely different texture, smooth and creamy versus the flaky, part solid/part liquid texture of the first two cases. Unsure about it, I put a sparing amount in my shake. Minutes later, my stomach starting to act up. It couldn't digest this coconut milk properly. My wife's stomach's reaction was even worse than mine. (I've also had a similar reaction before with another brand of coconut milk, bought much less expensively at an Asian grocery). So then I looked at the ingredients, and lo and behold, there were at the end: "guar gum, stabilizers." Looking back at the description of this item here on Amazon, I see it says "No Preservatives. No Stabilizers." I also have found from other reviews that people have discovered the ingredients have changed. A once-great product is no longer, and in fact, is not as advertised.

My family drinks a lot of coconut milk (about a can a day) and this is one of the best brands available. I also recommend Chaokoh but it isn't available directly from Amazon yet and is probably better to just purchase locally. This Natural Value Coconut Milk is one of the few that has no fillers or preservatives though which means it is perfect for making healthy coconut yogurt with the Salton YM9 1-Quart Yogurt Maker. If you haven't tried making coconut yogurt yet I highly recommend it!

A lot of people are still under the impression that Coconut milk is bad for you. There was some faulty research done years ago on hydrogenated coconut oil which is mostly to blame for this. If you are one of those people that are still convinced coconut is bad I highly recommend reading The Good Fat Cookbook.

Summary: Not as advertised - contains guar gum and stabilizer.
Text:
The description says it contains "no stabilizers", yet the case I received on 2/24/10 contains guar gum and stabilizers. The ingredients list reads: "Coconut extract, guar gum, emulsifier, stabilizer".

I am very unhappy about this - the ONLY reason I ordered it was because it was advertised as not having any stabilizers.

I have purchased the Organic coconut milk many times.  It has a fresh, coconut taste and is very smooth.  But, it has guar gum added.  I decided to give the regular Natural Value a try (non-organic, no guar gum).  It is a very different product.  The coconut milk has a strange smell and flavor.  It is unpleasant and does not taste like coconut.  The can contains a lot of liquid and the coconut solid is somewhat grainy in texture compared to the organic.  Overall, I am unhappy with this product.  I cannot recommend it.

I know Crystal Light gets mixed with water, so it's not exactly an "alternative", but I can't drink as much water as I should, it's just too blah. I have a gallon  of this mixed up in the fridge at all times, so no problems. Hard to find in grocery stores; at least in the economic size that I go through, so nice to see on Amazon.

Summary: More convenient but not as cost effective
Text: I was pleased to discover this product again after Sam's Club quit selling it.  However, the pricing per unit at Amazon.com is almost as high as in stores when the smaller individual packages go on sale.  The previous price at Sam's Club was about $6.48-$6.75 per box.  On line it runs about $10 per box or about .55 per tub.  The box is more convenient but not necessarily less expensive.

I love this product it's sugar free and tastes great!!!.
I wish it was a little less expensive.

In Italy the cafe to have is Lavazza or Illy , This is a very good deal if you drip brew. I prefer MOka , What I have found that you should re grind the coffee too a finer grind and you will be amazed how wonderful it is !!! Very low acid , very high pleasure !!!
Love this coffee! I have looked and looked for one that tastes like the Candy Cane for Keurig coffee makers....This is wonderful....not too pepperminty...just a taste.

Never received the order. Package tracking indicates USPS never received the package from the merchant, who also didn't respond to my inquiries. Now I get to jump through hoops with Amazon and Amex to get my money back. Save yourself the aggro.

You'd think marshmallows would put the sweetness of this cereal over-the-top, but then you'd be mistaken.  I don't know how, but they make an already tasty cereal even better (Great texture, too).  Hard to find in stores, so pick up from Amazon while you still can.  Highly recommended cereal!

Summary: OMG!! What a few Marshmellows can do
Text:
I don't know how just adding a few Marshmallows to the good old Froot Loops Cereal could make such a difference. I've ordered these box of 4, twice now, and each time, one box ended up being one serving ..... I just can't stop eating these.

Even my dog freaked out watching ME go into a Food Frenzy while eating these. Like a dog who has been waiting for his food, I turned primal with these. YUMMY!

Ughh..... My gawd. These things taste awful. Has no flavor, no kick, barely even fizzes. It's rather terrible. A local charity drive received some of these and sent this off to some hungry kids in Cambodia and the kids sent the entire shipment back saying they rather risk drinking the cholera-laden water from the nearby stream. I cant recommend anyone drinking this unless they've previously had their taste buds burned off with sulfuric acid. In that case....bottoms up!

2 stars...one extra because it's only 99 cents at most stores for when you have no money to quench the thirst and Arizona or Brisk arent available.
Picked these up at a great price and subscribe and save. These are really very elegant tea bags, like little pyramids and the flavor is excellent.

I'd have to say that these are my favorite of Judy's sugar-free caramels.  Chewy, sweet and delicious -- a real treat for those who are diabetic (like me) or just want to avoid processed sugar in their lives.

The Tassimo is a wonderful Coffeemaker. I got it for my sister who HATES "new" machines.  She loves the ease of working it. She is a tea drinker and she loves the Twinings English Breakfast Tea. We love that you make one good cup of tea at a time, and you can immediately switch to coffee or hot chocolate if you prefer.

It is absolutely delicious. It is MUCH BETTER than any other brand of ketchup that I have tasted. It is very rich and very good tasting. I got it on subscribe at a great price and I am so happy that I did.

I bought these for my husband for his Christmas stocking. They're hard to find in stores. I'm sad to report that the box is now half gone. First my son found them, then my granddaughter. Of course it was my duty to test a couple to make sure they were in good shape.  They are so good. They arrived very fresh and yummy. No broken bars at all. I guess they'll be a few left for his stocking. Well.... maybe. I've always had good luck ordering candies and groceries from Amazon. I will do so again.

This soup is delicious! One can makes a nice, filling and nutritious meal. I seson mine up with hot sauce, otherwise it is still good plain. You cant beat this for a canned soup. I love it and will be ordering more.
Accidentally ran accross these nuts in a grocery store, checked Amazon and found this great product @ a great price and have them delivered to me monthly-free shipping--what more could you ask for!

I was really skeptical, but lo and behold it really does taste as good as soy sauce. There is an ever so slight alcoholic smell when you open it, but it goes away and it doesn't, in my opinion, affect the taste. I put it in everything - stir fry, dips, soups - you name it.  Really glad I found this product.

This is a good almond tea.  I'd describe the flavor as a dry almond.  It's a light flavor (though definitely present), and I'd describe its presence as subtle.  This is not a very nutty flavor- choose Adagio's Chestnut if you're looking for that.  Rather, this is a subtle almond tea.  The flavor is not especially sweet, so it's good for both morning and evening consumption.  I'd probably have preferred a little more nuttiness, but I enjoyed this tea all the same.

Our family loves Ribena, a British favorite.  Ribena is a delicious black currant concentrate.  Add water and enjoy it hot or cold.  So glad to have found it on Amazon as up until now it's been very difficult to get in the USA.

Summary: Not the same as back home (UK)
Text: I was so excited to see Ribena on Amazon and ordered the pack of 6, but upon opening the first bottle and pouring some out to dilute it, I could see that it was weak and more watery than it should be.  Although this is made in Britain, I have a feeling they dilute it to ship to the US.  Cadbury's and Nestle's do the same thing with their chocolate...we get the waxy stuff over here, meanwhile the UK gets the creamy, good stuff!  Unless it was a fluke, my 6 bottles were much weaker than normal.  I won't order this again-I only gave it 4 stars because real Ribena is excellent and this does have the flavor.

I have avoided making real hummus for years.  I made a white bean/olive oil variation because I couldn't make hummus that tasted as good as what I bought in stores.  I believe this product will save on my grocery bill considering a tub of hummus averages $5.  I found and tweaked a recipe online and now people request I bring hummus to gathering.  Many don't believe I made it until I give them the recipe.  I use three tablespoons of the Al Wadi Tahina to one can of garbanzo beans, among other ingredients.  The product comes in a plastic container with a wide mouth making it easy to stir.

I love this!  I ordered it despite the fact that it's constantly back ordered and it didn't take long to get it.  Less than a week waiting, so don't worry about the 1-2 months wait time it says.  The price can't be beat and the quality is outstanding and very fresh (no separation at all.)  It's so tasty without any bitterness at all.  You can eat it with a spoon if you so desire, it's that tasty.  Nutty and very delicious.  I have used it in quite a few dishes and plan to make some hummus soon!

I have tried several different brands of tahini, but this one is my favorite.  The flavor is a nice, nutty roasted sesame flavor.  My only problem was ordering during a hot spell when the temps were high-90s to 100s, and when the shipment came, the product was quite warm - no fault of the product, but of the weather!

Alwadi has the best home made Tahina! Even without adding water, lemon and garlic it has a great taste. Price is fair for a high quality. I used to bye this Tahina a few years back in the California and just came across it now online and could not resist to by some. The first order came packed well but one pair of jars poped and the thina was out of the jar. luckily it was packed well in a strong bag so all i had to do is wash it. After a short chat with costumers service i was sent new tahini and all is well!

Highly recommended!

Sun Flour's cookies are AMAZING. They're rich and textured and delicious. I can't possibly recommend them enough, unless you're trying to diet or something. Good luck not eating the entire basket in a day.

We eat mostly homemade food but this is one exception. The soup is a nice, thick consistency and has chunks of veggies. My son is not a veggie fan but loves this soup. Also, it has no dairy or egg and is therefore good for someone with those allergies. Is not an everyday food since it's processed but really hits the spot once a week or so. My only disappointment is the price. I paid $17 on amazon for this same item in December and the price has now nearly doubled to about $30 with subscribe and save.

I don't like the three K-cups that are available right now for hot chocolate above about Ok. But this packet version from Ghirardelli is some of the best Hot Chocolate I've ever had. Really a rich chocolate taste.
We tried the Ghirardelli hot cocoa with our Keurig coffee machine and the results are superb.  The only problem is keeping it in the house.

Summary: Its Just a Packet of Chocolate
Text:
I was looking for the great k-cup chocolate. This is great Chocolate but is just a packet...buy the larger container for a fraction of the price and get the same thing.
pc

I have a beautiful 3 year old black and white Cocker Spaniel.  During the first several months with her, she demonstrated some puzzling symptoms...jerking and shivering, even in 100 degree summer weather...I took her to the vet. but he could find nothing wrong.....Instinct told me otherwise....So I tried giving her what we give our patients in the ER, when they have ingested something toxic...Activated charcoal....the shivers and jerking stopped.....I suspected immediately that something in the kibble type food I was giving her was toxic to her nervous system.....up to this point she would stare at the Kibble type food and eat only enough to survive.....I began a search for a substitute...thanks to a knowledgable pet store owner who showed me a bag of Sojos Europa...I now have a pet that no longer shivers or shakes, her coat is very healthy.....she has the energy of a puppy, and her breath no longer stinks....I mix Sojos with cooked chicken snapper and salmon, not all at once.  She loves it.  I'll try some other meats soon.....bottom line is this is really good stuff.....Read the list of ingredients,  this stuff smells so good,I have been tempted to taste it myself...but remember tasting lemon soap the Fuller Brush Man brought when I was a kid, but that's another story.

Summary: Quality ingredients, but gives my dog serious gas
Text: This dog food has quality ingredients, but it gives my dog serious gas, for along time. Also, you're supposed to add the water and let it hydrate overnight, which I didn't expect to have to mess with. I'll be looking for something abit different from this in the future.

Love the idea of grain free - dehydrated food.

Switched to raw a couple of months ago and wanted to add in veggies for fiber and fill as I also wanted my dog to loose some weight.

He's thriving on the raw and I love that this product is delivered to my door (I hate shopping) and it is less costly to purchase through Amazon than most other on-line and retailers.

The veggies are high quality. I tend to make my dog's food in small batches and I also run the ingredients through a blender to make it easier to digest for my dog.

Great product - will continue to buy - wonderful option to high quality dog food.

Sojos Grain-Free dog food is the best for my dog. The finding of this product was very easy on the websites. The ordering and recieving of this product from this company was great and I will be re=ordering very soon. Thank you so much.

Summary: This is a great choice for a noodle replacement!
Text:
I was initially scared to try this noodle because it was brownish. Then I felt silly because: A) whole-wheat pasta is brown, and B) I eat seaweed all the time at Japanese restaurants. Well, these noodles are no different than JFC's white yam noodles, outside of the fact that they are healthier because of the addition of seaweed.

The texture is really strong and firm, and they aren't too chewy (I microwave for 2 minutes prior to cooking in sauce or soup). I didn't smell any suspension liquid during rinsing, though it might be habit not to take any breaths before they are rinsed!

This is a great buy and went really great with my minty-pesto mahi-mahi tonight.
One of three bottles was received broken. Initial inquires to the sender were ignored. Complaint to Amazon resulted in a refund (less postage)when a replacement was requested.

My daughter, who is pretty picky about food, loves this oatmeal. It has good texture and taste. I can live with the nutritional content too, not loaded with sugar, has protein and fiber. She likes it better if I smash 1/2 a banana and mix it in. The oatmeal is a bit on the tart side. Overall a great product that kids will eat. Would like to try the raspberry flavor..
My Maltese has been suffering from some skin issues and it is very hard to find grain free treats. He loves these treats and they are wholesome for him. Great pricing too!

Summary: Jesus Should've Turned Water Into THIS!
Text:
I was looking forward to this soda for quite a while and after such a prolonged wait I was more than a little concerned that it wouldn't live up to the hype. Well it is with great relief that I can now say those worries went unfounded.

7-Up beautifully captures the true meaning of effervescence and it captures it rather appropriately in a plastic bottle. A clear bottle at that because 7-Up has nothing to hide. Everything that makes it great is there for all to see and see through, unless you're blind, in which case I'm afraid you'll have to settle for listening to it. Not that listening to those sparkling little miracles we call bubbles is any less satisfying than seeing them. In fact hearing those popping and fizzling sounds canoodle in and around your earlobe area can be quite cathartic, depending on what type of day you're having.

So what are you waiting for? Go grab a nice refreshing bottle of 7 Eleven!
The clams were ok. I also had some canned oysters around and they were much better. The clams seemed a little tough.

This oatmeal is the best instant that I've tasted. My only criticism is that it needs more fruit. However, it never occurred to me to add chia seeds--great call Umpqua! The sugar content versus fiber makes this a tasty, healthy breakfast! I would definitely recommend this oatmeal to my friends.

Royal Canin SS Skin Support Dog Food 32 lbDo not use this product. My dog was on it and threw up on my beige carpet. This dog food stains and even sears carpet cleaning people couldn't remove the yellow stain from my rug. I had to replace the carpet and am out a lot of money. It contains curcimin which turns everything yellow..

These are a perfect delicious, nutritious, low-cal snack and I love them! I bought the minis so they would be lower calorie. Love the nutritional content as well as the lack of chemicals and tons of sugar.
My grandoggy, a Pomeranian, LOVES these.  I got her some for Christmas, and her "mom" awoke to her under the tree with one in here mouth! Early Christmas for her!

Why does the package say you must wash your hands with soap and water after handling this product? The statement about this not being for human consumption seems to be very important too. I bought this for my dog but after reading the packaging I'd like to know, what is in this product that is made in China?

I usually drink The Republic of Tea's Gunpowder Green Tea, which I love, but for some reason thought I would try the Numi Gunpowder Green...and I ordered two canisters of it!  It was such a huge mistake - it smells and tastes like cigarette ashes - which obviously isn't what I like in a loose tea.  I don't know if this is normal for the Numi gunpowder green or if there is something wrong with the tea I received, but it is definitely going in the garbage...

Great individual serving sizes.  We love this for on the go.  I like that it's organic and fortified.  My only issue is that it's not always available.  It's a really good backup (for milk) and I keep one in my diaper bag.

Great Product. My family loves this size Smarties, the calories are lower than many of the candy bars out there. You have a regular customer with me.
Thanks!

Summary: Dogs switched to it easily, cleared up an apparent alergy in one dog
Text: Switched dog food again. The last brand was okay, dogs liked/ate it well enough, but we noticed our larger dog seemed to develop some strange skin reaction. (If you rubbed her fur in certain places she would grimace as if irritated, even through there was no visible rash.) We bought "Go! Dry Dog Food, Natural Grain Free Endurance Formula" and I immediately liked it better than the previous stuff. It's darker, softer and my dogs took to it immediately without any discomfort (bloat, gas, loose stools). The good news is that my large dog immediately lost the weird skin discomfort. She's totally back to normal. My wife had been worried that it was some allergic reaction to some grain in the previous food. She must've been right. My guess is that dogs will prove more vulnerable to GMO grain. Grain free may be the only way to go from here on out, at least in America where GMO now shows up in everything.

My 40# mixed breed pup thinks that this is a treat ... little does she know it is good for her.  She has a sensitivity to chicken, and this food does give her the itchies, but not nearly as bad as many foods.  If it weren't for the chicken, this might be our go-to food.  As it is, I only get this if I can't get hold of something as high quality without chicken.  I have recommended it to several of my friends for their dogs, as well.

Summary: Very pleased with the service and the product!
Text: Any one who enjoys potato chips and the flavor of basil and tomato will go wild over this product! Sooooooo delicious! If my Maker would have given me more than two thumbs, all the thumbs would be up! Buy some. You will not regret it. :)

Summary: Was not shipped the product advertised!
Text: The picture shown on amazon was not the product shipped.  I received blanced almonds (which are slightly processed - not RAW) and the bags were not 5 oz but labeled 4.5 oz.  Very dissapointed!

A real break from the dull turkey, cheese and tomato  sandwich on toasted whole wheat.  Add this to your sandwich and suddenly the sandwich comes alive. Seriously, if you like Indian food you will love this relish on ANYTHING you put it on.  Really well made!

This organic squeeze contains fragrant oil from the lemon peel, and, in my opinion, that is what gives it the fresh zing that is pasturized out of most bottled lemon juices. This one tastes more real than any bottled or squeezed lemon product, it is very close to fresh wedges. I squeeze it in soda, tea, on rice and veggies, even in cake icings. Rim cocktail glasses or just squirt a little in your water bottle. I like putting a pitcher of water out on the dinner table with a slice of lemon in it, but while it looks lovely, the peel can give the water a bitter taste after a few hours. A squirt of this does the trick without any bitterness! Pop in the fridge after breaking the seal.
I purchased these to add drops of lemon juice to my water.  They're great!  I gave it 4 stars because I don't really have anything else to compare it to.

Summary: SNYDERS OF HANOVER PRETZEL SNAPS, 10-OUNCE BAGS(PACK OF 12)
Text: A great tasting pretzel by Snyder's of Hanover of Pennsylvania and very easy between 2 people on a movie night finishing a bag throughout several hours. I got a couple of cases(Pack Of 12) shipped free to my home from Warehouse Deals fulfilled by Amazon.com for a rate of $16.99/per case *24 bags total*. They were very fresh, NOT SALTY like many pretzels are, and perfect mouth popping tic-tac-toe looking size pieces. Highly recommended pretzel for lovers of such product, on a diet, and great bargain if available at price I paid seeing that normally they would cost you according to price on bag @ $2.49/per X 12 = $29.88 full price!!! Bargain hunt like I do and enjoy your pretzels with family and friends during movie nights, sporting events, by yourself, etc..

All the Bear Naked granolas are fantastic: lower in sugar and fat and sans the additives and preservatives found in most grocery store granola. The Maple Pecan flavor is delicious without being over the top in sugar and calories. A nice complement to Greek yogurt and fruit!

I have always loved black turtle beans and eat them often. I was happy to learn of Eden Organic and the no-BPA can. As others reported, the shipment arrived very badly dented. Wasn't thrilled with that, but okay. Stuff happens. The real disappointment came when I opened the first can. I actually thought I had opened a can of kidney beans by mistake.

These are not traditional black turtle beans. I don't know what kind of bean they are, but if you are looking for the traditional black turtle bean, this is not it. And it's not just the reddish brown color that gives these away - even the taste is unlike traditional black beans.

They don't taste bad, just more along the lines of a kidney bean taste instead of a black bean. I know there are other types of black beans and maybe this is one of those. But the can says black turtle beans and those they certainly are not.

Summary: Picky Shih Tzu loves this food!
Text: Romeo, the pickest dog I have ever partnered with, does not hesitate to gobble this up! I have tried so many high quality foods only to have him turn his nose up (like a cat) and walk away. His sister, Juliet, equally finds this food yummy, but to her, everything is. I will be ordering other flavors, as well. This food got the highest rating from an independent, healthy dog food advocate website.

I was thrilled to find this flavor available at amazon.  I had not seen it in the grocery stores for a while so I called Quaker and was told they would no longer be packaging the Banana Bread flavor alone.  It would only be available as part of a variety pack.  This, of course, is the only flavor my husband likes, so I'll buy it from amazon until it's all gone. :-)

I bought this not because it was a 'weight control' formula but because of the flavor. I love Quaker oatmeal and I love Banana bread so I figured it would be a logical thing to buy. I'm glad I bought this because this oatmeal is delicious. It has a real banana flavor - not a fake banana flavor. And it does remind me of eating homemade banana bread. I love the fact that it's got 7g of protein and 6g of dietary fiber because I'm trying to get more protein and fiber in my diet.

Even though the chips arrived at least a month before their expiration date, the aroma of rancid oil assaulted my nose on the first bag.  The chips tasted stale and bland.  Just to be thorough, I checked several more bags and found them all to be inedible.  Thank goodness for curbside composting.  It will take a while to work up the nerve to try these again.

Summary: Just like Mom used to make!!
Text: This fig jam was the best!  It had real lemon peel in it just like Mom used to make it.  I just bought a jar and it is already gone!  You will love it too!

This product is not the same as the great tasting sour lemon.  It tastes like lemon hard candy with sugar in the middle.  The better tasting lemon is much lighter in color.  I ordered this product 3 times.  Returned the first two.  I'll keep this third order.  This darker yellow hard candy is no better than the $7 bucks for 7 lbs hard candy; no reason to pay $55

This product is my overal favorite. spicy, yet not too harsh, even the kids will enjoy this. The right of amount of zing allows you to use your own seasoning recipes and brush on this sunshine at the end! great product and great company.

These chestnuts are absolutely delicious! They are perfect for tossing into recipes, and are a low fat, low calorie, tasty snack. If you love other high-end chestnut products, these will please you.
Right now they are sold out, and I can understand why! So glad I bought the six pack. You will enjoy this purchase, and for anyone who loves chestnuts- you will be in hog heaven!
The lemon lime pathos is one of several plants I have purchased from Hirt's Garden and I continued to be impressed.
it's the best. we will all ways buy this bbq sauce, good on pork chops.i will have to find it in my home town.the best
This product is very delicious but the quanity was a little small... It came in less time than stated and the beans are simply delicious!!!

We just received the chocolate coated cherries I ordered for my wife for Valentine's Day and we were very disappointed with the product.  The coating was very light and the cherries were dry inside, tasting stale.  It certainly was not up to the standards we expected from Ghirardelli.

Okay.  I admit it. I was a little leary when I discovered Aspen had an egg nog mix.  I love their cider, but egg nog is another thing entirely.  Guess what?  It was great!  I mixed it with Lactaid and it tasted wonderful.  I can also vouch for combining the egg nog mix, milk, vanilla ice cream, and ice in a blender to make a smoothie/shake.

This was so great!  I am lactose intolerant and cannot have regular eggnog, and this is great with Lactaid!!  I use it to make Chai eggnog lattes!  Very happy with this product.  Only problem, I wish it came in a bigger size!  The carton is kinda small and I used it all up in about a month having 2 or 3 eggnogs a week.  Still really like it!

Summary: Closest thing to eggnog PDQ there is
Text:
Since the real PDQ crystals have gone the way of the dodo, other than making real eggnog this is about the only thing I've found that makes it easy and quick.

I bought a 9 pack and have gone through only one of the cartons so far, but with a sprinkle of nutmeg and a little more vanilla, this is by far the best way to have a glass of milk!

I love the holidays because I can buy eggnog at the store and stock up on the real deal. This gets me through the rest of the year.

I ordered one carton, and the company sent me three.  I didn't want 3 cartons!  If you try to return them, they will make you pay the shipping for the items you didn't order!! Moreover, the stuff is terrible because it doesn't stay mixed in the milk.  It separates into a gross layer on top.  What a waste of money!!
The tea made with the pod is too strong for my taste, but we share the first cup and dilute with hot water.  I can make at least 2 more cups with the pod that are perfect.

In reality, each bottle is worth two drinks or more. Here's how to get the most bang for your buck. After you spend $16.00 to $25.00 for the four-pack, buy a 1-liter of either (or both) Sprite and/or club soda for a couple of dollars.

If you have a sweet tooth, do a 50/50 mix of Tru Blood with Sprite. If you prefer to dull the sweetness, then do the same but with club soda. Be creative and mix to your taste.

Remember, this beverage has a slight fizz to it (carbonation), so you'll need a fizzy mixer to help it maintain its integrity.

You might also want to keep you first empty bottle so that you can poor half of the subsequent bottle into the first bottle and store your mixes.

Also tastes great with freshly-oxygenated arterial blood at 98.6F. (Just kidding.)

Hope this helps.

Jet

Summary: Despite the cost, it's worth it
Text:
I really enjoy this drink and have just bought my third pack. First of, consider that you are actually buying heavy glass, solid prop replicas. The drink inside doesn't matter so much. The bottle is most important. It looks just like the show. It's very large and substantial in your hand. Also the glass is quite thick and heavy. But what's disappointing is that it has a paper label. I really wish it was something more long lasting. However, if you're careful you can wash out the inside and mouth of the bottle without ruining the paper and reuse these. There's something just really enjoyable and rewarding about holding this heavy bottle that feels like you're drinking something really from the show.

As for the drink itself, I actually don't find it sweet tasting. I think it tastes a lot like Orange Crush, but a little bit less fizzy and more complex. I wish it was more carbonated. At first I didn't care much for the taste, but the more I drink, the more and more I like it.

To get your money's worth, though, just wash them out gently and refill with some Orange Crush or Sprite and a few drops of red food coloring if you want.
This is a very good drink. Its a little tart and lightly carbonated. The bottles are very detailed and have amazing labels. For any True Blood fan, this is a must have.

The product was everything i expected though I did expect the drink to be better tasting. I guess the person drinking just has to have required taste for the flavor. but shipping was great, it came on time and packed how it was described. it is a great gift for those True Blood fans out there.

Summary: Quality Flavorful, Versatile Tea without the Caffeine.
Text:
My search for a good all-purpose decaffeinated tea ended with Twinings English Breakfast Decaf. Twinings English Breakfast is a blend of Ceylon, Kenyan, and Indian teas with a crisp, full-bodied flavor that isn't heavy or bitter. It's a great tea for any time of the day and with any accompaniment, on its own, or with sugar or cream.

Twinings employs the carbon dioxide method of decaffeination for their decaf teas. The tea is exposed to compressed carbon dioxide, which acts as a solvent, extracting the caffeine while leaving larger molecules unaffected. The process preserves more flavor and removes more caffeine than water process decaffeination. 97% of caffeine must be eliminated for a beverage to be called "decaffeinated", which would leave only a few milligrams of caffeine per cup of tea, regardless of the method.

For a departure from plain tea, these are my favorite recipes:

*Homemade Mint Tea*
This is wonderful consumed hot and incomparable served over ice in the summer: Bring about 3 quarts of water, 2 English Breakfast Decaffeinated tea bags (remove the string), 1/4 cup of sugar, and a handful of sliced fresh mint leaves to a boil in a saucepan. Simmer for 10 minutes. Let cool, then strain. It will keep a few days in the refrigerator.

*Lemongrass Tea*
This has a smooth, mellow lemon flavor without the acidity of lemon tea: Bring about 3 quarts water, 2 English Breakfast Decaffeinated tea bags (remove the string), 1/3 cup powdered sugar cane juice (Sucanat, Florida Crystals, or substitute sugar), and half a stalk of lemongrass, thickly sliced, to a boil in a saucepan. Simmer for 10 minutes. Let cool, then strain. Serve chilled or over ice.

Summary: Product has slid downhill. Inconsistent in quality.
Text:
I've purchased about 5 cans per month of this for about 14 months. At first, this was a wonderful product.

Later, I started finding the bad can occasionally - where the taste was akin to either the product having a metallic reaction with the can, or the product tasting like it had gone bad. But it didn't happen often enough to make me quit buying it.

In the last few months, I've purchased more bad cans than good ones. I've written to their company, and called, numerous times. They don't seem too interested in my findings, sadly.

Just now, I read another reviewer's comments stating that Thai Kitchen was bought out about a year ago. That seems to coincide with when my dis-satisfaction with the product began. Not only is the taste often bad; but formerly there would be a nice thick lump of cream at the top of the can, and a bunch of thin watery milk at the bottom - as one would want. Now, however, the product is as thin as coffee creamer all the way through. It never thickens upon refrigeration, either. Clearly, there is NOT as much fat in the product as formerly. So disappointing!

I wanted a product without sodium metabisulfate - which is a huge allergy trigger. The other recommended brands like Chao Koh have the sodium metabisulfate. Thai Kitchen does add guar gum, but I can live with that. If only they could keep their quality consistently good!

I'm testing A Taste of Thai presently, which is more coconutty tasting, but is very thin and I'm not sure if I like the taste yet (there is an extra fruitiness that I can't quite identify and it is a little overpowering.)

It shouldn't be this hard to get a good prepared coconut milk!

I don't know why some people don't like this brand of coconut milk.  We like it.  While it is not organic, we wish it were, and it does have guar gum (which is a food derived, natural ingredient), it DOES NOT have chemicals/preservatives, which are bad for you.  It is thick and creamy, when slightly warmed, has a medium strength coconut flavor and tastes better than the brands with added preservatives.  (We've tried a lot of them!)  The ingredients are coconut milk, water, guar gum---that's it!  I DO wish it said what percentage of coconut milk was in the can, some brands do, but other than that, we are happy with this brand.  It has an expiration date printed on the bottom (we like that), some brands don't.  The price is more than the brands with preservatives, which I don't understand, I wish it were lower, but if we want food with no preservatives/added chemicals, I guess this is what our option is.  Hopefully, the price will come down.  What we don't like is the shipping--4 out of 12 cans in the case were severely or moderately dented, which means we had to use them soon or immediately (not happy at all about that).  We will order this brand again!

I never thought there was any difference between brands when it came for coconut milk, so I would always go for the cheapest option; usually Goya. It wasn't until the grocery store was out of Goya one day and I had no other option but to try Thai Kitchen did my misconception become startlingly clear. This coconut milk so perfectly smooth and creamy, whereas cheaper brands tend to be a bit lumpier.  Additionally, by some miracle, it has none of the harsh aftertaste that plagues so many coconut products. It's just pure coconut essence, subtly but naturally sweet.  Now it's the only kind I'll buy! It's a bit of a splurge in comparison to budget or store brands, but it's entirely worth it. It will enhance your cooking like nothing else!

I use this mainly when I am using charcoal for grilling steaks. My normal cooking method for charcoal is either Artisan Salt Co. Himalayan Pink Salt-coarse and pepper, or I grab the jar of Montreal seasoning. Either one is a great choice.

If I am using the propane grill, I marinate the steaks first to give them extra flavor that they do not receive with the tasteless propane. Sometimes I sprinkle the Montreal seasoning on the marinated steaks when I put them on the grill to give an extra layer of flavor.

The seasoning can be pretty strong if you coat the steaks with a heavy blanket of seasoning, but it is just right if you give it a much lighter coat. Season to taste.
