Summary: Great concept - but low quality - will jam permanently
Text: I wish another company would make the same product with better quality. Although the concept is spot on, there's a problem with the rubber o-ring inside the pump - it will slide out of place and jam up the pump so that it becomes unusable. My first one lasted about 9 months before that happened, so I was willing to try again. The second one, however, lasted less than a month before the o-ring slipped and the pump jammed. There is no way to open it up to fix it. So until they fix this problem, this product is hit or miss. Caveat emptor!

We ordered this to replace the same wine saver we received as a gift.  It works very well, preserving the wine's flavor and extending its shelf life.  We received the saver set in good working order and very promptly.  I would do business with this company again!

I've been using the Vacu Vin for probably about as long as they've been making them, and still had a good one with plenty of stoppers before I bought this "Concerto" model.  I bought it because of the "click" the user is supposed to hear when the right amount of air has been pumped out of the wine bottle, for the obvious reason that I didn't want to keep pumping when there was no need to. The problem is that after using this model multiple times, I have yet to hear it click, so I might as well have just stayed with the older device I had.  Since this thing is apparently clicking away for most reviewers, my case is probably just an isolated one (or maybe in my advanced years I'm just not robust enough to pump to the click--though I'm skeptical that that's the problem).

We've owned several wine bottle resealers, but this is by far the best design.  This is our second Vacu Vin, and both are working like new.  The other brands we tried just didn't seal well.  This is also the only company that designed a clicking sound in the pump to let you know you've gotten all the air out of the bottle.  We keep the wine resealed for weeks and I can not tell the difference in the taste of the red wines kept at room temperature.  I have not tried to reseal a bottle of white wine that should be kept chilled so I don't know if this would seal as well so I couldn't comment on the results.  But, for my red wines this has been great.  I've been very disappointed in other more popular wine sealing products on the market.  The others I've tried have lost their vacum effect over time, and there was no way to know if you got all the air out of the bottle.

If you drink wine pretty much daily but are not inclined to finish a bottle at each and every sitting, then Vacu Vin is the tool for you. Better than just corking, more cost-effective than a gas system, Vacu Vin allows one to, say, enjoy a Sangiovese with your pasta on Wednesday and return to it to with pizza on Saturday -- or even next Wednesday's pasta, and enjoy the wine again sans serious degradation due to oxygen exposure.

Some sources, like Snooth feel the vacuum pulls aromatics from the wine but my experience has been a very positive one and I recommend the Vacu Vin for the tool collection of any wine enthusiast.

I honestly don't know how we got by without this in the past. It used to be we would have to drink a bottle of wine in a few days or else it would go stale. Now we can have several different bottles of wine open at the same time for weeks and still enjoy them when we want.

Very simple to use and we've never had an issue with the top not sealing.

Have bought 3 more as gifts for family.
No reason to complain with this puppy. It does its job flawlessly and wine tastes fresh every time. Buy this and don't think twice about it.

I tilled the hill on my backyard and I have some ground cover plants on it now.  I was really worried that it would rain hard before the ground cover could prevent soil erosion.  I decided to spray this on to my plants to speed up the growing process.  It worked.  Not only did it work on the ground cover but the flowers in the flower bed also started to bloom and it looks great.  I use it once a week to keep it growing faster.  Excellent product.

The one cat loves this and would probably eat the whole 1 oz carton at a time,  if I would let it.  I have already purchased another 1 oz.  Interestly, the other cat won't even sniff it, but the dog likes it if there is any left over in the cats dish, which there never is, but he licks the bowl and would like more!

Summary: Three of four cats LOVE it
Text:
I love products that are simple and it doesn't get any more simple than freeze-dried salmon. That's it. This is chunks of fish you can use for treats for your cat or dog. No gluten or any other ingredient you cannot pronounce.

The chunks are small enough for small cats and dogs, but I'm told dogs really do like them.

Three out of four of our cats enjoy the treats and I think they're a lot healthier than others on the market.

Rebecca Kyle, May 2012

I have used this product in the past with great results. Just be sure you mix it into the dry ingredients and not the water.  I don't usually have it in the frig and it's nice to be able to make something calling for buttermilk without having to go to the store.  I haven't had a problem in the past with it getting hard.  I highly recommend it.

I have been using this product mostly in bread and pancakes for a while and it works well. I like that the shelf life is much longer than what is stated on the package. Also, it is convenient to add the powder to the flour and then I add more or less water to the batter depending on desired thickness. Another nice thing about using buttermilk in pancakes, rather than milk, is that I can then use just baking soda rather than baking powder (due to the acidity in the buttermilk). Oh, and my shipment was delivered without incident.

I love keeping this on hand at all times because I never seem to get through a half gallon of buttermilk before it goes bad, but I like to have it for use in biscuits, breads, and to brine chicken before frying. This stuff is very economical and super convenient. It does require refrigeration once opened, but that's no big deal to me. I mix up batches of biscuit mix and pancake mix in advance, then just add the liquid ingredients when I need it. I can store large quantities in the freezer and whip up buttermilk pancakes for breakfast in a flash. Love it. This is a pantry staple for me.

Summary: Never have to run out to the store just to get buttermilk again!
Text: After having to modify yet another recipe because I didn't have buttermilk on hand I decided to give this a try.  Since that time I have ordered it several times from Amazon who consistently has it for the best price.  I mix the powder with my dry ingredients and then combine it with the wet for less lumps. I love this product and use it weekly in my waffle recipe. It does have a good taste. My last order arrived with no issues or defects in packaging.

I love to bake. Breads, biscuits, cakes, etc. I keep this on hand because it's convenient. I don't have to buy buttermilk specifically for something, I know I have it on hand for spur of the moment baking.
This works great in quick breads, cakes and yeast breads. It adds a nice flavor to yeast breads, and it's acidic enough that in cakes and quick breads you get a lot of lift using it with baking powder or baking soda. It also works very well in pancakes.
I haven't yet tried it to culture cream to make creme fraiche with.

Summary: Great tool for the home cook
Text:
Repeatedly, I buy buttermilk for a recipe only to throw it out after having used it just once. I saw the powdered buttermilk used on "America's Test Kitchen" during the preparation of pancake batter. Since one of my favorite recipes for dumplings calls for buttermilk, I thought the powdered would be a good substitute. When it arrived, I feared I would never be able to use all three containers before I or they expired. However, the dumplings proved so superior that I have used the powdered buttermilk in many other preparations. The biscuit recipe on the container is superb. They expand so beautifully and are so delicious as to promote bitter fighting over who gets how many.
My pancakes are just as tasty as the biscuits. I now think I will have to order more of Saco powdered buttermilk rather than waste any at all.
You will not be disappointed.
I love the convience of this buttermilk powder. I use it in all my baking and with wonderful results!  Much more economical than real buttermilk and stores a whole lot longer.
One of the three containers was open slightly when it arrived.  Haven't tried it yet though.
First off, the volume is actually cheaper than buying at a liquor store.  The biggest plus for me was that I now have 6 bottles to use for mixers at my home bar, so that is huge

Being in the restaurant industry I have had my share of quality pasta sauces.  Fortunately in this case I was able to receive this one in a jar and take it home with me.  I was very impressed.  It has a restaurant quality taste and is definitely one of the better bottled sauces I have tasted. The fresh ingredients make a difference, no puree.  Great taste, you owe it to yourself to give it a shot.

I bought this cereal thinking I was buying an amazing product for my child...gotta try and be that supermom ya know :). I took it into her pediatrition to make sure that there was nothing too crazy in this cereal and she said basically it is just playing up all of the things that these cereals normally have in them. She said it may have a little bit different of percentages when comparing it to say a Gerber cereal but its practically the same thing. Now I personally love that this is organic and the Happy Bellies brand is one that I really like for my daughter. She doesnt however seem to like the taste of this cereal unless mixed with applesauce and/or added to a large quantity of formula or breastmilk. Overall I think this product is average for an organic cereal, however the price point is reasonable enough. I would say you dont need to go out of your way to purchase this but if your in the market for a higher end brand of cereal for your little one, you could give this a try.

I tried this cereal when my son was discovered to be allergic to peanuts.  Many cereal manufacturers are not labeling peanut allergens, nor will they answer questions about them when you call.  Post would not help at all.  Then I learned of Enjoy Life and their Perky's cereals.  I really liked this one.  It has a slightly nutty flavor, stays crunchy in milk and when mixed in with yogurt.  It is dense not lite at all.  It has a good level of fiber and the flax makes it have good fats too!  Plus, no unhealthy sugars.  My kids like the flavor, but have problems with the size since they are little tiny balls.  This cereal is great when making treats though.  It works well with crispie type treats and cookies.  I am next going to try it as a pie crust for the pumpkin pie this season.  Amazon has a pretty good deal on the price as well.  It is $4 per box at my local market at least.  I'm saving about a $1 per box ordering here.  I will buy again!

I went gluten free about 6 months ago and initially it was a struggle to figure out what to eat in the mornings.  I missed the crunch and texture of cereals and toast.  I first found Perky's Crunchy Flax at a major health food grocer, but it was priced over a dollar higher per box.  I was thrilled to find the bulk deal on Amazon as the boxes aren't very large and between my husband and I, we tend to go through at least 3 boxes a week.  This cereal is filling and delicious--I simply eat it with vanilla almond milk and it's perfect.  My husband likes to add a little honey to sweeten, but I don't feel it's necessary.  The cereal doesn't get soggy quickly at all, by the way.  It's proven a healthy and easy breakfast option and become a daily staple.

Summary: My wife loves this, must have gluten free food, tastes good, too
Text: I even eat some from time to time.  Best price I've found.  Of course it is a bit pricier than other cereals with gluten.

I don't eat this as a cereal. I really like it on salad as a substitute for croutons. My non-gluten sensitive friends and relatives were surprised by how much they liked it on their salads. I mix it with yogurt and it adds a crunchy texture and now my toddler granddaughter wants it in her yogurt.

What I don't like is that I need to buy twelve boxes at a time. That's too much.

I love coconut oil for it's high heat tolerance and for putting a great color on veggies but I don't always want the hefty coconut flavor. This is the perfect solution. Great product I'll be buying again for sure.

Summary: The healthier alternative to soda and energy drinks.
Text: Like most people I stumbled upon Nero at the gas station, looking for a healthier alternative to soda and energy drinks to give me a boost. That was many months ago, now I get two cases of this stuff delivered a month!  I've tried about five of Nero's flavors of drinks and Sonic is easily my favorite, it's got a tangy citrus taste (kinda grapefruit like) that is not only delicious but also quite healthy as it's packed with a lot of great vitamins and minerals that give you a healthy boost of energy, not a buzz.  I wouldn't go as far to say it really helps to stimulate the brain as it advertises, but it definitely does a better job at boosting energy and making you fell good than energy drinks and soda does.  I've also found myself losing a little weight, as I'd rather drink one of these than a soda and I seem to not be as hungry if I sip on this throughout the day, and at only 35 calories with minimal sugar it's the perfect drink alternative.  Now everyone complains about the price, but for me you can't really put a price on health.  Nero Sonic gives me the energy I need throughout the day, it's healthy, it's helped ween me off drinking a lot of soda, and in my opinon it tastes great.  Now I understand taste is subjective but if you can stomach the taste of energy drinks this is sweet nectar compared to most of those.  Sure you could just drink water and that might be even better for you, but water is boring and in my stressful daily life I need something with a little kick that I look forward to everyday, thankfully it's healthier than most sugary alternatives, and when I add up want I spent on sodas or energy drinks it's really not anymore costly.
My newest health drink discovery yet!  No similar product on the market comes near to this line of drinks....exceptionally good flavors, even the grandkids love them! NO HYPE!
This arrived very quickly and in great shape.  The variety pack gave us a nice coffee tasting test. We were surprised at how good the house blend and the breakfast blend were.
I have been looking for real Hungarian kolbasz (sausage) or salami but could find only imitations. This one is very good and I would buy it again and recommend it to those who like spicy sausages.

Summary: The right price for an excellent product
Text: This is excellent tea and this vendor is maintaining the Eden Price, do not buy direct from Amazon they have it priced at double this cost.  ron

I actually ordered from this company's website because of time constraints and I had a special order request. We tasted marzipan fruits from five different sources including a real Danish bakery and although this marzipan was on the sweeter side we liked it the best. Not only was it tasty but this company gets 5 stars for customer service. They went above and beyond for me.

My daughter wanted to have marzipan on her wedding cake, but she didn't want the bright red strawberries or the green limes so I called the company and they were happy to make substitutions in the large assorted order I placed. Unfortunately my order was shipped before the substitutions got made so Bergen Marzipan shipped me a corrected order at their expense during the busy time right before Christmas. At a time of high stress this company went above and beyond what you would expect (but secretly hope for) in terms of customer service.

The wedding guests and bride loved the marzipan on the cake. We even put just the marzipan out on the dessert table and there was little left at the end of the reception.

Be aware that marzipan gets harder with age and paper sticking to the bottom of the fruit pieces can be due to a variety of factors the manufacturer can't control such as during the shipping process

This paprika is definitely as good as I purchased while in Hungary.  It is essential in much of my cooking, so I really appreciate finding this.  I think the price is about right, but the vendor obviously wanted to charge more, so the shipping price is much more than you would expect.

Summary: not better than folgers or hill bros.
Text: I had high expectations for yuban but was surprised to discover a coffee that is really no better than folgers or hill bros.  It's just a plain jane coffee that i feel is way over priced and if anything has an aftertaste that I can only describe as a stale burnt sour linger......if that makes sense.  I will not purchase again and would consider a much better coffee like Dallamyr if you want to experiment.

I purchased this 20lb order of pasta to share with my family because we cannot seem to find these in the stores around us any more. Sadly, the imported pasta commonly has weevils which I know you cannot avoid.
I understood that this product could not be returned but it was a real shame paying $30 for this and only getting a few bags out of it because the rest had those bugs.

A credit of some kind would be greatly appreciated. :) Thanks

We love the Fountain Mist flavor and it is our regular "caffiene" soda we keep on hand.  Every person we've offered it to has said it tastes very close to name brand Mountain Dew (some say more like diet) and better than most store brands.  We have Faygo brand here in Michigan and most say it's very close to their Mountain Dew knock off.

Smooth and different than a peanut butter, but spreads on with a similiar texture.
Made from the same stuff as the Biscoff biscuits, but this is my preferred route to heaven!!

We have ordered extra boxes of this pasta because we found that even the adults enjoyed eating it. The letters hold their form perfectly and taste great. Our two year old enjoys identifying the letters as she eats. We originally picked it up at Whole Foods but are happy to find it on Amazon with subscribe and save.

I have tried many of the Gluten Free mixes and flours and Pamela's if by FAR the best of the 'bunch.'  If you find a better product, I'd really like to hear about it.  For now, I've decided that Pamela's is the best I can do - almost as good as wheat flour products.  lrc

Summary: A must have for gluten-free diets!
Text: I love this product!  For most of my baking needs, I have been able to effortlessly substitute this product for wheat flour to create wonderful baked goods!  I've made everything from the pancake, crepe, and muffin recipes as listed on the package to my own cinnamon rolls, donuts and coffee cakes.  Truly a wonderful baking mix!
Now, I never thought I would take the time to write a comment for pancake mix, but I am telling you, I just made some this morning and the pancake tastes GREAT!

Summary: The Best Gluten Free Baking Product out there!
Text: A year ago my daughter was diagnosed with Celiac's disease.  I have tried everything there is out there to give her the closest thing there is to "normal" food.  Pamels'a baking mix by far is the BEST!  My husbands Mom also has celiac's disease and agree's this is a great product, she came to visit for Christmas and we made pancakes out of it while she was here and she went home and bought some right away.  My son who is the pickest eater ever and is not allergic to Gluten LOVES the pancakes and waffles from the mix he eates more that my daughter who is allergic to gluten.  I recomend this product to anyone who is allergic to gluten, it lets you enjoy the taste of breads again without cheating.
My husband has celiac disease and this is a product that he can use.  Pancakes are the best and he enjoys them very much,
The best pancake mix ever made! We've been buying it for years, and don't use any other brands. It is also gluten free.

I had a friend recommend this product to me several years ago. She is gluten intolerant & she raved about it since she could use it to make waffles, pancakes, cookies, etc. Although I'm not gluten intolerant I love to use product because it makes cooking much simpler with its ingredients. Cookies come out so soft its unbelievable & they dont get hard after a few days. I'll continue to use this product for a long time to come.

Yum. Cooks up like a thin French pancake (but a bit thicker than a crepe). If you want fat and fluffy then you want the gluten free Bisquick Mix which lacks seasoning and costs alot more. If you are cooking Pamela's just for yourself, you can save half of the mixed batch and refrigerate for a day or two...they cook up exactly the same. Or you can go ahead and cook them all at once, refrigerate the unused, and reheat.I find all of Pamela's products to be excellent substitutes for what I used to be able to eat!

This mix is totally awesome.  We look forward to pancakes made from this mix every weekend.  We just can't get enough of them.  It's better than any other pancake mix we have ever tried and it so versatile.  You can use the mix for so many other great recipes.  Pamela's products are the only brand of gluten free in our household.  The other brands just don't cut it!

Bought it as a Christmas gift but they are really mini and much smaller than I would have expected for the price.  I would describe them more as a sample rather than a mini assortment.  Shipping is so expensive that is doesn't pay to return them.

Summary: Hot and Sour Noodle Bowl is Awesome if. . .
Text: I discovered this soup a couple of months ago at Giant Eagle, but thought it was too expensive ($4.29).  After searching other grocery stores to no avail, I was pleasantly surprised to find it on Amazon. . .  I LOVE this soup--but do not like it without adding soy sauce.  After it's cooked, stir in soy sauce to taste and you won't be disappointed!

Summary: The Best Instant Noodle Meals You Can Buy!
Text:
Why? Because the noodles come SOFT, sealed in plastic! If you are tired of noodles that "crunch" or that have to be reconstituted out of the original cardboard, you are in for a treat! Available in something like a dozen different varieties, try them all and then subscribe to your favorites in order to get the lowest price.

Note: The seasoning comes in a sealed pouch so if you tend to prefer yours less salty or less strong in taste, don't use it all to start. You can always add more in later.

Note: Since the bowl is made partially from cornstarch, it will biodegrade completely so toss it in the trash when you're done without feeling guilty. (For this reason you should NOT attempt to reuse this bowl like you may have done with other brand instant noodle meals that came in plastic bowls.)

Note: Of them all this is my favorite flavor, great tasting, medium hot, best hot and sour soup I've ever had from instant!

I wasn't overly happy with the flavor of these, but brought them to work in case someone else would like to try them.  They weren't overly impressed either.  BUT then I found out the ones I purchased in December carry expiration dates of February of this same year.  I can't find a way to complain to Amazon yet, but I will! They might have tasted better if they were fresh.
Annie's soups are wonderful.  The taste is just great and they are also low in calories.  The packaging of the soups is also outstanding.
THIS IS BY FAR THE BEST TASTING, MOST FLAVORFUL GREEN TEA I HAVE EVER TASTED... IT IS A REAL TREAT AND I DRINK IT EVERYDAY..I AM BUYING ANOTHER TIN TODAY... CAN'T DO WITHOUT.

These have been my favorite snack bar for years!  They are the perfect mid-day snack when my energy starts to fade at work - sweet but not cloying and the perfect balance of crunchiness and chewiness.  Love all the new flavors but my favorites are still any of the ones with cherries in them.  (And the chai bars - so perfect with a good cup of tea in the afternoon.)  They are also my go-to early-morning-flight breakfast - always throw one in my purse before I head out to the airport at dawn.  I love the sesame-seedy texture - makes me more inclined to nibble, which makes them last longer.  So yummy!
This is a nice white tea.  The berry flavor is very strong!  I actually prefer Rishi's Peach White Tea (not as tangy), but this is good for a change.

I love boiled peanuts and have tried a few brands but this one is by far the worst.  Most of the peanuts were soggy or empty.  Also, very small.  I wont order these again.  If on Amazon, I recommend these: http://www.amazon.com/Margaret-Holmes-Green-Boiled-Peanuts/dp/B001YXO0EO/ref=sr_1_1?ie=UTF8&qid=1325488826&sr=8-1
rich flavor, hard to go back to drinking anything else. This is for all those real tea lovers out there

For some reason sunflower oil has become hard to find. I am glad that it was available here. I ordered on-line through another seller and had to cancel after almost two months. "Out of stock" was the reason. Supermarkets in my area have stopped selling sunflower oil.

Coffee Bean Direct coffees are better than starbucks!  I buy the ground and the whole beans of the dark house blend and everyone seems to like it.  It is a great cup of coffee and the price is great.  If you are a coffee lover, it is for you!

I bought this coffee to add variety to my morning coffees.  I was not impressed.  It is not a bad coffee but it is not a great coffee by any means.  I regularly buy the regular French Roast by Coffee Bean Direct which for me is consistently the best tasting. They sell this Dark House Blend more expensive than the French Roast which makes no sense to me especially now after tasting it.  I will not buy this Dark House Blend coffee again.

I am a fan of dark roast beans and have been having trouble finding one that is dark enough to stand up to cream and yet not have a burned or bitter flavor. I finally found it. This is really fabulous coffee!! And the price is good enough that I save a lot of money by brewing my own in the morning and filling a travel mug for the commute.

We really wanted to love this coffee, but really only found it OK. It has been a long time since we had anything like Folgers. I'm sure this is better than that but does not beat even COSTCO in our opinion.
Beautifully wrapped, great price and looks great too.  Because it's Kosher it's the perfect gift to give (in my case at Christmas) as you never know eating preferences of guests invited over.

El Pato Jalapeño Salsa is a great tasting, versatile tomato product.  The sauce can be used straight out of the can for chip-dipping salsa, or it could be used in a variety of recipes.  For example, it could make a great, spicy sauce for baked chicken.  I've used it in soups and also mixed it with sour cream and served it with tortilla chips.
the product was great but the delivery was terrible.  Fed ex took my order and dropped it at a strangers house down the road from me and she didn't find me for a week after she got it.

Have tasted some good soda, but none as good as this. I was shocked at the taste of this. It's cane sugar, people! Its amazing! The taste of the ginger fully surrounds the smoothness of this soda. A must buy for anyone looking for an affordable soda with an excellent taste!

I was really hoping that this had that "fresh" ginger bite. It tastes like lemon/lime soda with ginger powder added. Maybe I'm more accustomed to the strong taste of fresh ginger in food and drinks. I tried Q-Ginger, 8-Ounce Glass Bottles (Pack of 24) and loved it. However it was a bit pricey. Guess I'll keep looking.

The flavor of this ginger ale isn't too strong or medicinal (something like baby asprin meets ginger beer)...rendering it perfect for making cocktails. The kids like to drink it straight too. Its also amazing in lemonade over ice on a hot day. Love that amazon delivers this. I'll be ordering more.
GREAT TASTING PRODUCT FOR COOKING OR JUST TO SIP ON A GREAT BROTH WHEN NOT FEELING WELL.  COMES INDIVIDUALLY BUBBLE WRAPPED.  VERY NICE.

I drive a school bus and like to get something for all 120 of my "little darlins" at Christmas...These suckers have been around since I was a child and I loved them! They are the same great suckers and havent' been cheapend through the years. I put cute little sucker covers I purchased at "oriental trading" They fit great look adorable and the kids love them. It's a cute way to say I thought about you w/out spending to much money! I spend less then a dollar a present! I get to eat the left overs!
i am addicted to this gum at work. i don't like coffee but i always need something to wake me up. i chew a pack a day, it's getting scary!
I don't know how I ever lived without Jolt Gum!! The advertising speaks for itself, and the product proves it beyond a reasonable doubt!!  I'm ordering more!!

My husband and I have been using Morton Salt Substitute for years.  I've tried those "Lite" salts but they just didn't taste like salt.  Now my adult sons use only Morton Salt Substitute in their homes.  I've fooled people who say, "they would never use any type of substitute because they can tell the difference".  Well, they couldn't!! If I can't find it in a grocery store or supermarket, I order it online because it's the only thing that tastes like salt.
This mustard is so delectable that you could, no joke, eat it with a spoon.  This is the best mustard ever and I hope there will always be a supply of it.

We crack the peppermint pig after dinner on Christmas Day. We used to get a larger pig but always had pieces left over. Eventually they got eaten but the smaller pig works better for us. There were 15 people sharing it this year. It is a very intense peppermint flavor and people just take a taste. In the past we have bought the fancy bag and the little hammer to go with it, but that is all unnecessary. We crack it with the back of a heavy kitchen spoon in a plastic bowl.

Summary: Somewhat Larger and Firmer, but Excellent Taste.
Text:
I've been on a campaign to add more fish to my diet and a lot of it has been by increasing my uptake of canned fish such as tuna, salmon and sardines. As such, I found a wrapped five-pack of Season Sardines at my local Costco store and picked it up. They're a good sardine and I've been eating them with seasoned crackers at lunchtime. Their somewhat larger than normal for me and they have a texture that is somewhat firm. The taste is excellent and they go down easily. My cat loves to lick the leftover crumbs on the plate. I don't care for Season Sardines as much as for the last can of Crown Prince bristling sardines, but the difference is slight. I would definitely buy this brand again.

Gary Peterson

Picked these up at my local CostCo. Good deal and great tasting, healthy sardines.

Does anybody know how much olive oil the fish are canned in? Tablespoon? Two? ??? Can't find any information that tells how much actual olive oil is in the can. Want to use that information for planning.

Hands down, best sardines ever! Not fishy in the least, in fact, tuna is fishier than these. they sold out at one store i went to and my husband, poor guy, picked up another brand so i could have some anyhow, and i couldn't even finish the other brand. they were in a red packaging, cant remember the names, but they were full bodies minus the heads! Gross!  I have friends who swore they would never eat sardines loving Season's brand. I squeeze a little lemon on them and just eat them right out of the can as a snack. tons of protein, good fats, low carb, they are quite fabulous.

Summary: Love the bars; especially chocolate; DIDN'T GET CHOCOLATE + ???
Text: I had just purchased a 96 bar package of the regular NV Crunchy Oats Bars at Sam's Club--which no longer carries chocolate in my city.  Smaller packages at my grocery store disappear quickly. There are seldom any left. I DID NOT GET WHAT I ORDERED!  But since I would eventually eat them because I alternate regular and chocolate, I kept them.  Tried to order the 96 bar size of chocolate today and there is only 1 seller listed and the price is TWICE the stated regular price!  Is everyone asleep?  Also, should the manufacturers hear this, you have created alternatives that are much less good for my health and clearly are substituting those fatty/sweet bars for the ones that are healthiest!

Summary: Excellent quality food at a reasonable price
Text: This food is the best I have found overall. It has a great balance of veggies, greens, vitamins, and of course protein while being grown with out hormones or chemicals used. There are other foods out there which I found to be more expensive that have a nice balance, but they are filled with chemicals and hormones: if they are causing cancer for humans, what would they do to our pets? I can find it at a local pet store that is part of a national chain with the word "smart" in it. The cost is lower than most of the other healthy brands, and of all the healthy cat foods out there, this is the only one my cat will not leave a crumb of! Another good result of this food is "optimal poopers". LOL I don't have to give him wet food to keep him regular. This fact alone shows how good for his digestion it is. It is great if you have cats with sensitive stumachs or food allergies also. I can't say enough good about the food. Try it! Your cat(s) will love you for it!

Oh my goodness, this vanilla is incredible! I use it as the "secret ingredient" for my chocolate chip cookies because it makes them come out so much better than other vanillas I've tried.

It just makes everything taste extra delicious, really.

(For most spices and flavors I'm not very fancy, but you won't see me go near imitation vanilla. It just makes too big of a difference.)

I highly recommend this to anyone who bakes desserts. It really is extraordinary.

How can you review soap? OK, it isn't soap, it is a moisturizing bar. But still, it is Dove, it rocks (especially in the dry winter months). But the real kicker for me is buying in quantity. We never run out. I have it in our Subscribe and Save which garners you another 15% off and always free shipping. Amazon has something going on with that Subscribe and Save!

Dove has always been a product my whole family uses from our youngest to oldest.  All of my boys(husband included)have extremely dry skin and dove seems to work the best.  This was a good price when you sign up for subscribe and save.

I am very pleased with my purchase of the Dove Beauty Bar soap.  I was not sure if it was up to the task of keeping my skin clean.  I was pleasantly surprised when the complaints about my BO stopped.  It was embarrassing when my my dog would run away whimpering when I attempted to pet him.  The change in his behavior has made the change to the Dove soap worth it.  People have recently stopped me on the street inquiring about the type of soap I use, I proudly proclaim Dove.  Hopefully my praises will generate more business for this wonderful soap company.  I feel that this little white bar of soap will change my life.  Its that good!

This Fig Balsamic Vinegar is wonderful.  I mix it with olive oil, fresh grated garlic, fresh rosemary, fresh oregano and fresh basil.  I let it sit for 24 hours to let all the flavors mix.  So good on a salad.  Will be ordering more.

I followed the directions on the bag: boil 2 cups of lightly salted water, then add 1/2 cup of Teff. It says to cover and let it simmer for 15-20 minutes or until all the water is absorbed. The first time I made it, the Teff was all over the inside of the pot and cover. So it needs to be on a very low simmer. I find that it works best to cook it like they say but stir it around 2-3 times during the first 15 minutes.

UPDATE: By the way, if you cook it the entire time with the cover on like the directions say, the water won't evaporate. I remove the cover about half-way through. I set the kitchen timer for 5 minute intervals and simmer the Teff, then come back and stir it. After 10 minutes, I leave the cover off, otherwise the water won't evaporate and it will be too watery.

If you don't use a low simmer, it will stick to the sides of the pot so you have to stir it to make sure it doesn't stick to the bottom.

It takes around 17-18 minutes, it has the consistency of a bit loose Cream of Rice or oatmeal in terms of how much water stays in. I turn off the heat and keep stirring until it stops bubbling, then put it in a bowl.

Note: The portion size above and on the instructions yields a huge bowl of the stuff, definitely two big servings. Cut the ingredients in half for one serving. Also, don't over-salt it, it seems to carry the salt taste pretty well.

Although I try to eat healthily, I am a big fan of all kinds of candy, which I try to reserve for an occasional treat. Newman's Own Organics Pomegranate Licorice Twists are a nice compromise--sweet, but not filled with a lot of chemicals. For example, there are eleven ingredients in the Newman's Own Licorice, while Twizzlers has a list of ingredients too long to count.

Newman's Own Licorice is shorter in length than typical licorice, and come in a much smaller package. The ingredients are not totally organic, and corn syrup is the third ingredient (it's the first ingredient in Twizzlers). The Newman's Own Licorice is made in Mexico, which is a drawback for me, I prefer my candy to be made in the US, the quality is usually better.

The best part of Newman's licorice is the flavor, it is a clear, strong pomegranate. It is really refreshing for a candy to taste like the flavor it's supposed to be instead of being just sweet with no specific taste profile. Two or three of these twists are enough for a snack, which I suspect is because the flavor is so good. The back of the package says that strawberry, tangerine, and black Newman's Own Licorice is available, which I will definitely look for and try.

Maybe.

Summary: Eat This, Not That (for old time flavor)

In later years, I tried to substitute those old flavors with a supermarket brand of licorice that (Twi**Elers), in a strawberry flavor. Pure sugar with that. And some kind of "gum" for chewiness.

Let me tell you, as someone old enough to remember real licorice-- these licorice twists, in POMEGRANATE, from Newman's Own Organics, are as chewy, tasty, juicy, and real tasting as candy gets. Takes me right back to the penny candy drugstore.

Now, I know, these days, people want carb counts, calories, sugar, etc. So, here's some of that:

sugars: 10g
carbs: 32g
calories: 5 pieces, 130 calories

Hey, I'm not your doctor. I'm reviewing a candy. And it tastes GOOD. For those with real health issues with sugar, etc., I recommend reading the ingredients (see package) in the grocery store. For anyone else who just wants a nice, great tasting, old fashioned treat, get these, and enjoy yourself!

These licorice twists are very tasty. They are soft and pliable but still chewy and firm. The pomegranate flavor isn't strong, but there is definitely a fruit flavor to them though not too sweet. I like the color of the twists, they look like that deep pink of pomegranates. I really liked that the many of the ingredients are organic. I've been happy with many other Newman's Own Organic products and this was no different. This is a good company that supports good causes, and makes great products. These Licorice Twists were enjoyed by me, my husband, and our six year old. I am interested in trying their other flavors as well. If you find these, give them a try!

Summary: Tasty Candy But A Bit Pricy
Text:
This licorice is very much like Twizzlers or Red Vines in texture, which I like. It is chewy without being too much so and not sticky. The flavor is good. It is distinctive without being overpowering, and no aftertaste.

I normally don't care what my candy is made of or how many calories it has. After all, it is candy. I don't expect any healthy ingredients. However, since Newman's is promoting the organic aspects of the product I decided to comment on them. While the brand is "Newman's Own Organics," only three of the eleven ingredients in the product are organic. The rest are conventional. At least there are no artificial colors or flavors. Calorie-wise, Newman's comes off slightly better at 3.1 calories/gram vs. 3.6 for Twizzlers and Red Vines.

While the foil packaging may keep the candy fresh on the shelf, once opened there is no way to reseal the package. In all fairness, though, neither Red Vines nor Twizzler packages can be resealed after opening.

When comparing 5 oz. packages of all three products here on Amazon, you find Newman's costs over twice as much as Twizzlers and over 2.5 times more than Red Vines. Twizzlers and Red Vines are made in the USA and Newman's are made in Mexico.

For me, licorice is an occasional treat. Therefore, if I am in the market and craving a licorice type candy, I would probably reach for these, price not withstanding. I like the pomegranate flavor, and I think I would give the black licorice flavor a try as well.

Newman's Own Organics Pomegranate Licorice met mixed reviews in our home.

Pomegranate has become the new flavor of choice with many products--especially beverages and snack foods. This is due to the increased emphasis on the important of anti-oxidents, the anti-oxident benefits of pomegranate, and the cosumer's desire for the "next new thing" in exciting fruity flavors.

Newman's Own Organics authentically brings together both the flavor of licorice and pomegranate. The folks in our home that loved pomegranate enjoyed the taste of this treat. The folks less accustomed to this ancient fruit simply felt the licorice was adequate.

Most of the complaints about the licorice had to do with texture. This licorice had a mushy quality, which is disappointing those that like a sturdy chew with their licorice. It is braided, but not tightly braided.

All in all, this was a fun snack for us to have, but not something we will be looking to buy more of.

Summary: Good, but has a different behavior than traditional 3-way mixes..
Text:
I've used this product (a mcpa, dicamba, triclopyr mix) for several years now, and I find it has some pros, and some cons compared with a traditional 2,4-d/mcpp/dicamba mixes (and possibly newer mixes). Loving it or hating it will depend on your weeds.

On the plus side, it has triclopyr, and because of this it does much better against wild violet, creeping charlie, and Oxalis/sorrel than the old-school mixes (which have no affect at all on the first 2).

On the down side, it seems control most of the common weeds that 2,4-d does well against, but it takes a lot longer to kill them, and may require two passes to do it. (ie: dandelion, plantain, clover)

My old house had wild violet problems, and my new house has creeping woodsorrel problems. I love this product because it is effective against those troublesome weeds that so few other products kill.

Of course, we now in 2012 have a whole new set of "plus crabgrass" mixes coming out, based on 2,4-d, dicamba and quinclorac (and one brand adding sulfentrazone to the mix). The quinclorac gives them control of grassy weeds previously untouched by post-emergent sprays, and the sulfentrazone takes that further (nutsedge!). The quinclorac should also be at least somewhat effective against wild violet, but I suspect that the lack of mcpa/mcpp may cause them to have a different set of common weeds they won't work on. Time will tell as these are somewhat newer herbicides and a lot of detailed herbicide guides don't cover them yet..

Moral of the story: No weed killer is perfect and will kill every weed without killing your lawn too. If you have a weed in your yard you can't kill, find out what it is (plenty of picture guides on the web), find out what kills it, and buy a product with the right ingredients.

EC-1118
Saccharomyces bayanus

Origin
The EC-1118 strain was isolated, studied and selected from Champagne fermentations. Due to its competitive factor and ability to ferment equally well over a wide temperature range, the EC-1118 is one of the most widely used yeasts in the world.

Oenological properties and applications
The fermentation characteristics of the EC-1118 -- extremely low production of foam, volatile acid and hydrogen sulfide (H2S) -- make this strain an excellent choice. This strain ferments well over a very wide temperature range, from 10° to 30°C (50° to 86°F) and demonstrates high osmotic and alcohol tolerance. Good flocculation with compact lees and a relatively neutral flavor and aroma contribution are also properties of the EC-1118.

The EC-1118 strain is recommended for all types of wines, including sparkling, and late harvest wines and cider. It may also be used to restart stuck fermentations.

An excellent choice for champagnes and late harvest wines. Also a very good choice for dry whites.

Summary: Wonder food - best food for healthy cats!
Text:
I've always fed my cats "good" food, per my vet's recommendations (Royal Canin (sp) or Science Diet). But I made a crazy mistake when my cats turned 7; given Science Diet recommends a switch to a geriatric food at age 7, I changed to the geriatric formula. BAD decision. I have Siamese cats (boy weighed 9# and girl weighed 7#) - over the course of 9 months, they each lost about a pound, which is a LOT for these little guys! Talked to my vet and he said my cats definitely did NOT need a geriatric diet yet. They are extremely active, as are most Orientals.

Instead of switching back to their old Science Diet, I asked friends who did rescue work and friends who were breeders for their recommendations: they all swore by Innova Evo. I started my cats on it and they LOVED it - and put back on the weight they lost. I also increased the amount of wet food in my cats' diet, as they previously ate predominantly dry food diet with a small amount of wet food as a treat. The change had other positives: I noticed they were vomiting less than they had in the past and my male cat, who had long suffered with allergies got better. (This was a big deal, as he has been through extensive testing and we've tried MANY foods to help his allergies.) The only negative is that my female cat, who always had the silkiest fur, lost some of the silk and luster in her fur. I have no idea what Science Diet puts in the food that Innova Evo doesn't have, but there was a marked change. I talked to my vet and he put both of them on Fel-V omega-3 oils, and my little girl regained most of the silkiness of her coat.

Over time, my cats started to quit eating the Innova Evo and I experimented with some of the Innova foods with some grains, but they were only mildly interested. My cats are finicky eaters and they get tired of the same wet food after awhile. So, I went back to giving them many varieties of Fancy Feast (they share a 3 oz can as a dinner-time treat, as most of their diet is dry food, which they love). They had regained the weight and were healthy.

Jump ahead seven years. My cats are now just shy of 15, and about six months ago, I realized my boy was losing some weight. I took him to the vet, and he checked out fine - just getting older. He still loves to eat, so I decided it was time to pack in more nutrition and calories in what he eats. Given my prior positive experience with Innova Evo, I went back to it. My cats have again taken to it well, and my little boy has gradually regained some weight. (Both cats remain active, racing through the house, playing, etc.) When I went to get the Innova, I was thrilled to find that there were more flavors of Innova available than I could find seven years ago (might just have been the pet store I used). Perfect! With the variety of flavors, I've been able to provide them some variety in their diet, while still knowing they're getting nutritious food (the regular Innova has grains, but is still a well-balanced, superior cat food, and I work the Innova Evo in as much as I can).

When I changed my cats' wet food to Innova, I realized they also made a dry food with salmon and herring (my cats are seafood lovers, with chix as a second choice). I got them started on the Innova dry food and they love it, too! It's got about 3 times the protein of most "commercial" dry foods.

I'm committed to ensuring my cats have long, healthy lives, and I'll be staying with Innova! Nothing else compares (in my opinion - and I've tried a lot of foods due to my boy's allergies). You've got nothing to lose my giving it a try - because it's so nutrition dense, the higher cost actually balances out.

Innova Evo Cat and Kitten food is one of the best wet foods on the market without question. Both of my cats love the taste of this product. Add the high protein to the grain-free ingredients list and you have a winner. Highly recommended!

HOW MANY BARS COME IN THIS PACKAGE?! Giving me the ounces is nice and all, but it didn't really help me fully know how many bars are in the pack, and the stock image is of a 5 bar pack.

There are 16 of these bad boys in here, in one of the counter displays from the store (the little cardboard box that the top rips off). But don't eat all of these in one day or you will be messed up. At like 35% your daily value of fiber, you would be like 560% your daily value - which is really dangerous.

So do what I do and eat about one every day or so, when I need a healthy delicious snack.

Summary: Pretty good.. I would buy this again
Text:
I bought a smaller 5 oz. can of this from my local drugstore to try. Processed meat in a can almost never tastes like the freshly prepared version, and this one is no different. The texture has changed considerably because of the canning process. The pieces are large and chunky, with the flavor and appearance very similar to canned solid white tuna. I added two photos to the product gallery to show the texture of the pieces.

The broth is a bit on the salty side, but overall, I would buy this product again. It is good on its own or mixed with rice and beans or salad if you are short on time or cooking skills. The only thing that I would add is possibly having a pull-ring top that doesn't need a can opener to open.

Summary: Smucker's natural PB is great. You'll not go back
Text:
Smuckers Natural PB is pure peanuts. It does not have sugar or palm oil like so many of the other big name "natural" peanut butters.
Try Smucker's Natural Peanut Butter, and you'll never go back to the processed peanut butter. The sweet, horribly textured, processed peanut butter.

Smuckers = Healthy.
Smuckers = Good.

But....
$22.55 For two 26 oz jars, works out to $0.43/ounce. Ouch.
My local grocery store has 16oz jars for $3.26, or $0.20/ounce.
The product is great, HOWEVER the shipping was outlandish not a good buy, unless u live in a remote location with NO stores, then the shipping would be worse.BAD IDEA TO BUY THIS!

We love this Honey Tree Sugar Free Imitation Honey. It isn't only good on biscuits, but great in recipes that call for honey.

We have shared it with some friends and told others about this product.

Walmart use to carry it but doesn't anymore. So glad we found it on Amazon.

Hope you will continue to carry this product. It is great and so was the service.

I tried this Ramen on a whim.  I normally steer clear of Ramen noodles because they have a high fat content and the broth pretty much tastes like briny water no matter what flavor you are eating. These noodles are truly delicious. First of all they are organic, which is a draw for me.  Second they are baked, which makes them healthier for those of us who need to be conscious about fat content.  I can't say enough about how tasty these noodles are.  Mixing in the flavor packet, I could actually SEE the lemongrass and ginger.  Super flavorful and very unique.  I love these noodles.  Highly recommended.

These have better than average broth, but less than average noodles. The decent powdered soup mix is not enough to make me want to buy such plain, tasteless noodles. The ramen seems like plain flour with water, poor texture and pasty, bland flavor.

Dr. McDougall's Right Foods Vegan Miso Ramen, in Cups (on Amazon) has a better ramen noodle. I have found nothing as tasty (and vegetarian) since Westbrae stopped making delicious brown rice ramen, buckwheat ramen, etc..

(Anyone know another good, vegetarian ramen?)

I have purchased this item twice in the past & thought it an excellent product at a fair price. It was $41.15 for a case of 25 items or $1.65 each. Now that amazon has raised the price to $50.65 a case or $2.03 each, it is not such a great deal anymore. That is a 23% increase in the price. Same quality as Whole Foods at a significant savings per tin--plus free shipping.  Can't beat it.
These are the best tasting of the Crown Prince offerings for Sardines in Olive Oil.

Sardines are a terrific food source... high in protein and naturally high in fish oil (Omega 3 & 6); plust these are packed in quality olive oil. They're easily carried in your backpack (though, not easily, neatly eaten while on the go). Only concern is that occasionally, a can will be very salty - weird.

Text: I have such fond childhood memories of the early Automats and the Sunday mornings I spent there with my dad.  I love my coffee, especially (like most people) first thing in the morning.  It gives my day a kick start.  When I first tasted this coffee with its rich and full-bodied (not acidic) flavor, I knew I had entered into a lasting relationship. perfect for brother and family(4 kids and dog)  who moved from San Francisco to Maryland.  Package is very cute, home bucket  very appropriate  for welcoming gift

This hemp bag barely measures 6" by 8" and the drawstring is sewn into the fabric on the one end which makes it hard to close. Don't fall for the cheap carabiner trick like I did. Go with the Sprout Lady bags they are almost twice the size and the drawstring works well, then go get yourself a carabiner from the dollar store. Sprouts are awesome, Sprouts=Life :)

I used this tumeric and along with 3 other chili powders ordered in my recipe for the South Florida 2008 Chili Cook-off and placed 21 out of 80 for my 1st attempt.  The product itself is of great quality and lends to a superb taste.  However, my only complaint is that when I originally ordered these products the delivery date was quoted to be within the next 2 business days when i didn't receive it in 3 days I went back onto Amazon to track my order only to see that my entire order was delayed a week without notification.  I like my spices to be as fresh as possible and had they been delayed 1 more day, I would not have had essential ingredients on time.

Summary: Best beef stock available, short of homemade.
Text: For the  price, you can't make a beef stock better than this. I use it for my Greek hot dog sauce, chili, beef stroganoff, and even for gravy. Great flavor and a real time saver.

These are a sweet and chewy alternative to the sugar-laden, princess/pirate/cuddly bear-shaped fruit snacks that kids devour.  My toddlers love them and I am happy knowing they're getting some actual fruit. Of course my 4-year-old knows the difference, but these are all I keep in the house now and she eats them anyway!

Summary: Excellent value for an excellent dried fruit product
Text: I've always trusted Sun-Maid.  When I first saw this item on grocery store shelves I was a bit turned off by the high price, and yet at the same time, understood that Sun-Maid is a high quality product that I've eaten since my childhood years.  So I bought a package.  Then I could only buy them when they were on sale.  I found these Fruit Bits on Amazon and was happily surprised by the price.  I get twice as more bags for half the price if I bought them at my grocery store.  I enjoy these right out of the bag.  I know they would be great for baking or on oatmeal or other cereal, but I just enjoy the flavors so much as they are.  Resealable, definitely easy to travel with, nutritious, delicious, and I highly recommend this product.

Reese canned artichoke hearts are best used in hot, cooked dishes.

These canned artichokes are not good on their own. They are a little waxy and need to be rinsed to get rid of the metalic flavor.

A good item in a pinch, but not my first choice.

Summary: Hard to believe they are good for you!
Text: Excellent flavor in filling and outer shell. When toasted, crust has a nice crispness too it. Just like "regular" Pop Tarts (that I won't buy again BTW), it is hard to eat just one. I will definitely buy these again.

So glad they're not frosted as they're already very sweet. We like to grab these when we don't have time for a big breakfast or when we want a quick, easy snack. It's great that they are full of healthy ingredients, but still taste good to kids.

Summary: Give me GOOD and healthy over 'name brand' any day!
Text: The flavor seems to vary from one pastry to the next.  I accredit that to 'natural'.  Apples have different tastes.  Without artificial flavor added it's all up to nature!  Dough/bread products are a favorite of mine anyway.  Each one is topped with cinnamon; another favorite of mine.  Eat and enjoy!

Only small grip is the price with shipping, since it's pretty much the same as the product. But that is life.

I think "Restful Don" covered it all in his review, but I just wanted to wholeheartedly agree. :-)

I have been a lifelong fan of hot sauce, and though I like to occasionally test my limits with the super hot stuff, Habanero Tabasco is my absolute favorite for daily use.

It's sufficiently hot, but also has great flavor. I use a "Frank's Red Hot" bottle (re-labeled, as suggested) to dispense it, and use a small funnel to refill it whenever I need to.

The small bottles at the grocery store will cost you about a dollar an ounce - buying the whole gallon will cost you almost half that.

Also, you'll save yourself the hassle of the store being sold out - my gallon lasted me almost an entire year!

Have been buying this tea & brewing fresh for over 5 years. Ashby's has just the right balance of black tea & apricot blossoms. Most teas run up to $4/oz; at $1.60/oz this is a true bargain in tea. -Dan G.

Summary: The best litter I have ever used, period.
Text: I've tried many different types of litter. I have three cats. This litter is the best. It's as simple as that. It fights smells better than any other litter, and it does it naturally, without fake perfumey smells trying to cover it up. It clumps perfectly. It flushes with NO problems whatsoever. I've been absolutely shocked by how much I am able to flush at a time without it clogging up my toilet at all. You just let it sit in the water for a few minutes before flushing and it starts to break down. The stuff is amazing, plain and simple. One word of warning though - watch out with dogs being allowed near it. Since it is made of wheat they may have a hard time realizing that it isn't supposed to be food.

Text: I needed a good dipping sauce for soba noodles and tried a couple bottles of Kikkoman Tsuyu. You know its always difficult to get the sauce to come out even to the noodles and vice versa. So this sauce has been used with Somen and Soba noodles and some potstickers. I like it! Not overly salty and a bit smoky plus very complementary to the noodle - subtle. More will be ordered!

This product is absolutely spot on done right. Texture, flavor and size in my opinion, Perfect. Oh, the balance of sugar and salt, love it. I could not find this item in my local grocery so Amazon got the business.

Summary: Lindt: A touch of sea salt
Text: This is an amazing chocolate bar. It has just enough salt to enhance the dark chocolate. It is not salty at all. Even my husband who is a milk chocolate fan enjoys it and steals some of it.  One bar lasts about 2.5 servings. It's great to satisfy your sweet tooth. I always keep a few bars on hand in the fridge. The bars can get pretty pricey in the stores ranging to almost $4 to the lowest price of $2.

I love this stuff!  If you like dark chocolate, you will really like this.  The amount of sea salt is perfect to balance with the bitterness of the chocolate.  It is a great chocolate to have in the evening with a cup of coffee.

Bamboo rice is very different. Unusual for a lot of people. The color makes it somewhat fun to play with. The jade color of can compliment many different kind of meals. We served it with large gulf pranws sauteed and then simmered very shortly with coconut milk and red Thai Curry.

It's high content of chlorophyll causes the rice to be high on Vitamin B and its flavor and aroma of jasmine green tea.

Since we have to be gluten free, it can be hard to find a good variety of grains we can eat. I was so happy to find this rice. I wish it was more readily available in my area, but even with shipping, the price per pound was under six dollars and the rice was fresh and a nice change from all the white and brown rice.

Bamboo rice is actually a white rice that is infused with bamboo juice, which gives it a flavor similar to fresh green vegetables. It is moist and sticky, and goes well with chicken, pork, and vegetables.
I only drink flavored coffee, and this one is my favorite so far. It's pretty sweet, which I really enjoyed, and it has a definite caramel taste and aroma. Recommended.

Summary: Great cake but no date code on box to tell freshness
Text: Great price from Amazon on the Tortuga rum cake since it's about half from the local liquor store. Since we had them before and loved them so we ordered 3 16oz cakes as gifts from Amazon. Two turned out to be moldy and the other was fine. The problem is there's no way to tell on the box when these things were made nor was there a "Best consume by date" anywhere so we have no idea how "fresh" or how old these things are. There is a small white label on the bottom with some 7 digit numbers but we have no idea what they stand for nor could we decipher their code. We contacted Amazon and they didn't know about the date code either. Should you buy them from Amazon, buy them for your own consumption and not as gifts so if they turn out to be bad, you can get an exchange or refund thus saving you embarassment from your relatives or friends who ended up with your moldy gifts. Or try to contact Amazon to find out when they were made before sending them off to your friends.

Summary: Glenfarclas 25 is the sweet floral sherried heart of Speyside pushed to the limit in the wood.
Text:
When most people picture "scotch whiskey" as an archetype they are thinking of a malt sweet spirit with a floral sherried nose, a golden yellow color, and some oak in the finish. Blends such as Johnny Walker and Chivas mix many malts (and varying amounts of spirit fillers to get at this ideal with clock-like consistency. There are a number of pure single malts that embody this ideal, from Macallan to Glenlivet. Most tend to be Speyside malts. The limpid marble waters and sweet grain of the region exemplify scotch whiskey. None, however nails the archetype's lightness, floral sweetness, and consistent mix of attributes more or more consistently than Glenfarclas. Glenfarclas has an extensive line from moderately young to extremely old that are all clear kin and utterly archetypical Speyside scotch - every single one. The sweet heart of the line are the 17 (perfect) and 21 (just a kiss older and richer than perfect) year old expressions. Today I'm drinking the 25 year expression. Is it gilding the lilly? Does the extra age ruin the magic with too much wood or is it even a scooch better yet?

Color: Light amber gold. Just like "scotch" looks in the dictionary picture.

Nose is Sweet vanilla sherry - simple "Scotch" - increasingly rich with time. Toffee malt richness turns the aroma ambrosial with time (lots of time) in the glass.

Light mouthfeel. The entry is mostly sweet with straight malt sugars. Expansion is broad but light and floral with vanilla from oak tannins which bring a pepperiness and a dryness in the texture. Sherry and nougat and cake frosting flavors round into red fruits (cherry and red plum) as the midpalate blooms into honeyed splendor. Finish is sweet turning tannin dry with a long tail of vanilla and honeysuckle and citrus (tangerine) that ends on a slightly bitter note.

This is clearly kissing cousins with the 21 but there is a little more of everything... including that bitterness at the end. Personally I'd stand pat with the 21, but I can see why the distiller pushed it. There is definitely a perspective that the 25 delivers that is valid and delicious - just I feel the balance of attributes is best with the 21. You might feel differently. None of these Glenfarclases are big intense flavors. All are gentle, sweet, and polite. It's what Chivas dreams of when it dreams of scotch.

Summary: Ethically traded, shade grown, and great flavor

It has the soft muted snap of milk chocolate, as long it's kept cool, it doesn't just bend like some milk chocolate bars and it's not as hard as a Hershey's bar. It's more like Nestle consistency.

Summary: Banana Chocolate Chip Bars that taste like Fig Newtons
Text:
If you are a person who is used to eating healthy products, and especially Kashi products, you may very much enjoy this snack bar. But if you are looking for a snack bar that tastes like banana and chocolate chips, the name of this variety of snack bar, you may be (like me) quite disappointed.

I have had Kashi cereals and energy bars and the past and have enjoyed them (some more than others), so I was shocked when I opened my first "Banana Chocolate Chip Chewy Snack Bar" to find that it had zero banana flavor and not much chocolate flavor either. There ARE chips in it that look like they might be chocolate chips, but even when I plucked one out and ate it by itself, I could just BARELY identify it as tasting chocolate-like (i.e., it tasted like carob or some other fake chocolate, even though "semi sweet chocolate" is indeed in the ingredient list)...and certainly, among the sweet taste of a base that tastes like Fig Newtons, the chips have little chance of standing out.

I admire Kashi as a company, but I was truly disappointed and angry to have something marketed as banana chocolate chip that tasted like neither. One part of the marketing that IS correct is that it IS chewy. It has a soft chewy texture and there are some crunchy bits in there that I can't identify. Looking at the ingredient list, it could be oats or another of the "Kashi seven whole grains."

The description for this product included the words "Yummy banana bread taste with dark chocolate chips, just like homemade." Uh...NOT! I found the sweetness cloying, likely a result of using evaporated cane sugar, fruit purees (apple and banana), and dried pumpkin as sweeteners vs. sugar. The weirdest thing to me is that it tastes so much like Fig Newtons but has no figs in it (which makes me now want to read the ingredient list for Fig Newtons). For the record, I love Fig Newtons...but not all the time...and not when billed as chocolate.

Basic Nutrition Facts PER 40g bar:

Calories 140
Total Fat 3g
Sat Fat 0.5g (no trans fat)
Cholesterol 0
Sodium 125mg
Total Carb 25g (not for you low carbers!)
Fiber 4g
Sugars 9g
Protein 3g
Includes small amounts of Vitamin A and the minerals Iron and Calcium. The list of ingredients is about 2 inches long on the side of the box.

The box includes 5 1.4 ounce bars and claims that these bars provide 1/2 serving of fruit and 1/2 serving of veggie. I was only able to eat 1 1/2 bars in order to write this review. I will be giving the rest of the box to a friend. They don't contain enough protein to be effective as a protein bar and are definitely not satisfying enough TO ME to be used as a sweet snack.

Not recommended unless you:
1. Are already accustomed to the cloying sweetness/aftertaste of evaporated cane sugar or are already eating very healthy;
2. Are looking for a healthy snack bar and don't mind the taste;
3. Are looking for a snack bar for your kids that is better for them than a candy bar or a high fat snack bar; or
4. Don't mind that the product doesn't taste like bananas or chocolate.

As others have pointed out, this tastes of BURNT bananas. Those who don't think so must have LOTS of dead taste buds or have a funky-taste fetish (it takes all-kinds to make a world).

The bottom of the bars coloring looks suspiciously over-cooked, as well.

Many people have come to the same conclusions on Amazon and other sites regarding the flavor of these things.

I know, I know. Taste is subjective. As someone who enjoys bananas AND chocolate, this bars are an ultra-bummer.

...tastes like they've burned the bananas and up-chucked in the chocolate. :-L

Kashi's Banana Chocolate Chip Chewy Snack Bar is intended for the health conscious and those who prefer more natural ingredients in their snacks. The bar has great banana and chocolate flavors; however it has the texture of a dry fig newton without the gooey center. The product describes itself as having a banana bread taste. Though Kashi's bar is a fine attempt to replicate banana bread, I would always select real banana bread over this product. It's not that it doesn't do what it's intended to do, but it's hard to get past the bar's dryness and underwhelming texture. Give it a try, but as for me, I'll be walking past Kashi's Snack Bar the next time I see it in the grocery aisle.

Straight out of the box, these are tasty. But...you know what's even better? Leave one in your lunchbox, in the car, on a sunny day.  Then, when it's all warm and moist, scarf it down like it's Grandma's Chocolate Chipper Banana Bread. True story. These are triple yummy when warmed up a bit. Everyone in the house--from the kid to the picky husband--loves them now.

The Kashi Banana Chocolate Chip Bars sound perfect. Each bar has a half serving of fruit and veggies. Each contain 4g of fiber and are soft and natural. At only 140 calories, they won't ruin your diet and can make a perfect snack or breakfast supplement. So, the question is, do they taste good?

They taste GOOD. Not great, but they are tasty and easy to eat. The oats on top give the banana bread a crunch, and chocolate chips give it a sweetness. I great, natural bar you can have for a snack or supplement your breakfast.

Summary: A Few Things I Love And A Few I Just Might Learn To!

So...wow! This is a lot of tea. I bought this tea after reading about the many health benefits. It arrived in a sealed-foil bag. I will be drinking raspberry leaf tea for months before I run out.

I'm a big iced tea fan. I could drink it in lieu of water. The big downside however is going to the bathroom all day. (Between being 9 mos. pregnant and tea being a diuretic, I can't say which is more to blame though.) I started drinking this stuff b/c of all the purported benefits of red raspberry leaf in pregnancy and toning the uterus. I drank it throughout my first pregnancy as well.
I was very happy that I was able to find this organic loose leaf tea online. I actually doubled the strength of it and would make it in batches. About 1/2 cup of loose tea leaves per 4 cups of boiling water which I poured into my French press. If you don't have a French press or tea infuser pot, then you can just pour the hot water and loose tea into any mug or tempered container and allow the leaves to seep. I let the tea seep until the water cooled down, then I poured the tea through another strainer into a large jug. Eventually I collected a gallon of it and added splenda and sugar and then put into the fridge to cool. It is better than the gallons and gallons of Arizona green tea that I go through; and much cheaper than Starbucks or Dunkin Donuts iced teas which are also my vices. (I learned that the secret to Starbucks' iced tea is to double the concentration and use plenty of sweetener; hence it's so good.)

The other tea that my doula recommended, dandelion root, is a whole 'nother ballgame, though. That stuff tastes awful. But I would highly recommended the raspberry leaf tea for both its taste and medicinal benefits.

Summary: Not enough relief for severe cramps
Text: I decided to try the red raspberry leaf tea because my Dr said I should not take ibuprofen until my stomach healed. I get really wicked cramps and need to take four ibuprofen every 4-5 hours for the first two days. I started drinking the tea a day before period as someone suggested online. I used 3 heaping tablespoons of tea for 32 oz of water. I let the tea steep with a plate over it. I drank two cups every hour. I upped it to four cups an hour to see if this would further help me. It did not. This takes the edge off the cramps so I can bear it but I am not comfortable. I am dreading the next few days of cramps without ibuprofen because this does not help me enough. If you are one of those lucky ladies who can take two ibuprofen every six hours for cramps this will probably work for you. If you get severe cramps I doubt it will help. If the natural thing helps as good or better than the drug then I am all for it. THis is not the case with this tea. By the way I also tried the ALvita brand tea some ladies said worked better. It did no better in relieving the cramps than this bulk product. I am disappointed it is not helping me more than it is.

This tea arrived promptly in an obviously hand-filled plastic bag, with aluminum foil wrapped around it and a nice handwritten note from the seller. The tea is in the form of a super-fine, talcum-like green powder.

I didn't bother with bags -- just a pinch in the near-boiling water will do. A little goes a long way, so an ounce, for example, can last for weeks or longer.

It is stimulating, but smoothly so -- even smoother than strong coffee or normal tea, I'd say. I've never felt jumpy or "wired" from drinking this tea, even after several cups, which I've done several times on cool winter days. You don't notice any feeling other than the soothing, aromatic tea experience. I do find that it's best not to drink within a few hours of when you want to go to bed, however.

I plan to buy this fresh, delicious tea again, and would recommend it to anyone interested in trying it, particularly if you enjoy the taste of green tea.

Five stars. Highly recommended.

Crunchy Nut is really good. I was dubious at first because there are a ton of honey and nut flavored cereals out there and I didn't see how a new one would stand out. I loved it but it just isn't that good for you (hence, the 4 stars). Crunchy nut definitely falls into the sugary-cereal category but it tastes so good that one box lasted only a couple days.

This morning my husband, one of my granddaughters and I tried this new cereal from Kellogg's, Crunchy Nut Golden Honey Nut. All three of us liked the cereal, but the other two liked it a little more than I did.

When milk is first poured over the flakes they are, indeed, very crunchy and toothsome. I liked the fact that I could actually "feel" the peanut pieces on the flakes, as well as see them. The touch of honey is maybe a little over done for me, but my fellow crunchers didn't agree. I do think this cereal is a little too sweet, but that may just be my taste preference. The serving size is given as 3/4 cup for a count of 120 calories. Pair that with 1/2 cup of fat free milk and you are up to 160 calories. Certainly not bad numbers except that nobody bothered to stay within the 3/4 cup limit. The flakes do not, alas, stay crunchy for long in the milk. After 5 minutes they were almost completely flat and yet still very good.

I have been requested to buy this cereal after this box runs out along with another new release, Crunchy Roasted Honey Nut, 10.8-Ounce (Pack of 4), and since there is a coupon printed on the box I'm sure I will do that. I think this will end up being one of those things my grandgirls request I have on hand for their sleep over parties. There was much discussion of how good these would be eaten as a snack without adding the milk to them. Humm, Granny will have to be vigilant in watching these boxes.

Summary: Surprisingly tasty, crunchy, not too sweet
Text: As a lover of more hearty cereals like Grape-Nuts, I was a little worried this one might be too sweet.  Instead, I was pleasantly surprised to find that, sure, it reminded me (a lot) of Frosted Flakes, but was better.  It stayed very crunchy in milk (can't say that about the Frosted Flakes I remember), had a nice nuttiness to it - although I can't say I'd necessarily have realized it had nuts if the package hadn't clued me in.  As for healthiness - it's fortified like most cereals these days, but I was definitely hungry again an hour later and wasn't impressed by the protein or fiber content.  Overall a good cereal, but I docked one star for its dubious health value - I'll probably go back to Grape Nuts for daily eating.
