I think it a step up from Folgers, on par with some of Green Mountain ( I am not a fan) and not even close to Coffee People, Starbucks or Barista Blend. The flavored coffee (I have only tried Maple Sleigh but flavored coffee is flavored coffee in my opinion) was very good. I am not a fan of flavored coffee, but this was very good. The donut shop taste like, well, donut shop coffee and that can be had anywhere and of all the Brooklyn blends I have tired thus far I think this was the most successful.

So, if you are looking for a medium blend donut shop, I would recommend this if you are looking to save money. Otherwise, go with Coffee People. Again, this a good bang for the buck, but not for the discerning coffee drinker who likes a more robust, finely honed flavor to their coffee.

Summary: I am a Starbucks extra Bold Roast kind of girl, so keep that in mind.
Text:
French Roast

I love French Roast in general, so I started my variety pack with a Brooklyn Beans French Roast. I made it as I usually make my K-cups (I drink Van Houtte Eclipse almost every morning) and used a 6 ounce cup of water. I don't use sugar and do use coffee cream.

It smelled good, but when I poured cream in, went super white almost immediately, which usually means the k cup is not going to be a strong enough taste for me. I want to find a Brooklyn Bean product I like, because they are very reasonably priced. In any case, it won't be French Roast. I poured it out. Too weak for me on six ounce setting.

Cyclone

My son said I was going to like this one but he likes Starbucks blonde roast. He really liked it. I thought it was ok. It didn't turn completely white with a bit of cream but it's just not full flavored enough for me.

That said, I am sure someone who is not as into very strong coffee as me, will like it. It's not bad, or anything, its just I am a Starbucks extra bold kind of girl, so remember that when you read my reviews. Interesting though that two of my favourite K cups (other than double black diamond) are Caribou regular (I don't like the mahogany which is supposed to be stronger tasting) and the Eclipse, both of which are sort of medium smooth coffees. Looking forward to trying and reviewing some more (I recently learned about reviewing on amazon when my cousin Joanne Levy wrote a book 'Small Medium at large' and I reviewed it because I liked it so much!

My wife an I are pretty much hooked on these cups. I was a skeptic at first I must admit. I tried the San Fran cups, and didn't really go for their style. I was getting tired of paying an arm and a leg for the main brands that got this whole biz going, so I tried these cups from Brooklyn Bean Roastery. I originally ordered the Columbian blend, and admittedly I thought they were ok, I also thought they were a little weak for a Medium/Bold roast. I reflected that in my original review of that one flavor. The company immediately offered email assistance, to help me choose another flavor that would better meet my taste preferences. I never did respond back to that request as I was not really looking for any assistance. It was merely my first impression and observation. I got through those cups and decided to give the Brooklyn Bridge roast a try. I liked these much better. Then it happened... I had a couple of those cups more or less pop their tops in my coffee brewer. It was a mess and a pain in the caboose to clean up. I had known of other customers complain of the same issues, but again I reluctantly gave these a try hoping that would not happen to me. Well, it did. I then signaled the company with a review, reflecting what had happened, and the company immediately sprung to action again, wanting to resolve the issue I had, and desired to make me whole. I never once thought that I would really get the attention that I got from the company, nor did I solicit any new product directly from the company. It's like going to a grocery store, and buying any one of a myriad of items. I believe that it is something you take an inherent risk, if you've never bought that item before. If you don't like it, lesson learned. You just probably don't buy it again. You don't run back to the store, demanding a refund, or contact the manufacturer and expect anything.
Well, Brooklyn Bean emailed me, and basically summoned me to give them a detailed explanation of what happened, what cups I was using, the expiration date, which translates to the manufacture date, etc. After giving them that requested info (I even sent them a photo of the messy exploded cup) they emailed me back and unexpectedly offered to send out new product. I thought, Wow! This company must be serious about making it in the business. They are trying to make right, what had gone wrong, and at no expense to me, they sent out new product, and then some. They sent out replacement cups, and also a 16 cup sampler pack. We tried all of them and my wife fell in love with the Vanilla Skyline. We have since ordered more product, including the Vanilla, and each cup has performed flawlessly!!! I emailed the company and thanked them, and added that it surprised me that they would go to that effort for me, just one lousy customer in UTAH, and their response back was, how could a company NOT stand behind their product, and make it right, if they want to make it a successful company. That is music to my ears! I told them, that not every start up company would do that.
So, I highly recommend this product. Find the flavor you like and run with it!!!

I recently purchased a Keurig and was having a lot of trouble finding a k-cup I enjoyed. I received a sample pack of this coffee and was thrilled- it was the first time I was able to illy enjoy my new coffee maker. I can honestly say that each flavor was excellent and I can't wait for them to restock. You will not be disappointed!

Summary: Let me tell you about it.
Text: It tastes great, like sweet potato pie filling. The jars are packaged securely. Don't expect smuckers-sized jars, okay? I would buy it again.
Parle-G Glucose Biscuits received as ordered. Same as old, as we found in 1970s. For my personal taste, I re-heat to keep crispyness intact. Overall Good.

I was totally ripped off by this company. I received 120 little pieces of gum for 34.47!!!! They made it sound like you got 120 packs of gum, please do not order from this company as they will RIP YOU off!!!!

Looking for some bulk 1 minute oats as our local Sam's Club sometimes does not stock it, so off to Amazon.

Save your money and go buy it at your local supermarket - this stuff is at 2-3X normal supermarket prices.

The oats themselves are fine, a commodity...try them with some ground almonds and a handful of raisins - mmmm.
Good ingredients but my allergy dog can't eat it. the natural lamb flavor must be an allergen.  :( Luckily my other dog does not have allergies so she eats it.

Just on a whim, I thought I'd try this and it seems to work. It has several B-vitamins in it and that might be the reason. Even if it's only psychological, I don't feel as tired after drinking it. Best yet, it's delicious!

Eat food in as natural form as possible, that is the rule I adopted. I can't eat raw cracked wheat but I boil it for 20 minutes and eat it with Indian curries. This is most healthiest food I have eaten.

Summary: Gerber 1st Foods Assorted Fruits and Vegetables 18
Text: We purchased the Gerber 1st Foods Assorted Fruits and Vegetables 18 on a family vacation for our infant granddaughter they came in very handy and made feeding her a convenient non messy task.

My daughter is not supposed to have any sugar or artificial sweeteners.  She loves gum, but we had a hard time finding anything that didn't have aspartame.  Once we found this gum, we were all hooked.  It tastes great...almost like Juicy Fruit of the old days...and has the coating like Chiclets.

xylitol gum may prevent cavities but the flavor lasts about 45 seconds. i'll choose
the aspertame flavored gum, thank you.
This gum is no longer made so it was wonderful to give as a gift to my son who thought he would never enjoy it again.  The look on his face was priceless.

Caffe Kimbo is the only coffe I drink at home. I use to live in Naples and became so use to drinking Kimbo, that I can drink it black...with no sugar and cream. Far better than Lavazza!

Kimbo to me has a very distinct auroma. The auroma, and the taste are all part of the experience of drinking caffe!

Summary: Kimbo is far better than Illy
Text: For those of you that have had real Italian Espresso. Kimbo is a far better brand than Illy. Better balance and the beans have not been over roasted.  Illy is overpriced and over rated.  You can go to Starbucks and get the same type of espresso if you prefer Illy.  If you really love espresso Kimbo is the way to go.  The heart of Neopolitan espresso.  Italians never have even heard of Illy!

Summary: Illy is better, but Kimbo is decent for the price
Text: The espresso is okay. A little on the dry side. Illy is better and more consistent but I can't afford it.
I have always loved this dressing and have looked for it everywhere in the stores; but unable to find. When I saw this; I couldn't resist single serving or not, I'd buy it.

Summary: Best ever for serious dark choc fans
Text: This chocolate is absolute heaven on earth for hard-core chocolate fans. This is not your sweet and creamy hershey's though. I actually prefer the 70% dark as I like my chocolate a little sweeter; but, I think this stuff is yummy anyway and my sister and mother LOVE this stuff!!!!

I have 2 great danes and this bone was great.  I liked these better than the extra large mammoth bone.  the extra large one just broke into 2 pieces and were about this size.  i'll always just buy these.  My dogs managed to break it apart and chew it down.  They went through a couple of them over the course of like three months.

I was so excited when I found these cookies online, they were perfect for my sister's hello kitty themed birthday party, i was going to pass these out as favors. When I received them, I was less than thrilled. They are defintely a lot cuter online. I wasn't expecting them to be perfect (after all they are just cookies), but I wanted them to be made with more care/time. In the entire box, there are about 3 that I like. The rest it looks like someone made them very quickly. About 90% of the black outline of the face are jagged as if they did it on purpose, but only a select few have a nice smooth outline like in the picture. Many of the faces have tons of black marks from the black frosting, but the marks are extrememly noticeable on the white face and I'm embarrassed for the people who end up with a MESSED UP LOOKING HELLO KITTY. Also, many of the pink bows are mixed with black so much that it bothers me. I am not a picky person, but when I order Hello Kitty cookies, I expect them to be done decently. I am a person who makes things for parties and I put a lot of time and detail into my work. Next time, I will make these myself. Such a disappointment. I had high hopes for this item. Oh well. If you want to order these for a party and don't really care what they look like, then go for it, but if you want them to pass out as favors, I would suggest you think of something else. Hopefully by adding cute packaging and some ribbon I can salvage these. Next time, please make products that look more like the pictures. There needs to be quality control. Thanks.

Summary: Weight Loss or no Weight Loss ?
Text: I purchased this tea to see if it would excellerate my fat and weight loss by adding this to my regimen. I have not seen any addtional benefits in that regard but it is a tasty tea and well worth the price.

The long search for a quality oolong tea, that tastes great and doesn't tax your wallet. Flavorful, robust and delicious, this is a soothing vacation without travelling. Look no further, the search has ended. Great product, great service. Wuyi Oolong tea, the best.

I purchased this tea after reading about it on a popular weight loss website.  Though I'm not sure about it's weight loss properties, I did lose 20lbs while drinking it. However, I was using other tools as well. Regardless, I enjoy the flavor of it and it is a good value as well.

This is my first experience with Wu Long tea of any kind.  I have to admit, it's quite bitter and hard/almost impossible for me to drink without adding tons of liquid stevia.  I even tried mixing it with my Lipton mixed berries green tea that I love, to no avail.  Finally, I decided to add vanilla flavored almond milk and stevia.  It's more of a dessert drink now that I actually ENJOY drinking.  After a few days now of drinking it, I can tell that it decreases my appetite and the scale may have been lying, but it was two pounds lighter today than it was 3 days ago, so overall, 4-5 days into drinking this tea, I'm happy with it.  Just as a side note though, I'm not sitting on the couch eating bon bons as I drink this and losing weight.  I'm a very healthy eater (green smoothies, raw nuts & veggies, fresh fruit, lean meat, etc., who exercises light to moderately).
The verdict is still out. But I like it, I mean I like the way it tastes with a little honey.
Tea is delicious- i like to add lemon to mine for better taste. Recommend! Tea makes me wanna go to bathroom many times during the day which i like cuz everything i eat goes out :D
3/4 of the leaves had fallen out of the tea bag and were sitting in the paper envelope; consider this a loose tea (not bagged) and remember to have a strainer handy!

Summary: Excellent!  Hard to find good gluten food - this has opened doors
Text:
This soup is awesome! I have family & friends that don't even know it's Gluten Free!! It's opened doors on cooking that required a cream soup.
Thank you, thank you, thank you!!!!

I was so upset to receive this soup only to find out that the label listed on the Amazon website is incorrect.  It DOES contain soy and now I have 12 cans of soup I can't eat and don't want. Very disappointed.

Summary: The taste is excellent! Can be found cheaper everywhere.
Text:
I completely agree with another reviewer, why this is twice the price on Amazon is crazy??! You can find this from Walmart for just over $3. You can even get it from them online from their website. What is going on with the price here, I don't know.

As to the cappuccino itself, I love it. Because I want it to go further, I add a heaping teaspoon to my coffee, then I add Coffeemate French Vanilla Creamer. I know...that's a lot of flavor. So? It gets me going!!! :D

I have made it straight, but you need a lot of it to achieve a rich, full bodied cup of coffee. Then when you do, it is soooo rich, it's more like dessert. If you want that, then totally go for it!! But I like a more coffee flavor, so I mix them.

I do love General Foods International Coffees, but you get soooo much less in each can for the same price. If you love flavored coffee, try this from Hills Bros. (Note, currently at Wmart they have two sizes, 16 oz and 12 oz for exactly the same price. Be sure to get the big one!) It comes in a plastic container similar to the Folger's red container. Nice, because you could reuse it and store rubber bands or post it notes in this.

As to a gift? I think adding it to a basket would be wonderful, although the GF International coffees do look a bit nicer in their tins IMO. Flavor-wise, you can't beat this. It comes out creamy and rich but not toooo sweet, like a good cappuccino should be.
Our dog "Brenda Lee" enjoys this high quality food!  Great food to give to your shorter family members  :o)

The soup is delicious.......the price is not!

I purchased an 8 pack of this soup for under twenty dollars delivered about 6 months ago direct from Amazon. Unfortunately it looks like we now have to go through a reseller to obtain this product and pay an inflated price, hence the one star rating. I'm down to my last can but I cannot bring myself to pay this much for soup!
There's really nothing like it. It's not so easy to find in the states, sadly.

Barb: I have before me three different brands of alternative sweetners to sample and decide which I like best(pre-diabetic).  Splenda, Pure Via(Stevia), and Wholesome Sweeteners Organic Stevia.  Splenda tastes like sugar: is a chemically altered malt and cane product,(been using it in cooking).  Pure Via has a very intense strange supersweet/bitter taste, leaving an aftertaste,(stuck with a big box): is a Stevia extract, cellulose, etc.  Wholesome Sweeteners Organic Stevia tastes like sugar with honey undertones, smooth and mild: is an organic Agave inulin (inulin is good stuff produced from many different plants), organic Stevia extract, silica.  Of the three products, "THE WHOLESOME SWEETENERS ORGANIC STEVIA TASTES THE BEST", says my tastebuds!  The product may cost a bit more, but the benefits seem to be worth it.  The company has a nice website.

Summary: It's ok, but not my favorite artificial sweetener.
Text: I liked the idea of an organic sweetener, so I was prepared to make Wholesome Sweeteners Organic Stevia my preferred product, but after trying it for a month, I think I shall stay with my old favorite, Splenda.  Stevia is "OK", but I found it to be not as sweet, when used in some instances.  My breakfast Cheerios needed at least two packets, and still didn't seem to pack the sweet flavor.  Plus I found the individual packets rather difficult to open sometimes.  They are kind of a foil/plastic type packet, and occasionally they fight back when I try to open them.  Plus sometimes the product is lumpy inside, despite the packaging.  If you are truly wary of side effects of other sweeteners, than this should work for you.  But I'm not going to give up my old brand.

Sure, nothing tastes quite as good as sugar, but this product is just as tasty as the other Stevia based sweeteners on the market. And unlike so many of the other sweeteners on the shelves, it won't have a negative glycemic impact. Thumbs up.
I have been drinking this tea for years.  I cannot get enough. Really great tasting and perfect with chocolate! I go through these boxes so fast I'm happy they sell these in a 4 pack.

I have to agree with the guy who complained about consistency.  I have wasted two very expensive pods so far.  The first time I used a Kona pod the machine jammed and I could not open it for 24 hours,(caused a steam lock), about 5 tablespoons of undrinkable crap came out of my senseo.  The next time I tried a Kona pod I got a quarter amount of what should have been a two cup try. I am not very impressed so far.  I am now afraid to try again.

Summary: Top Quality Coffee, but Pod technology leaves something to be desired
Text: Yes the coffee is the best quality, pesticide free.  There are technical issues with the pods. 1 pod was broken when I opened up the pouch it was stored in.  For any pods to arrive broken when they are so expensive is just not acceptable.  Also, many times the pod is not working, but turning it around and pressing down on it with a fork or a spoon makes it work (I have Black & Decker Home Cafe Machine).  Great coffee, but I felt that I had to really work for it.  I also feel that to charage $15 to ship a box of coffee pods is a bit excessive, considering that they are being shiped from LA not HI.

Summary: Best cup of coffee I have ever had...
Text: After reading many of the reviews I think I have figured out the problem.  You guys have the wrong POD brewer. I have a BUNN and tried various different pods with it.  The Aloha Island pods are the best of the lot. I have been in search of a good cup of coffee for years.  The answer is a BUNN and the Aloha dark roast Pods.  I bought two el-cheapo pod brewers including black and decker and senseo.  I couldn't get a good cup of coffee even with the Aloha pods.  Once I ditched the cheap pod brewer and spent the $200.00 on the BUNN, all my troubles were over.  You guys will never be happy until you get a good pod brewer.

I prepared this kit with just the basics...I didn't add any shrimp or anything...just some red pepper flakes.  It provided me with two very tasty light meals.  I definitely would buy this product again.  Next time I'll add some shrimp, limes, chopped peanuts, etc.
Ok, but certainly need to add some fresh items to make this good. Try with chicken OR shrimp, egg, peanuts, and fresh cilantro.

I haven't used this for bread yet. Too busy right now, but my husband made oatmeal, chocolate chip cookies with Craisens and almonds. They were amazing. The flour gave them a nutty, bite. The cookies were gone in a flash.

I finally used this for bread. OUTSTANDING. I am writing a bread baking book and am including a whole grain loaf. I used this flour plus a 1/4 cup of gluten flour for a 2.5 pound loaf. It rose up high and light. The texture is soft and stretchy with crunchies to boot. I was skeptical about using a whole grain flour nearly exclusively for bread but this is amazing!

Describing flavors is always difficult, so forgive me if I don't do it justice. It tastes of fresh berries and mild white tea, with a hint of citrus. It's refreshing but there is a certain warmth to it. I can't taste the licorice at all, which is great because though I like its properties (helps digestion), I hate its taste. This is the most balanced and delicious berry flavored tea I have ever had. The fact that it is organic makes it even better. Strongly recommend it.

My local supermarket stopped carrying if for some reason and I was heartbroken. Looked everywhere for it, until it finally occurred to me that I could probably find it where I find everything else - Amazon. : ) Great price, too!
This tea is tasty and I like that it is organic. You save by buying it in bulk here on Amazon.

I thought I'd have trouble going through a case of wild rice so I split it with a friend of mine.  I have a couple of recipes that use it and I was having trouble finding wild rice in my local grocery store.  This stuff is great.  I've got on the internet looking for new wild rice recipes for an excuse to use it some more.  The package size is nice so you don't have to open a big honking bag and hope it doesn't spill all over.  I won't have any problems using up a case when this one is gone.

Splenda Mocha adds flavor to the skim milk drinks that provide protein to those of us watching our weight.  Splenda made several flavors, including Hazelnut and French Vanilla that all helped make smoothies and "lite" drinks more palatable.  In fact, they make the taste terrific.  However, they have been disappearing from supermarket shelves in the past year so now the only way I can find the Mocha flavor is online.  Thank you for offering it thru Amazon!
I'm never disappointed with this product.  Just enough mocha flavor to not make me feel as if I'm drinking hot chocolate.
This flavor works great in coffee the mocha flavor blends nicely with all coffee flavors.

Summary: Great - Awesome - Amazing from every ASPECT!!!!!!
Text: Finally something that is good for you AND tastes like you are cheating....... JUST LOVE IT!!!!!... please do not let the ball drop and tell me there is something "bad" in it that we aren't supposed to have .... I can only speak about the chocolate flavor.... i actually look forward to it every morning!

For starters - I do not like most forms of energy and protein drinks. I find the tastes are too sugary or the aftertaste is bitter or it just doesn't do what it's supposed to. Anything that states it can be a meal replacement should not make me feel starved or deprived 1 hour later - as is the case normally.
The Svelte Chocolate is good. Yes some aftertaste exists, but to me it taste like the same aftertaste as anything made from soy. I've only had the chocolate because my local store carries chocolate and cappuccino and I don't like coffee related flavors.
This drink will leave you feeling full and sated for several hours. I had one for breakfast one time and was perfectly fine all morning. I didn't sit at my desk craving food. It also works really well for afternoons if there is a long time between lunch and dinner.
The flavor is also rich. It's not super sugar sweet but more of a rich sweet, which satisfies any cravings for sugar or chocolate.
One of my favorite things is the size - 1 bottle is an entire serving! It's not one of those, "Here's a single-serving size container that has 4 servings in it" products. Which probably helps with the satisfaction afterwords because you can have more than 4 oz.

If chocolate isn't your style - try one of the other 3 flavors. I hope to try the french vanilla and chai soon.

I was so excited for this to arrive because I LOVE Orgain drinks and this has two benefits over Orgain.  The first benefit is the drink is larger in size (15.9 oz versus 11 oz) and it has a twist off cap that you can put back on (which Orgain does not).  This unfortunately is where the benefits end for this product.  Orgain tastes SO much better and also has more vitamins in it.  I don't know if it is the soy milk or what, but the taste of this is absolutely horrible!  It is like a bad medicine after taste.  I purchased this because of all of the positive reviews on amazon and because of the packaging versus Orgain.  I was REALLY hoping this would be great, but I now have eleven containers of this stuff that I will never drink.  I cannot stress how bad this was to me, but maybe you will like it since so many others do.  I wish that I would have purchased an individual bottle before buying a whole case, but that was my own fault for not doing so.  Don't make the same mistake I did!

A co-worker recently bought this in to work from an island vacation. It was so good, it was gone within seconds of opening it! I searched for it and was lucky to find it on Amazon and pretty decent prices! Once I received it, my husband and I dug into this and it was extremely good!
It is the perfect cake! moist through out, sweet with a slight pungent sweet rum aroma and flavor. Yum Yum!

My new favorite type of cake! It is pretty lethal, and pretty saturated with sugar, so be careful!
I love this rum cake.  I've only had the original flavor but it always amazes me how moist it is.  I recommend storing it in the fridge after opening but a must try for anyone who likes rum.

I have a popular single cup coffee brewer and liked the hot chocolate but they always lacked the mini marshmallows.  This helps make that cup PERFECT!!!  I also add these to Rice Krispies for my daughter's morning cereal and they make great toppings for cake pops too!  Oh, and don't forget to add these little bits to your homemade Rice Krispes treats.  I have to buy 3 or 4 when I go to the store and find these. (Because not all stores stock them and my daughter likes to eat them up before I can use them sometimes.)

After visiting the Cayman Islands on a cruise and coming back with just one pack of Tortuga chocolate cake, I decided to get this 6 pack to give friends and also try the key lime and original golden cakes. Key lime was definitely much better than I expected.
Note that the individual cake packets are not suited for more than 2 people.
Price for this 6 pack on the cruise ship was $25+, about one $ less than what Amazon carries this for.

This is the best rum cake!  I got some in Grand Cayman when I went on a cruise several years ago.  My favorite is the original flavor, but the variety pack is awesome for trying a little of every flavor.  Highly recommended!
The Newman's Own Special Blend Extra Bold is the best make at home coffee I have ever tasted!  I recommend this to all my friends that use K-cups.

I have never been outside the U.S. and I don't think I have a drop of British or Australian blood in me, but I love both Marmite and Vegemite, and get both of them at World Market (formerly known as Cost Plus World Market) for about $5 a jar. Marmite is more syrupy and salty than Vegemite / Vegemite is more solid and less salty (but still quite salty) than Marmite. VEGANS TAKE NOTE : both are good sources of vegan B vitamins, but Vegemite lacks the crucial B12 and Marmite HAS B12.

Although not for everyone (many people seem almost allergic to the stuff), I'm very fond of it - having been raised eating it.  For those who can appreciate the strange flavor, it's a very good spread (preferrable to vegemite in my opinion).  But definitely approach with caution, as it's something of an acquired taste.

Summary: Forget the Marmite, Where's the Vegemite?
Text: Where can I get the Australian version: Vegemite?  I know marmite well, but truly Vegemite beats it hands down.  Technically the same product, but you must try Vegemite it's so much better.
The dates were moist and plump.  I would and will purchase them again.  The only problem is they are TOO good and its easy to eat a lot of them in one sitting!
Why don't they sell this in every store?  This is absolutely the best pasta sauce ever. It has the perfect amount of heat. I am trying to buy all that I can.
My two young Siberian Huskies love these.  They are very crunchy and have a very strong smell.  Piece sizes vary.  Labeled as made in America.

My Siberian Husky is very picky with food, and can easily get sick from treats, so I bought the small bag to see if she liked it, or get sick, or not, and she loves it, she knows when is training time, or when she does something really good that deserves a reward, because of the sort of strong smell. The only issue I have with it is that this is extremely hard to break in smaller pieces, and if the pieces are too small for the dog, it can be dangerous for the dod, that is the only reason I won't get any more until she is an adult. I wouldn't recommend it for puppies.

Summary: Look at the ingredients list - this has more sugar by weight than it has almonds
Text: I am all for nut and grain milks and have been drinking them for 12 years.  I am now looking for a good almond milk but unfortunately this one is not going to be it.  I think that this company's large cartons (half gallon) of organic almond milk have more almonds than sugar, but unfortunately these small cartons seem to not be made of organic almonds, and, more importantly to me, seem to hardly be almond milk at all, but rather water and sugar with some almond flavoring (according to the ingredients list).  Also, they add "other natural flavorings" which I try to avoid because usually that's food-industry-speak for msg and stuff like that, which gives me headaches.  I understand that the company wants to make this drink more palatable to children and to reluctant health-nuts, but I think it's the wrong way to go to put more sugar than almonds in it, and the wrong way to go to add all kinds of "flavoring" when almonds are so beautifully flavored on their own.  I wanted this to be a product I could order from Amazon, but I'll need to keep looking.

As the parent of a 4 year old little boy who is casein intolerant, I wanted to pack him something in his lunch for school that wasn't juice.  Since we have to limit his dairy intake, we are always concerned about making sure he gets enough calcium.  I bought these to pack in his school lunches thinking this would give him another serving of calcium.  Unfortunately I was mistaken, as there is no calcium in this product.  There are many other almond milk brands that are fortified with calcium (Almond Breeze and Silk's almond milk to name two) but at least for now they don't make 8oz sizes.  My son does love the taste, which is why I didn't give it 1 star.
Good product if packing your lunch or perfect for toddlers. Pricing is good considering higher in most markets.

Five stars for the product. This is the nicest formulation for a 100% liver product I have seen (as opposed to the "liver flavored" treats with other, cheaper ingredients). The pieces are firm, easily broken into smaller bits and do not break down into a dusty powder like the freeze dried ones do (especially chicken livers). And they are buffalo instead of beef or chicken if that matters (due to food allergies and sensitivities, it might). The only issue I have is cost. These are $3.21/oz. The beef liver treats I have used previously range between $1.28 and $1.68 per oz.
If your dog can not eat beef or chicken, I highly recommend this product.

I'm amazed at how much this tastes like coffee, but it's so weak the only way I can drink it is to make half a mug (I can't afford 2 teabags), add a teeny bit more vanilla, brown sugar, cinnamon and half and half. (I experimented with different things until I settled on that combo.) It's pleasant then, but it's gone almost immediately, and then I have to go make a mug of regular tea anyway.

It never occurred to me to have to check to make sure a tea is gluten-free, but this one isn't (has barley), as I learned the hard way.

I'm not sure where the folks are saying this is bitter.  I would guess that they are just using too much at one time.  You need far far less stevia than other sugar substitutes or sugar. Actually I think it is almost sweeter than sugar.  I use this in my hot tea.  Great product.  I love the idea that it is not sugar and that it is not a chemical substitute for sugar.

This is a great everyday roast. It is not my favorite from Starbucks but holds it own with just a splash of half & half, takes flavored syrups well and even goes great with super sweet desserts. Most people try to choose a coffee with a lot of complimentary flavors to pair with a dessert but many desserts are so sweet and complex on their own that they just need a solid smooth coffee to let them shine, this roast is spot-on for that. I received this as a product test but will most definitely purchase it already brewed and for use at home.
Ok, i have to say I love having this service. No more I forgot to buy the coffee, it just come every three months and is always fresh.

To those of you who wish to purchase the coffee & chicory blend that you remember from your visit (or childhood) in New Orleans, be warned! This CDM is NOT from the original Cafe Du Monde in New Orleans, even though the package makes it look like it is. I purchased this blend thinking that since it says "Cafe du Monde" on it that that meant it was from the actual cafe in New Orleans but it's not. This is some 'knockoff' product from who knows where. Maybe some of you will enjoy the knockoff, but for me, I'm sticking with the original Cafe Du Monde!

I generally love New Orleans coffee with chicory, but find it's hard to get in the New England area.  I was happy to see that Amazon sells it, and  i ordered some, depending on reviews to determine the brand.  I have been disappointed to find that it has an "off" taste and smell (a bit like mold, but not bad enough to return it for a refund), unlike previous similar coffees that I have tasted.  There is a lot of it so it'll take a long time to use it up, unfortunately.

This is a great product that works.  We rarely had any roach trouble until lately due to an infested house next door.  Do not expect total elimination of your bug problem.  You will have to use it in combination with other roach treatments and practices like the other reviewer said.  But this item will greatly help in reducing the number of pest you have to deal with.

I just reordered more of these traps. I originally bought them to catch the silverfish, spiders and crickets that had taken residence. Was I surprised to find some little roaches as well as some unidentified bugs in the traps along with the crickets, spiders and silverfish. I will be putting out some Combat gel for the raoches too. Victor and Combat are 2 products that really work. Thanks

I put a couple dozen of these all throughout my house, and they ALL caught insects. I saw some with moths, house centipedes, and a beetle. I didn't think it'd be so effective against such large insects - especially the centipedes. However I was fairly impressed. Of course it worked pretty good on smaller various insects as well. I'm sure they didn't catch everything that went through them, but considering my main problem was house centipedes of which they caught several - I was very pleased. Pretty decent purchase for the price, great to use in combination with other insect control methods, but don't expect them to work a miracle by themselves..
I use these traps continually in the house, and it's amazing how many insects make their way into these little boxes to get stuck.  I highly recommend them.

These traps are amazing, especially for spiders.  There isn't really anything else that effectively stops spiders poison wise,  but placing this in corners and near doors has allowed me to catch 100+ insects within a month.  I haven't noticed any increase in the amount of bugs getting in my house because of these, and have certianly noticed a lack of living ones (they die inside the traps).  The traps have caught tiny baby spiders to full grown adult cockroaches, and sadly, even a full grown gecko that got into my house near the door.
I'll make this short - these traps work exactly as advertised. Easy to assemble and place, and they simply fill up with bugs - no mess, etc... Great product for intended use.

My review is for pill bugs (rolly pollies) only.  Our house had a lot of them.  I put out two 12-packs of the Insect Magnet traps.  It caught enough of them that I haven't seen any around for the last two weeks or so.

Summary: Traps full size American cockroaches, nymphs, spiders and flies
Text: One reviewer stated that these don't work with full size adult roaches, however I've captured three using these traps. I was also surprised to discover that these work great to control small fruit flies, coffin flies, and gnats. The key is to always place them along the wall or in corners. Theyre good to place behind furniture and especially near electrical outlets, as these are the most common paths that insects take when navigating through your home. If you catch nothing at all, move the traps to other areas around the house and try again. They're cheap enough that you should buy more than you think you'll need and then place a couple in each room. Keep in mind that the more you place strategically around the more likely you'll trap insect that treads close enough to catch the scent and investigate. Good luck!

i came to discover the wonders of tomato soup somewhat late in life, but became fixated. I was very sad when Costco's Kirkland brand stopped selling their tomato soup, which i just loved. I learned it was actually made by the Campbell's Company, but the ingredients appeared to be specially mixed for Costco, and I've found no equivalent in other Campbell's many tomato soup offerings, which don't taste so good. I don't know why Kirkland's canned tomato soup disappeared from my Costco, but it has now been a long, sad, taste journey for me, through many many cans of brands and tubs of specialty-type tomato soups. I was a bit leary of the Wolfgang Puck label, because I tried one soup variety previously, and found it extremely salty. However, this was on sale, and i had not found a reasonable tomato soup substitute.

so, WOW. i'm so relieved i found this soup. It's delish and rich. The consistency is great (smooth, but with texture) and you can really taste the blend of cream and butter that really complements the tomato to make the overall flavor soooo delicious--almost cheesy (my son asked if I had added parmesan). it's also a great plus that the ingredients are simple and clean (and organic). I heartily recommend this soup. i certainly will be ordering it from now on using subscribe and save. Great job, Mr. Puck.

I live on a remote Island in Alaska and stumbled on this black gold.  We use pepper like most, but also need it for smoking salmon, seasoning game meats and just making sure our burgers taste decent.  I grow many of my green spices (oregano, basil, chives....etc) but must rely on the local grocer for my other spices.  This pepper has real kick, advise you use it sparingly, but frequently.  It's truly good.  I like it so much that I'll gift it this Christmas to friends who enjoy the real art of cooking, and thought to check Amazon for availability......not terribly surprised to find on their site, but surprised to see I pay 3 dollars less here in Alaska.  No matter, I'll still shop them (Amazon) for gifting this wonderful pepper, but take serious note on pricing disparities.  No matter where you shop this, buy some, check it out and judge for yourself.  I really think you'll appreciate the kick this particular spice provides.  Sadly only only 5 reviews as I type this, but all are 5 star, and so mine as well.  Give it a shot, and take a few minutes to input your thoughts...it's one of the reasons we shop here.....and no, I'm employed in the military, not Amazon.  Take care all, spread a smile wherever you are...it actually matters. And use spices in your cooking!

Summary: Didn't help hot spots but better overall quality
Text:
One of my dogs has skin allergies and I wasn't sure if it was from Gluten or filler found in other commercial grade dog food. Someone on here mentioned a dog food analysis Website that rates all dog food ... thank you for that! I went on there and found that the food they had been eating for the past 3 years was 1-star! So searched around a little and found that this Prairie food was 5-star (out of 6-star total). Based on that and the subscribe and save price on amazon and being a prime member it was a done deal for me.

I switched their food cold turkey as both my dogs are very large breeds and have no stomach issues. They took to it right away with no issues.

After 1 month of use my dog still had his hot spots and the only thing that seems to work for him is the fish oil pills. The food didn't do anything in that area. They both have great coats so I didn't really see a difference. I just feel better knowing that it has more protein and not so much filler and comes from good ingredients. Plus it gets shipped right to my door so no complaints here at all.

Was going to rate it 4-star due to no immediate noticeable difference but will rate 5-star since the dog food analysis site also gave it 5 -stars for quality ingredients.

We have a 8 year old yellow lab. She has been eating this food fora  few years now. She eats the Chicken Meal & Brown rice variety.  The food is a good quality. We often have people comment that she is much younger than her actual age. She is trim (about 65 lbs) and is able to maintain a healthy weight.  We love having this food delivered from Amazon. It is much easier then lugging it home from the store. Even with pet store 'discount' member cards, the food is a better value at Amazon.

Summary: Even the picky eaters love this one!
Text: On the recommendation of a breeder friend, we decided to try out a new kibble for our small pack of assorted fur babes. My mother has two Pomeranians (one of which is *extremely* picky, even with fresh "people" food), I have one Pom, one Peke mix and a German Shepherd mix. Since we were all together over the holidays we decided to give this food a try to see how they all liked it. I was impressed with the nutritional content, but that doesn't always translate to taste or appealing to our dogs. From the very first bowl, they were all interested - even my mother's super picky eater. I highly recommend this food, especially for picky eaters. We haven't been using it long enough to determine it's long term effects on the health of our dogs, but have noticed smaller stools, less gas/tummy upset and happier, more playful pooches!

You really do get what you pay for most of the time when it comes to pet foods.  There are foods out there that are better than this one, but this one is a good value when you look at the lbs and the ingredient list.  High quality ingredients in small kibbles mean that I can feed less food and that it turn means less waste!  My dogs have been on this food for 6 years and I've never once felt like they need to be on something different.  We rotate flavors (lamb, chicken, beef, etc) if the store is out of stock or Amazon's price isn't suiting me.  I've never had a hard time getting them to eat it and they look absolutely amazing.  Very pleased with this company and with this food!  Only thing is that I wish they would bring back the zippered 30 lb bags, I had to buy a rolling bin and I still don't feel like this food is very fresh.

This is a very mild and tasty cheese. It is quite mild, very soft and a bit crumbly, with a slight hint of salt. It is a good eating cheese and would mix well with various types of salads. I ordered 2 rolls of this cheese which considerably reduced the cost/pound of the cheese as the combined shipping was lower.

The packaging was well done and the cheese arrived cool and in good condition. Of course, I live in New England and it is not very ht here. I would be a bit more concerned if I lived in a warmer climate. I am not certain that the packaging would provide adequate cooling for a warmer location.

It has taken me a while to review this item, but better late than never.  My wife enjoys making soup and mentioned how expensive really good French green lentils are.  Decided to take a look and take a chance on this item.  Not only was it a very good price but the lentils were really top quality. They store well, and when we are finished with these my wife (who is very particular on the quality of ingredients she uses) has said she would order these again.

I purchased these at a local health food store, however, these are cheaper through Amazon.  They are wonderful dried fruit, in all the different varieties.  I am especially fond of the pomegranate.  Just enough dried out, just a bit chewy some of the time.

Feeding 2 cats twice a day is made so simple with this bigger can.  I just give each half!  I give them Tiki Cat, which they adore, but I wanted to try this one because of the good deal.  I was hesitant because of the menedione sodium bisulfate listed in the product description, which isn't in any of the pate forms of this brand.  I took a risk and am glad I did...there is no MSB in the case I got and I have to say, it looks just like Tiki!  Only difference is, it cost me 27 cents a serving versus 83 cents.  I ordered more!

My cat loves this stuff, and would order a case but paying over $18 for shipping is ridiculous. Their total price makes this stuff almost twice the 89 cents that this is available for at the corner store. Keep shopping.

If you are buying these as a chocolate flavored treats with a fringe benefit of  contributing to oral health, look elsewhere! If you are primarily interested in using xylitol sweetened candy as a preventative measure to use against cavities and gum disease, you might find these barely satisfactory. The bottom line is that these, allegedly, chocolate flavored lollipops have hardly a hint of flavor AT ALL and if it weren't for the dark brown color that primes the mind to expect a chocolate flavor, I doubt whether one could even discern that that they are supposed to BE chocolate. I may order again but it certainly won't be the chocolate.

Excellent product. Tender, not stringy at all. Perfect for eating just as is.

Great, true ginger flavor. Will purchase again.

It's funny to see that I'm not the only one who thought this smells and tastes like cherry! Everyone I asked to smell it said I was crazy. I suppose it depends on your sense of smell. If you love rooibos, black cherries, almonds, and vanilla, you'll love this tea too. If you've never had rooibos, good luck with getting any idea of what it tastes like before you actually taste it. It's pretty hard to describe, but it's very pleasant. Once again, this is one amazing tea!

Summary: I'm starting to like this tea more after shortening the brewing time.
Text:
Upon opening the canister and taking a whiff, my first thought was, "OMG, they sent a canister of my grandfather's pipe tobacco!" My grandfather died more than 40 years ago and I still recall the smell of his tobacco. A pleasant smell for tobacco, but not for tea!
Getting past the aroma, I brewed a cup per the instructions and ... didn't like it ... at all.
A few days later, I thought I'd try again. Brewed it again, using solidly boiling water and let it steep 6 minutes again, as recommended. Again, failure in the taste bud and aroma department.
Finally, I got up the courage to try it one more time this week. I again used rapidly boiling water but only steeped if for 3 minutes... and I like it!! A shorter steeping time cuts the overwhelming vanilla flavor (and aroma) but keeps the pleasant rooibos flavor and color and allows a hint of almond to hover in the background.

I don't think this will ever be a "favorite" tea of mine but I'm finding it drinkable now. I'd actually rate it a 3.5 stars if that were an option.

It comes with two tins of tea and I'm going to pawn the 2nd tin of it off on my sister ... :-)

I would recommend this product and company to anyone considering buying a Bonsai tree or the like.

Summary: Some of the air-seals of the individual packs were broken from crushed shipping.
Text:
I bought this whole box of 30 individual packs from Amazon.com.
I had no idea, and I did not have to know that it came from some third-party trading company, Nishimoto Trading/SE, Kent, WA98032, then, shipped to Lewisberry, PA, via UPS, then redirected to my home. This was all put on the box.

Inside the usual Amazon brown cardboard box, There was the snack's original white packaging box from Samyang, quite beaten, then, inside, the 2 layers of individual packs of 15 each. While the individual package should be air-sealed for freshness of this fried snack, the bottom half lost its air, and , the sweet smell of the snack, was everywhere.

It looks like the Korean manufacturer overstacked the packaging boxes in their storage location or from shipping to burst the snack's tight air seal. I wish the packaging material is thicker not to collapse and the box size bigger to keep the snacks all air-tight, and not crushed from tight space all the way to US customers.

The snack, itself is still fresh, hah!, from the broken packs, as it is only 5 weeks old from original manufacturing date."w"

Summary: Good Cereal, But Nothing Like Cheerios
Text:
I bought this cereal after reading all the reviews on here about how great it is as a GF version of Cheerios. Cheerios were a staple in my house before I was diagnosed with CD. While Whole O's are good, the similarities between the two stop at shape. When I had my first bowl, it was a strange feeling because my eyes thought I was eating Cheerios, but i was tasting corn flakes. Whole O's are made from corn and rice, while Cheerios are more oat-based. The Whole O's are, in my opinion, exactly like Nature's Path's corn flakes, except a different shape.

Whole O's are pretty high in fiber and low in sugar, taste fine and hold milk well. As a celiac, I definitely recommend them.

Summary: CHILDHOOD MEMORIES (AND THE INTERNET) CAN BE WONDERFUL THINGS
Text:
When I was growing up, penny candy was one of the simple joys of life. Even if you were 5, you didn't need a lot on money to go into the neighborhood penny candy store by yourself and purchase a bag full of sheer decadence! And although I found candy in general to be completely irresistible, ZOTZ were, by far, my favorite.

Talking about childhood memories and the candy we enjoyed with a friend of mine recently prompted me to go looking for this simple sweet treat on the Internet. Having not seen the candy in over 40 years, I was only really expecting to find a brief history/write-up, if that, on the item since I didn't think they were being made any more. Imagine my pure elation when I discovered they were still around (and could be ordered on AMAZON!) I couldn't order them fast enough!

When I finally received my package and popped that first ZOTZ (in decades) into my mouth, it was like being transported back in time. The anticipation and exhilaration of that explosion of fizz and flavor to overtake my mouth when I finally bit into the hard candy shell and released the flavorful fizz inside ... pure rapture! I have to say, while the experience on the whole was certainly wonderful, the 'fizz experience' was somewhat less than I remembered (as a child, it was all I could do to keep my lips together so the fizz didn't escape my mouth), but all-in-all, well-worth the price of admission. Would I do it again? Oh yeh! Would I recommend it to others? For sure! (DISCLAIMER: INDIVIDUAL RESULTS MAY VARY).

I first had Q Club Soda several months ago when I found it at my local "gourmet" grocery store. It had been a while since I had had any club soda, probably years. I had been thirsty all day, and I thought this would quench my thirst. Well that it certainly did - and more; I just cannot believe how good this club soda is each time I take a drink. I am not sure exactly what it is that makes it so good. Maybe it is that pinch of Himalayan salt they put in each bottle, or maybe they fill each bottle with as much carbonation as it can theoretically hold. Whatever the reason, this beverage is good - I mean really good. It has become my beverage of choice all day long (except in the morning when I revert to coffee). This is one smooth club soda. It is so refreshing.

So I got to thinking - other than the pinch of Himalayan salt, I really did not know the first thing about club soda. Therefore, I did a little research. Here is what I found out: Club soda goes by many names. But mainly, it is merely carbonated water, also referred to as sparkling water or seltzer water. However, believe me when I state that Q Club Soda is not just "merely" carbonated water. I have been drinking a lot of club soda over the years, just by different names. All this carbonated water is simply a concoction of carbon dioxide and water. How simple is that. This Q Club Soda is unique because of its maximum carbonation and that wonderful pinch of salt. I am assuming that this Q Club Soda is so good because of the extra fizz and the salt from the region from whence the Yangtze flows. Either way, I certainly would not want my Q Club Soda to be used for stain remover when spills occur on clothes. That would be a waste. I would use my Q Club Soda to relieve an upset stomach, with a touch of bitters.

Therefore, if you try Q Club Soda, I hope you like it.

Summary: It's just one thin little waaafer...so good
Text:
I get a bag of Ghiradelli Squares every year from my admin, for my birthday--it's a tradition. Last year it was caramel. This year, I'm going to leave bags of these around so he gets the hint that I like MINT chocolate, too.

The squares are my favorite little treat. They are just enough to satisfy a sweet tooth and not so much that you feel you've overdone it. And the individual wrapping makes it hard (well, a bit harder) to overindulge. One square seems to work for me. The chocolate is nice and dark, the mint is creamy and minty enough to show up and make you take notice. They remind me of those "After 8" mints that got so popular in the 80's and made a cameo in a Monty Python film, with disastrous results. But as long as you don't mix up all your dinner in a gallon bucket, you should have room for a little one of these for afters. Nice to serve with coffee to guests, by the way.

This is my favorite of the Thai Kitchen soups. The broth has a tangy taste, and since the noodles are not fried they are lower in calories and better for you than the ubiquitous instant ramen noodles. I like to add some frozen veggies and/or precooked meat to the soup to turn it into more of a meal.

But.... Amazon's price is something of a rip-off. I can get these for $.79/packet at a local natural foods store and I'd expect to pay less than that when buying them in bulk. I'm sticking with shopping locally for this item for now.
My family has used this "Krazy salt" on everything: starches, meats, veggies - - even smeared bagels!

Summary: Nothing wrong with ordering 12 boxes of cookies...
Text:
First and foremost, why are strawberry newtons no longer offered at every supermarket? As though someone out there is systematically sabotaging my snacking habits. Thanks to Amazon for not letting the strawberry newton fall victim to what I regretfully refer to as "Hydrox-ing."

As for my order Fig Newtons, Strawberry, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12), I didn't think that my expectations could be exceeded (after all, I was ordering an entire case of my favorite treat.) Thanks to all who were involved in this. You made my day.

Just love the mint hint in this chocolate. It has a wonderful flavor (unlike other mint chocolates I've tried. Additionally, the seller has been wonderful in delivering this as a gift! The tin can be reused if you want to just order the refill bag of chocolate.

I used to buy this from Trader Joe's until they stopped selling it. I have no idea why they did, because this is like crack. We were overjoyed that this product is still available because it's simply the most ridiculously good spice combination we've ever had. It's salt free! It also works tremendously on chicken and fish! This is a must-have!

Summary: out of date on delivery date
Text: There was no expiration date on the box or the jars, so I phoned the distributor, Beaverton Foods.  Based on a short letter-number sequence on a sample jar, which, they said, represents the Julian date of the jar's production, this whole case, which I received yesterday, will reach its early expiration date in 8 days. I do recommend that the manufacturer clearly mark the expiration on these jars.

Since it has become virtually impossible gto purchase these mints at any store around here, I was pleasantly surprised to find that I ewas able to purchase them from Amazon.  Another plus was that I received them within four (4) days!!

In Texas recently I was given a taste-tour of a hot sauce shop by the owner. While most of the sauces were intent of being as hot as possible at the expense of any sort of taste, this was different. While heat is there (and lots of it) it was one of the few that combined it with flavour. The garlic and meat taste to it convinced me to buy a bottle. If you like hot and tasty - go for it!

For several years I have been drinking a cup of chamomile and/or spearmint tea every night before bed because it relaxes me. I also keep a box of Traditional Medicinals regular chamomile tea at work in case I need something to ease my stomach. I came across the chamomile with lavender in an ordinary supermarket the other day and as soon as I brewed a cup & took a sip, I was in love. I want to know, where has this tea been all my life?!

Lavender is known to promote restfulness and is perfect paired with chamomile for a cup of caffeine-free tea at bedtime. Just brewing this tea will ease your stress as it's lavender scent will fill the room. This is aromatherapy in a beverage that tastes delicious.

For years I've been searching for a candy to replace my twerpz cravings and I finally think I found a product that fills the void.  For those unfortunate souls that were never privileged to try twerpz they were a sweet sour and tangy produced by the Hershey company that was very addicting.  This is a similar product with a sugar coating to boot.  At first I was a little worried that the sugar coating would leave me with the post-sour patch kid mouth but pleasantly I haven't found that to be the case.  I highly recommend this delicious candy.
I love these chocolates! They were so delicious. When I got them I immediately put them in the fridge. I love them! I would definitely recommend this to anyone!
Pickled sausages are becoming harder to find. I found this one and decided to give it a shot. Full of flavor and spice. Excellent!

Summary: Ripped apart in less than 2 hours!
Text: This toy should not be called Tuffy at all. My dog tore it apart in two hours. He loves the toy, so I gave it two stars, but I have already restuffed and sewed it back together three times. A great toy to destroy, but who wants to keep paying for toys that last less than a few hours? I do not recommend if your dog is a chewer like mine.

Summary: 5 on the "Tuff scale" and still going strong!
Text:
My 45 pound pup's relationship with stuffed toys (Kong wubba & Hartz tuff stuff) used to be: I give her the toy. she tears open a small hole and meticulously removes most of the stuffing. She'd then bring me the newly limp toy when she gets to the squeaker. I'd remove the squeaker, hand it back so she can finish the job. We'd then play with the toy as rope, or a fairly tough scrap of material until it finally would fall apart completely about a month or so later.

Then... I discovered this Alligator. I doubted that the 5 out of 10 rating would be high enough with her destuffing history, but I didn't want to pay SO much money for the higher numbers if they were just going to be the same deal. Also some of the higher tough rating toys can get a bit heavy. This is the perfect size for my dalmatian-sized dog to flip around, wrestle with and carry around. It's been months- at least 6 now- and my pup has only managed to take a small bit out of Alligator's forehead. I am amazed. I am on Amazon right now to get her another... not because this one is failing, but because she has this toybox sitting here with her old gross toys looking so ratty compared to the Alligator... :)

I do with they would put the "tuff scale" in their description so I wouldn't have to keep flipping back and forth through their site, though.
Company has agreed to send me a replacement.If the product is not an improvement, I will write another review when I try it.

Text: My 5 month old son loves this brand and flavor. I bet this brewed tea would be a good ingredient in recipes (deserts or as a marinade) and as a compliment to any party/social beverage event (wedding punch, tea parties, holiday Wassail). I've tried other 'sweet and spicy' herbal teas but they lack the potency his particular brand has (you can get 2 or 3 cups of hot tea from just one teabag- getting your money's worth and then some). Summary: Use in place of  garlic oil...
Text:
Truffles remind me of garlic with an added dimension of aromatic appeal. In fact, I'm convinced that you can use truffle oil in many recipes that are compatible with garlic oil. While black truffles are highly prized, you may prefer the white truffle oil in a rice recipe.

"Risotto with Red Bell Peppers and Truffle Oil" is a good example of a recipe using truffle oil. I actually created this recipe using the URBANI truffle oil and it is superior in flavor!

The chicken base gives excellent flavor and is less salty than most bouillon cubes which are less flavorful.

1 T. Urbani "white" truffle oil

1 T. salted butter

1 chicken liver, chopped, this is optional

1 T. chopped yellow onion

1 T. chopped fresh parsley

1/4 c. chopped celery stalks

1/4 c. chopped red bell pepper

1/4 tsp. ground black pepper

1 tsp. garlic salt

1 c. uncooked Arborio rice

1 T. chicken base

4 c. boiling water

Heat the oil (some have told me to add it later, but I don't think it makes much of a difference in this recipe) and butter in a 6-quart Dutch oven over medium heat. Fry chicken livers, then add onion, parsley, celery and bell pepper. Cook 5 minutes. Add pepper, garlic salt and rice. Stir until rice absorbs the butter and looks transparent on both ends of the grain. This actually takes 2 minutes. Stir in 1/2 cup of the water with chicken base. Stir until most of the water is absorbed. Continue to add water in 1/2 cup additions for the next 30 minutes. This dish must be continually stirred and is completely done when water is almost completely absorbed and there is a creamy sauce coating the rice. Serve immediately or the creamy sauce will be absorbed into the rice and you will have a drier, but still delicious, dish.

Makes 6 servings.

Recipe Note: This creamy dish is perfect as an accompaniment to Roast Chicken. Red bell pepper has a dramatic effect on any dish it touches, any remaining bell pepper may be chopped and frozen to be used later for decorating a cream soup.
